Declarative 3D Video Renderer Engine
Created with 4 Argon October 14, 2026 at 04:55 PM
Published October 14, 2026 at 09:48 PM
i want a solution to different kind of video format that is made of assets and timeline based animation with timestamped audio text which can be precisely converted to actual audio via a tts matching the video animation as intended. This should be a threejs like we animation synced with tts audio running in html container. The whole point is that we can build interactive videos as well as consistency in world and assets as it progresses through several hours not just few minutes and does not require a 10 trillion param llm. We can think of the render engine as a react component and use react advantages. First start with a react renderer with few few precreated samples to choose to run and rather than audio show transcript as subtitle and if audio is there then render that too. Start by planning a expandable structure with hooks and other creative features to scale the player as well as asset, transformation, timeline interaction

Decoupling video generation from pixel diffusion by treating video as a deterministic 3D scene graph driven by a declarative timeline manifest solves both the multi-hour consistency problem and the compute problem. Instead of asking a massive model to hallucinate 60 frames of pixels per second, a lightweight model (or human author) only emits sparse keyframes, persistent asset IDs, and timestamped dialogue.

Below is the complete expandable architecture followed by a working React + Three.js Renderer featuring custom hooks, synchronized subtitle/audio playback, interactive 3D raycasting, and three pre-built sample scenes.

1. Expandable Architecture & Hook Design
To scale to multi-hour interactive experiences without blowing up React's reconciliation loop, the architecture separates 60 FPS spatial interpolation (handled via mutable refs and Three.js in requestAnimationFrame) from semantic timeline events (subtitles, audio sync, chapters, and UI overlays handled via React state).

Core Hook System
Hook	Responsibility	Scaling Advantage
useTimelineClock	Master timekeeper. Syncs requestAnimationFrame to an HTML5 `<audio>` element if audioUrl exists, or falls back to an internal delta clock for subtitle-only mode.	Prevents audio/visual drift over multi-hour playback; supports variable playback speeds (0.5x–2x) and scrubbing.
useAssetRegistry	Instantiates and caches Three.js meshes, materials, and lights by persistent id.	An asset created at 00:01:00 is the exact same object instance at 03:45:00—zero visual drift and constant memory footprint.
useKeyframeEngine	Evaluates position, rotation, scale, color, and camera tracks at timestamp t using easing curves (linear, easeInOutCubic, step).	Allows sparse JSON data (a few kilobytes per minute) to drive smooth 60/120 FPS 3D animations.
useDialogueSync	Matches currentTime against transcript segments, calculating word-level progress and triggering <audio> or Web Speech TTS fallback.	Enables karaoke-style word highlighting and automatic timeline stretching if TTS audio takes longer than estimated.
useSceneInteraction	Raycasts pointer clicks against active 3D assets and executes timeline actions (seek, pause, mutateState).	Turns passive viewers into active participants who can inspect objects or branch the story mid-playback.
The Declarative Timeline Schema (LLM-Friendly Format)
Rather than frame-by-frame data, a small model outputs a structured manifest where animations can bind either to absolute timestamps or dialogue anchor IDs (so when a TTS engine generates exact audio durations, the keyframes automatically snap to the spoken words):

JSON
{
  "id": "ep_01_orbital",
  "duration": 20,
  "audioUrl": null,
  "world": { "background": "#070913", "fog": ["#070913", 10, 35] },
  "assets": [
    { "id": "core_station", "type": "torusKnot", "color": "#38bdf8", "scale": [1.2, 1.2, 1.2] }
  ],
  "tracks": [
    {
      "targetId": "core_station",
      "property": "rotation",
      "keyframes": [
        { "time": 0, "value": [0, 0, 0], "easing": "linear" },
        { "time": 20, "value": [0, 6.28, 3.14], "easing": "linear" }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dialogue": [
    {
      "id": "line_1",
      "start": 0.5,
      "end": 5.0,
      "speaker": "AI Narrator",
      "text": "Welcome to Sector Seven. This station persists across hours of simulation.",
      "audioUrl": null
    }
  ]
}
2. React + Three.js Timeline Renderer (With 3 Pre-Built Samples)
Install three and lucide-react in any React project (npm install three lucide-react) and drop in this component. It includes:

3 Pre-Created Samples:

Sample 1: Orbital Station Alpha (Camera fly-throughs, orbital physics, and synced technical subtitles).

Sample 2: Interactive Artifact Lab (Click 3D objects during playback to trigger timeline jumps and inspect state).

Sample 3: Multi-Hour World Persistence Demo (Demonstrates dynamic lighting, environment color shifts, and multi-actor choreography sharing the same persistent asset registry).

Dual Audio/Subtitle Engine: Renders synchronized subtitles with word-by-word progress, plays native <audio> when an audioUrl is provided on a track or line, and includes an optional Browser TTS Live Synth toggle so you can hear the timestamped transcript spoken in real time.

TypeScript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {
  Play,
  Pause,
  RotateCcw,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Sparkles,
  Layers,
  MousePointer,
  Clock,
  Subtitles,
  FastForward
} from 'lucide-react';

// ============================================================================
// 1. TYPES & EXPANDABLE SCHEMA DEFINITIONS
// ============================================================================

type EasingType = 'linear' | 'easeInOutQuad' | 'easeOutCubic' | 'step';
type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];

interface AssetDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'box' | 'sphere' | 'torusKnot' | 'cylinder' | 'icosahedron' | 'grid' | 'pointLight';
  color: string;
  wireframe?: boolean;
  emissive?: string;
  initialPosition: Vector3Tuple;
  initialRotation?: Vector3Tuple;
  initialScale?: Vector3Tuple;
  interactive?: {
    hoverLabel: string;
    onClickAction: 'seek' | 'togglePause' | 'highlight';
    targetTime?: number;
    description?: string;
  };
}

interface Keyframe<T = any> {
  time: number;
  value: T;
  easing?: EasingType;
}

interface AnimationTrack {
  targetId: string; // Asset ID, 'camera', or 'world'
  property: 'position' | 'rotation' | 'scale' | 'color' | 'lookAt' | 'background';
  keyframes: Keyframe[];
}

interface DialogueSegment {
  id: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  speaker: string;
  text: string;
  audioUrl?: string | null; // Optional pre-rendered TTS audio file
}

interface SceneManifest {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  duration: number;
  masterAudioUrl?: string | null; // Optional full-track audio
  world: {
    background: string;
    ambientIntensity: number;
  };
  assets: AssetDefinition[];
  tracks: AnimationTrack[];
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[];
}

          { time: 22, value: [-2.5, 2.2, 7.5], easing: 'easeInOutQuad' }
        ]
      }
    ],
    dialogue: [
      {
        id: 'wp_1',
        start: 0.3,
        end: 6.2,
        speaker: 'CHRONICLER',
        text: 'Chapter One, Dawn: The Explorer and Companion approach the Central Monolith as the sun rises over the terrain grid.'
      },
      {
        id: 'wp_2',
        start: 6.8,
        end: 13.8,
        speaker: 'CHRONICLER',
        text: 'Chapter Two, High Noon: Notice how the sky background, lighting, and actor coordinates update via simple declarative tracks.'
      },
      {
        id: 'wp_3',
        start: 14.3,
        end: 21.5,
        speaker: 'CHRONICLER',
        text: 'Chapter Three, Dusk to Night: Even if this story runs for ten hours, the monolith and characters never lose geometric consistency.'
      }
    ]
  }
];

// ============================================================================
// 3. INTERPOLATION ENGINE UTILITIES
// ============================================================================

function applyEasing(t: number, easing: EasingType = 'linear'): number {
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  switch (easing) {
    case 'easeInOutQuad':
      return clamped < 0.5
        ? 2 * clamped * clamped
        : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * clamped + 2, 2) / 2;
    case 'easeOutCubic':
      return 1 - Math.pow(1 - clamped, 3);
    case 'step':
      return clamped < 1 ? 0 : 1;
    case 'linear':
    default:
      return clamped;
  }
}

function evaluateTrackAtTime(keyframes: Keyframe[], time: number, property: string): any {
  if (!keyframes || keyframes.length === 0) return null;
  if (time <= keyframes[0].time) return keyframes[0].value;
  if (time >= keyframes[keyframes.length - 1].time) {
    return keyframes[keyframes.length - 1].value;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < keyframes.length - 1; i++) {
    const startKf = keyframes[i];
    const endKf = keyframes[i + 1];
    if (time >= startKf.time && time <= endKf.time) {
      const span = endKf.time - startKf.time;
      const rawAlpha = span === 0 ? 1 : (time - startKf.time) / span;
      const alpha = applyEasing(rawAlpha, endKf.easing || startKf.easing || 'linear');

      if (property === 'color' || property === 'background') {
        const c1 = new THREE.Color(startKf.value);
        const c2 = new THREE.Color(endKf.value);
        return c1.lerp(c2, alpha);
      }

      if (Array.isArray(startKf.value) && Array.isArray(endKf.value)) {
        return startKf.value.map((v, idx) => v + (endKf.value[idx] - v) * alpha);
      }
    }
  }
  return keyframes[0].value;
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. CUSTOM HOOKS FOR THE TIMELINE PLAYER
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Hook 1: Master Timeline Clock synced with HTML5 <audio> (if present) or rAF delta clock
 */
function useTimelineClock(
  duration: number,
  masterAudioUrl?: string | null,
  playbackRate: number = 1
) {
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const lastFrameTimeRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Setup optional master audio element
  useEffect(() => {
    if (masterAudioUrl) {
      const audio = new Audio(masterAudioUrl);
      audio.preload = 'auto';
      audioRef.current = audio;
      return () => {
        audio.pause();
        audioRef.current = null;
      };
    } else {
      audioRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [masterAudioUrl]);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (newTime: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(duration, newTime));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
      if (audioRef.current) {
        audioRef.current.currentTime = clamped;
      }
    },
    [duration]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    let animationFrameId: number;

    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying) {
        if (audioRef.current && !audioRef.current.paused) {
          // Audio-Locked Mode: Audio element is the single source of truth
          timeRef.current = audioRef.current.currentTime;
        } else {
          // Synthetic Clock Mode: High-precision delta timer
          if (lastFrameTimeRef.current !== null) {
            const deltaSec = ((now - lastFrameTimeRef.current) / 1000) * playbackRate;
            let nextTime = timeRef.current + deltaSec;
            if (nextTime >= duration) {
              nextTime = 0; // Loop smoothly or pause at end
            }
            timeRef.current = nextTime;
          }
        }
        setCurrentTime(timeRef.current);
      }
      lastFrameTimeRef.current = now;
      animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };

    animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
  }, [isPlaying, duration, playbackRate]);

  return {
    isPlaying,
    setIsPlaying,
    currentTime,
    timeRef,
    seek
  };
}

/**
 * Hook 2: Dialogue & Subtitle Sync + Optional Web Speech TTS Engine
 */
function useDialogueSync(
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[],
  currentTime: number,
  isPlaying: boolean,
  ttsEnabled: boolean
) {
  const lastSpokenIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const segmentAudioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);

  const activeSegment = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      dialogue.find((seg) => currentTime >= seg.start && currentTime <= seg.end) ||
      null
    );
  }, [dialogue, currentTime]);

  // Calculate word-level progress for karaoke-style subtitle rendering
  const wordProgressIndex = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeSegment) return -1;
    const words = activeSegment.text.split(' ');
    const progress =
      (currentTime - activeSegment.start) /
      Math.max(0.1, activeSegment.end - activeSegment.start);
    return Math.floor(progress * words.length);
  }, [activeSegment, currentTime]);

  // Trigger segment audio file OR Browser TTS fallback when entering a new segment
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || !activeSegment) {
      if (!isPlaying && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (lastSpokenIdRef.current !== activeSegment.id) {
      lastSpokenIdRef.current = activeSegment.id;

      // Priority 1: Play segment-specific pre-rendered TTS audio file if provided
      if (activeSegment.audioUrl) {
        if (segmentAudioRef.current) {
          segmentAudioRef.current.pause();
        }
        const segAudio = new Audio(activeSegment.audioUrl);
        segmentAudioRef.current = segAudio;
        segAudio.play().catch(() => {});
      }
      // Priority 2: Use Web Speech API Live TTS if enabled by user
      else if (ttsEnabled && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(activeSegment.text);
        utterance.rate = 1.05;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
      }
    }
  }, [activeSegment, isPlaying, ttsEnabled]);

  // Cleanup speech on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  return { activeSegment, wordProgressIndex };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. MAIN DECLARATIVE 3D VIDEO PLAYER COMPONENT
// ============================================================================

export default function DeclarativeThreeVideoPlayer() {
  const [selectedSampleIndex, setSelectedSampleIndex] = useState<number>(0);
  const manifest = SAMPLE_SCENES[selectedSampleIndex];

  const [playbackRate, setPlaybackRate] = useState<number>(1);
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showSubtitles, setShowSubtitles] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [inspectedAsset, setInspectedAsset] = useState<AssetDefinition | null>(null);
  const [hoveredAssetName, setHoveredAssetName] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const sceneRef = useRef<THREE.Scene | null>(null);
  const cameraRef = useRef<THREE.PerspectiveCamera | null>(null);
  const assetMapRef = useRef<Map<string, THREE.Object3D>>(new Map());

  const { isPlaying, setIsPlaying, currentTime, timeRef, seek } = useTimelineClock(
    manifest.duration,
    manifest.masterAudioUrl,
    playbackRate
  );

  const { activeSegment, wordProgressIndex } = useDialogueSync(
    manifest.dialogue,
    currentTime,
    isPlaying,
    ttsEnabled
  );

  // Reset timeline when switching samples
  const handleSelectSample = (index: number) => {
    setSelectedSampleIndex(index);
    setInspectedAsset(null);
    seek(0);
    setIsPlaying(true);
  };

  // Initialize Three.js Scene & Persistent Asset Registry
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const width = container.clientWidth;
    const height = container.clientHeight;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(manifest.world.background);
    sceneRef.current = scene;

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, width / height, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(0, 3.5, 9);
    camera.lookAt(0, 1.5, 0);
    cameraRef.current = camera;

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(width, height);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Ambient lighting
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(
      0xffffff,
      manifest.world.ambientIntensity
    );
    scene.add(ambientLight);

    // Populate Persistent Asset Registry
    const registry = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();
    assetMapRef.current = registry;

    manifest.assets.forEach((asset) => {
      let obj: THREE.Object3D;

      if (asset.type === 'pointLight') {
        const light = new THREE.PointLight(asset.color, 2.5, 30);
        obj = light;
      } else if (asset.type === 'grid') {
        const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(24, 24, asset.color, asset.color);
        obj = grid;
      } else {
        let geometry: THREE.BufferGeometry;
        switch (asset.type) {
          case 'sphere':
            geometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 32);
            break;
          case 'torusKnot':
            geometry = new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(1, 0.3, 100, 16);
            break;
          case 'cylinder':
            geometry = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 32);
            break;
          case 'icosahedron':
            geometry = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0);
            break;
          case 'box':
          default:
            geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
            break;
        }

        const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: asset.color,
          wireframe: Boolean(asset.wireframe),
          emissive: asset.emissive ? new THREE.Color(asset.emissive) : new THREE.Color(0x000000),
          emissiveIntensity: asset.emissive ? 0.45 : 0,
          roughness: 0.3,
          metalness: 0.6
        });

        obj = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      }

      obj.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
      if (asset.initialRotation) {
        obj.rotation.set(...asset.initialRotation);
      }
      if (asset.initialScale) {
        obj.scale.set(...asset.initialScale);
      }

      // Attach metadata for raycasting interactivity
      obj.userData = { assetDefinition: asset };
      scene.add(obj);
      registry.set(asset.id, obj);
    });

    // Raycaster for Interactive 3D Video Clicking & Hovering
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();

    const getIntersectedAsset = (event: MouseEvent): AssetDefinition | null => {
      const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      pointer.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
      pointer.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
      raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);

      const meshes = Array.from(registry.values()).filter(
        (o) => o instanceof THREE.Mesh
      );
      const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(meshes, false);
      if (intersects.length > 0) {
        const hit = intersects[0].object;
        return hit.userData?.assetDefinition || null;
      }
      return null;
    };

    const handlePointerMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const hitAsset = getIntersectedAsset(e);
      if (hitAsset?.interactive) {
        renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'pointer';
        setHoveredAssetName(hitAsset.interactive.hoverLabel);
      } else {
        renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'default';
        setHoveredAssetName(null);
      }
    };

    const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const hitAsset = getIntersectedAsset(e);
      if (!hitAsset?.interactive) return;

      setInspectedAsset(hitAsset);
      const { onClickAction, targetTime } = hitAsset.interactive;
      if (onClickAction === 'seek' && typeof targetTime === 'number') {
        seek(targetTime);
      } else if (onClickAction === 'togglePause') {
        setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
      }
    };

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener('mousemove', handlePointerMove);
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', handleClick);

    // 60FPS Render Loop Evaluating Tracks from timeRef
    let reqId: number;
    const lookAtTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.5, 0);

    const renderLoop = () => {
      const t = timeRef.current;

      // Evaluate all declarative animation tracks at current timestamp t
      manifest.tracks.forEach((track) => {
        const val = evaluateTrackAtTime(track.keyframes, t, track.property);
        if (val === null) return;

        if (track.targetId === 'world' && track.property === 'background') {
          scene.background = val as THREE.Color;
          return;
        }

        if (track.targetId === 'camera') {
          if (track.property === 'position') {
            camera.position.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
          } else if (track.property === 'lookAt') {
            lookAtTarget.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
          }
          return;
        }

        const targetObj = registry.get(track.targetId);
        if (!targetObj) return;

        if (track.property === 'position') {
          targetObj.position.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
        } else if (track.property === 'rotation') {
          targetObj.rotation.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
        } else if (track.property === 'scale') {
          targetObj.scale.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
        } else if (
          track.property === 'color' &&
          targetObj instanceof THREE.Mesh &&
          targetObj.material instanceof THREE.MeshStandardMaterial
        ) {
          targetObj.material.color.copy(val as THREE.Color);
        }
      });

      camera.lookAt(lookAtTarget);
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      reqId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    reqId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(reqId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      renderer.domElement.removeEventListener('mousemove', handlePointerMove);
      renderer.domElement.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [manifest, seek, setIsPlaying, timeRef]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-6 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-5">
        {/* Header & Sample Switcher */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              Declarative 3D Video Engine (React + Three.js)
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mt-1">{manifest.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{manifest.subtitle}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {SAMPLE_SCENES.map((sample, idx) => (
              <button
                key={sample.id}
                onClick={() => handleSelectSample(idx)}
                className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
                  selectedSampleIndex === idx
                    ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Sample {idx + 1}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Viewport & Registry Inspector Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5">
          {/* HTML + Three.js Video Container (3 Cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-3 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[440px] bg-black">
              {/* Three.js Canvas Mount */}
              <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Top-Left Live Telemetry Badge */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300 pointer-events-none">
                <span
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                    isPlaying ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-400'
                  }`}
                />
                <span>
                  T+{currentTime.toFixed(2)}s / {manifest.duration.toFixed(1)}s
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-sky-400">
                  {manifest.assets.length} Persistent Assets
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Interactive Raycast Hover Tooltip */}
              {hoveredAssetName && (
                <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500/90 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs shadow-lg pointer-events-none">
                  <MousePointer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {hoveredAssetName}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Inspected 3D Asset Overlay Card */}
              {inspectedAsset && (
                <div className="absolute top-14 left-3 max-w-xs bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-sky-500/40 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sky-400 font-semibold">
                    <span>Asset Inspected: {inspectedAsset.name}</span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setInspectedAsset(null)}
                      className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white ml-2"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-slate-300">
                    {inspectedAsset.interactive?.description}
                  </p>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                    ID: {inspectedAsset.id} ({inspectedAsset.type})
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Synchronized Subtitle / Transcript Overlay */}
              {showSubtitles && activeSegment && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-5 inset-x-6 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-2xl bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800/90 px-5 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl text-center">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-sky-400 mb-1">
                      {activeSegment.speaker}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm md:text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-200">
                      {activeSegment.text.split(' ').map((word, idx) => (
                        <span
                          key={idx}
                          className={`inline-block mr-1.5 transition-colors duration-100 ${
                            idx <= wordProgressIndex
                              ? 'text-white font-medium'
                              : 'text-slate-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {word}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Timeline Scrubber & Transport Controls */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              {/* Interactive Scrubber with Dialogue Segment Markers */}
              <div className="relative flex items-center">
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min={0}
                  max={manifest.duration}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={currentTime}
                  onChange={(e) => seek(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition"
                  >
                    {isPlaying ? (
                      <>
                        <Pause className="w-4 h-4" /> Pause
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Play className="w-4 h-4" /> Play
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => seek(0)}
                    className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition"
                    title="Restart Timeline"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() =>
                      setPlaybackRate((r) => (r === 1 ? 1.5 : r === 1.5 ? 0.5 : 1))
                    }
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono transition"
                    title="Playback Speed"
                  >
                    <FastForward className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                    {playbackRate}x
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowSubtitles(!showSubtitles)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      showSubtitles
                        ? 'bg-slate-800 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800/50 text-slate-500'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Subtitles className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Subtitles
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setTtsEnabled(!ttsEnabled)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      ttsEnabled
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                    }`}
                    title="Synthesize speech from transcript using Browser TTS"
                  >
                    {ttsEnabled ? (
                      <>
                        <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" /> Live TTS On
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4" /> TTS Muted
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Panel: Persistent Asset Registry & Interactive Transcript */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {/* Persistent World Asset Registry */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2.5">
                <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
                Persistent Asset Registry
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {manifest.assets.map((asset) => (
                  <div
                    key={asset.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (asset.interactive) {
                        setInspectedAsset(asset);
                        if (
                          asset.interactive.onClickAction === 'seek' &&
                          typeof asset.interactive.targetTime === 'number'
                        ) {
                          seek(asset.interactive.targetTime);
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    className={`flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg text-xs border transition ${
                      asset.interactive
                        ? 'bg-slate-800/90 border-slate-700 hover:border-sky-500/50 cursor-pointer'
                        : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800/80 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                      <span
                        className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full shrink-0"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: asset.color }}
                      />
                      <span className="truncate font-medium">{asset.name}</span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 uppercase">
                      {asset.type}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Timestamped Dialogue Cues (Click any line to seek) */}
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2.5">
                <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
                Timestamped Transcript
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {manifest.dialogue.map((seg) => {
                  const isActive = activeSegment?.id === seg.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={seg.id}
                      onClick={() => seek(seg.start)}
                      className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition border ${
                        isActive
                          ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/50 text-white'
                          : 'bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400 mb-1">
                        <span>{seg.speaker}</span>
                        <span>
                          {seg.start.toFixed(1)}s – {seg.end.toFixed(1)}s
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="leading-snug">{seg.text}</p>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
3. Scaling to Multi-Hour Worlds & Precision TTS Sync
To scale this player from short scenes to multi-hour interactive worlds generated by compact models, layer in these three extensions:

A. TTS-Driven Time-Warping (Zero Audio/Animation Desync)
When an LLM writes a scene, it doesn't know whether a TTS engine will take 4.2s or 5.1s to speak a sentence. Instead of hardcoding seconds on keyframes, bind keyframes to Dialogue Cue Anchors:

Authoring Phase: The LLM outputs symbolic time anchors like "time": "@d2.start + 0.5" or "time": "@d2.word(4)".

TTS Compilation Step: Your TTS service (e.g., ElevenLabs, Kokoro, or Azure Speech with word-boundary events) synthesizes d2.text and returns exact audio duration (5.32s) plus word timestamps.

Hydration Hook (useResolvedTimeline): Before playback starts, a lightweight preprocessor resolves @d2.start to exact seconds and shifts subsequent keyframes automatically—guaranteeing that an actor's gesture or camera zoom lands on the exact spoken word.

B. Chunked Episode Streaming (useEpisodeStreamer)
A 3-hour video in this format is only ~2–5 MB of JSON, but audio buffers and custom GLTF meshes should stream in segments:

Global WorldState Context: Keep assetMapRef alive across chapter boundaries. When transitioning from chapter_01.json to chapter_02.json, any asset ID already present in assetMapRef retains its last transform state (position, rotation, damageState) unless explicitly overridden.

Delta Snapshots for Instant Scrubbing: Every 5 minutes of timeline time, store a lightweight state snapshot (CheckpointSnapshot) of all asset transforms so scrubbing from 00:02:00 to 02:45:00 resolves in O(1) time without replaying two hours of deltas.

C. Hierarchical Bone & Morph-Target Tracks
As you move from geometric primitives to GLTF characters (useGLTF from @react-three/drei), extend AnimationTrack.property to support:

Skeletal Animation Blending: { property: "animationClip", keyframes: [{ time: 0, value: "Idle" }, { time: 4.2, value: "PointAtReactor", crossFade: 0.4 }] }.

Viseme / Lip-Sync Tracks: Map TTS phoneme timestamps (viseme_AA, viseme_OH) directly to mesh morph targets on the speaking character's head mesh inside the renderLoop.

Where should we take the engine next?

Build the TTS-to-Timeline compiler pipeline

Add GLTF character animations and lip-sync

Design the small-LLM prompt & JSON generator
Extend the React renderer to support loading GLTF 3D models with skeletal animation blending and TTS viseme lip-sync.

Adding GLTF character models, scrub-safe skeletal animation blending, and TTS viseme lip-sync requires solving a classic game-engine problem: THREE.AnimationMixer is normally stateful (delta-driven), whereas a video timeline must be deterministic at any arbitrary timestamp 
t
t so the user can scrub backward or jump chapters without breaking character poses.

1. Architectural Upgrades for Skeletal & Viseme Tracks
Extended Hook & Subsystem Architecture
Subsystem / Hook	How It Works	Why It Scales for Multi-Hour Worlds
useGLTFRegistry	Wraps GLTFLoader with an in-memory cloneable cache and a procedural THREE.SkinnedMesh + morphTarget fallback rig.	Loads a character .glb once; reuses the cached skeleton and geometry across hours of episodes.
Scrub-Safe evaluateSkeletalClip	Evaluates animationClip keyframes at timestamp t. During a crossfade window, it enables both the outgoing and incoming AnimationActions, sets their exact local clip times, assigns normalized blend weights (α and 1−α), and calls mixer.update(0).	Seeking from 00:01:00 to 02:30:00 resolves the exact blended skeletal pose in a single frame with zero state drift.
compileTextToVisemes	Converts timestamped dialogue text (or explicit phoneme JSON from Azure/ElevenLabs/Rhubarb) into a dense stream of 14 standard Oculus/ARKit viseme cues (viseme_aa, viseme_O, viseme_PP, etc.).	Works immediately from plain text subtitles and upgrades seamlessly when word/phoneme timestamps arrive from a TTS API.
Morph & Bone Lip-Sync Driver	Applies smoothed viseme weights to mesh.morphTargetInfluences (via morphTargetDictionary) and drives a secondary jaw/lip bone transform.	Supports both ReadyPlayerMe/ARKit blendshape heads and simpler rigged models without facial morph targets.
Extended Manifest Schema (animationClip & visemes)
Characters now accept a gltfUrl (or built-in rig preset), an animationClip track with crossFade durations, and either auto-compiled or explicit visemeCues:

2. React + Three.js Renderer with GLTF, Skeletal Blending & Viseme Lip-Sync
Install three and lucide-react (npm install three lucide-react).

External .glb + Instant Rig Fallback: Each character asset supports an optional gltfUrl (loaded via GLTFLoader). So you can test immediately without hosting external .glb files, the renderer also builds a complete THREE.SkinnedMesh humanoid rig with a 9-bone THREE.Skeleton, 5 procedural THREE.AnimationClips, and 15 morphTargetInfluences blendshapes.

Live Viseme & Blend-Weight Telemetry: The right-hand inspector shows real-time skeletal clip crossfade percentages (Idle: 28% / Explain: 72%) and live bar meters for all active facial visemes.

TypeScript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
import {
  Play,
  Pause,
  RotateCcw,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Sparkles,
  Activity,
  UserCheck,
  Clock,
  Subtitles,
  FastForward,
  Sliders
} from 'lucide-react';

// ============================================================================
// 1. SCHEMA & TYPES (GLTF, SKELETAL CLIPS & VISEMES)
// ============================================================================

type EasingType = 'linear' | 'easeInOutQuad' | 'easeOutCubic';
type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];

export type VisemeName =
  | 'viseme_sil'
  | 'viseme_PP' // p, b, m
  | 'viseme_FF' // f, v
  | 'viseme_TH' // th
  | 'viseme_DD' // t, d, n
  | 'viseme_kk' // k, g
  | 'viseme_CH' // ch, j, sh
  | 'viseme_SS' // s, z
  | 'viseme_RR' // r, l
  | 'viseme_aa' // a (ah)
  | 'viseme_E'  // e (eh)
  | 'viseme_I'  // i (ee)
  | 'viseme_O'  // o (oh)
  | 'viseme_U'; // u (oo)

const ALL_VISEMES: VisemeName[] = [
  'viseme_sil',
  'viseme_PP',
  'viseme_FF',
  'viseme_TH',
  'viseme_DD',
  'viseme_kk',
  'viseme_CH',
  'viseme_SS',
  'viseme_RR',
  'viseme_aa',
  'viseme_E',
  'viseme_I',
  'viseme_O',
  'viseme_U'
];

type ClipName = 'Idle' | 'Wave' | 'Explain' | 'PointRight' | 'Inspect';

interface AssetDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'gltfCharacter' | 'torusKnot' | 'box' | 'sphere' | 'grid' | 'pointLight';
  gltfUrl?: string | null; // Optional URL to external .glb/.gltf (falls back to built-in SkinnedMesh rig)
  color: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  initialPosition: Vector3Tuple;
  initialRotation?: Vector3Tuple;
  initialScale?: Vector3Tuple;
  interactive?: {
    hoverLabel: string;
    onClickAction: 'seek' | 'triggerClip';
    targetTime?: number;
    description: string;
  };
}

interface Keyframe<T = any> {
  time: number;
  value: T;
  easing?: EasingType;
  crossFade?: number; // Seconds to crossfade when property === 'animationClip'
}

interface AnimationTrack {
  targetId: string;
  property: 'position' | 'rotation' | 'scale' | 'animationClip' | 'lookAt';
  keyframes: Keyframe[];
}

interface VisemeCue {
  time: number;
  duration: number;
  viseme: VisemeName;
  weight: number;
}

interface DialogueSegment {
  id: string;
  speakerId: string; // Matches a gltfCharacter Asset ID for targeted lip-sync
  speaker: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  text: string;
  audioUrl?: string | null;
  visemeCues?: VisemeCue[]; // Optional explicit TTS phoneme timestamps
}

interface SceneManifest {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  duration: number;
  world: { background: string };
  assets: AssetDefinition[];
  tracks: AnimationTrack[];
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[];
}

// Runtime container stored per instantiated character
interface CharacterRigInstance {
  id: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  morphMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
  jawBone?: THREE.Bone;
  mouthWidthBone?: THREE.Bone;
}

// ============================================================================
// 2. GRAPHEME-TO-VISEME COMPILER (AUTO LIP-SYNC FROM TEXT OR TTS CUES)
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Converts a dialogue segment's text + start/end window into timed Oculus/ARKit viseme cues.
 * If explicit TTS viseme cues exist (e.g., from ElevenLabs/Azure/Polly), those are used directly.
 */
function compileDialogueVisemes(segment: DialogueSegment): VisemeCue[] {
  if (segment.visemeCues && segment.visemeCues.length > 0) {
    return segment.visemeCues;
  }

  const cleanText = segment.text.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/g, '');
  const words = cleanText.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0) return [];

  const totalDuration = Math.max(0.2, segment.end - segment.start);
  const totalChars = words.reduce((acc, w) => acc + w.length + 1, 0);
  const secPerChar = totalDuration / Math.max(1, totalChars);

  const cues: VisemeCue[] = [];
  let cursor = segment.start;

  const charToViseme = (ch: string, nextCh: string): VisemeName => {
    const pair = (ch + nextCh).toLowerCase();
    if (pair === 'th') return 'viseme_TH';
    if (pair === 'sh' || pair === 'ch') return 'viseme_CH';
    if (pair === 'oo' || pair === 'ou') return 'viseme_U';
    if (pair === 'ee' || pair === 'ea') return 'viseme_I';

    switch (ch.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'a':
        return 'viseme_aa';
      case 'e':
        return 'viseme_E';
      case 'i':
      case 'y':
        return 'viseme_I';
      case 'o':
        return 'viseme_O';
      case 'u':
      case 'w':
        return 'viseme_U';
      case 'p':
      case 'b':
      case 'm':
        return 'viseme_PP';
      case 'f':
      case 'v':
        return 'viseme_FF';
      case 't':
      case 'd':
      case 'n':
        return 'viseme_DD';
      case 'k':
      case 'g':
      case 'c':
      case 'q':
        return 'viseme_kk';
      case 's':
      case 'z':
      case 'x':
        return 'viseme_SS';
      case 'j':
        return 'viseme_CH';
      case 'r':
      case 'l':
        return 'viseme_RR';
      default:
        return 'viseme_sil';
    }
  };

  words.forEach((word) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < word.length; i++) {
      const ch = word[i];
      const nextCh = word[i + 1] || '';
      const viseme = charToViseme(ch, nextCh);
      const isVowel = ['viseme_aa', 'viseme_E', 'viseme_I', 'viseme_O', 'viseme_U'].includes(
        viseme
      );
      const charDur = secPerChar * (isVowel ? 1.25 : 0.85);

      cues.push({
        time: cursor,
        duration: charDur,
        viseme,
        weight: isVowel ? 0.95 : 0.75
      });
      cursor += secPerChar;
    }
    // Brief micro-closure between words
    cues.push({
      time: cursor,
      duration: secPerChar * 0.9,
      viseme: 'viseme_sil',
      weight: 0.1
    });
    cursor += secPerChar;
  });

  return cues;
}

/**
 * Evaluates smooth viseme weights [0..1] for a given speaker at timestamp t
 */
function evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
  speakerId: string,
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[],
  compiledMap: Map<string, VisemeCue[]>,
  t: number
): Record<VisemeName, number> {
  const weights: Record<VisemeName, number> = {
    viseme_sil: 0,
    viseme_PP: 0,
    viseme_FF: 0,
    viseme_TH: 0,
    viseme_DD: 0,
    viseme_kk: 0,
    viseme_CH: 0,
    viseme_SS: 0,
    viseme_RR: 0,
    viseme_aa: 0,
    viseme_E: 0,
    viseme_I: 0,
    viseme_O: 0,
    viseme_U: 0
  };

  const activeSeg = dialogue.find(
    (d) => d.speakerId === speakerId && t >= d.start && t <= d.end
  );
  if (!activeSeg) {
    weights.viseme_sil = 1;
    return weights;
  }

  const cues = compiledMap.get(activeSeg.id) || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cues.length; i++) {
    const cue = cues[i];
    const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
    const halfWidth = Math.max(0.04, cue.duration * 0.85);
    const dist = Math.abs(t - center);

    if (dist < halfWidth) {
      // Smooth cosine bell envelope for natural mouth co-articulation
      const influence = Math.cos((dist / halfWidth) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight;
      weights[cue.viseme] = Math.min(1, Math.max(weights[cue.viseme], influence));
    }
  }

  return weights;
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. PROCEDURAL SKINNED + MORPH-TARGET RIG & SKELETAL CLIPS
// (Provides an instant GLTF-compatible character + supports external GLB URLs)
// ============================================================================

function createProceduralSkinnedCharacter(
  asset: AssetDefinition
): CharacterRigInstance {
  const root = new THREE.Group();

  // 1. Build Bone Hierarchy (Hips -> Spine -> Neck -> Head -> Jaw + Left/Right Arms)
  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.0, 0);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.45, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.75, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  const jawBone = new THREE.Bone();
  jawBone.name = 'Jaw';
  jawBone.position.set(0, -0.14, 0.32);
  headBone.add(jawBone);

  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.62, 0.45, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const forearmLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmLBone.name = 'ForearmL';
  forearmLBone.position.set(-0.48, -0.42, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(forearmLBone);

  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.62, 0.45, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const forearmRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmRBone.name = 'ForearmR';
  forearmRBone.position.set(0.48, -0.42, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(forearmRBone);

  root.add(hipsBone);

  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.color,
    roughness: 0.3,
    metalness: 0.5
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.4,
    metalness: 0.7
  });
  const visorMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.accentColor || '#38bdf8',
    emissive: asset.accentColor || '#0284c7',
    emissiveIntensity: 0.7
  });

  // Attach articulated visual meshes to bones
  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.95, 1.05, 0.5), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.12, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  const pelvisMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.45, 0.9, 16), darkMat);
  pelvisMesh.position.set(0, -0.45, 0);
  hipsBone.add(pelvisMesh);

  // Arms
  const upperArmGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.42, 8, 16);
  const armL = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armL.position.set(-0.24, -0.2, 0);
  armL.rotation.z = -0.5;
  shoulderLBone.add(armL);

  const handL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.4, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handL.position.set(0, -0.22, 0.1);
  forearmLBone.add(handL);

  const armR = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armR.position.set(0.24, -0.2, 0);
  armR.rotation.z = 0.5;
  shoulderRBone.add(armR);

  const handR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.4, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handR.position.set(0, -0.22, 0.1);
  forearmRBone.add(handR);

  // Head & Eyes
  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.68, 0.64, 0.64), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const visorMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.56, 0.16, 0.08), visorMat);
  visorMesh.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.31);
  headBone.add(visorMesh);

  // 2. Build Morph-Target Expressive Mouth Mesh (with full morphTargetDictionary for all 14 visemes)
  const baseMouthGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.08, 0.1, 8, 4, 2);
  const basePos = baseMouthGeo.attributes.position;
  const morphPositions: THREE.BufferAttribute[] = [];
  const morphDict: Record<string, number> = {};

  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName, idx) => {
    morphDict[vName] = idx;
    const cloned = basePos.clone();

    for (let i = 0; i < cloned.count; i++) {
      let x = cloned.getX(i);
      let y = cloned.getY(i);
      let z = cloned.getZ(i);

      switch (vName) {
        case 'viseme_aa': // Wide open jaw
          y *= 3.8;
          x *= 1.15;
          break;
        case 'viseme_O': // Rounded O
          y *= 3.2;
          x *= 0.62;
          z += 0.04;
          break;
        case 'viseme_U': // Tighter puckered U
          y *= 2.1;
          x *= 0.45;
          z += 0.06;
          break;
        case 'viseme_E':
        case 'viseme_I': // Wide grin / stretched corners
          y *= 2.1;
          x *= 1.38;
          break;
        case 'viseme_PP': // Pressed lips
          y *= 0.25;
          x *= 0.9;
          break;
        case 'viseme_FF': // Lower lip tucked
          y *= 1.4;
          x *= 1.05;
          break;
        default:
          y *= 1.8;
          break;
      }
      cloned.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    morphPositions.push(cloned);
  });

  baseMouthGeo.morphAttributes.position = morphPositions;

  const mouthMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#38bdf8',
    emissive: asset.accentColor || '#38bdf8',
    emissiveIntensity: 0.95
  });

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(baseMouthGeo, mouthMat);
  mouthMesh.name = 'VisemeMouthMesh';
  mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary = morphDict;
  mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences = new Array(ALL_VISEMES.length).fill(0);
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.14, 0.31);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  // Lower jaw chin indicator attached to JawBone
  const chinMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.38, 0.07, 0.14), darkMat);
  chinMesh.position.set(0, -0.08, -0.02);
  jawBone.add(chinMesh);

  // 3. Author 5 Built-in THREE.AnimationClips (Idle, Wave, Explain, PointRight, Inspect)
  const createClip = (name: ClipName): THREE.AnimationClip => {
    const times = [0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4];

    if (name === 'Wave') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('Wave', 2.4, [
        new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
          'Hips.position',
          times,
          [0, 1.0, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.0, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.0, 0]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderR.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.2)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.6)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 1.9)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.6)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.2)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ForearmR.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, -0.5)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0.5)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, -0.5)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0.4)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'Head.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0.1, 0.08)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.1, -0.08)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0.1, 0.08)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.1, -0.08)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0.1, 0.08)).toArray()
          ]
        )
      ]);
    }

    if (name === 'Explain') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('Explain', 2.4, [
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'Spine.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.05, -0.15, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.08, 0.18, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.03, -0.12, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.08, 0.15, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.05, -0.15, 0)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderL.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.7, 0.2, -0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.1, -0.3, -0.8)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.6, 0.1, -0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.0, -0.2, -0.7)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.7, 0.2, -0.4)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderR.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.6)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.5, 0.2, 0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.1, -0.3, 0.8)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.6, 0.1, 0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.6)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'Head.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.05, 0.15, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.08, -0.15, 0.05)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.06, 0.12, -0.05)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.05, -0.1, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.05, 0.15, 0)).toArray()
          ]
        )
      ]);
    }

    if (name === 'PointRight') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('PointRight', 2.4, [
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'Spine.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.35, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.42, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.35, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.42, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.35, 0)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderR.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.35, -0.4, 1.1)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.45, -0.45, 1.2)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.35, -0.4, 1.1)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.45, -0.45, 1.2)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.35, -0.4, 1.1)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'Head.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.45, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.06, -0.5, 0)).toArray(),

            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, -0.45, 0)).toArray()
          ]
        )
      ]);
    }

    if (name === 'Inspect') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('Inspect', 2.4, [
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'Spine.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.28, 0.2, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.32, -0.2, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.28, 0.2, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.32, -0.2, 0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.28, 0.2, 0)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderL.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.2, 0.4, -0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.3, 0.5, -0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.2, 0.4, -0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.3, 0.5, -0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.2, 0.4, -0.4)).toArray()
          ]
        )

    }

    // Default: Idle breathing clip
    return new THREE.AnimationClip('Idle', 2.4, [
      new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
        'Hips.position',
        times,
        [0, 1.0, 0, 0, 1.03, 0, 0, 1.0, 0, 0, 1.03, 0, 0, 1.0, 0]
      ),
      new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
        'Spine.quaternion',
        times,
        [
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.03, 0.04, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0.03, -0.04, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray()
        ]
      ),
      new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
        'ShoulderL.quaternion',
        times,
        [
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, -0.06)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, -0.06)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray()
        ]
      ),
      new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
        'ShoulderR.quaternion',
        times,
        [
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0.06)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0.06)).toArray(),
          ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 0)).toArray()
        ]
      )
    ]);
  };

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  (['Idle', 'Wave', 'Explain', 'PointRight', 'Inspect'] as ClipName[]).forEach(
    (clipName) => {
      const clip = createClip(clipName);
      const action = mixer.clipAction(clip);
      action.play();
      action.setEffectiveWeight(clipName === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
      actions.set(clipName, action);
    }
  );

  // If an external GLTF URL is provided, asynchronously load and swap in its meshes/clips
  if (asset.gltfUrl) {
    const loader = new GLTFLoader();
    loader.load(
      asset.gltfUrl,
      (gltf) => {
        root.clear();
        root.add(gltf.scene);
        const loadedMorphs: THREE.Mesh[] = [];
        gltf.scene.traverse((child) => {
          if (
            child instanceof THREE.Mesh &&
            child.morphTargetDictionary &&
            child.morphTargetInfluences
          ) {
            loadedMorphs.push(child);
          }
        });
        gltf.animations.forEach((clip) => {
          const action = mixer.clipAction(clip);
          action.play();
          action.setEffectiveWeight(0);
          actions.set(clip.name, action);
        });
      },
      undefined,
      () => {
        // Keep procedural rig if external URL is offline/blocked
      }
    );
  }

  return {
    id: asset.id,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    jawBone
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. DETERMINISTIC SKELETAL CROSSFADE & SPATIAL TRACK EVALUATOR
// ============================================================================

interface SkeletalBlendState {
  primaryClip: string;
  primaryWeight: number;
  secondaryClip: string | null;
  secondaryWeight: number;
}

/**
 * Evaluates a character's animationClip track at exact timestamp t.
 * Computes exact crossfade weights and sets deterministic local clip times on the THREE.AnimationMixer.
 */
function evaluateSkeletalTrackAtTime(
  rig: CharacterRigInstance,
  keyframes: Keyframe[],
  t: number
): SkeletalBlendState {
  if (!keyframes || keyframes.length === 0) {
    return { primaryClip: 'Idle', primaryWeight: 1, secondaryClip: null, secondaryWeight: 0 };
  }

  // Find active keyframe at time t
  let activeIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < keyframes.length; i++) {
    if (t >= keyframes[i].time) {
      activeIdx = i;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }

  const currentKf = keyframes[activeIdx];
  const prevKf = activeIdx > 0 ? keyframes[activeIdx - 1] : null;
  const crossFadeDur = currentKf.crossFade ?? 0.45;
  const timeSinceSwitch = t - currentKf.time;

  let primaryClip = String(currentKf.value);
  let primaryWeight = 1;
  let secondaryClip: string | null = null;
  let secondaryWeight = 0;

  if (prevKf && crossFadeDur > 0 && timeSinceSwitch >= 0 && timeSinceSwitch < crossFadeDur) {
    const alpha = timeSinceSwitch / crossFadeDur;
    // Smoothstep crossfade curve
    const smoothAlpha = alpha * alpha * (3 - 2 * alpha);
    primaryWeight = smoothAlpha;
    secondaryClip = String(prevKf.value);
    secondaryWeight = 1 - smoothAlpha;
  }

  // Zero out all actions first, then apply exact weights and deterministic local clip times
  rig.actions.forEach((action, clipName) => {
    const clipDur = action.getClip().duration || 1;
    if (clipName === primaryClip) {
      action.enabled = true;
      action.setEffectiveWeight(primaryWeight);
      action.time = Math.max(0, t - currentKf.time) % clipDur;
    } else if (secondaryClip && clipName === secondaryClip && prevKf) {
      action.enabled = true;
      action.setEffectiveWeight(secondaryWeight);
      action.time = Math.max(0, t - prevKf.time) % clipDur;
    } else {
      action.setEffectiveWeight(0);
    }
  });

  // Evaluate pose at delta = 0 so scrubbing is 100% deterministic
  rig.mixer.update(0);

  return { primaryClip, primaryWeight, secondaryClip, secondaryWeight };
}

function evaluateSpatialTrack(keyframes: Keyframe[], t: number): number[] {
  if (t <= keyframes[0].time) return keyframes[0].value;
  if (t >= keyframes[keyframes.length - 1].time) return keyframes[keyframes.length - 1].value;

  for (let i = 0; i < keyframes.length - 1; i++) {
    const k0 = keyframes[i];
    const k1 = keyframes[i + 1];
    if (t >= k0.time && t <= k1.time) {
      const span = Math.max(0.0001, k1.time - k0.time);
      const raw = (t - k0.time) / span;
      const alpha = raw < 0.5 ? 2 * raw * raw : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * raw + 2, 2) / 2;
      return k0.value.map((v: number, idx: number) => v + (k1.value[idx] - v) * alpha);
    }
  }
  return keyframes[0].value;
}
