// ============================================================================
// 6. MAIN REACT COMPONENT
// ============================================================================

export default function GLTFSkeletalVisemePlayer() {
  const [sampleIdx, setSampleIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const manifest = SAMPLE_SCENES[sampleIdx];

  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [playbackRate, setPlaybackRate] = useState<number>(1);
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showSubtitles, setShowSubtitles] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [inspectedSpeakerId, setInspectedSpeakerId] = useState<string>('actor_aria');

  // Live telemetry state for UI display
  const [liveVisemes, setLiveVisemes] = useState<Record<VisemeName, number>>(() => {
    const init: any = {};
    ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (init[v] = 0));
    return init;
  });
  const [liveBlendState, setLiveBlendState] = useState<SkeletalBlendState>({
    primaryClip: 'Idle',
    primaryWeight: 1,
    secondaryClip: null,
    secondaryWeight: 0
  });

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastSpokenSegRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Pre-compile viseme envelopes for all dialogue lines in the active manifest
  const compiledVisemeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, VisemeCue[]>();
    manifest.dialogue.forEach((seg) => {
      map.set(seg.id, compileDialogueVisemes(seg));
    });
    return map;
  }, [manifest]);

  const activeSegment = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      manifest.dialogue.find(
        (seg) => currentTime >= seg.start && currentTime <= seg.end
      ) || null
    );
  }, [manifest.dialogue, currentTime]);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(manifest.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
    },
    [manifest.duration]
  );

  // Optional Browser Web Speech TTS Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || !activeSegment) {
      if (!isPlaying && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (lastSpokenSegRef.current !== activeSegment.id) {
      lastSpokenSegRef.current = activeSegment.id;
      if (ttsEnabled && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(activeSegment.text);
        utter.rate = 1.05;
        utter.pitch = activeSegment.speakerId.includes('zephyr') ? 0.85 : 1.15;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
      }
    }
  }, [activeSegment, isPlaying, ttsEnabled]);

  // Master Clock Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const updateClock = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const delta = ((now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000) * playbackRate;
        let next = timeRef.current + delta;
        if (next >= manifest.duration) next = 0;
        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(updateClock);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(updateClock);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying, playbackRate, manifest.duration]);

  // Three.js Scene Setup, Character Rigs, Skeletal Evaluation & Viseme Morph Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(manifest.world.background);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      48,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );
    camera.position.set(0, 1.8, 4.2);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.85));

    const objectMap = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();
    const characterRigs = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>();

    manifest.assets.forEach((asset) => {
      if (asset.type === 'gltfCharacter') {
        const rig = createProceduralSkinnedCharacter(asset);
        rig.root.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialRotation) rig.root.rotation.set(...asset.initialRotation);
        if (asset.initialScale) rig.root.scale.set(...asset.initialScale);
        rig.root.userData = { asset };
        scene.add(rig.root);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, rig.root);
        characterRigs.set(asset.id, rig);
      } else if (asset.type === 'pointLight') {
        const light = new THREE.PointLight(asset.color, 2.5, 25);
        light.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(light);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, light);
      } else if (asset.type === 'grid') {
        const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, asset.color, asset.color);
        grid.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(grid);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, grid);
      } else {
        const geo =
          asset.type === 'torusKnot'
            ? new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.6, 0.18, 96, 16)
            : new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: asset.color,
          roughness: 0.25,
          metalness: 0.7
        });
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
        mesh.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialScale) mesh.scale.set(...asset.initialScale);
        mesh.userData = { asset };
        scene.add(mesh);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, mesh);
      }
    });

    const lookAtVec = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.5, 0);
    let renderId: number;
    let frameCounter = 0;

    const renderTick = () => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      frameCounter++;

      // 1. Evaluate Spatial & Skeletal Animation Tracks
      manifest.tracks.forEach((track) => {
        if (track.property === 'animationClip') {
          const rig = characterRigs.get(track.targetId);
          if (rig) {
            const blendInfo = evaluateSkeletalTrackAtTime(rig, track.keyframes, t);
            if (track.targetId === inspectedSpeakerId && frameCounter % 3 === 0) {
              setLiveBlendState(blendInfo);
            }
          }
          return;
        }

        const val = evaluateSpatialTrack(track.keyframes, t);
        if (track.targetId === 'camera') {
          if (track.property === 'position') camera.position.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
          if (track.property === 'lookAt') lookAtVec.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
          return;
        }

        const obj = objectMap.get(track.targetId);
        if (!obj) return;
        if (track.property === 'position') obj.position.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
        if (track.property === 'rotation') obj.rotation.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
        if (track.property === 'scale') obj.scale.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
      });

      // 2. Evaluate & Apply Viseme Lip-Sync Morphs + Jaw Bone per Character Rig
      characterRigs.forEach((rig, charId) => {
        const visemeWeights = evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
          charId,
          manifest.dialogue,
          compiledVisemeMap,
          t
        );

        // Apply to all GLTF morphTargetInfluences
        rig.morphMeshes.forEach((mesh) => {
          const dict = mesh.morphTargetDictionary;
          const influences = mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
          if (!dict || !influences) return;

          ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName) => {
            const idx = dict[vName];
            if (typeof idx === 'number') {
              // Smooth damping for natural blendshape transitions
              influences[idx] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
                influences[idx],
                visemeWeights[vName] || 0,
                0.45
              );
            }
          });
        });

        // Drive Jaw Bone rotation proportional to open-mouth vowel visemes
        if (rig.jawBone) {
          const jawOpenAmount =
            visemeWeights.viseme_aa * 0.35 +
            visemeWeights.viseme_O * 0.28 +
            visemeWeights.viseme_E * 0.22 +
            visemeWeights.viseme_U * 0.16 +
            visemeWeights.viseme_DD * 0.12;
          rig.jawBone.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
            rig.jawBone.rotation.x,
            jawOpenAmount,
            0.45
          );
          rig.jawBone.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
            rig.jawBone.position.y,
            -0.14 - jawOpenAmount * 0.22,
            0.45
          );
        }

        if (charId === inspectedSpeakerId && frameCounter % 3 === 0) {
          setLiveVisemes(visemeWeights);
        }
      });

      camera.lookAt(lookAtVec);
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderTick);
    };

    renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderTick);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(renderId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [manifest, compiledVisemeMap, inspectedSpeakerId]);

  const characterAssets = manifest.assets.filter((a) => a.type === 'gltfCharacter');

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-6 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-5">
        {/* Top Bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              GLTF Skeletal Crossfade & TTS Viseme Engine
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mt-1">{manifest.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{manifest.subtitle}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {SAMPLE_SCENES.map((s, idx) => (
              <button
                key={s.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSampleIdx(idx);
                  seek(0);
                  setIsPlaying(true);
                }}
                className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  sampleIdx === idx
                    ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Sample {idx + 1}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Viewport + Live Skeletal/Viseme Telemetry */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {/* 3D Viewport (2 Cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[450px] bg-black">
              <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Top Overlay Status */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300">
                <span
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                    isPlaying ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-400'
                  }`}
                />
                <span className="font-mono">
                  T+{currentTime.toFixed(2)}s / {manifest.duration.toFixed(1)}s
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-sky-400 font-semibold">
                  Clip: {liveBlendState.primaryClip} (
                  {Math.round(liveBlendState.primaryWeight * 100)}%)
                </span>
                {liveBlendState.secondaryClip && (
                  <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono">
                    ← {liveBlendState.secondaryClip} (
                    {Math.round(liveBlendState.secondaryWeight * 100)}%)
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Subtitle + Active Speaker Indicator */}
              {showSubtitles && activeSegment && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-4 inset-x-5 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-5 py-3 rounded-xl text-center shadow-2xl">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-sky-400 mb-1">
                      {activeSegment.speaker}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-white leading-relaxed">
                      {activeSegment.text}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Scrubber & Controls */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={manifest.duration}
                step={0.02}
                value={currentTime}
                onChange={(e) => seek(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              />

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition"
                  >
                    {isPlaying ? <Pause className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Play className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    {isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => seek(0)}
                    className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() =>
                      setPlaybackRate((r) => (r === 1 ? 0.5 : r === 0.5 ? 1.5 : 1))
                    }
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono"
                  >
                    <FastForward className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                    {playbackRate}x
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowSubtitles(!showSubtitles)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      showSubtitles
                        ? 'bg-slate-800 text-sky-400 border border-sky-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800/40 text-slate-500'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Subtitles className="w-4 h-4" /> Subtitles
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setTtsEnabled(!ttsEnabled)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      ttsEnabled
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {ttsEnabled ? (
                      <>
                        <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" /> Live TTS On
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4" /> TTS Muted
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Inspector: Skeletal Crossfade Mixer + Live Viseme Morph Meters */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {/* Character Selector */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" /> Inspected GLTF Rig
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {characterAssets.map((char) => (
                  <button
                    key={char.id}
                    onClick={() => setInspectedSpeakerId(char.id)}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium border transition ${
                      inspectedSpeakerId === char.id
                        ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/50 text-sky-300'
                        : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {char.name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Live Skeletal Action Mixer Weights */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">
                <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                Skeletal AnimationBlender State
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between font-mono text-[11px] text-sky-400">
                    <span>Active: {liveBlendState.primaryClip}</span>
                    <span>{Math.round(liveBlendState.primaryWeight * 100)}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-0.5">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-sky-400 transition-all duration-75"
                      style={{ width: `${liveBlendState.primaryWeight * 100}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {liveBlendState.secondaryClip && (
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between font-mono text-[11px] text-amber-400">
                      <span>Outgoing: {liveBlendState.secondaryClip}</span>
                      <span>{Math.round(liveBlendState.secondaryWeight * 100)}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-0.5">
                      <div
                        className="h-full bg-amber-400 transition-all duration-75"
                        style={{ width: `${liveBlendState.secondaryWeight * 100}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Real-Time Viseme Blendshape Telemetry (14 Oculus/ARKit Targets) */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300 mb-2">
                <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                morphTargetInfluences (Visemes)
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-3 gap-y-1.5">
                {ALL_VISEMES.filter((v) => v !== 'viseme_sil').map((vName) => {
                  const val = liveVisemes[vName] || 0;
                  return (
                    <div key={vName} className="space-y-0.5">
                      <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono">
                        <span className={val > 0.15 ? 'text-emerald-300 font-semibold' : 'text-slate-500'}>
                          {vName.replace('viseme_', '')}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-500">{Math.round(val * 100)}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full bg-emerald-400 transition-all duration-75"
                          style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, val * 100)}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Dialogue Cue Jump List */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1 max-h-40">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-1">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" /> Dialogue Cues
              </div>
              {manifest.dialogue.map((seg) => (
                <button
                  key={seg.id}
                  onClick={() => seek(seg.start)}
                  className={`w-full text-left p-2 rounded-lg text-xs border transition ${
                    activeSegment?.id === seg.id
                      ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/50 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/50'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400">
                    <span>{seg.speaker}</span>
                    <span>{seg.start.toFixed(1)}s</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="truncate mt-0.5">{seg.text}</p>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
3. Plugging in ReadyPlayerMe, Mixamo, or Custom .glb Models
Because the renderer uses standard Oculus/ARKit viseme naming (viseme_aa, viseme_E, viseme_I, viseme_O, viseme_U, viseme_PP, viseme_FF, viseme_TH, viseme_DD, viseme_kk, viseme_CH, viseme_SS, viseme_RR, viseme_sil), you can point gltfUrl directly at any ReadyPlayerMe avatar URL with morph targets enabled:

https://models.readyplayer.me/<avatar-id>.glb?morphTargets=Oculus%20Visemes
Automatic Mesh Discovery: When GLTFLoader resolves in createProceduralSkinnedCharacter, it traverses gltf.scene, locates every THREE.SkinnedMesh with a morphTargetDictionary, and binds rig.morphMeshes to those meshes automatically.

External TTS Word & Phoneme Timestamps: When you generate audio using ElevenLabs, Amazon Polly, Azure Speech, or Kokoro + Rhubarb Lip Sync, pass their phoneme timestamp array into dialogue[i].visemeCues. The compileDialogueVisemes function automatically bypasses the grapheme estimator and locks the mouth blendshapes to the exact acoustic phoneme boundaries.

What should we build next for this engine?

Build the TTS-to-Timeline compiler pipeline

Add inverse kinematics (IK) head & eye look-at tracking

Design the small-LLM prompt & JSON generator
Extend the character rig so characters automatically turn their head and eyes toward the active speaker or target asset ID using lookAt constraints.

Adding hierarchical head, eye, and upper-spine lookAt constraints to a timeline-driven 3D renderer requires executing an Inverse Kinematics (IK) post-pass on every frame after THREE.AnimationMixer evaluates the skeletal clip, so the procedural gaze layers cleanly on top of keyframed body animations without fighting the mixer.

1. Architecture of the 3-Tier Gaze & Look-At Solver
Execution Order in the 60 FPS Render Loop
Because mixer.update(0) overwrites bone quaternions with the active skeletal animation clip (Idle, Wave, Explain, PointRight), the gaze constraint system runs in four deterministic stages each frame:

Base Skeletal Pose Pass: evaluateSkeletalTrackAtTime sets the exact blended pose on Hips, Spine, Head, and limb bones.

Target Resolution Pass (resolveGazeTarget): Determines what each character should look at using a 3-tier priority cascade:

Priority 1 — Interactive Pointer Beacon (Optional Live Test Mode): Tracks a live 3D target orb moved by the user's cursor in the viewport.

Priority 2 — Explicit Declarative lookAtTarget Track: Keyframes on an actor's lookAtTarget track can name any persistent assetId ("holo_core", "actor_zephyr", "camera") or world [x, y, z] coordinate.

Priority 3 — Automatic Conversational Turn-Taking (autoSpeakerGaze): When no explicit track overrides the actor, listeners automatically look at the active speaker's head, while the active speaker alternates gaze between their listener and the "camera".

Anatomical Clamping & Multi-Bone Distribution Pass (applyLookAtIK):

Converts the world-space target coordinate into the character's local space to compute spherical Yaw (
θ
θ) and Pitch (
ϕ
ϕ) angles.

Distributes the rotation across three anatomical joints with independent angular limits and damping speeds:

Joint / Bone	Share of Gaze Angle	Angular Clamp Limits (Yaw / Pitch)	Slerp Damping Speed	Purpose
Spine (Upper Chest)	20% (activates when yaw exceeds 15°)	±22 
∘
  Yaw / ±10 
∘
  Pitch	0.08 (Slow, heavy)	Prevents robotic neck-only twisting on wide side glances.
Head (Neck Pivot)	75% of total target angle	±62 
∘
  Yaw / ±32 
∘
  Pitch	0.16 (Medium, natural)	Primary orientation toward speaker or target asset.
EyeL & EyeR (Eyeballs)	100% of remaining angle + vergence	±35 
∘
  Yaw / ±25 
∘
  Pitch	0.45 (Fast saccades)	True binocular convergence onto the exact target point + micro-saccades.
Viseme & Blink Pass: Applies TTS lip-sync blendshapes to morphTargetInfluences and triggers natural periodic eye blinks (eyeL.scale.y / eyeR.scale.y).

2. Extended Declarative Schema (lookAtTarget Track)
You can now script gaze changes in the manifest just like position or skeletal clips, or omit the track entirely to let autoSpeakerGaze handle multi-character conversations automatically:

JSON
{
  "targetId": "actor_aria",
  "property": "lookAtTarget",
  "keyframes": [
    { "time": 0.0, "value": "camera", "weight": 1.0 },
    { "time": 4.5, "value": "actor_zephyr", "weight": 1.0 },
    { "time": 9.0, "value": "holo_core", "weight": 1.0 },
    { "time": 14.5, "value": "auto", "weight": 1.0 }
  ]
}
3. React + Three.js Renderer with Hierarchical Head/Eye IK, Gaze Rays & Auto-Speaker Tracking
Install three and lucide-react (npm install three lucide-react). This updated component adds:

Articulated EyeL and EyeR Bones with Iris/Pupil Geometry: Replaces the static visor with dual eyeball rigs that converge on targets and blink periodically.

3D Gaze Vector Laser Toggle: Renders live cyan (head) and emerald (left/right eye) sightlines from each character to their resolved target asset or speaker.

Interactive Pointer Gaze Override: Toggle "Mouse Gaze Override" in the toolbar and move your cursor across the 3D viewport to watch both characters track your pointer with their eyes, heads, and upper spines in real time.

TypeScript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {
  Play,
  Pause,
  RotateCcw,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Sparkles,
  Eye,
  Crosshair,
  UserCheck,
  Clock,
  Subtitles,
  FastForward,
  Sliders,
  Activity
} from 'lucide-react';

// ============================================================================
// 1. SCHEMA & TYPES (WITH LOOK-AT IK CONSTRAINTS)
// ============================================================================

type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];

export type VisemeName =
  | 'viseme_sil'
  | 'viseme_PP'
  | 'viseme_FF'
  | 'viseme_TH'
  | 'viseme_DD'
  | 'viseme_kk'
  | 'viseme_CH'
  | 'viseme_SS'
  | 'viseme_RR'
  | 'viseme_aa'
  | 'viseme_E'
  | 'viseme_I'
  | 'viseme_O'
  | 'viseme_U';

const ALL_VISEMES: VisemeName[] = [
  'viseme_sil',
  'viseme_PP',
  'viseme_FF',
  'viseme_TH',
  'viseme_DD',
  'viseme_kk',
  'viseme_CH',
  'viseme_SS',
  'viseme_RR',
  'viseme_aa',
  'viseme_E',
  'viseme_I',
  'viseme_O',
  'viseme_U'
];

type ClipName = 'Idle' | 'Wave' | 'Explain' | 'PointRight' | 'Inspect';

interface LookAtConstraintConfig {
  maxHeadYawDeg: number;   // e.g., 62 deg
  maxHeadPitchDeg: number; // e.g., 32 deg
  maxEyeYawDeg: number;    // e.g., 35 deg
  maxEyePitchDeg: number;  // e.g., 25 deg
  spineWeight: number;     // 0..0.35 torso twist contribution
}

interface AssetDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'gltfCharacter' | 'torusKnot' | 'box' | 'sphere' | 'grid' | 'pointLight';
  color: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  initialPosition: Vector3Tuple;
  initialRotation?: Vector3Tuple;
  initialScale?: Vector3Tuple;
  lookAtConfig?: LookAtConstraintConfig;
}

interface Keyframe<T = any> {
  time: number;
  value: T;
  crossFade?: number;
  weight?: number; // Used for lookAtTarget blend weight (0..1)
}

interface AnimationTrack {
  targetId: string;
  property:
    | 'position'
    | 'rotation'
    | 'scale'
    | 'animationClip'
    | 'lookAt'
    | 'lookAtTarget'; // New: Asset ID ('holo_core', 'camera', 'actor_zephyr', 'auto') or [x,y,z]
  keyframes: Keyframe[];
}

interface VisemeCue {
  time: number;
  duration: number;
  viseme: VisemeName;
  weight: number;
}

interface DialogueSegment {
  id: string;
  speakerId: string;
  speaker: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  text: string;
}

interface SceneManifest {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  duration: number;
  world: { background: string };
  assets: AssetDefinition[];
  tracks: AnimationTrack[];
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[];
}

interface CharacterRigInstance {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  morphMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
  // Hierarchical IK Bones
  spineBone: THREE.Bone;
  headBone: THREE.Bone;
  jawBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyeLBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyeRBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyelidLMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  eyelidRMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  // Smoothed IK state quaternions (so post-mixer overrides damp smoothly)
  smoothedSpineOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedHeadOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedEyeLQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedEyeRQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  // Debug Gaze Lines
  headGazeLine: THREE.Line;
  eyeLGazeLine: THREE.Line;
  eyeRGazeLine: THREE.Line;
  config: LookAtConstraintConfig;
}

interface GazeTelemetry {
  resolvedTargetId: string;
  targetSource: 'Cursor Override' | 'Explicit Track' | 'Auto Speaker Gaze';
  headYawDeg: number;
  headPitchDeg: number;
  eyeYawDeg: number;
  eyePitchDeg: number;
  isClamped: boolean;
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. VISEME COMPILER & SKELETAL / SPATIAL INTERPOLATION HELPERS
// ============================================================================

function compileDialogueVisemes(segment: DialogueSegment): VisemeCue[] {
  const cleanText = segment.text.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/g, '');
  const words = cleanText.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0) return [];

  const totalDuration = Math.max(0.2, segment.end - segment.start);
  const totalChars = words.reduce((acc, w) => acc + w.length + 1, 0);
  const secPerChar = totalDuration / Math.max(1, totalChars);

  const cues: VisemeCue[] = [];
  let cursor = segment.start;

  const charToViseme = (ch: string): VisemeName => {
    switch (ch.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'a':
        return 'viseme_aa';
      case 'e':
        return 'viseme_E';
      case 'i':
      case 'y':
        return 'viseme_I';
      case 'o':
        return 'viseme_O';
      case 'u':
      case 'w':
        return 'viseme_U';
      case 'p':
      case 'b':
      case 'm':
        return 'viseme_PP';
      case 'f':
      case 'v':
        return 'viseme_FF';
      case 't':
      case 'd':
      case 'n':
        return 'viseme_DD';
      case 'k':
      case 'g':
      case 'c':
        return 'viseme_kk';
      case 's':
      case 'z':
        return 'viseme_SS';
      case 'r':
      case 'l':
        return 'viseme_RR';
      default:
        return 'viseme_sil';
    }
  };

  words.forEach((word) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < word.length; i++) {
      const viseme = charToViseme(word[i]);
      const isVowel = ['viseme_aa', 'viseme_E', 'viseme_I', 'viseme_O', 'viseme_U'].includes(
        viseme
      );
      cues.push({
        time: cursor,
        duration: secPerChar * (isVowel ? 1.25 : 0.85),
        viseme,
        weight: isVowel ? 0.95 : 0.7
      });
      cursor += secPerChar;
    }
    cues.push({
      time: cursor,
      duration: secPerChar * 0.8,
      viseme: 'viseme_sil',
      weight: 0.1
    });
    cursor += secPerChar;
  });

  return cues;
}

function evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
  speakerId: string,
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[],
  compiledMap: Map<string, VisemeCue[]>,
  t: number
): Record<VisemeName, number> {
  const weights: any = {};
  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (weights[v] = 0));

  const activeSeg = dialogue.find(
    (d) => d.speakerId === speakerId && t >= d.start && t <= d.end
  );
  if (!activeSeg) {
    weights.viseme_sil = 1;
    return weights;
  }

  const cues = compiledMap.get(activeSeg.id) || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cues.length; i++) {
    const cue = cues[i];
    const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
    const halfWidth = Math.max(0.04, cue.duration * 0.85);
    const dist = Math.abs(t - center);
    if (dist < halfWidth) {
      const influence = Math.cos((dist / halfWidth) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight;
      weights[cue.viseme] = Math.min(1, Math.max(weights[cue.viseme], influence));
    }
  }
  return weights;
}

function evaluateSpatialTrack(keyframes: Keyframe[], t: number): number[] {
  if (t <= keyframes[0].time) return keyframes[0].value;
  if (t >= keyframes[keyframes.length - 1].time) return keyframes[keyframes.length - 1].value;

  for (let i = 0; i < keyframes.length - 1; i++) {
    const k0 = keyframes[i];
    const k1 = keyframes[i + 1];
    if (t >= k0.time && t <= k1.time) {
      const span = Math.max(0.0001, k1.time - k0.time);
      const raw = (t - k0.time) / span;
      const alpha = raw < 0.5 ? 2 * raw * raw : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * raw + 2, 2) / 2;
      return k0.value.map((v: number, idx: number) => v + (k1.value[idx] - v) * alpha);
    }
  }
  return keyframes[0].value;
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. CHARACTER RIG BUILDER WITH ARTICULATED EYEBALL BONES & GAZE RAYS
// ============================================================================

function createRigWithEyeAndHeadIK(
  asset: AssetDefinition,
  scene: THREE.Scene
): CharacterRigInstance {
  const root = new THREE.Group();

  // Bone Hierarchy: Hips -> Spine -> Head -> (Jaw, EyeL, EyeR) + Shoulders/Forearms
  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.0, 0);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.45, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.78, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  const jawBone = new THREE.Bone();
  jawBone.name = 'Jaw';
  jawBone.position.set(0, -0.16, 0.32);
  headBone.add(jawBone);

  // Articulated Left & Right Eyeball Bones (child of HeadBone)
  const eyeLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  eyeLBone.name = 'EyeL';
  eyeLBone.position.set(-0.15, 0.08, 0.29);
  headBone.add(eyeLBone);

  const eyeRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  eyeRBone.name = 'EyeR';
  eyeRBone.position.set(0.15, 0.08, 0.29);
  headBone.add(eyeRBone);

  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.62, 0.45, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const forearmLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmLBone.name = 'ForearmL';
  forearmLBone.position.set(-0.48, -0.42, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(forearmLBone);

  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.62, 0.45, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const forearmRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmRBone.name = 'ForearmR';
  forearmRBone.position.set(0.48, -0.42, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(forearmRBone);

  root.add(hipsBone);

  // Materials
  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.color,
    roughness: 0.32,
    metalness: 0.45
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.65
  });
  const scleraMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#f8fafc',
    roughness: 0.15
  });
  const irisMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.accentColor || '#38bdf8',
    emissive: asset.accentColor || '#0284c7',
    emissiveIntensity: 0.6
  });
  const pupilMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#020617' });

  // Body & Limbs
  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.95, 1.05, 0.5), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.12, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  const pelvisMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.45, 0.9, 16),
    darkMat
  );
  pelvisMesh.position.set(0, -0.45, 0);
  hipsBone.add(pelvisMesh);

  const upperArmGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.42, 8, 16);
  const armL = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armL.position.set(-0.24, -0.2, 0);
  armL.rotation.z = -0.5;
  shoulderLBone.add(armL);

  const handL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.4, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handL.position.set(0, -0.22, 0.1);
  forearmLBone.add(handL);

  const armR = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armR.position.set(0.24, -0.2, 0);
  armR.rotation.z = 0.5;
  shoulderRBone.add(armR);

  const handR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.4, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handR.position.set(0, -0.22, 0.1);
  forearmRBone.add(handR);

  // Head Mesh & Recessed Eye Socket Visor Frame
  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.7, 0.66, 0.64), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const socketFrame = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.58, 0.24, 0.08), darkMat);
  socketFrame.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.29);
  headBone.add(socketFrame);

  // Build Articulated Eyeball Meshes (Sclera + Iris + Pupil) on EyeL & EyeR Bones
  const buildEyeballAssembly = (eyeBone: THREE.Bone) => {
    const sclera = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.095, 24, 24), scleraMat);
    // Flatten slightly on Z so rotation of iris is super crisp
    sclera.scale.set(1, 1, 0.85);
    eyeBone.add(sclera);

    const iris = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.048, 0.048, 0.02, 20), irisMat);
    iris.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    iris.position.set(0, 0, 0.078);
    eyeBone.add(iris);

    const pupil = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.024, 0.024, 0.025, 16),
      pupilMat
    );
    pupil.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    pupil.position.set(0, 0, 0.082);
    eyeBone.add(pupil);

    const eyelid = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.21, 0.21, 0.18), bodyMat);
    eyelid.position.set(0, 0.1, 0.02);
    eyelid.scale.y = 0.05; // Open by default; scales to 1.0 during blink
    eyeBone.add(eyelid);
    return eyelid;
  };

  const eyelidLMesh = buildEyeballAssembly(eyeLBone);
  const eyelidRMesh = buildEyeballAssembly(eyeRBone);

  // Expressive Viseme Morph-Target Mouth Mesh
  const baseMouthGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.08, 0.1, 8, 4, 2);
  const basePos = baseMouthGeo.attributes.position;
  const morphPositions: THREE.BufferAttribute[] = [];
  const morphDict: Record<string, number> = {};

  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName, idx) => {
    morphDict[vName] = idx;
    const cloned = basePos.clone();
    for (let i = 0; i < cloned.count; i++) {
      let x = cloned.getX(i);
      let y = cloned.getY(i);
      let z = cloned.getZ(i);
      if (vName === 'viseme_aa') {
        y *= 3.8;
        x *= 1.15;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_O') {
        y *= 3.2;
        x *= 0.62;
        z += 0.04;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_U') {
        y *= 2.1;
        x *= 0.45;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_E' || vName === 'viseme_I') {
        y *= 2.1;
        x *= 1.38;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_PP') {
        y *= 0.25;
      } else {
        y *= 1.7;
      }
      cloned.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    morphPositions.push(cloned);
  });
  baseMouthGeo.morphAttributes.position = morphPositions;

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    baseMouthGeo,
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: asset.accentColor || '#38bdf8',
      emissive: asset.accentColor || '#38bdf8',
      emissiveIntensity: 0.9
    })
  );
  mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary = morphDict;
  mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences = new Array(ALL_VISEMES.length).fill(0);
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.31);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  const chinMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.38, 0.07, 0.14), darkMat);
  chinMesh.position.set(0, -0.07, -0.02);
  jawBone.add(chinMesh);

  // Create Skeletal AnimationClips
  const times = [0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4];
  const makeClip = (name: ClipName): THREE.AnimationClip => {
    if (name === 'Wave') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('Wave', 2.4, [
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderR.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.2)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.6)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 1.9)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.6)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, 0, 2.2)).toArray()
          ]
        )
      ]);
    }
    if (name === 'Explain') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('Explain', 2.4, [
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderL.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.7, 0.2, -0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.1, -0.3, -0.8)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.6, 0.1, -0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.0, -0.2, -0.7)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.7, 0.2, -0.4)).toArray()
          ]
        ),
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderR.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.6)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.5, 0.2, 0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.1, -0.3, 0.8)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.6, 0.1, 0.4)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.6)).toArray()
          ]
        )
      ]);
    }
    if (name === 'PointRight') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('PointRight', 2.4, [
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderR.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.3, -0.3, 1.0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.4, -0.4, 1.1)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.3, -0.3, 1.0)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.4, -0.4, 1.1)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.3, -0.3, 1.0)).toArray()
          ]
        )
      ]);
    }
    if (name === 'Inspect') {
      return new THREE.AnimationClip('Inspect', 2.4, [
        new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
          'ShoulderL.quaternion',
          times,
          [
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.1, 0.4, -0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.2, 0.5, -0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.1, 0.4, -0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.2, 0.5, -0.3)).toArray(),
            ...new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(-1.1, 0.4, -0.3)).toArray()
          ]
        )
      ]);
    }
    return new THREE.AnimationClip('Idle', 2.4, [
      new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
        'Hips.position',
        times,
        [0, 1.0, 0, 0, 1.03, 0, 0, 1.0, 0, 0, 1.03, 0, 0, 1.0, 0]
      )
    ]);
  };

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  (['Idle', 'Wave', 'Explain', 'PointRight', 'Inspect'] as ClipName[]).forEach(
    (cName) => {
      const action = mixer.clipAction(makeClip(cName));
      action.play();
      action.setEffectiveWeight(cName === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
      actions.set(cName, action);
    }
  );

  // Create 3D Debug Gaze Ray Lines (Head = Sky Blue, Left/Right Eyes = Emerald)
  const createGazeLine = (hex: string, opacity: number) => {
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
      new THREE.Vector3(),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1)
    ]);
    const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
      color: hex,
      transparent: true,
      opacity
    });
    const line = new THREE.Line(geo, mat);
    scene.add(line);
    return line;
  };

  const headGazeLine = createGazeLine('#38bdf8', 0.45);
  const eyeLGazeLine = createGazeLine('#10b981', 0.85);
  const eyeRGazeLine = createGazeLine('#10b981', 0.85);

  return {
    id: asset.id,
    name: asset.name,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    spineBone,
    headBone,
    jawBone,
    eyeLBone,
    eyeRBone,
    eyelidLMesh,
    eyelidRMesh,
    smoothedSpineOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedEyeLQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedEyeRQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    headGazeLine,
    eyeLGazeLine,
    eyeRGazeLine,
    config: asset.lookAtConfig || {
      maxHeadYawDeg: 62,
      maxHeadPitchDeg: 32,
      maxEyeYawDeg: 35,
      maxEyePitchDeg: 25,
      spineWeight: 0.22
    }
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. HIERARCHICAL HEAD, EYE & SPINE LOOK-AT IK CONSTRAINT SOLVER
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Resolves the world-space 3D coordinate that a character should look at for timestamp t.
 */
function resolveCharacterGazeTarget(
  rig: CharacterRigInstance,
  manifest: SceneManifest,
  characterRigs: Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>,
  objectMap: Map<string, THREE.Object3D>,
  camera: THREE.Camera,
  t: number,
  pointerOverridePos: THREE.Vector3 | null
): {
  worldPoint: THREE.Vector3;
  resolvedTargetId: string;
  source: GazeTelemetry['targetSource'];
  weight: number;
} {
  // Priority 1: Live Interactive Mouse Pointer Beacon
  if (pointerOverridePos) {
    return {
      worldPoint: pointerOverridePos.clone(),
      resolvedTargetId: 'cursor_beacon',
      source: 'Cursor Override',
      weight: 1.0
    };
  }

  // Priority 2: Check if an explicit `lookAtTarget` track exists and is not set to 'auto'
  const lookTrack = manifest.tracks.find(
    (tr) => tr.targetId === rig.id && tr.property === 'lookAtTarget'
  );
  let explicitTarget: any = 'auto';
  let trackWeight = 1.0;

  if (lookTrack && lookTrack.keyframes.length > 0) {
    for (let i = 0; i < lookTrack.keyframes.length; i++) {
      if (t >= lookTrack.keyframes[i].time) {
        explicitTarget = lookTrack.keyframes[i].value;
        trackWeight = lookTrack.keyframes[i].weight ?? 1.0;
      }
    }
  }

  const getTargetPositionById = (targetId: string): THREE.Vector3 => {
    if (targetId === 'camera') {
      return camera.position.clone();
    }
    // If target is another character, aim specifically at their HeadBone world position!
    const otherChar = characterRigs.get(targetId);
    if (otherChar) {
      const headWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
      otherChar.headBone.getWorldPosition(headWorld);
      headWorld.y += 0.06; // Eye level
      return headWorld;
    }
    const sceneObj = objectMap.get(targetId);
    if (sceneObj) {
      const pos = new THREE.Vector3();
      sceneObj.getWorldPosition(pos);
      return pos;
    }
    return camera.position.clone();
  };

  if (Array.isArray(explicitTarget) && explicitTarget.length === 3) {
    return {
      worldPoint: new THREE.Vector3(
        explicitTarget[0],
        explicitTarget[1],
        explicitTarget[2]
      ),
      resolvedTargetId: `[${explicitTarget.map((n) => n.toFixed(1)).join(',')}]`,
      source: 'Explicit Track',
      weight: trackWeight
    };
  }

  if (typeof explicitTarget === 'string' && explicitTarget !== 'auto') {
    return {
      worldPoint: getTargetPositionById(explicitTarget),
      resolvedTargetId: explicitTarget,
      source: 'Explicit Track',
      weight: trackWeight
    };
  }

  // Priority 3: Automatic Conversational Turn-Taking (Auto Speaker Gaze)
  const activeDialogue = manifest.dialogue.find(
    (seg) => t >= seg.start && t <= seg.end
  );

  if (activeDialogue) {
    if (activeDialogue.speakerId !== rig.id) {
      // Listener automatically looks at the active speaker's head/eyes!
      return {
        worldPoint: getTargetPositionById(activeDialogue.speakerId),
        resolvedTargetId: activeDialogue.speakerId,
        source: 'Auto Speaker Gaze',
        weight: 1.0
      };
    } else {
      // Active speaker alternates between addressing another character (70%) and the camera (30%)
      const otherCharIds = Array.from(characterRigs.keys()).filter(
        (id) => id !== rig.id
      );
      const cycle = (t - activeDialogue.start) % 4.5;
      const targetId =
        otherCharIds.length > 0 && cycle < 3.1 ? otherCharIds[0] : 'camera';
      return {
        worldPoint: getTargetPositionById(targetId),
        resolvedTargetId: targetId,
        source: 'Auto Speaker Gaze',
        weight: 1.0
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    worldPoint: camera.position.clone(),
    resolvedTargetId: 'camera',
    source: 'Auto Speaker Gaze',
    weight: 1.0
  };
}

/**
 * Applies anatomically clamped Spine, Head, and Binocular Eye look-at rotations
 * AFTER mixer.update(0) has set the base skeletal pose.
 */
function applyCharacterLookAtIK(
  rig: CharacterRigInstance,
  targetWorldPos: THREE.Vector3,
  resolvedTargetId: string,
  source: GazeTelemetry['targetSource'],
  weight: number,
  t: number,
  showGazeRays: boolean
): GazeTelemetry {
  rig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);

  // 1. Compute target vector in Character Root local space (+Z is forward)
  const headWorldPos = new THREE.Vector3();
  rig.headBone.getWorldPosition(headWorldPos);

  const rootWorldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
  rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootWorldQuat);
  const invRootQuat = rootWorldQuat.clone().invert();

  const toTargetLocal = targetWorldPos
    .clone()
    .sub(headWorldPos)
    .applyQuaternion(invRootQuat);

  const horizontalDist = Math.sqrt(
    toTargetLocal.x * toTargetLocal.x + toTargetLocal.z * toTargetLocal.z
  );
  const rawYawRad = Math.atan2(toTargetLocal.x, toTargetLocal.z);
  const rawPitchRad = Math.atan2(toTargetLocal.y, Math.max(0.001, horizontalDist));

  const maxHeadYawRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(rig.config.maxHeadYawDeg);
  const maxHeadPitchRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(rig.config.maxHeadPitchDeg);
  const maxEyeYawRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(rig.config.maxEyeYawDeg);
  const maxEyePitchRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(rig.config.maxEyePitchDeg);

  // If the target goes far behind the character (> 135 deg), smoothly relax toward forward
  const isBehind = Math.abs(rawYawRad) > THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(135);
  const effectiveWeight = isBehind ? weight * 0.15 : weight;

  const isClamped =
    Math.abs(rawYawRad) > maxHeadYawRad || Math.abs(rawPitchRad) > maxHeadPitchRad;

  // 2. Tier 1: Upper Spine Twist (20% share when yaw > 12 deg)
  const spineYaw =
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      rawYawRad * rig.config.spineWeight,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-22),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(22)
    ) * effectiveWeight;
  const spinePitch =
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      -rawPitchRad * 0.12,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-10),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(10)
    ) * effectiveWeight;

  const targetSpineQuat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
    new THREE.Euler(spinePitch, spineYaw, 0, 'YXZ')
  );
  rig.smoothedSpineOffset.slerp(targetSpineQuat, 0.08);
  rig.spineBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedSpineOffset);

  // 3. Tier 2: Head & Neck Rotation (Clamped to ±62° Yaw, ±32° Pitch)
  const desiredHeadYaw =
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(rawYawRad - spineYaw, -maxHeadYawRad, maxHeadYawRad) *
    effectiveWeight;
  const desiredHeadPitch =
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      -rawPitchRad * 0.72,
      -maxHeadPitchRad,
      maxHeadPitchRad
    ) * effectiveWeight;
  // Subtle natural head tilt (roll) when turning sideways
  const desiredHeadRoll = -desiredHeadYaw * 0.08;

  const targetHeadQuat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
    new THREE.Euler(desiredHeadPitch, desiredHeadYaw, desiredHeadRoll, 'YXZ')
  );
  rig.smoothedHeadOffset.slerp(targetHeadQuat, 0.16);
  rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedHeadOffset);
  rig.headBone.updateMatrixWorld(true);

  // 4. Tier 3: Binocular Eyeball Convergence (EyeL & EyeR track exact 3D point in Head space + micro-saccades)
  const saccadeYaw = Math.sin(t * 7.3 + rig.id.length) * 0.014;
  const saccadePitch = Math.cos(t * 5.7) * 0.01;

  const solveSingleEye = (
    eyeBone: THREE.Bone,
    smoothedQuat: THREE.Quaternion
  ): { yawDeg: number; pitchDeg: number } => {
    const eyeWorldPos = new THREE.Vector3();
    eyeBone.getWorldPosition(eyeWorldPos);

    const headWorldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
    rig.headBone.getWorldQuaternion(headWorldQuat);
    const invHeadQuat = headWorldQuat.clone().invert();

    // Vector from this specific eyeball to the target in Head-local coordinates
    const eyeToTargetLocal = targetWorldPos
      .clone()
      .sub(eyeWorldPos)
      .applyQuaternion(invHeadQuat);

    const eyeHorizDist = Math.sqrt(
      eyeToTargetLocal.x * eyeToTargetLocal.x +
        eyeToTargetLocal.z * eyeToTargetLocal.z
    );
    const eyeYaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      Math.atan2(eyeToTargetLocal.x, Math.max(0.05, eyeToTargetLocal.z)) +
        saccadeYaw,
      -maxEyeYawRad,
      maxEyeYawRad
    );
    const eyePitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      -Math.atan2(eyeToTargetLocal.y, Math.max(0.05, eyeHorizDist)) +
        saccadePitch,
      -maxEyePitchRad,
      maxEyePitchRad
    );

    const targetEyeQuat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
      new THREE.Euler(eyePitch * effectiveWeight, eyeYaw * effectiveWeight, 0, 'YXZ')
    );
    smoothedQuat.slerp(targetEyeQuat, 0.45);
    eyeBone.quaternion.copy(smoothedQuat);
    eyeBone.updateMatrixWorld(true);

    return {
      yawDeg: THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(eyeYaw * effectiveWeight),
      pitchDeg: THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(-eyePitch * effectiveWeight)
    };
  };

  const eyeLStats = solveSingleEye(rig.eyeLBone, rig.smoothedEyeLQuat);
  solveSingleEye(rig.eyeRBone, rig.smoothedEyeRQuat);

  // 5. Natural Periodic Eye Blinking (every ~3.6 seconds)
  const blinkPhase = (t + (rig.id === 'actor_aria' ? 0.0 : 1.7)) % 3.6;
  const isBlinking = blinkPhase > 3.44;
  const targetLidScale = isBlinking ? 1.0 : 0.05;
  rig.eyelidLMesh.scale.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
    rig.eyelidLMesh.scale.y,
    targetLidScale,
    0.55
  );
  rig.eyelidRMesh.scale.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
    rig.eyelidRMesh.scale.y,
    targetLidScale,
    0.55
  );

  // 6. Update 3D Debug Gaze Ray Lines
  rig.headGazeLine.visible = showGazeRays;
  rig.eyeLGazeLine.visible = showGazeRays;
  rig.eyeRGazeLine.visible = showGazeRays;

  if (showGazeRays) {
    const updateLinePoints = (
      line: THREE.Line,
      originBone: THREE.Bone,
      rayLen: number
    ) => {
      const origin = new THREE.Vector3();
      const quat = new THREE.Quaternion();
      originBone.getWorldPosition(origin);
      originBone.getWorldQuaternion(quat);
      const forward = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, rayLen)
        .applyQuaternion(quat)
        .add(origin);
      const posAttr = line.geometry.attributes.position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
      posAttr.setXYZ(0, origin.x, origin.y, origin.z);
      posAttr.setXYZ(1, forward.x, forward.y, forward.z);
      posAttr.needsUpdate = true;
    };

    const distToTarget = Math.min(4.5, headWorldPos.distanceTo(targetWorldPos));
    updateLinePoints(rig.headGazeLine, rig.headBone, distToTarget);
    updateLinePoints(rig.eyeLGazeLine, rig.eyeLBone, distToTarget);
    updateLinePoints(rig.eyeRGazeLine, rig.eyeRBone, distToTarget);
  }

  const appliedHeadEuler = new THREE.Euler().setFromQuaternion(
    rig.smoothedHeadOffset,
    'YXZ'
  );

  return {
    resolvedTargetId,
    targetSource: source,
    headYawDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(appliedHeadEuler.y)),
    headPitchDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(-appliedHeadEuler.x)),
    eyeYawDeg: Math.round(eyeLStats.yawDeg),
    eyePitchDeg: Math.round(eyeLStats.pitchDeg),
    isClamped
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 6. MAIN REACT COMPONENT
// ============================================================================

export default function HierarchicalLookAtIKPlayer() {
  const [sampleIdx, setSampleIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const manifest = SAMPLE_SCENES[sampleIdx];

  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [playbackRate, setPlaybackRate] = useState<number>(1);
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showSubtitles, setShowSubtitles] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showGazeRays, setShowGazeRays] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [cursorGazeOverride, setCursorGazeOverride] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [inspectedCharId, setInspectedCharId] = useState<string>('actor_aria');

  const [gazeTelemetry, setGazeTelemetry] = useState<GazeTelemetry>({
    resolvedTargetId: 'actor_zephyr',
    targetSource: 'Auto Speaker Gaze',
    headYawDeg: 0,
    headPitchDeg: 0,
    eyeYawDeg: 0,
    eyePitchDeg: 0,
    isClamped: false
  });

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastSpokenSegRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const showGazeRaysRef = useRef<boolean>(showGazeRays);
  const cursorOverrideRef = useRef<boolean>(cursorGazeOverride);
  const pointerWorldPosRef = useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.7, 1.8));

  useEffect(() => {
    showGazeRaysRef.current = showGazeRays;
  }, [showGazeRays]);

  useEffect(() => {
    cursorOverrideRef.current = cursorGazeOverride;
  }, [cursorGazeOverride]);

  const compiledVisemeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, VisemeCue[]>();
    manifest.dialogue.forEach((seg) => {
      map.set(seg.id, compileDialogueVisemes(seg));
    });
    return map;
  }, [manifest]);

  const activeSegment = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      manifest.dialogue.find(
        (seg) => currentTime >= seg.start && currentTime <= seg.end
      ) || null
    );
  }, [manifest.dialogue, currentTime]);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(manifest.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
    },
    [manifest.duration]
  );

  // Browser TTS Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || !activeSegment) {
      if (!isPlaying && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (lastSpokenSegRef.current !== activeSegment.id) {
      lastSpokenSegRef.current = activeSegment.id;
      if (ttsEnabled && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(activeSegment.text);
        utter.rate = 1.05;
        utter.pitch = activeSegment.speakerId.includes('zephyr') ? 0.85 : 1.12;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
      }
    }
  }, [activeSegment, isPlaying, ttsEnabled]);

  // Master Clock
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const delta = ((now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000) * playbackRate;
        let next = timeRef.current + delta;
        if (next >= manifest.duration) next = 0;
        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying, playbackRate, manifest.duration]);

  // Three.js Scene, Skeletal Mixer & Post-Pass Look-At IK Solver
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(manifest.world.background);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      46,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );
    camera.position.set(0, 1.85, 4.4);
    camera.lookAt(0, 1.5, 0);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.9));

    // Interactive Cursor Target Beacon Mesh (visible when Mouse Gaze Override is active)
    const cursorBeacon = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.14, 20, 20),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#22d3ee', wireframe: true })
    );
    cursorBeacon.visible = false;
    scene.add(cursorBeacon);

    const objectMap = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();
    const characterRigs = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>();

    manifest.assets.forEach((asset) => {
      if (asset.type === 'gltfCharacter') {
        const rig = createRigWithEyeAndHeadIK(asset, scene);
        rig.root.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialRotation) rig.root.rotation.set(...asset.initialRotation);
        scene.add(rig.root);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, rig.root);
        characterRigs.set(asset.id, rig);
      } else if (asset.type === 'pointLight') {
        const light = new THREE.PointLight(asset.color, 2.5, 25);
        light.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(light);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, light);
      } else if (asset.type === 'grid') {
        const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, asset.color, asset.color);
        grid.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(grid);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, grid);
      } else {
        const geo =
          asset.type === 'torusKnot'
            ? new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.55, 0.18, 80, 16)
            : new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: asset.color,
          emissive: asset.color,
          emissiveIntensity: 0.35,
          roughness: 0.25,
          metalness: 0.7
        });
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
        mesh.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialScale) mesh.scale.set(...asset.initialScale);
        scene.add(mesh);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, mesh);
      }
    });

    // Pointer move handler for Interactive Mouse Gaze Override
    const handlePointerMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!cursorOverrideRef.current) return;
      const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ndcX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
      const ndcY = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
      pointerWorldPosRef.current.set(ndcX * 2.6, 1.5 + ndcY * 1.3, 1.75);
    };
    renderer.domElement.addEventListener('mousemove', handlePointerMove);

    let renderId: number;
    let frameCount = 0;

    const renderLoop = () => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      frameCount++;

      cursorBeacon.visible = cursorOverrideRef.current;
      if (cursorOverrideRef.current) {
        cursorBeacon.position.copy(pointerWorldPosRef.current);
      }

      // STAGE 1: Evaluate Spatial & Base Skeletal Animation Tracks
      manifest.tracks.forEach((track) => {
        if (track.property === 'lookAtTarget') return; // Handled in Stage 2

        if (track.property === 'animationClip') {
          const rig = characterRigs.get(track.targetId);
          if (!rig) return;
          let activeIdx = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < track.keyframes.length; i++) {
            if (t >= track.keyframes[i].time) activeIdx = i;
          }
          const curKf = track.keyframes[activeIdx];
          const prevKf = activeIdx > 0 ? track.keyframes[activeIdx - 1] : null;
          const fade = curKf.crossFade ?? 0.4;
          const elapsed = t - curKf.time;
          let pWeight = 1;
          let sClip: string | null = null;
          let sWeight = 0;

          if (prevKf && fade > 0 && elapsed >= 0 && elapsed < fade) {
            const a = elapsed / fade;
            pWeight = a * a * (3 - 2 * a);
            sClip = String(prevKf.value);
            sWeight = 1 - pWeight;
          }

          rig.actions.forEach((action, cName) => {
            const dur = action.getClip().duration || 1;
            if (cName === curKf.value) {
              action.setEffectiveWeight(pWeight);
              action.time = Math.max(0, t - curKf.time) % dur;
            } else if (sClip && cName === sClip && prevKf) {
              action.setEffectiveWeight(sWeight);
              action.time = Math.max(0, t - prevKf.time) % dur;
            } else {
              action.setEffectiveWeight(0);
            }
          });
          rig.mixer.update(0);
          return;
        }

        const val = evaluateSpatialTrack(track.keyframes, t);
        const obj = objectMap.get(track.targetId);
        if (!obj) return;
        if (track.property === 'position') obj.position.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
        if (track.property === 'rotation') obj.rotation.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
        if (track.property === 'scale') obj.scale.set(val[0], val[1], val[2]);
      });

      // STAGE 2: Post-Mixer Hierarchical Head, Spine & Binocular Eye Look-At IK Pass
      characterRigs.forEach((rig) => {
        const resolved = resolveCharacterGazeTarget(
          rig,
          manifest,
          characterRigs,
          objectMap,
          camera,
          t,
          cursorOverrideRef.current ? pointerWorldPosRef.current : null
        );

        const telemetry = applyCharacterLookAtIK(
          rig,
          resolved.worldPoint,
          resolved.resolvedTargetId,
          resolved.source,
          resolved.weight,
          t,
          showGazeRaysRef.current
        );

        if (rig.id === inspectedCharId && frameCount % 3 === 0) {
          setGazeTelemetry(telemetry);
        }

        // STAGE 3: Apply Viseme Morph Targets & Jaw Rotation
        const visemes = evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
          rig.id,
          manifest.dialogue,
          compiledVisemeMap,
          t
        );
        rig.morphMeshes.forEach((mesh) => {
          const dict = mesh.morphTargetDictionary;
          const inf = mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
          if (!dict || !inf) return;
          ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName) => {
            const idx = dict[vName];
            if (typeof idx === 'number') {
              inf[idx] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inf[idx], visemes[vName] || 0, 0.45);
            }
          });
        });

        const jawOpen =
          visemes.viseme_aa * 0.35 +
          visemes.viseme_O * 0.28 +
          visemes.viseme_E * 0.22;
        rig.jawBone.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          rig.jawBone.rotation.x,
          jawOpen,
          0.45
        );
      });

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(renderId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      renderer.domElement.removeEventListener('mousemove', handlePointerMove);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [manifest, compiledVisemeMap, inspectedCharId]);

  const characterAssets = manifest.assets.filter((a) => a.type === 'gltfCharacter');

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-6 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-5">
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              Hierarchical Head, Spine & Binocular Eye Look-At IK Engine
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mt-1">{manifest.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{manifest.subtitle}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {SAMPLE_SCENES.map((s, idx) => (
              <button
                key={s.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSampleIdx(idx);
                  setInspectedCharId('actor_aria');
                  seek(0);
                  setIsPlaying(true);
                }}
                className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  sampleIdx === idx
                    ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Sample {idx + 1}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Grid: 3D Viewport + Live Gaze IK Telemetry */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {/* 3D Viewport (2 Cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[450px] bg-black">
              <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Top Telemetry Pill */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300 pointer-events-none">
                <span
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                    isPlaying ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-400'
                  }`}
                />
                <span className="font-mono">
                  T+{currentTime.toFixed(2)}s / {manifest.duration.toFixed(1)}s
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">
                  Gaze Target: {gazeTelemetry.resolvedTargetId}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] bg-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-sky-300">
                  {gazeTelemetry.targetSource}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Interactive Cursor Override Banner */}
              {cursorGazeOverride && (
                <div className="absolute top-12 left-3 bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-400/50 text-cyan-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs pointer-events-none">
                  Move your mouse inside the 3D viewport to steer character eyes & heads
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Subtitles */}
              {showSubtitles && activeSegment && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-4 inset-x-5 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-5 py-3 rounded-xl text-center shadow-2xl">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-sky-400 mb-1">
                      {activeSegment.speaker}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-white leading-relaxed">
                      {activeSegment.text}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Scrubber & Interactive Look-At Controls */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={manifest.duration}
                step={0.02}
                value={currentTime}
                onChange={(e) => seek(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              />

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition"
                  >
                    {isPlaying ? <Pause className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Play className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    {isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => seek(0)}
                    className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() =>
                      setPlaybackRate((r) => (r === 1 ? 0.5 : r === 0.5 ? 1.5 : 1))
                    }
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono"
                  >
                    <FastForward className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                    {playbackRate}x
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowGazeRays(!showGazeRays)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      showGazeRays
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-4 h-4" /> Gaze Rays
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setCursorGazeOverride(!cursorGazeOverride)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      cursorGazeOverride
                        ? 'bg-cyan-500/25 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-400/50'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Crosshair className="w-4 h-4" /> Mouse Gaze Override
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setTtsEnabled(!ttsEnabled)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      ttsEnabled
                        ? 'bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/40'
