                    }`}
                  >
                    {ttsEnabled ? (
                      <>
                        <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" /> TTS On
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4" /> TTS
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Panel: Hierarchical Gaze IK Inspector & Dialogue Cues */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {/* Character Selector */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" /> Inspected Character Rig
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {characterAssets.map((char) => (
                  <button
                    key={char.id}
                    onClick={() => setInspectedCharId(char.id)}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium border transition ${
                      inspectedCharId === char.id
                        ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/50 text-sky-300'
                        : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {char.name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Resolved Target Card */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  Active Look-At Target
                </span>
                <span
                  className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold ${
                    gazeTelemetry.isClamped
                      ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40'
                      : 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300'
                  }`}
                >
                  {gazeTelemetry.isClamped ? 'Neck Limit Clamped' : 'Within Foveal Cone'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-xs bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                <span className="text-sky-400 font-semibold">
                  targetId: &quot;{gazeTelemetry.resolvedTargetId}&quot;
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                  {gazeTelemetry.targetSource}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Live Bone Angle Meters (Head vs Eyes) */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">
                <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                Live IK Joint Angles (Degrees)
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs font-mono">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-sky-300">Head Yaw (Clamp ±62°)</span>
                    <span>{gazeTelemetry.headYawDeg}°</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-1">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-sky-400 transition-all duration-75"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.min(
                          100,
                          (Math.abs(gazeTelemetry.headYawDeg) / 62) * 100
                        )}%`
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-sky-300">Head Pitch (Clamp ±32°)</span>
                    <span>{gazeTelemetry.headPitchDeg}°</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-1">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-sky-400 transition-all duration-75"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.min(
                          100,
                          (Math.abs(gazeTelemetry.headPitchDeg) / 32) * 100
                        )}%`
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-emerald-300">EyeL/R Vergence Yaw (±35°)</span>
                    <span>{gazeTelemetry.eyeYawDeg}°</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden mt-1">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-emerald-400 transition-all duration-75"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.min(
                          100,
                          (Math.abs(gazeTelemetry.eyeYawDeg) / 35) * 100
                        )}%`
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Dialogue Cue List */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1 max-h-44">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-1">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" /> Dialogue & Gaze Cues
              </div>
              {manifest.dialogue.map((seg) => (
                <button
                  key={seg.id}
                  onClick={() => seek(seg.start)}
                  className={`w-full text-left p-2 rounded-lg text-xs border transition ${
                    activeSegment?.id === seg.id
                      ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/50 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/50'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400">
                    <span>{seg.speaker}</span>
                    <span>
                      {seg.start.toFixed(1)}s – {seg.end.toFixed(1)}s
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="truncate mt-0.5">{seg.text}</p>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
4. How ReadyPlayerMe & Mixamo Rigs Map to This IK Solver
When loading external .glb characters via GLTFLoader, map standard humanoid bone names directly to the solver's references during asset initialization:

Spine / Upper Chest: gltf.scene.getObjectByName('Spine2') or gltf.scene.getObjectByName('UpperChest')

Head: gltf.scene.getObjectByName('Head')

Left / Right Eyes: gltf.scene.getObjectByName('LeftEye') and gltf.scene.getObjectByName('RightEye')

Because applyCharacterLookAtIK multiplies headBone.quaternion and spineBone.quaternion by smoothed delta offset quaternions (smoothedHeadOffset and smoothedSpineOffset) after mixer.update(0), it preserves any subtle head bobbing baked into the underlying Mixamo animation clip while still steering the character's gaze accurately toward the target.

2. Extended Declarative Schema (splinePath Track)
Instead of keyframing dozens of linear coordinates and manual rotation angles, a lightweight LLM or human author defines a splinePath track with waypoints, pause segments, tension, and stride length:

      "closed": false,
      "easing": "easeInOutQuad",
      "waypoints": [

3. React + Three.js Renderer with 3D Catmull-Rom Spline Locomotion, Articulated Legs & Gaze IK
Install three and lucide-react (npm install three lucide-react). This expanded renderer includes:

Full 15-Bone Articulated Humanoid Rig: Adds ThighL, ShinL, FootL, ThighR, ShinR, and FootR bones with counter-swinging arms and double-frequency vertical hip bounce (Hips.position.y) synced to footfalls.

3D Spline Path & Waypoint Visualizer: Renders glowing Catmull-Rom curve ribbons, numbered waypoint beacons, and a live velocity/tangent arrow underneath walking characters.

Interactive Spline Tension & Stride Length Sliders: Adjust curve tension (0.0 sharp corners to 1.0 wide arcs) and stride length (0.7m to 2.2m) in real time while watching the character's stepping cadence adapt automatically.

TypeScript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {
  Play,
  Pause,
  RotateCcw,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Sparkles,
  Eye,
  Footprints,
  Route,
  UserCheck,
  Clock,
  FastForward,
  Sliders,
  Compass
} from 'lucide-react';

// ============================================================================
// 1. SCHEMA & TYPES (WITH CATMULL-ROM SPLINE LOCOMOTION)
// ============================================================================

type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];
type EasingType = 'linear' | 'easeInOutQuad' | 'smoothstep';

export type VisemeName =
  | 'viseme_sil'
  | 'viseme_PP'
  | 'viseme_FF'
  | 'viseme_TH'
  | 'viseme_DD'
  | 'viseme_kk'
  | 'viseme_CH'
  | 'viseme_SS'
  | 'viseme_RR'
  | 'viseme_aa'
  | 'viseme_E'
  | 'viseme_I'
  | 'viseme_O'
  | 'viseme_U';

const ALL_VISEMES: VisemeName[] = [
  'viseme_sil',
  'viseme_PP',
  'viseme_FF',
  'viseme_TH',
  'viseme_DD',
  'viseme_kk',
  'viseme_CH',
  'viseme_SS',
  'viseme_RR',
  'viseme_aa',
  'viseme_E',
  'viseme_I',
  'viseme_O',
  'viseme_U'
];

type ClipName = 'Idle' | 'Walk' | 'Wave' | 'Explain' | 'PointRight';

interface SplineSegmentDefinition {
  id: string;
  startTime: number;
  endTime: number;
  waypoints: Vector3Tuple[];
  tension?: number;      // Catmull-Rom tension (0.0 to 1.0, default 0.5)
  closed?: boolean;      // Loop back to start waypoint
  strideLength?: number; // Meters per 2-step walk cycle (default 1.35m)
  easing?: EasingType;
  bankFactor?: number;   // Into-turn lean multiplier
}

interface AssetDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'gltfCharacter' | 'torusKnot' | 'box' | 'grid' | 'pointLight';
  color: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  initialPosition: Vector3Tuple;
  initialRotation?: Vector3Tuple;
  initialScale?: Vector3Tuple;
}

interface Keyframe<T = any> {
  time: number;
  value: T;
  crossFade?: number;
  weight?: number;
}

interface AnimationTrack {
  targetId: string;
  property:
    | 'position'
    | 'rotation'
    | 'scale'
    | 'animationClip'
    | 'lookAtTarget'
    | 'splinePath';
  keyframes?: Keyframe[];
  segments?: SplineSegmentDefinition[];
}

interface VisemeCue {
  time: number;
  duration: number;
  viseme: VisemeName;
  weight: number;
}

interface DialogueSegment {
  id: string;
  speakerId: string;
  speaker: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  text: string;
}

interface SceneManifest {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  duration: number;
  world: { background: string };
  assets: AssetDefinition[];
  tracks: AnimationTrack[];
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[];
}

interface CharacterRigInstance {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  morphMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
  // 15-Bone Articulated Hierarchy
  hipsBone: THREE.Bone;
  spineBone: THREE.Bone;
  headBone: THREE.Bone;
  jawBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyeLBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyeRBone: THREE.Bone;
  thighLBone: THREE.Bone;
  shinLBone: THREE.Bone;
  thighRBone: THREE.Bone;
  shinRBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyelidLMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  eyelidRMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  // Smoothed Quaternion & Heading States
  smoothedHeadingQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedSpineOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedHeadOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedEyeLQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedEyeRQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  // Debug Visualizers
  headGazeLine: THREE.Line;
  velocityArrow: THREE.ArrowHelper;
}

interface LocomotionTelemetry {
  activeSegmentId: string;
  arcLengthMeters: number;
  distanceTraveled: number;
  instantSpeedMps: number;
  walkBlendWeight: number;
  stridePhasePct: number;
  headingYawDeg: number;
  bankRollDeg: number;
  gazeTargetId: string;
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. VISEME COMPILER & EASING HELPERS
// ============================================================================

function applySplineEasing(alpha: number, mode: EasingType = 'smoothstep'): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, alpha));
  if (mode === 'smoothstep') {
    return c * c * (3 - 2 * c);
  }
  if (mode === 'easeInOutQuad') {
    return c < 0.5 ? 2 * c * c : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * c + 2, 2) / 2;
  }
  return c;
}

function compileDialogueVisemes(segment: DialogueSegment): VisemeCue[] {
  const cleanText = segment.text.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/g, '');
  const words = cleanText.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0) return [];

  const totalDuration = Math.max(0.2, segment.end - segment.start);
  const totalChars = words.reduce((acc, w) => acc + w.length + 1, 0);
  const secPerChar = totalDuration / Math.max(1, totalChars);

  const cues: VisemeCue[] = [];
  let cursor = segment.start;

  const charToViseme = (ch: string): VisemeName => {
    switch (ch.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'a':
        return 'viseme_aa';
      case 'e':
        return 'viseme_E';
      case 'i':
      case 'y':
        return 'viseme_I';
      case 'o':
        return 'viseme_O';
      case 'u':
      case 'w':
        return 'viseme_U';
      case 'p':
      case 'b':
      case 'm':
        return 'viseme_PP';
      case 'f':
      case 'v':
        return 'viseme_FF';
      case 't':
      case 'd':
      case 'n':
        return 'viseme_DD';
      case 'k':
      case 'g':
      case 'c':
        return 'viseme_kk';
      case 's':
      case 'z':
        return 'viseme_SS';
      case 'r':
      case 'l':
        return 'viseme_RR';
      default:
        return 'viseme_sil';
    }
  };

  words.forEach((word) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < word.length; i++) {
      const viseme = charToViseme(word[i]);
      const isVowel = ['viseme_aa', 'viseme_E', 'viseme_I', 'viseme_O', 'viseme_U'].includes(
        viseme
      );
      cues.push({
        time: cursor,
        duration: secPerChar * (isVowel ? 1.25 : 0.85),
        viseme,
        weight: isVowel ? 0.95 : 0.7
      });
      cursor += secPerChar;
    }
    cues.push({
      time: cursor,
      duration: secPerChar * 0.8,
      viseme: 'viseme_sil',
      weight: 0.1
    });
    cursor += secPerChar;
  });

  return cues;
}

function evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
  speakerId: string,
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[],
  compiledMap: Map<string, VisemeCue[]>,
  t: number
): Record<VisemeName, number> {
  const weights: any = {};
  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (weights[v] = 0));

  const activeSeg = dialogue.find(
    (d) => d.speakerId === speakerId && t >= d.start && t <= d.end
  );
  if (!activeSeg) {
    weights.viseme_sil = 1;
    return weights;
  }

  const cues = compiledMap.get(activeSeg.id) || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cues.length; i++) {
    const cue = cues[i];
    const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
    const halfWidth = Math.max(0.04, cue.duration * 0.85);
    const dist = Math.abs(t - center);
    if (dist < halfWidth) {
      const influence = Math.cos((dist / halfWidth) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight;
      weights[cue.viseme] = Math.min(1, Math.max(weights[cue.viseme], influence));
    }
  }
  return weights;
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. 15-BONE ARTICULATED HUMANOID RIG BUILDER (WITH FULL WALK CYCLE CLIP)
// ============================================================================

function createArticulatedLocomotionRig(
  asset: AssetDefinition,
  scene: THREE.Scene
): CharacterRigInstance {
  const root = new THREE.Group();

  // 1. Bone Hierarchy: Hips -> (Spine -> Head -> Jaw/Eyes/Arms) + (ThighL/R -> ShinL/R -> FootL/R)
  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.02, 0);
  root.add(hipsBone);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.35, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.72, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  const jawBone = new THREE.Bone();
  jawBone.name = 'Jaw';
  jawBone.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.3);
  headBone.add(jawBone);

  const eyeLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  eyeLBone.name = 'EyeL';
  eyeLBone.position.set(-0.14, 0.08, 0.28);
  headBone.add(eyeLBone);

  const eyeRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  eyeRBone.name = 'EyeR';
  eyeRBone.position.set(0.14, 0.08, 0.28);
  headBone.add(eyeRBone);

  // Arms
  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const forearmLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmLBone.name = 'ForearmL';
  forearmLBone.position.set(-0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(forearmLBone);

  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const forearmRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmRBone.name = 'ForearmR';
  forearmRBone.position.set(0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(forearmRBone);

  // Articulated Legs (Thigh -> Shin -> Foot) attached to Hips
  const thighLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighLBone.name = 'ThighL';
  thighLBone.position.set(-0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighLBone);

  const shinLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinLBone.name = 'ShinL';
  shinLBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighLBone.add(shinLBone);

  const footLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  footLBone.name = 'FootL';
  footLBone.position.set(0, -0.44, 0.08);
  shinLBone.add(footLBone);

  const thighRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighRBone.name = 'ThighR';
  thighRBone.position.set(0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighRBone);

  const shinRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinRBone.name = 'ShinR';
  shinRBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighRBone.add(shinRBone);

  const footRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  footRBone.name = 'FootR';
  footRBone.position.set(0, -0.44, 0.08);
  shinRBone.add(footRBone);

  // Materials
  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.color,
    roughness: 0.32,
    metalness: 0.45
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.65
  });
  const accentMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.accentColor || '#38bdf8',
    emissive: asset.accentColor || '#0284c7',
    emissiveIntensity: 0.55
  });
  const scleraMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#f8fafc', roughness: 0.15 });
  const pupilMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#020617' });

  // Torso & Pelvis Meshes
  const pelvisMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.72, 0.24, 0.42), darkMat);
  hipsBone.add(pelvisMesh);

  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.86, 0.88, 0.46), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.14, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  // Chest Direction Badge (makes forward body orientation clearly visible)
  const chestBadge = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.18, 0.06), accentMat);
  chestBadge.position.set(0, 0.28, 0.24);
  spineBone.add(chestBadge);

  // Arm Meshes
  const upperArmGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const armL = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armL.position.set(-0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(armL);

  const handL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handL.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmLBone.add(handL);

  const armR = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armR.position.set(0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(armR);

  const handR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handR.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmRBone.add(handR);

  // Leg & Foot Meshes
  const thighGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const shinGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const footGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.22, 0.12, 0.38);

  const thighLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighLBone.add(thighLMesh);

  const shinLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinLBone.add(shinLMesh);

  const footLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(footGeo, accentMat);
  footLMesh.position.set(0, -0.02, 0.05);
  footLBone.add(footLMesh);

  const thighRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighRBone.add(thighRMesh);

  const shinRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinRBone.add(shinRMesh);

  const footRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(footGeo, accentMat);
  footRMesh.position.set(0, -0.02, 0.05);
  footRBone.add(footRMesh);

  // Head & Articulated Eyeballs
  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.62, 0.6), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const socketFrame = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.54, 0.22, 0.08), darkMat);
  socketFrame.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.27);
  headBone.add(socketFrame);

  const buildEye = (eyeBone: THREE.Bone) => {
    const sclera = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.088, 20, 20), scleraMat);
    sclera.scale.set(1, 1, 0.85);
    eyeBone.add(sclera);

    const iris = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.044, 0.044, 0.02, 16),
      accentMat
    );
    iris.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    iris.position.set(0, 0, 0.072);
    eyeBone.add(iris);

    const pupil = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.022, 0.022, 0.025, 12),
      pupilMat
    );
    pupil.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    pupil.position.set(0, 0, 0.076);
    eyeBone.add(pupil);

    const eyelid = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.19, 0.19, 0.16), bodyMat);
    eyelid.position.set(0, 0.09, 0.02);
    eyelid.scale.y = 0.05;
    eyeBone.add(eyelid);
    return eyelid;
  };

  const eyelidLMesh = buildEye(eyeLBone);
  const eyelidRMesh = buildEye(eyeRBone);

  // Expressive Viseme Mouth Mesh
  const baseMouthGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.32, 0.075, 0.1, 8, 4, 2);
  const basePos = baseMouthGeo.attributes.position;
  const morphPositions: THREE.BufferAttribute[] = [];
  const morphDict: Record<string, number> = {};

  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName, idx) => {
    morphDict[vName] = idx;
    const cloned = basePos.clone();
    for (let i = 0; i < cloned.count; i++) {
      let x = cloned.getX(i);
      let y = cloned.getY(i);
      let z = cloned.getZ(i);
      if (vName === 'viseme_aa') {
        y *= 3.6;
        x *= 1.15;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_O') {
        y *= 3.0;
        x *= 0.62;
        z += 0.04;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_U') {
        y *= 2.0;
        x *= 0.45;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_E' || vName === 'viseme_I') {
        y *= 2.0;
        x *= 1.35;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_PP') {
        y *= 0.25;
      } else {
        y *= 1.6;
      }
      cloned.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    morphPositions.push(cloned);
  });
  baseMouthGeo.morphAttributes.position = morphPositions;

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(baseMouthGeo, accentMat);
  mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary = morphDict;
  mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences = new Array(ALL_VISEMES.length).fill(0);
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.14, 0.29);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  // 2. Author Full-Body Skeletal AnimationClips (including biomechanically phased 'Walk' cycle)
  const qEuler = (x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(x, y, z)).toArray();

  // 1.0-second normalized Walk Cycle (0.0 = Right Heel Strike, 0.25 = Passing, 0.5 = Left Heel Strike, 0.75 = Passing, 1.0 = Loop)
  const walkTimes = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0];
  const walkClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Walk', 1.0, [
    // Double-frequency vertical hip bounce + subtle lateral hip sway
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      walkTimes,
      [
        -0.03, 0.99, 0,
        0.0, 1.06, 0,
        0.03, 0.99, 0,
        0.0, 1.06, 0,
        -0.03, 0.99, 0
      ]
    ),
    // Left Thigh Swing (Forward on 0.5, Backward on 0.0/1.0)
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    // Left Shin Knee Bend (Flexes during swing phase at t=0.25)
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    // Right Thigh Swing (Opposite phase to Left Thigh)
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    // Right Shin Knee Bend (Flexes during swing phase at t=0.75)
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    // Counter-Swinging Left & Right Arms
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.42, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.42, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.42, 0, -0.08)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.42, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.42, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.42, 0, 0.08)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ForearmL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.35, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.35, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ForearmR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.35, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const gTimes = [0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4];
  const idleClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Idle', 2.4, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      gTimes,
      [0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0)]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0)]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0)]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0), ...qEuler(0, 0, 0)]
    )
  ]);

  const explainClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Explain', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, -0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.6, 0.1, -0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.0, -0.2, -0.6),
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0.2, 0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, 0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.65, 0.1, 0.35),
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const waveClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Wave', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 1.95),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();

  [
    ['Idle', idleClip],
    ['Walk', walkClip],
    ['Explain', explainClip],
    ['Wave', waveClip]
  ].forEach(([name, clip]) => {
    const act = mixer.clipAction(clip as THREE.AnimationClip);
    act.play();
    act.setEffectiveWeight(name === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
    actions.set(name as string, act);
  });

  // Gaze Ray & Velocity Tangent Arrow Visualizers
  const headGazeLine = new THREE.Line(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
      new THREE.Vector3(),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1)
    ]),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: '#10b981', transparent: true, opacity: 0.75 })
  );
  scene.add(headGazeLine);

  const velocityArrow = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
    new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1),
    new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.1, 0),
    1.1,
    0x38bdf8,
    0.25,
    0.16
  );
  scene.add(velocityArrow);

  return {
    id: asset.id,
    name: asset.name,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    hipsBone,
    spineBone,
    headBone,
    jawBone,
    eyeLBone,
    eyeRBone,
    thighLBone,
    shinLBone,
    thighRBone,
    shinRBone,
    eyelidLMesh,
    eyelidRMesh,
    smoothedHeadingQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedSpineOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedEyeLQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedEyeRQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    headGazeLine,
    velocityArrow
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. DETERMINISTIC CATMULL-ROM SPLINE & ARC-LENGTH STRIDE SOLVER
// ============================================================================

interface CompiledSplineSegment {
  def: SplineSegmentDefinition;
  curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3;
  totalLength: number;
}

/**
 * Evaluates a character's position, tangent heading, centripetal turn banking,
 * instantaneous speed, and arc-length stride phase along a 3D Catmull-Rom spline at timestamp t.
 */
function evaluateSplineLocomotionAtTime(
  rig: CharacterRigInstance,
  compiledSegments: CompiledSplineSegment[],
  baseClipName: string,
  strideLengthOverride: number,
  t: number,
  showSplineGizmos: boolean
): LocomotionTelemetry {
  // Find active or most recently completed spline segment
  let activeSeg: CompiledSplineSegment | null = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < compiledSegments.length; i++) {
    const seg = compiledSegments[i];
    if (t >= seg.def.startTime && t <= seg.def.endTime) {
      activeSeg = seg;
      break;
    }
    if (t > seg.def.endTime) {
      activeSeg = seg; // Hold final waypoint pose until next segment begins
    }
  }

  if (!activeSeg && compiledSegments.length > 0) {
    activeSeg = compiledSegments[0];
  }

  if (!activeSeg) {
    rig.velocityArrow.visible = false;
    return {
      activeSegmentId: 'Stationary',
      arcLengthMeters: 0,
      distanceTraveled: 0,
      instantSpeedMps: 0,
      walkBlendWeight: 0,
      stridePhasePct: 0,
      headingYawDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(rig.root.rotation.y)),
      bankRollDeg: 0,
      gazeTargetId: 'auto'
    };
  }

  const { def, curve, totalLength } = activeSeg;
  const duration = Math.max(0.01, def.endTime - def.startTime);
  const isInsideWindow = t >= def.startTime && t <= def.endTime;

  const rawAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - def.startTime) / duration));
  const u = applySplineEasing(rawAlpha, def.easing || 'smoothstep');

  // 1. Arc-Length Parameterized Position & Tangent at u
  const pos = curve.getPointAt(u);
  const tangent = curve.getTangentAt(u).normalize();
  rig.root.position.copy(pos);

  // 2. Compute Instantaneous Physical Ground Velocity v(t) via micro-delta
  const dt = 0.03;
  let instantSpeedMps = 0;
  let bankRollRad = 0;

  if (isInsideWindow) {
    const rawAlphaNext = Math.min(1, (t + dt - def.startTime) / duration);
    const uNext = applySplineEasing(rawAlphaNext, def.easing || 'smoothstep');
    const distNow = u * totalLength;
    const distNext = uNext * totalLength;
    instantSpeedMps = Math.abs(distNext - distNow) / dt;

    // Compute signed horizontal turn curvature for centripetal body banking
    const uAhead = Math.min(1, u + 0.025);
    const uBehind = Math.max(0, u - 0.025);
    const tanAhead = curve.getTangentAt(uAhead);
    const tanBehind = curve.getTangentAt(uBehind);
    const yawAhead = Math.atan2(tanAhead.x, tanAhead.z);
    const yawBehind = Math.atan2(tanBehind.x, tanBehind.z);
    let deltaYaw = yawAhead - yawBehind;
    // Wrap angle to [-PI, PI]
    while (deltaYaw > Math.PI) deltaYaw -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (deltaYaw < -Math.PI) deltaYaw += Math.PI * 2;

    const bankFactor = def.bankFactor ?? 0.35;
    bankRollRad = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      -deltaYaw * bankFactor * Math.min(1.5, instantSpeedMps),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-16),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(16)
    );
  }

  // 3. Automatic Body Heading Alignment along Horizontal Tangent
  const headingYawRad = Math.atan2(tangent.x, tangent.z);
  const targetHeadingQuat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
    new THREE.Euler(0, headingYawRad, bankRollRad, 'YXZ')
  );
  rig.smoothedHeadingQuat.slerp(targetHeadingQuat, 0.25);
  rig.root.quaternion.copy(rig.smoothedHeadingQuat);

  // 4. Distance-Driven Stride Phase (Zero Foot-Sliding!)
  const distanceTraveled = u * totalLength;
  const effectiveStrideLen = strideLengthOverride || def.strideLength || 1.3;
  const stridePhase = (distanceTraveled / Math.max(0.25, effectiveStrideLen)) % 1.0;

  // Blend weight between Base Gesture Clip ('Idle'/'Explain') and 'Walk' based on physical speed
  const walkBlendWeight = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(instantSpeedMps / 0.85, 0, 1);

  rig.actions.forEach((action, clipName) => {
    if (clipName === 'Walk') {
      action.enabled = true;
      action.setEffectiveWeight(walkBlendWeight);
      // Lock Walk clip time directly to arc-length stridePhase!
      action.time = stridePhase * action.getClip().duration;
    } else if (clipName === baseClipName) {
      action.enabled = true;
      // If baseClip is an upper-body gesture ('Explain' or 'Wave'), keep it active while walking!
      const isUpperGesture = baseClipName === 'Explain' || baseClipName === 'Wave';
      const baseWeight = isUpperGesture ? 0.85 : 1 - walkBlendWeight;
      action.setEffectiveWeight(baseWeight);
      action.time = t % (action.getClip().duration || 1);
    } else {
      action.setEffectiveWeight(0);
    }
  });

  rig.mixer.update(0);

  // 5. Update Velocity / Tangent Arrow Helper
  rig.velocityArrow.visible = showSplineGizmos && instantSpeedMps > 0.05;
  if (rig.velocityArrow.visible) {
    rig.velocityArrow.position.set(pos.x, pos.y + 0.08, pos.z);
    rig.velocityArrow.setDirection(tangent);
    rig.velocityArrow.setLength(
      Math.max(0.4, Math.min(1.8, instantSpeedMps * 0.9)),
      0.24,
      0.15
    );
  }

  return {
    activeSegmentId: isInsideWindow ? def.id : `${def.id} (Arrived)`,
    arcLengthMeters: Number(totalLength.toFixed(2)),
    distanceTraveled: Number(distanceTraveled.toFixed(2)),
    instantSpeedMps: Number(instantSpeedMps.toFixed(2)),
    walkBlendWeight: Number(walkBlendWeight.toFixed(2)),
    stridePhasePct: Math.round(stridePhase * 100),
    headingYawDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(headingYawRad)),
    bankRollDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(bankRollRad)),
    gazeTargetId: 'auto'
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 6. POST-MIXER HEAD & EYE LOOK-AT IK SOLVER (WORKS WHILE WALKING)
// ============================================================================

function applyWalkingLookAtIK(
  rig: CharacterRigInstance,
  targetWorldPos: THREE.Vector3,
  t: number,
  showGazeRays: boolean
) {
  rig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);

  const headWorldPos = new THREE.Vector3();
  rig.headBone.getWorldPosition(headWorldPos);

  const rootWorldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
  rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootWorldQuat);
  const invRootQuat = rootWorldQuat.clone().invert();

  // Compute target direction relative to the walking character's current spline heading!
  const toTargetLocal = targetWorldPos
    .clone()
    .sub(headWorldPos)
    .applyQuaternion(invRootQuat);

  const horizDist = Math.sqrt(
    toTargetLocal.x * toTargetLocal.x + toTargetLocal.z * toTargetLocal.z
  );
  const rawYaw = Math.atan2(toTargetLocal.x, toTargetLocal.z);
  const rawPitch = Math.atan2(toTargetLocal.y, Math.max(0.01, horizDist));

  // Relax toward forward path if target passes behind character's back (> 125 deg)
  const isBehind = Math.abs(rawYaw) > THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(125);
  const weight = isBehind ? 0.15 : 1.0;

  const spineYaw =
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      rawYaw * 0.22,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-22),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(22)
    ) * weight;
  const headYaw =
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      rawYaw - spineYaw,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-62),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(62)
    ) * weight;
  const headPitch =
    THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      -rawPitch * 0.7,
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-30),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(30)
    ) * weight;

  rig.smoothedSpineOffset.slerp(
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, spineYaw, 0, 'YXZ')),
    0.12
  );
  rig.spineBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedSpineOffset);

  rig.smoothedHeadOffset.slerp(
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
      new THREE.Euler(headPitch, headYaw, -headYaw * 0.08, 'YXZ')
    ),
    0.18
  );
  rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedHeadOffset);
  rig.headBone.updateMatrixWorld(true);

  // Binocular Eye Convergence
  const solveEye = (eyeBone: THREE.Bone, smoothedQuat: THREE.Quaternion) => {
    const eyeWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
    eyeBone.getWorldPosition(eyeWorld);
    const headWorldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
    rig.headBone.getWorldQuaternion(headWorldQuat);
    const localVec = targetWorldPos
      .clone()
      .sub(eyeWorld)
      .applyQuaternion(headWorldQuat.invert());
    const eYaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      Math.atan2(localVec.x, Math.max(0.05, localVec.z)),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-35),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(35)
    );
    const ePitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      -Math.atan2(
        localVec.y,
        Math.sqrt(localVec.x * localVec.x + localVec.z * localVec.z)
      ),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-25),
      THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(25)
    );
    smoothedQuat.slerp(
      new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
        new THREE.Euler(ePitch * weight, eYaw * weight, 0, 'YXZ')
      ),
      0.45
    );
    eyeBone.quaternion.copy(smoothedQuat);
  };

  solveEye(rig.eyeLBone, rig.smoothedEyeLQuat);
  solveEye(rig.eyeRBone, rig.smoothedEyeRQuat);

  // Periodic Blink
  const blink = (t + (rig.id === 'actor_aria' ? 0 : 1.6)) % 3.5 > 3.35 ? 1.0 : 0.05;
  rig.eyelidLMesh.scale.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(rig.eyelidLMesh.scale.y, blink, 0.55);
  rig.eyelidRMesh.scale.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(rig.eyelidRMesh.scale.y, blink, 0.55);

  // Update Gaze Ray Line
  rig.headGazeLine.visible = showGazeRays;
  if (showGazeRays) {
    const origin = new THREE.Vector3();
    const quat = new THREE.Quaternion();
    rig.headBone.getWorldPosition(origin);
    rig.headBone.getWorldQuaternion(quat);
    const dist = Math.min(4.5, origin.distanceTo(targetWorldPos));
    const end = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, dist).applyQuaternion(quat).add(origin);
    const attr = rig.headGazeLine.geometry.attributes.position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
    attr.setXYZ(0, origin.x, origin.y, origin.z);
    attr.setXYZ(1, end.x, end.y, end.z);
    attr.needsUpdate = true;
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 7. MAIN REACT COMPONENT
// ============================================================================

export default function CatmullRomSplineLocomotionPlayer() {
  const [sampleIdx, setSampleIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const manifest = SAMPLE_SCENES[sampleIdx];

  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [playbackRate, setPlaybackRate] = useState<number>(1);
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showSplineGizmos, setShowSplineGizmos] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showGazeRays, setShowGazeRays] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [inspectedCharId, setInspectedCharId] = useState<string>('actor_aria');

  // Interactive Spline & Stride Parameters
  const [splineTension, setSplineTension] = useState<number>(0.5);
  const [strideLength, setStrideLength] = useState<number>(1.3);

  const [telemetry, setTelemetry] = useState<LocomotionTelemetry>({
    activeSegmentId: 'seg_scurve_approach',
    arcLengthMeters: 8.4,
    distanceTraveled: 0,
    instantSpeedMps: 0,
    walkBlendWeight: 0,
    stridePhasePct: 0,
    headingYawDeg: 0,
    bankRollDeg: 0,
    gazeTargetId: 'holo_pylon'
  });

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastSpokenSegRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const showSplineGizmosRef = useRef<boolean>(showSplineGizmos);
  const showGazeRaysRef = useRef<boolean>(showGazeRays);
  const strideLengthRef = useRef<number>(strideLength);

  useEffect(() => {
    showSplineGizmosRef.current = showSplineGizmos;
  }, [showSplineGizmos]);

  useEffect(() => {
    showGazeRaysRef.current = showGazeRays;
  }, [showGazeRays]);

  useEffect(() => {
    strideLengthRef.current = strideLength;
  }, [strideLength]);

  const compiledVisemeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, VisemeCue[]>();
    manifest.dialogue.forEach((seg) => {
      map.set(seg.id, compileDialogueVisemes(seg));
    });
    return map;
  }, [manifest]);

  const activeSegment = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      manifest.dialogue.find(
        (seg) => currentTime >= seg.start && currentTime <= seg.end
      ) || null
    );
  }, [manifest.dialogue, currentTime]);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(manifest.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
    },
    [manifest.duration]
  );

  // Browser TTS Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || !activeSegment) {
      if (!isPlaying && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (lastSpokenSegRef.current !== activeSegment.id) {
      lastSpokenSegRef.current = activeSegment.id;
      if (ttsEnabled && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(activeSegment.text);
        utter.rate = 1.05;
        utter.pitch = activeSegment.speakerId.includes('zephyr') ? 0.85 : 1.12;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
      }
    }
  }, [activeSegment, isPlaying, ttsEnabled]);

  // Master Clock
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const delta = ((now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000) * playbackRate;
        let next = timeRef.current + delta;
        if (next >= manifest.duration) next = 0;
        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying, playbackRate, manifest.duration]);

  // Three.js Scene, Spline Geometry Builder & 60FPS Locomotion Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(manifest.world.background);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      46,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );
    camera.position.set(0, 4.2, 6.6);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0.8, 0);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.9));

    const objectMap = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();
    const characterRigs = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>();
    const splineGizmoGroup = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(splineGizmoGroup);

    manifest.assets.forEach((asset) => {
      if (asset.type === 'gltfCharacter') {
        const rig = createArticulatedLocomotionRig(asset, scene);
        rig.root.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialRotation) rig.root.rotation.set(...asset.initialRotation);
        scene.add(rig.root);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, rig.root);
        characterRigs.set(asset.id, rig);
      } else if (asset.type === 'pointLight') {
        const light = new THREE.PointLight(asset.color, 2.5, 25);
        light.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(light);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, light);
      } else if (asset.type === 'grid') {
        const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, asset.color, asset.color);
        grid.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(grid);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, grid);
      } else {
        const geo =
          asset.type === 'torusKnot'
            ? new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.55, 0.18, 80, 16)
            : new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: asset.color,
          emissive: asset.color,
          emissiveIntensity: 0.35,
          roughness: 0.25,
          metalness: 0.7
        });
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
        mesh.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialScale) mesh.scale.set(...asset.initialScale);
        scene.add(mesh);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, mesh);
      }
    });

    // Compile CatmullRomCurve3 segments & build 3D Ribbon + Waypoint Beacons
    const compiledSplineMap = new Map<string, CompiledSplineSegment[]>();

    manifest.tracks.forEach((track) => {
      if (track.property !== 'splinePath' || !track.segments) return;

      const charColor =
        manifest.assets.find((a) => a.id === track.targetId)?.accentColor || '#38bdf8';
      const compiledList: CompiledSplineSegment[] = [];

      track.segments.forEach((segDef, segIdx) => {
        const pts = segDef.waypoints.map((w) => new THREE.Vector3(w[0], w[1], w[2]));
        const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
          pts,
          Boolean(segDef.closed),
          'catmullrom',
          splineTension
        );
        // High-resolution arc-length table for uniform velocity
        curve.arcLengthDivisions = 300;
        curve.updateArcLengths();

        compiledList.push({
          def: segDef,
          curve,
          totalLength: curve.getLength()
        });

        // Visual 3D Tube along the Catmull-Rom Spline
        const tubeGeo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(
          curve,
          96,
          0.032,
          8,
          Boolean(segDef.closed)
        );
        const tubeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: segIdx === 0 ? charColor : '#f472b6',
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.65
        });
        const tubeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(tubeGeo, tubeMat);
        tubeMesh.position.y = 0.03;
        splineGizmoGroup.add(tubeMesh);

        // Waypoint Node Beacons
        pts.forEach((p, wpIdx) => {
          const wpMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.12, 0.12, 0.06, 16),
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
              color: wpIdx === 0 ? '#facc15' : charColor
            })
          );
          wpMesh.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.03, p.z);
          splineGizmoGroup.add(wpMesh);
        });
      });

      compiledSplineMap.set(track.targetId, compiledList);
    });

    let renderId: number;
    let frameCount = 0;

    const renderLoop = () => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      frameCount++;

      splineGizmoGroup.visible = showSplineGizmosRef.current;

      // 1. Evaluate non-character spatial tracks (like rotating hologram)
      manifest.tracks.forEach((tr) => {
        if (
          tr.property === 'rotation' &&
          tr.keyframes &&
          !characterRigs.has(tr.targetId)
        ) {
          const obj = objectMap.get(tr.targetId);
          if (obj) {
            const progress = t / manifest.duration;
            obj.rotation.set(progress * 6.28, progress * 12.56, 0);
          }
        }
      });

      // 2. Evaluate Spline Locomotion, Stride Phase & Base Skeletal Clips per Character
      characterRigs.forEach((rig) => {
        // Resolve current base gesture clip ('Idle', 'Explain', 'Wave')
        const clipTrack = manifest.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === rig.id && tr.property === 'animationClip'
        );
        let baseClip = 'Idle';
        if (clipTrack && clipTrack.keyframes) {
          for (let i = 0; i < clipTrack.keyframes.length; i++) {
            if (t >= clipTrack.keyframes[i].time) {
              baseClip = String(clipTrack.keyframes[i].value);
            }
          }
        }

        const compiledSegs = compiledSplineMap.get(rig.id) || [];
        const locoStats = evaluateSplineLocomotionAtTime(
          rig,
          compiledSegs,
          baseClip,
          strideLengthRef.current,
          t,
          showSplineGizmosRef.current
        );

        // 3. Resolve & Apply Post-Mixer Head/Eye Look-At IK
        const lookTrack = manifest.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === rig.id && tr.property === 'lookAtTarget'
        );
        let targetId = 'camera';
        if (lookTrack && lookTrack.keyframes) {
          for (let i = 0; i < lookTrack.keyframes.length; i++) {
            if (t >= lookTrack.keyframes[i].time) {
              targetId = String(lookTrack.keyframes[i].value);
            }
          }
        }

        let targetWorldPos = camera.position.clone();
        if (characterRigs.has(targetId)) {
          const otherRig = characterRigs.get(targetId)!;
          otherRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
          otherRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(targetWorldPos);
        } else if (objectMap.has(targetId)) {
          objectMap.get(targetId)!.getWorldPosition(targetWorldPos);
        }

        applyWalkingLookAtIK(rig, targetWorldPos, t, showGazeRaysRef.current);

        // 4. Apply TTS Viseme Lip-Sync
        const visemes = evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
          rig.id,
          manifest.dialogue,
          compiledVisemeMap,
          t
        );
        rig.morphMeshes.forEach((mesh) => {
          const dict = mesh.morphTargetDictionary;
          const inf = mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
          if (!dict || !inf) return;
          ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName) => {
            const idx = dict[vName];
            if (typeof idx === 'number') {
              inf[idx] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inf[idx], visemes[vName] || 0, 0.45);
            }
          });
        });

        if (rig.id === inspectedCharId && frameCount % 3 === 0) {
          setTelemetry({ ...locoStats, gazeTargetId: targetId });
        }
      });

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(renderId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [manifest, compiledVisemeMap, inspectedCharId, splineTension]);

  const characterAssets = manifest.assets.filter((a) => a.type === 'gltfCharacter');

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-6 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-5">
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              3D Catmull-Rom Spline Locomotion & Arc-Length Stride Engine
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mt-1">{manifest.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{manifest.subtitle}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {SAMPLE_SCENES.map((s, idx) => (
              <button
                key={s.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSampleIdx(idx);
                  setInspectedCharId('actor_aria');
                  seek(0);
                  setIsPlaying(true);
                }}
                className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  sampleIdx === idx
                    ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20'
                    : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
                }`}
              >
                Sample {idx + 1}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Grid: 3D Viewport + Live Spline Locomotion Inspector */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {/* 3D Viewport (2 Cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[460px] bg-black">
              <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Top Telemetry Pill */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300 pointer-events-none">
                <span
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                    isPlaying ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-400'
                  }`}
                />
                <span className="font-mono">
                  T+{currentTime.toFixed(2)}s / {manifest.duration.toFixed(1)}s
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-sky-400 font-semibold">
                  Speed: {telemetry.instantSpeedMps.toFixed(2)} m/s
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                  Walk Blend: {Math.round(telemetry.walkBlendWeight * 100)}%
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Subtitles */}
              {activeSegment && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-4 inset-x-5 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-5 py-3 rounded-xl text-center shadow-2xl">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-sky-400 mb-1">
                      {activeSegment.speaker}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-white leading-relaxed">
                      {activeSegment.text}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Scrubber & Transport Controls */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={manifest.duration}
                step={0.02}
                value={currentTime}
                onChange={(e) => seek(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              />

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition"
                  >
                    {isPlaying ? <Pause className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Play className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    {isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => seek(0)}
                    className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() =>
                      setPlaybackRate((r) => (r === 1 ? 0.5 : r === 0.5 ? 1.5 : 1))
                    }
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono"
                  >
                    <FastForward className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                    {playbackRate}x
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowSplineGizmos(!showSplineGizmos)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      showSplineGizmos
                        ? 'bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Route className="w-4 h-4" /> 3D Spline & Tangents
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowGazeRays(!showGazeRays)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      showGazeRays
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-4 h-4" /> Gaze Rays
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setTtsEnabled(!ttsEnabled)}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition ${
                      ttsEnabled
                        ? 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {ttsEnabled ? (
                      <>
                        <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" /> TTS On
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4" /> TTS
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Panel: Spline Parameter Sliders & Locomotion Telemetry */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {/* Character Selector */}
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" /> Inspected Walker Rig
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {characterAssets.map((char) => (
                  <button
                    key={char.id}
                    onClick={() => setInspectedCharId(char.id)}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium border transition ${
                      inspectedCharId === char.id
                        ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/50 text-sky-300'
                        : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800 text-slate-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {char.name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Interactive Spline & Stride Tuning Sliders */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-300">
                <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                Live Spline & Stride Parameters
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Stride Length (Foot Lock)</span>
                  <span className="text-sky-400">{strideLength.toFixed(2)} m/cycle</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min={0.65}
                  max={2.2}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={strideLength}
                  onChange={(e) => setStrideLength(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Catmull-Rom Curve Tension</span>
                  <span className="text-sky-400">{splineTension.toFixed(2)}</span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min={0.0}
                  max={1.0}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={splineTension}
                  onChange={(e) => setSplineTension(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Live Arc-Length & Tangent Heading Telemetry */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-2.5 text-xs font-mono">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-300 font-sans font-semibold">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Footprints className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  Arc-Length Stride Telemetry
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400">
                  {telemetry.activeSegmentId}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Distance / Total</div>
                  <div className="text-sky-300 font-semibold mt-0.5">
                    {telemetry.distanceTraveled}m / {telemetry.arcLengthMeters}m
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-900 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Tangent Yaw / Roll</div>
                  <div className="text-emerald-300 font-semibold mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Compass className="w-3 h-3" />
                    {telemetry.headingYawDeg}° / {telemetry.bankRollDeg}°
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] mb-1">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">Stride Cycle Phase (d / L_stride)</span>
                  <span className="text-emerald-400">{telemetry.stridePhasePct}%</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-emerald-400 transition-all duration-75"
                    style={{ width: `${telemetry.stridePhasePct}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Dialogue Cue List */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1 max-h-40">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-1">
                <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" /> Dialogue Cues
              </div>
              {manifest.dialogue.map((seg) => (
                <button
                  key={seg.id}
                  onClick={() => seek(seg.start)}
                  className={`w-full text-left p-2 rounded-lg text-xs border transition ${
                    activeSegment?.id === seg.id
                      ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/50 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/50'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400">
                    <span>{seg.speaker}</span>
                    <span>
                      {seg.start.toFixed(1)}s – {seg.end.toFixed(1)}s
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="truncate mt-0.5">{seg.text}</p>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
4. Why This Solves Multi-Hour Character Blocking for Small LLMs
Zero Math Burden on the LLM: A small 8B parameter model does not need to compute quaternions, movement velocities, or walk-cycle timing. It simply outputs semantic waypoints ([[-3, 0, -2], [0, 0, 1], [2, 0, 1.5]]) and a start/end window.

Upper/Lower Body Decoupling: Because evaluateSplineLocomotionAtTime blends the Walk clip based on ground velocity while preserving upper-body gesture tracks (Explain, Wave) and the post-mixer applyWalkingLookAtIK pass, characters can naturally walk, gesture with their hands, turn their head toward a companion, and speak with synchronized lip-sync simultaneously.

Where should we take the engine next?

Build the TTS-to-Timeline symbolic anchor compiler

Design the small-LLM system prompt & JSON generator

Add automated camera director rules (over-the-shoulder & tracking shots)
Extend the camera system with declarative cinematography rules like over-the-shoulder shots, two-shots, and dolly tracking along character splines.

Declarative cinematography decouples narrative intent ("show a reverse over-the-shoulder shot of Aria listening to Zephyr, then smoothly dolly alongside Aria as she walks") from frame-by-frame 3D camera math. Instead of requiring an LLM or author to guess world-space [x, y, z] camera coordinates while characters move along curves, a Camera Director pass runs each frame after spline locomotion and skeletal IK have updated every bone's world matrix.

1. Mathematical Architecture of the Declarative Camera Director
To guarantee that shots never cross the 180-degree line of action or clip through character geometry, every shot rule computes its camera transform dynamically from the live world positions of the referenced subjectId and secondaryId.

Scrub-Safe Shot Blending vs. Hard Cuts
In traditional game engines, smoothing the camera with camera.position.lerp() makes timeline scrubbing non-deterministic (dragging the playhead from 15s to 4s causes the camera to fly across the room). Instead, our director evaluates shots purely as a function of timestamp

3. React + Three.js Renderer with Declarative Camera Director & Picture-in-Picture Crane Monitor
Install three and lucide-react (npm install three lucide-react). This complete component adds:

Declarative Camera Director Engine: Evaluates twoShot, overTheShoulder, splineDolly (lead, parallel, follow), closeUp, and establishingOrbit shots with automatic 180-degree line enforcement and focal-length (fov) animation.

Picture-in-Picture (PiP) Overhead Director's Monitor: Renders a live secondary WebGL pass in the top-right corner showing an overhead crane view of the stage, complete with a 3D wireframe camera frustum (THREE.CameraHelper), the 180° Line of Action axis, and the Catmull-Rom spline paths so you can watch the virtual camera crew move in real time.

Interactive Shot Switchboard & Framing Guides: Toggle Rule-of-Thirds + 2.35:1 Anamorphic Guides, or override the timeline with one-click live camera presets.

TypeScript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {
  Play,
  Pause,
  RotateCcw,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Sparkles,
  Video,
  Camera,
  Grid,
  Compass,
  Clock,
  FastForward,
  Sliders,
  Eye,
  Film
} from 'lucide-react';

// ============================================================================
// 1. SCHEMA & TYPES (DECLARATIVE CINEMATOGRAPHY + SPLINE + IK + VISEMES)
// ============================================================================

type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];
type EasingType = 'linear' | 'easeInOutQuad' | 'smoothstep';

export type ShotType =
  | 'twoShot'
  | 'overTheShoulder'
  | 'splineDolly'
  | 'closeUp'
  | 'establishingOrbit';

export type DollySubMode = 'lead' | 'follow' | 'parallel';

export interface CameraShotRule {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  startTime: number;
  endTime: number;
  shotType: ShotType;
  subjectId: string;           // Primary framed actor or asset ID
  secondaryId?: string;        // Secondary actor (for twoShot or overTheShoulder)
  side?: 'left' | 'right';     // Enforces the 180-degree line of action
  dollyMode?: DollySubMode;    // For 'splineDolly': lead, follow, or parallel
  distance?: number;           // Camera standoff distance (meters)
  heightOffset?: number;       // Vertical camera offset relative to eye/chest level
  lateralOffset?: number;      // Horizontal framing offset (rule of thirds / shoulder offset)
  fov?: number;                // Vertical field of view (e.g., 28 = 85mm close-up, 46 = 45mm)
  transitionDuration?: number; // 0 = Hard Cut; > 0 = Smooth scrub-safe crane blend (seconds)
}

export type VisemeName =
  | 'viseme_sil'
  | 'viseme_PP'
  | 'viseme_FF'
  | 'viseme_TH'
  | 'viseme_DD'
  | 'viseme_kk'
  | 'viseme_CH'
  | 'viseme_SS'
  | 'viseme_RR'
  | 'viseme_aa'
  | 'viseme_E'
  | 'viseme_I'
  | 'viseme_O'
  | 'viseme_U';

const ALL_VISEMES: VisemeName[] = [
  'viseme_sil',
  'viseme_PP',
  'viseme_FF',
  'viseme_TH',
  'viseme_DD',
  'viseme_kk',
  'viseme_CH',
  'viseme_SS',
  'viseme_RR',
  'viseme_aa',
  'viseme_E',
  'viseme_I',
  'viseme_O',
  'viseme_U'
];

interface SplineSegmentDefinition {
  id: string;
  startTime: number;
  endTime: number;
  waypoints: Vector3Tuple[];
  tension?: number;
  closed?: boolean;
  strideLength?: number;
  easing?: EasingType;
  bankFactor?: number;
}

interface AssetDefinition {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'gltfCharacter' | 'torusKnot' | 'box' | 'grid' | 'pointLight';
  color: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  initialPosition: Vector3Tuple;
  initialRotation?: Vector3Tuple;
  initialScale?: Vector3Tuple;
}

interface Keyframe<T = any> {
  time: number;
  value: T;
  crossFade?: number;
  weight?: number;
}

interface AnimationTrack {
  targetId: string;
  property: 'rotation' | 'animationClip' | 'lookAtTarget' | 'splinePath';
  keyframes?: Keyframe[];
  segments?: SplineSegmentDefinition[];
}

interface VisemeCue {
  time: number;
  duration: number;
  viseme: VisemeName;
  weight: number;
}

interface DialogueSegment {
  id: string;
  speakerId: string;
  speaker: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  text: string;
}

interface SceneManifest {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  duration: number;
  world: { background: string };
  assets: AssetDefinition[];
  tracks: AnimationTrack[];
  cameraShots: CameraShotRule[];
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[];
}

interface CharacterRigInstance {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  morphMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
  hipsBone: THREE.Bone;
  spineBone: THREE.Bone;
  headBone: THREE.Bone;
  jawBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyeLBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyeRBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyelidLMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  eyelidRMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  smoothedHeadingQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedSpineOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedHeadOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedEyeLQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedEyeRQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  // Last evaluated spline tangent & position for Spline Dolly Camera attachment
  currentSplineTangent: THREE.Vector3;
  currentSpeedMps: number;
}

interface EvaluatedCameraPose {
  position: THREE.Vector3;
  lookAt: THREE.Vector3;
  fov: number;
  shotLabel: string;
  shotType: ShotType;
  focalLengthMm: number;
  transitionAlpha: number;
  lineOfActionStart?: THREE.Vector3;
  lineOfActionEnd?: THREE.Vector3;
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. VISEME & EASING UTILITIES
// ============================================================================

function smoothstep(x: number): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  return c * c * (3 - 2 * c);
}

function applySplineEasing(alpha: number, mode: EasingType = 'smoothstep'): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, alpha));
  if (mode === 'smoothstep') return smoothstep(c);
  if (mode === 'easeInOutQuad') {
    return c < 0.5 ? 2 * c * c : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * c + 2, 2) / 2;
  }
  return c;
}

function fovToFocalLengthMm(fovDeg: number): number {
  // Standard 24mm vertical 35mm sensor height: f = 12 / tan(fov / 2)
  const rad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(Math.max(10, Math.min(120, fovDeg)));
  return Math.round(12 / Math.tan(rad / 2));
}

function compileDialogueVisemes(segment: DialogueSegment): VisemeCue[] {
  const cleanText = segment.text.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/g, '');
  const words = cleanText.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0) return [];

  const totalDuration = Math.max(0.2, segment.end - segment.start);
  const totalChars = words.reduce((acc, w) => acc + w.length + 1, 0);
  const secPerChar = totalDuration / Math.max(1, totalChars);

  const cues: VisemeCue[] = [];
  let cursor = segment.start;

  const charToViseme = (ch: string): VisemeName => {
    switch (ch.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'a':
        return 'viseme_aa';
      case 'e':
        return 'viseme_E';
      case 'i':
      case 'y':
        return 'viseme_I';
      case 'o':
        return 'viseme_O';
      case 'u':
      case 'w':
        return 'viseme_U';
      case 'p':
      case 'b':
      case 'm':
        return 'viseme_PP';
      case 'f':
      case 'v':
        return 'viseme_FF';
      case 't':
      case 'd':
      case 'n':
        return 'viseme_DD';
      case 'k':
      case 'g':
      case 'c':
        return 'viseme_kk';
      case 's':
      case 'z':
        return 'viseme_SS';
      case 'r':
      case 'l':
        return 'viseme_RR';
      default:
        return 'viseme_sil';
    }
  };

  words.forEach((word) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < word.length; i++) {
      const viseme = charToViseme(word[i]);
      const isVowel = ['viseme_aa', 'viseme_E', 'viseme_I', 'viseme_O', 'viseme_U'].includes(
        viseme
      );
      cues.push({
        time: cursor,
        duration: secPerChar * (isVowel ? 1.25 : 0.85),
        viseme,
        weight: isVowel ? 0.95 : 0.7
      });
      cursor += secPerChar;
    }
    cues.push({
      time: cursor,
      duration: secPerChar * 0.8,
      viseme: 'viseme_sil',
      weight: 0.1
    });
    cursor += secPerChar;
  });

  return cues;
}

function evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
  speakerId: string,
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[],
  compiledMap: Map<string, VisemeCue[]>,
  t: number
): Record<VisemeName, number> {
  const weights: any = {};
  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (weights[v] = 0));

  const activeSeg = dialogue.find(
    (d) => d.speakerId === speakerId && t >= d.start && t <= d.end
  );
  if (!activeSeg) {
    weights.viseme_sil = 1;
    return weights;
  }

  const cues = compiledMap.get(activeSeg.id) || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cues.length; i++) {
    const cue = cues[i];
    const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
    const halfWidth = Math.max(0.04, cue.duration * 0.85);
    const dist = Math.abs(t - center);
    if (dist < halfWidth) {
      const influence = Math.cos((dist / halfWidth) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight;
      weights[cue.viseme] = Math.min(1, Math.max(weights[cue.viseme], influence));
    }
  }
  return weights;
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. 15-BONE ARTICULATED HUMANOID RIG BUILDER
