function createArticulatedCharacterRig(asset: AssetDefinition): CharacterRigInstance {
  const root = new THREE.Group();

  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.02, 0);
  root.add(hipsBone);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.35, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.72, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  const jawBone = new THREE.Bone();
  jawBone.name = 'Jaw';
  jawBone.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.3);
  headBone.add(jawBone);

  const eyeLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  eyeLBone.name = 'EyeL';
  eyeLBone.position.set(-0.14, 0.08, 0.28);
  headBone.add(eyeLBone);

  const eyeRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  eyeRBone.name = 'EyeR';
  eyeRBone.position.set(0.14, 0.08, 0.28);
  headBone.add(eyeRBone);

  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const forearmLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmLBone.name = 'ForearmL';
  forearmLBone.position.set(-0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(forearmLBone);

  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const forearmRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmRBone.name = 'ForearmR';
  forearmRBone.position.set(0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(forearmRBone);

  const thighLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighLBone.name = 'ThighL';
  thighLBone.position.set(-0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighLBone);

  const shinLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinLBone.name = 'ShinL';
  shinLBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighLBone.add(shinLBone);

  const footLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  footLBone.name = 'FootL';
  footLBone.position.set(0, -0.44, 0.08);
  shinLBone.add(footLBone);

  const thighRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighRBone.name = 'ThighR';
  thighRBone.position.set(0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighRBone);

  const shinRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinRBone.name = 'ShinR';
  shinRBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighRBone.add(shinRBone);

  const footRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  footRBone.name = 'FootR';
  footRBone.position.set(0, -0.44, 0.08);
  shinRBone.add(footRBone);

  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.color,
    roughness: 0.32,
    metalness: 0.45
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.65
  });
  const accentMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: asset.accentColor || '#38bdf8',
    emissive: asset.accentColor || '#0284c7',
    emissiveIntensity: 0.55
  });
  const scleraMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#f8fafc', roughness: 0.15 });
  const pupilMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#020617' });

  hipsBone.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.72, 0.24, 0.42), darkMat));

  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.86, 0.88, 0.46), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.14, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  const chestBadge = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.18, 0.06), accentMat);
  chestBadge.position.set(0, 0.28, 0.24);
  spineBone.add(chestBadge);

  const upperArmGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const armL = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armL.position.set(-0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(armL);

  const handL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handL.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmLBone.add(handL);

  const armR = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armR.position.set(0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(armR);

  const handR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handR.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmRBone.add(handR);

  const thighGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const shinGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const footGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.22, 0.12, 0.38);

  const thighLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighLBone.add(thighLMesh);

  const shinLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinLBone.add(shinLMesh);

  const footLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(footGeo, accentMat);
  footLMesh.position.set(0, -0.02, 0.05);
  footLBone.add(footLMesh);

  const thighRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighRBone.add(thighRMesh);

  const shinRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinRBone.add(shinRMesh);

  const footRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(footGeo, accentMat);
  footRMesh.position.set(0, -0.02, 0.05);
  footRBone.add(footRMesh);

  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.62, 0.6), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const socketFrame = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.54, 0.22, 0.08), darkMat);
  socketFrame.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.27);
  headBone.add(socketFrame);

  const buildEye = (eyeBone: THREE.Bone) => {
    const sclera = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.088, 20, 20), scleraMat);
    sclera.scale.set(1, 1, 0.85);
    eyeBone.add(sclera);

    const iris = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.044, 0.044, 0.02, 16),
      accentMat
    );
    iris.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    iris.position.set(0, 0, 0.072);
    eyeBone.add(iris);

    const pupil = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.022, 0.022, 0.025, 12),
      pupilMat
    );
    pupil.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    pupil.position.set(0, 0, 0.076);
    eyeBone.add(pupil);

    const eyelid = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.19, 0.19, 0.16), bodyMat);
    eyelid.position.set(0, 0.09, 0.02);
    eyelid.scale.y = 0.05;
    eyeBone.add(eyelid);
    return eyelid;
  };

  const eyelidLMesh = buildEye(eyeLBone);
  const eyelidRMesh = buildEye(eyeRBone);

  // Viseme Mouth Mesh
  const baseMouthGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.32, 0.075, 0.1, 8, 4, 2);
  const basePos = baseMouthGeo.attributes.position;
  const morphPositions: THREE.BufferAttribute[] = [];
  const morphDict: Record<string, number> = {};

  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName, idx) => {
    morphDict[vName] = idx;
    const cloned = basePos.clone();
    for (let i = 0; i < cloned.count; i++) {
      let x = cloned.getX(i);
      let y = cloned.getY(i);
      let z = cloned.getZ(i);
      if (vName === 'viseme_aa') {
        y *= 3.6;
        x *= 1.15;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_O') {
        y *= 3.0;
        x *= 0.62;
        z += 0.04;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_U') {
        y *= 2.0;
        x *= 0.45;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_E' || vName === 'viseme_I') {
        y *= 2.0;
        x *= 1.35;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_PP') {
        y *= 0.25;
      } else {
        y *= 1.6;
      }
      cloned.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    morphPositions.push(cloned);
  });
  baseMouthGeo.morphAttributes.position = morphPositions;

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(baseMouthGeo, accentMat);
  mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary = morphDict;
  mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences = new Array(ALL_VISEMES.length).fill(0);
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.14, 0.29);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  const qEuler = (x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(x, y, z)).toArray();

  const walkTimes = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0];
  const walkClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Walk', 1.0, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      walkTimes,
      [-0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, 0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, -0.03, 0.99, 0]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.42, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.42, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.42, 0, -0.08)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.42, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.42, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.42, 0, 0.08)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const gTimes = [0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4];
  const idleClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Idle', 2.4, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      gTimes,
      [0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0]
    )
  ]);

  const explainClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Explain', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, -0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.6, 0.1, -0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.0, -0.2, -0.6),
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0.2, 0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, 0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.65, 0.1, 0.35),
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const waveClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Wave', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 1.95),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  [
    ['Idle', idleClip],
    ['Walk', walkClip],
    ['Explain', explainClip],
    ['Wave', waveClip]
  ].forEach(([name, clip]) => {
    const act = mixer.clipAction(clip as THREE.AnimationClip);
    act.play();
    act.setEffectiveWeight(name === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
    actions.set(name as string, act);
  });

  const initRotY = asset.initialRotation ? asset.initialRotation[1] : 0;

  return {
    id: asset.id,
    name: asset.name,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    hipsBone,
    spineBone,
    headBone,
    jawBone,
    eyeLBone,
    eyeRBone,
    eyelidLMesh,
    eyelidRMesh,
    smoothedHeadingQuat: new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
      new THREE.Euler(0, initRotY, 0)
    ),
    smoothedSpineOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedEyeLQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedEyeRQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    currentSplineTangent: new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(initRotY), 0, Math.cos(initRotY)),
    currentSpeedMps: 0
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. DECLARATIVE CINEMATOGRAPHY & CAMERA DIRECTOR SOLVER
// ============================================================================

interface CompiledSplineSegment {
  def: SplineSegmentDefinition;
  curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3;
  totalLength: number;
}

/**
 * Evaluates a single declarative CameraShotRule at timestamp t, returning exact
 * world camera position, lookAt point, FOV, and 180-degree line-of-action endpoints.
 */
function solveSingleShotRule(
  shot: CameraShotRule,
  characterRigs: Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>,
  objectMap: Map<string, THREE.Object3D>,
  t: number
): {
  position: THREE.Vector3;
  lookAt: THREE.Vector3;
  fov: number;
  lineStart?: THREE.Vector3;
  lineEnd?: THREE.Vector3;
} {
  const getSubjectAnchor = (
    id: string
  ): { eyePos: THREE.Vector3; forward: THREE.Vector3 } => {
    const rig = characterRigs.get(id);
    if (rig) {
      rig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      const headWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
      rig.headBone.getWorldPosition(headWorld);
      headWorld.y += 0.04;
      const fwd = rig.currentSplineTangent.clone().normalize();
      if (fwd.lengthSq() < 0.01) fwd.set(0, 0, 1);
      return { eyePos: headWorld, forward: fwd };
    }
    const obj = objectMap.get(id);
    if (obj) {
      const pos = new THREE.Vector3();
      obj.getWorldPosition(pos);
      return { eyePos: pos, forward: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1) };
    }
    return {
      eyePos: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.6, 0),
      forward: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1)
    };
  };

  const primary = getSubjectAnchor(shot.subjectId);
  const secondary = shot.secondaryId
    ? getSubjectAnchor(shot.secondaryId)
    : {
        eyePos: primary.eyePos.clone().add(primary.forward.clone().multiplyScalar(2)),
        forward: primary.forward.clone().negate()
      };

  const sideSign = shot.side === 'left' ? -1 : 1;
  const fov = shot.fov ?? 42;
  const heightOff = shot.heightOffset ?? 0.05;

  // Compute 180-Degree Line of Action Vector (Primary -> Secondary on XZ plane)
  const lineVec = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(secondary.eyePos, primary.eyePos);
  const horizLine = new THREE.Vector3(lineVec.x, 0, lineVec.z);
  const separationDist = Math.max(0.5, horizLine.length());
  const lineDir = horizLine.clone().normalize();

  // Perpendicular 180° Side Normal (Right-hand normal rotated by sideSign)
  const sideNormal = new THREE.Vector3(
    -lineDir.z * sideSign,
    0,
    lineDir.x * sideSign
  ).normalize();

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // RULE 1: DYNAMIC TWO-SHOT (Frames both actors & scales distance with separation)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (shot.shotType === 'twoShot') {
    const midpoint = new THREE.Vector3()
      .addVectors(primary.eyePos, secondary.eyePos)
      .multiplyScalar(0.5);
    midpoint.y += heightOff - 0.12;

    const halfFovRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(fov * 0.5);
    // Automatically scale standoff distance so wide separations never clip actors at screen edges
    const adaptiveDist = Math.max(
      shot.distance ?? 2.8,
      (separationDist * 0.82) / Math.tan(halfFovRad)
    );

    const camPos = midpoint
      .clone()
      .add(sideNormal.clone().multiplyScalar(adaptiveDist));
    camPos.y = Math.max(0.7, midpoint.y + 0.18);

    return {
      position: camPos,
      lookAt: midpoint,
      fov,
      lineStart: primary.eyePos,
      lineEnd: secondary.eyePos
    };
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // RULE 2: OVER-THE-SHOULDER (OTS / Reverse OTS respecting the 180° axis)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (shot.shotType === 'overTheShoulder') {
    // `subjectId` is the framed target speaker; `secondaryId` is the foreground shoulder anchor!
    const targetPos = primary.eyePos;
    const shoulderAnchorPos = secondary.eyePos;

    // Direction from Foreground Shoulder Anchor -> Framed Target Speaker
    const anchorToTarget = new THREE.Vector3()
      .subVectors(targetPos, shoulderAnchorPos)
      .setY(0)
      .normalize();

    // Camera stays on the SAME side of the 180-degree line regardless of who is subject vs secondary!
    const canonicalSideNormal = sideNormal;
    const behindDist = shot.distance ?? 1.15;
    const shoulderLateral = shot.lateralOffset ?? 0.46;

    const camPos = shoulderAnchorPos
      .clone()
      .add(anchorToTarget.clone().multiplyScalar(-behindDist))
      .add(canonicalSideNormal.clone().multiplyScalar(shoulderLateral));
    camPos.y = shoulderAnchorPos.y - 0.04 + heightOff;

    // LookAt point biased 78% toward the target speaker and 22% toward the foreground shoulder
    // so the target sits on the far rule-of-thirds vertical line and the shoulder frames the near third
    const lookAtPoint = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(
      shoulderAnchorPos,
      targetPos,
      0.78
    );
    lookAtPoint.y = targetPos.y - 0.06;

    return {
      position: camPos,
      lookAt: lookAtPoint,
      fov: shot.fov ?? 34,
      lineStart: primary.eyePos,
      lineEnd: secondary.eyePos
    };
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // RULE 3: SPLINE DOLLY TRACKING ('lead', 'follow', 'parallel')
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (shot.shotType === 'splineDolly') {
    const tangent = primary.forward.clone().setY(0).normalize();
    const rightVec = new THREE.Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x).normalize();
    const dist = shot.distance ?? 2.3;
    const lat = shot.lateralOffset ?? 0.4;
    const mode = shot.dollyMode || 'lead';

    let camPos = primary.eyePos.clone();
    if (mode === 'lead') {
      // Steadicam walking backward in front of the character
      camPos
        .add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(dist))
        .add(rightVec.clone().multiplyScalar(lat));
    } else if (mode === 'follow') {
      // Chase dolly trailing behind the character's shoulder
      camPos
        .add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(-dist))
        .add(rightVec.clone().multiplyScalar(lat));
    } else {
      // Parallel dolly rail gliding alongside the character
      camPos.add(rightVec.clone().multiplyScalar(dist * sideSign));
    }
    camPos.y = primary.eyePos.y + heightOff - 0.08;

    const lookAtPoint = primary.eyePos
      .clone()
      .add(tangent.clone().multiplyScalar(mode === 'follow' ? 0.6 : 0.0));
    lookAtPoint.y = primary.eyePos.y - 0.1;

    return {
      position: camPos,
      lookAt: lookAtPoint,
      fov
    };
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // RULE 4: 85mm PORTRAIT CLOSE-UP ('closeUp')
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  if (shot.shotType === 'closeUp') {
    const dist = shot.distance ?? 1.55;
    const angleDir = shot.secondaryId
      ? lineDir
          .clone()
          .negate()
          .add(sideNormal.clone().multiplyScalar(0.45))
          .normalize()
      : primary.forward.clone();

    const camPos = primary.eyePos
      .clone()
      .add(angleDir.multiplyScalar(dist));
    camPos.y = primary.eyePos.y + heightOff - 0.02;

    const lookAtPoint = primary.eyePos.clone();
    lookAtPoint.y -= 0.04;

    return {
      position: camPos,
      lookAt: lookAtPoint,
      fov: shot.fov ?? 28
    };
  }

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // RULE 5: ESTABLISHING CRANE ORBIT ('establishingOrbit')
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const radius = shot.distance ?? 6.5;
  const orbitAngle = t * 0.35 + 0.4;
  const camPos = new THREE.Vector3(
    primary.eyePos.x + Math.sin(orbitAngle) * radius,
    primary.eyePos.y + (shot.heightOffset ?? 2.0),
    primary.eyePos.z + Math.cos(orbitAngle) * radius
  );

  return {
    position: camPos,
    lookAt: primary.eyePos.clone(),
    fov: shot.fov ?? 50
  };
}

/**
 * Evaluates the active camera shot (or live manual override) at timestamp t,
 * handling both instant editorial cuts and scrub-safe multi-second crane blends.
 */
function evaluateCameraDirectorAtTime(
  shots: CameraShotRule[],
  overrideShot: CameraShotRule | null,
  characterRigs: Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>,
  objectMap: Map<string, THREE.Object3D>,
  t: number
): EvaluatedCameraPose {
  if (overrideShot) {
    const solved = solveSingleShotRule(overrideShot, characterRigs, objectMap, t);
    return {
      position: solved.position,
      lookAt: solved.lookAt,
      fov: solved.fov,
      shotLabel: `[Manual Override] ${overrideShot.label}`,
      shotType: overrideShot.shotType,
      focalLengthMm: fovToFocalLengthMm(solved.fov),
      transitionAlpha: 1,
      lineOfActionStart: solved.lineStart,
      lineOfActionEnd: solved.lineEnd
    };
  }

  let activeIdx = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < shots.length; i++) {
    if (t >= shots[i].startTime) {
      activeIdx = i;
    }
  }

  const currentShot = shots[activeIdx];
  const prevShot = activeIdx > 0 ? shots[activeIdx - 1] : null;
  const transDur = currentShot.transitionDuration ?? 0;
  const elapsedInShot = t - currentShot.startTime;

  const curSolved = solveSingleShotRule(currentShot, characterRigs, objectMap, t);

  // If inside a smooth crane/dolly transition window, evaluate outgoing shot at t and blend!
  if (prevShot && transDur > 0 && elapsedInShot >= 0 && elapsedInShot < transDur) {
    const alpha = smoothstep(elapsedInShot / transDur);
    const prevSolved = solveSingleShotRule(prevShot, characterRigs, objectMap, t);

    const blendedPos = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(
      prevSolved.position,
      curSolved.position,
      alpha
    );
    const blendedLook = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(
      prevSolved.lookAt,
      curSolved.lookAt,
      alpha
    );
    const blendedFov = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(prevSolved.fov, curSolved.fov, alpha);

    return {
      position: blendedPos,
      lookAt: blendedLook,
      fov: blendedFov,
      shotLabel: `${currentShot.label} (Blending ${Math.round(alpha * 100)}%)`,
      shotType: currentShot.shotType,
      focalLengthMm: fovToFocalLengthMm(blendedFov),
      transitionAlpha: alpha,
      lineOfActionStart: curSolved.lineStart,
      lineOfActionEnd: curSolved.lineEnd
    };
  }

  return {
    position: curSolved.position,
    lookAt: curSolved.lookAt,
    fov: curSolved.fov,
    shotLabel: currentShot.label,
    shotType: currentShot.shotType,
    focalLengthMm: fovToFocalLengthMm(curSolved.fov),
    transitionAlpha: 1,
    lineOfActionStart: curSolved.lineStart,
    lineOfActionEnd: curSolved.lineEnd
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 6. MAIN REACT COMPONENT (CINEMA VIEWPORT + PIP OVERHEAD CRANE MONITOR)
// ============================================================================

const LIVE_OVERRIDE_PRESETS: { id: string; label: string; rule: CameraShotRule | null }[] = [
  { id: 'auto', label: 'Timeline Auto-Director', rule: null },
  {

    label: 'OTS: Past Zephyr → Aria',
    rule: {
      id: 'ovr_ots_aria',
      label: 'OTS past Zephyr onto Aria (35° FOV)',
      startTime: 0,
      endTime: 99,
      shotType: 'overTheShoulder',
      subjectId: 'actor_aria',
      secondaryId: 'actor_zephyr',
      side: 'right',
      fov: 34
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'ots_zephyr',
    label: 'Reverse OTS: Past Aria → Zephyr',
    rule: {
      id: 'ovr_ots_zephyr',
      label: 'Reverse OTS past Aria onto Zephyr (35° FOV)',
      startTime: 0,
      endTime: 99,
      shotType: 'overTheShoulder',
      subjectId: 'actor_zephyr',
      secondaryId: 'actor_aria',
      side: 'right',
      fov: 34
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'twoshot',
    label: 'Dynamic Two-Shot (180° Safe)',
    rule: {

      label: 'Adaptive Two-Shot (45° FOV)',
      startTime: 0,
      endTime: 99,
      shotType: 'twoShot',
      subjectId: 'actor_aria',
      secondaryId: 'actor_zephyr',
      side: 'right',
      fov: 45
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'dolly_lead',
    label: 'Spline Lead Steadicam',
    rule: {

      startTime: 0,

      shotType: 'splineDolly',

    }
  },
  {

    rule: {

      label: 'Spline Parallel Side-Dolly on Aria',

      shotType: 'splineDolly',

    }
  },
  {
    id: 'closeup_85mm',
    label: '85mm Close-Up (Aria)',
    rule: {

      label: '85mm Portrait Close-Up (28° FOV)',
      startTime: 0,
      endTime: 99,

];

export default function DeclarativeCameraDirectorPlayer() {
  const [sampleIdx, setSampleIdx] = useState<number>(0);
  const manifest = SAMPLE_SCENES[sampleIdx];

  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [playbackRate, setPlaybackRate] = useState<number>(1);
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showCompositionGuides, setShowCompositionGuides] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [showPipCraneView, setShowPipCraneView] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [activeOverrideId, setActiveOverrideId] = useState<string>('auto');

  const [camTelemetry, setCamTelemetry] = useState<{
    shotLabel: string;
    shotType: ShotType;
    fov: number;
    focalLengthMm: number;
    transitionAlpha: number;
    camPos: string;
  }>({
    shotLabel: manifest.cameraShots[0].label,
    shotType: manifest.cameraShots[0].shotType,
    fov: 44,
    focalLengthMm: 30,
    transitionAlpha: 1,
    camPos: '[0.0, 1.6, 3.0]'
  });

  const mainMountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const pipMountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastSpokenSegRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const overrideRuleRef = useRef<CameraShotRule | null>(null);
  const showPipRef = useRef<boolean>(showPipCraneView);

  useEffect(() => {
    const preset = LIVE_OVERRIDE_PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === activeOverrideId);
    overrideRuleRef.current = preset ? preset.rule : null;
  }, [activeOverrideId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    showPipRef.current = showPipCraneView;
  }, [showPipCraneView]);

  const compiledVisemeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, VisemeCue[]>();
    manifest.dialogue.forEach((seg) => {
      map.set(seg.id, compileDialogueVisemes(seg));
    });
    return map;
  }, [manifest]);

  const activeSegment = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      manifest.dialogue.find(
        (seg) => currentTime >= seg.start && currentTime <= seg.end
      ) || null
    );
  }, [manifest.dialogue, currentTime]);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(manifest.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
    },
    [manifest.duration]
  );

  // Browser Web Speech TTS Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || !activeSegment) {
      if (!isPlaying && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (lastSpokenSegRef.current !== activeSegment.id) {
      lastSpokenSegRef.current = activeSegment.id;
      if (ttsEnabled && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(activeSegment.text);
        utter.rate = 1.05;
        utter.pitch = activeSegment.speakerId.includes('zephyr') ? 0.85 : 1.12;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
      }
    }
  }, [activeSegment, isPlaying, ttsEnabled]);

  // Master Clock
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const delta = ((now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000) * playbackRate;
        let next = timeRef.current + delta;
        if (next >= manifest.duration) next = 0;
        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying, playbackRate, manifest.duration]);

  // Three.js Scene + Dual Renderers (Main Cinema Camera + Overhead Director's Crane Monitor)
  useEffect(() => {
    const mainContainer = mainMountRef.current;
    const pipContainer = pipMountRef.current;
    if (!mainContainer) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(manifest.world.background);

    // 1. Primary Cinema Camera (Driven by Declarative Camera Director)
    const cinemaCam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      44,
      mainContainer.clientWidth / mainContainer.clientHeight,
      0.15,
      40
    );

    // 2. Overhead Director's Crane Camera (For PiP Monitor)
    const overheadCam = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, 16 / 10, 0.5, 60);
    overheadCam.position.set(0, 7.8, 5.2);
    overheadCam.lookAt(0, 0.6, 0.2);

    const mainRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    mainRenderer.setSize(mainContainer.clientWidth, mainContainer.clientHeight);
    mainRenderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    mainContainer.innerHTML = '';
    mainContainer.appendChild(mainRenderer.domElement);

    let pipRenderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer | null = null;
    if (pipContainer) {
      pipRenderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
      pipRenderer.setSize(pipContainer.clientWidth, pipContainer.clientHeight);
      pipRenderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      pipContainer.innerHTML = '';
      pipContainer.appendChild(pipRenderer.domElement);
    }

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.92));

    // Director Gizmos Group (Visible ONLY in the Overhead PiP Monitor so the Cinema Feed stays clean!)
    const directorGizmoGroup = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(directorGizmoGroup);

    // Camera Frustum Helper + Physical Camera Rig Mesh for PiP View
    const camHelper = new THREE.CameraHelper(cinemaCam);
    directorGizmoGroup.add(camHelper);

    const camBodyMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.32, 0.24, 0.45),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#facc15' })
    );
    directorGizmoGroup.add(camBodyMesh);

    // 180-Degree Line-of-Action Laser Line (Amber dashed indicator in PiP monitor)
    const lineOfActionGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
      new THREE.Vector3(-2, 1.5, 0),
      new THREE.Vector3(2, 1.5, 0)
    ]);
    const lineOfActionMesh = new THREE.Line(
      lineOfActionGeo,
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: '#f59e0b', linewidth: 2 })
    );
    directorGizmoGroup.add(lineOfActionMesh);

    const objectMap = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();
    const characterRigs = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>();

    manifest.assets.forEach((asset) => {
      if (asset.type === 'gltfCharacter') {
        const rig = createArticulatedCharacterRig(asset);
        rig.root.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialRotation) rig.root.rotation.set(...asset.initialRotation);
        scene.add(rig.root);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, rig.root);
        characterRigs.set(asset.id, rig);
      } else if (asset.type === 'pointLight') {
        const light = new THREE.PointLight(asset.color, 2.5, 25);
        light.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(light);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, light);
      } else if (asset.type === 'grid') {
        const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, asset.color, asset.color);
        grid.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        scene.add(grid);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, grid);
      } else {
        const geo =
          asset.type === 'torusKnot'
            ? new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.55, 0.18, 80, 16)
            : new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
        const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: asset.color,
          emissive: asset.color,
          emissiveIntensity: 0.35,
          roughness: 0.25,
          metalness: 0.7
        });
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
        mesh.position.set(...asset.initialPosition);
        if (asset.initialScale) mesh.scale.set(...asset.initialScale);
        scene.add(mesh);
        objectMap.set(asset.id, mesh);
      }
    });

    // Compile Catmull-Rom Splines & Add Spline Ribbons to Director Gizmo Group
    const compiledSplineMap = new Map<string, CompiledSplineSegment[]>();
    manifest.tracks.forEach((track) => {
      if (track.property !== 'splinePath' || !track.segments) return;
      const charColor =
        manifest.assets.find((a) => a.id === track.targetId)?.accentColor || '#38bdf8';
      const segList: CompiledSplineSegment[] = [];

      track.segments.forEach((segDef) => {
        const pts = segDef.waypoints.map((w) => new THREE.Vector3(w[0], w[1], w[2]));
        const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
          pts,
          Boolean(segDef.closed),
          'catmullrom',
          segDef.tension ?? 0.5
        );
        curve.arcLengthDivisions = 250;
        curve.updateArcLengths();
        segList.push({ def: segDef, curve, totalLength: curve.getLength() });

        const tube = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 80, 0.035, 8, Boolean(segDef.closed)),
          new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: charColor,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.75
          })
        );
        tube.position.y = 0.03;
        directorGizmoGroup.add(tube);
      });
      compiledSplineMap.set(track.targetId, segList);
    });

    let renderId: number;
    let frameCount = 0;

    const renderLoop = () => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      frameCount++;

      // STAGE 1: Update Non-Character Props
      manifest.tracks.forEach((tr) => {
        if (
          tr.property === 'rotation' &&
          tr.keyframes &&
          !characterRigs.has(tr.targetId)
        ) {
          const obj = objectMap.get(tr.targetId);
          if (obj) {
            const p = t / manifest.duration;
            obj.rotation.set(p * 6.28, p * 12.56, 0);
          }
        }
      });

      // STAGE 2: Evaluate Character Spline Locomotion & Stride Locking
      characterRigs.forEach((rig) => {
        const clipTrack = manifest.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === rig.id && tr.property === 'animationClip'
        );
        let baseClip = 'Idle';
        if (clipTrack && clipTrack.keyframes) {
          for (let i = 0; i < clipTrack.keyframes.length; i++) {
            if (t >= clipTrack.keyframes[i].time) {
              baseClip = String(clipTrack.keyframes[i].value);
            }
          }
        }

        const segs = compiledSplineMap.get(rig.id) || [];
        let activeSeg: CompiledSplineSegment | null = null;
        for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
          if (t >= segs[i].def.startTime && t <= segs[i].def.endTime) {
            activeSeg = segs[i];
            break;
          }
          if (t > segs[i].def.endTime) activeSeg = segs[i];
        }

        let walkWeight = 0;
        let stridePhase = 0;

        if (activeSeg) {
          const { def, curve, totalLength } = activeSeg;
          const dur = Math.max(0.01, def.endTime - def.startTime);
          const inWindow = t >= def.startTime && t <= def.endTime;
          const rawA = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - def.startTime) / dur));
          const u = applySplineEasing(rawA, def.easing || 'smoothstep');

          const pos = curve.getPointAt(u);
          const tan = curve.getTangentAt(u).normalize();
          rig.root.position.copy(pos);
          rig.currentSplineTangent.copy(tan);

          if (inWindow) {
            const uNext = applySplineEasing(
              Math.min(1, (t + 0.03 - def.startTime) / dur),
              def.easing || 'smoothstep'
            );
            const speed = Math.abs(uNext - u) * totalLength / 0.03;
            rig.currentSpeedMps = speed;
            walkWeight = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(speed / 0.85, 0, 1);
          } else {
            rig.currentSpeedMps = 0;
          }

          const headingYaw = Math.atan2(tan.x, tan.z);
          rig.smoothedHeadingQuat.slerp(
            new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, headingYaw, 0)),
            0.25
          );
          rig.root.quaternion.copy(rig.smoothedHeadingQuat);

          stridePhase =
            ((u * totalLength) / Math.max(0.3, def.strideLength || 1.3)) % 1.0;
        }

        rig.actions.forEach((act, name) => {
          if (name === 'Walk') {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(walkWeight);
            act.time = stridePhase * act.getClip().duration;
          } else if (name === baseClip) {
            const isUpper = baseClip === 'Explain' || baseClip === 'Wave';
            act.setEffectiveWeight(isUpper ? 0.85 : 1 - walkWeight);
            act.time = t % (act.getClip().duration || 1);
          } else {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(0);
          }
        });

        rig.mixer.update(0);
      });

      // STAGE 3: Post-Mixer Head/Eye Look-At IK & Viseme Lip-Sync
      characterRigs.forEach((rig) => {
        const lookTrack = manifest.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === rig.id && tr.property === 'lookAtTarget'
        );
        let targetId = 'actor_zephyr';
        if (lookTrack && lookTrack.keyframes) {
          for (let i = 0; i < lookTrack.keyframes.length; i++) {
            if (t >= lookTrack.keyframes[i].time) {
              targetId = String(lookTrack.keyframes[i].value);
            }
          }
        }

        const targetWorldPos = new THREE.Vector3();
        if (characterRigs.has(targetId)) {
          const other = characterRigs.get(targetId)!;
          other.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
          other.headBone.getWorldPosition(targetWorldPos);
        } else {
          targetWorldPos.copy(cinemaCam.position);
        }

        rig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        const headPos = new THREE.Vector3();
        rig.headBone.getWorldPosition(headPos);
        const rootQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
        rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootQuat);

        const localDir = targetWorldPos
          .clone()
          .sub(headPos)
          .applyQuaternion(rootQuat.invert());
        const rawYaw = Math.atan2(localDir.x, localDir.z);
        const rawPitch = Math.atan2(
          localDir.y,
          Math.sqrt(localDir.x * localDir.x + localDir.z * localDir.z)
        );
        const isBehind = Math.abs(rawYaw) > THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(130);
        const w = isBehind ? 0.15 : 1.0;

        const spineYaw =
          THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            rawYaw * 0.22,
            THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-22),
            THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(22)
          ) * w;
        const headYaw =
          THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            rawYaw - spineYaw,
            THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-62),
            THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(62)
          ) * w;
        const headPitch =
          THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            -rawPitch * 0.7,
            THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-30),
            THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(30)
          ) * w;

        rig.smoothedSpineOffset.slerp(
          new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, spineYaw, 0, 'YXZ')),
          0.14
        );
        rig.spineBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedSpineOffset);

        rig.smoothedHeadOffset.slerp(
          new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
            new THREE.Euler(headPitch, headYaw, -headYaw * 0.08, 'YXZ')
          ),
          0.2
        );
        rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedHeadOffset);

        // Visemes
        const visemes = evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
          rig.id,
          manifest.dialogue,
          compiledVisemeMap,
          t
        );
        rig.morphMeshes.forEach((mesh) => {
          const dict = mesh.morphTargetDictionary;
          const inf = mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
          if (!dict || !inf) return;
          ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName) => {
            const idx = dict[vName];
            if (typeof idx === 'number') {
              inf[idx] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inf[idx], visemes[vName] || 0, 0.45);
            }
          });
        });
      });

      // STAGE 4: Evaluate Declarative Camera Director (Post-Locomotion & Post-IK)
      const evaluatedCam = evaluateCameraDirectorAtTime(
        manifest.cameraShots,
        overrideRuleRef.current,
        characterRigs,
        objectMap,
        t
      );

      cinemaCam.position.copy(evaluatedCam.position);
      cinemaCam.lookAt(evaluatedCam.lookAt);
      if (Math.abs(cinemaCam.fov - evaluatedCam.fov) > 0.05) {
        cinemaCam.fov = evaluatedCam.fov;
        cinemaCam.updateProjectionMatrix();
      }

      // Render Primary Cinema Feed (Hide Director Gizmos during Cinema Pass)
      directorGizmoGroup.visible = false;
      mainRenderer.render(scene, cinemaCam);

      // Render Overhead Director's PiP Monitor (Show Camera Frustum & 180° Line of Action)
      if (pipRenderer && showPipRef.current) {
        directorGizmoGroup.visible = true;
        camBodyMesh.position.copy(cinemaCam.position);
        camBodyMesh.quaternion.copy(cinemaCam.quaternion);
        camHelper.update();

        if (evaluatedCam.lineOfActionStart && evaluatedCam.lineOfActionEnd) {
          lineOfActionMesh.visible = true;
          const attr = lineOfActionMesh.geometry.attributes
            .position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
          attr.setXYZ(
            0,
            evaluatedCam.lineOfActionStart.x,
            0.15,
            evaluatedCam.lineOfActionStart.z
          );
          attr.setXYZ(
            1,
            evaluatedCam.lineOfActionEnd.x,
            0.15,
            evaluatedCam.lineOfActionEnd.z
          );
          attr.needsUpdate = true;
        } else {
          lineOfActionMesh.visible = false;
        }

        pipRenderer.render(scene, overheadCam);
      }

      if (frameCount % 3 === 0) {
        setCamTelemetry({
          shotLabel: evaluatedCam.shotLabel,
          shotType: evaluatedCam.shotType,
          fov: Math.round(evaluatedCam.fov),
          focalLengthMm: evaluatedCam.focalLengthMm,
          transitionAlpha: evaluatedCam.transitionAlpha,
          camPos: `[${evaluatedCam.position.x.toFixed(1)}, ${evaluatedCam.position.y.toFixed(1)}, ${evaluatedCam.position.z.toFixed(1)}]`
        });
      }

      renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!mainContainer) return;
      cinemaCam.aspect = mainContainer.clientWidth / mainContainer.clientHeight;
      cinemaCam.updateProjectionMatrix();
      mainRenderer.setSize(mainContainer.clientWidth, mainContainer.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(renderId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      mainRenderer.dispose();
      if (pipRenderer) pipRenderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [manifest, compiledVisemeMap]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-6 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-5">

        {/* Main Grid: Cinema Viewport + Director Shot Inspector */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {/* Primary Cinema Viewport (2 Cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">

              {/* Primary Cinema Canvas */}
              <div ref={mainMountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Optional 2.35:1 Anamorphic + Rule-of-Thirds Composition Guides */}
              {showCompositionGuides && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
                  {/* Rule of Thirds Grid Lines */}
                  <div className="w-full h-full grid grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3">

              )}

              {/* Top-Left Live Camera Lens & Shot Telemetry Badge */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300 pointer-events-none">

                })}
              </div>

            {/* Dialogue Cue List */}
            <div className="overflow-y-auto space-y-1.5 pr-1 max-h-36 border-t border-slate-800 pt-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-1">

              </div>
              {manifest.dialogue.map((seg) => (
                <button
                  key={seg.id}

                  className={`w-full text-left p-2 rounded-lg text-xs border transition ${
                    activeSegment?.id === seg.id
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/50 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/50'

                >

                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="truncate mt-0.5">{seg.text}</p>

              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
4. Why This Completes the Spatial Layer for Compact LLMs
With this cinematography engine in place, an 8B parameter model never has to output raw 3D camera matrices or worry about characters walking out of frame:

Guaranteed 180-Degree Continuity: By keeping side: "right" constant across a sequence of twoShot 
→
→ overTheShoulder (Aria) 
→
→ overTheShoulder (Zephyr) shots, Aria always remains on screen-left and Zephyr always remains on screen-right—even while they walk along curved trajectories.

Automatic Shot-Reverse-Shot Generation: If an LLM doesn't specify explicit camera shots for a dialogue sequence, a simple default rule can automatically generate alternating OTS shots anchored to dialogue[i].speakerId with transitionDuration: 0.

What should we build next to complete the pipeline?

Build the TTS-to-Timeline symbolic anchor compiler

Design the small-LLM system prompt & JSON generator

Add interactive branching choices & world-state memory
Extend the renderer with interactive mid-video decision cards that branch the timeline while persisting character positions and inventory state across chapters.

Branching a 3D timeline without breaking spatial continuity or losing narrative state requires upgrading the renderer from a single-manifest player into a Stateful Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Scene Engine. In traditional pre-rendered interactive video, every branch forces characters to reset to a rigid starting mark or hides transitions behind awkward jump cuts. In a declarative 3D engine, the persistent WorldState survives across chapter transitions—allowing the incoming chapter's Catmull-Rom spline and camera director to dynamically stitch onto the exact [x, y, z] coordinates, bone sockets, and inventory state left behind by the previous chapter.

1. Architecture of the Branching & World-State Persistence Engine
Subsystem	Mechanism	How It Solves Multi-Chapter Continuity
Dynamic Spline Stitching (inheritStartPose)	When a new chapter branch loads, any splinePath segment flagged with inheritStartPose: true reads the character's live world position  
P

  
current
​
  from the Three.js registry and prepends it as Waypoint 0 ([P_current, ...branchWaypoints]), then recomputes curve.updateArcLengths().	Eliminates position pops or teleportation when branching. Wherever a character was standing when the user clicked a choice becomes the exact starting point of their new walk path.
3D Hand-Socket & Inventory Persistence (useWorldStateStore)	Stores inventory: InventoryItem[], flags: Record<string, boolean | number>, and socketAttachments: Record<assetId, { characterId, boneName }>. During the 60 FPS loop, attached 3D props lock directly to the character's animated ForearmR or Spine bone world matrix.	If the user chooses to pick up the Quantum Core in Chapter 1, the 3D mesh physically locks into ARIA's right hand and stays in her hand across Chapters 2 and 3.
Mid-Video Decision Gate (DecisionPrompt)	Triggers at decision.triggerTime. Smoothly ramps playback speed down to a cinematic idle orbit (0.0x timeline clock) while keeping character breathing, eye saccades, and camera orbital drift alive at 60 FPS.	Evaluates each option's requiredItemId or requiredFlag against WorldState, unlocking secret branches in Chapter 2 only if the user acquired a specific item in Chapter 1.
Checkpoint Snapshot Time-Travel (ChapterSnapshot)	Captures an immutable snapshot of { chapterId, inventory, flags, socketAttachments, characterTransforms } at the start of every visited chapter.	Clicking any node in the Interactive Branch Graph rewinds both the 3D scene transforms and the inventory state to that exact historical moment.
2. Extended Declarative Schema (DecisionPrompt & WorldStateEffect)
A lightweight LLM or narrative designer authors choices that mutate world state, attach 3D assets to character bones, and conditionally gate downstream branches:

3. React + Three.js Renderer with Mid-Video Decision Cards, Dynamic Spline Stitching & Persistent Inventory
Install three and lucide-react (npm install three lucide-react). This self-contained engine includes a 4-Chapter Interactive Branching Story Graph:

Chapter 1 (ch1_anomaly_detected): ARIA walks toward the Quantum Core pedestal and consults ZEPHYR. At t = 9.8s, Decision Card #1 appears over the live 3D scene.

Branch 2A (ch2a_extract_core) vs. Branch 2B (ch2b_remote_scan):

Choosing Extract the Core dynamically stitches ARIA's spline from her Chapter 1 position up to the pedestal, physically locks the spinning 3D Quantum Core into her right hand bone (ForearmR), and adds it to your persistent inventory.

Choosing Run Remote Diagnostics stitches ARIA's spline over to ZEPHYR's console, shifts the core's color to emerald shield mode, and grants the Telemetry Cipher item.

Decision Card #2 (Inventory-Gated Branching): At the end of Chapter 2A or 2B, a second decision appears with 3 choices—two of which are locked/unlocked dynamically depending on whether you hold the Unstable Quantum Core or the Telemetry Cipher in your persistent inventory.

Chapter 3 (ch3_convergence_finale): Remembers ARIA's exact 3D coordinates, whether the 3D Core is still held in her hand or mounted on the pedestal, and adapts the final dialogue and camera framing accordingly.

TypeScript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {
  Play,
  Pause,
  RotateCcw,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Sparkles,
  GitBranch,
  Package,
  Lock,
  CheckCircle2,
  ArrowRight,
  History,
  Film,
  ShieldAlert,
  Cpu
} from 'lucide-react';

// ============================================================================
// 1. SCHEMA & TYPES (BRANCHING DAG, PERSISTENT WORLD STATE & SPLINE STITCHING)
// ============================================================================

type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];
type ShotType = 'twoShot' | 'overTheShoulder' | 'splineDolly' | 'closeUp' | 'establishingOrbit';

export interface InventoryItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  color: string;
  description: string;
  acquiredInChapter: string;
}

export interface SocketAttachment {
  assetId: string;
  characterId: string;
  boneName: 'ForearmR' | 'ForearmL' | 'Spine';
  localOffset: Vector3Tuple;
  localScale: Vector3Tuple;
}

export interface WorldStateEffect {
  addItem?: Omit<InventoryItem, 'acquiredInChapter'>;
  removeItemId?: string;
  attachAssetToBone?: SocketAttachment | null;
  detachAssetId?: string;
  setFlags?: Record<string, boolean | number | string>;
  mutateAssetColor?: { assetId: string; color: string };
}

export interface DecisionChoice {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  targetChapterId: string;
  badgeText?: string;
  requiredItemId?: string; // Gates this choice unless item is in persistent inventory
  requiredFlag?: { key: string; value: boolean | number | string };
  effects?: WorldStateEffect;
}

export interface DecisionPrompt {
  id: string;
  triggerTime: number;
  promptTitle: string;
  promptSubtitle: string;
  timeoutSeconds: number;
  defaultChoiceIndex: number;
  choices: DecisionChoice[];
}

interface SplineSegmentDefinition {
  id: string;
  startTime: number;
  endTime: number;
  inheritStartPose?: boolean; // Dynamically injects character's current world [x,y,z] as Waypoint 0!
  waypoints: Vector3Tuple[];
  strideLength?: number;
}

interface CameraShotRule {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  startTime: number;
  endTime: number;
  shotType: ShotType;
  subjectId: string;
  secondaryId?: string;
  side?: 'left' | 'right';
  dollyMode?: 'lead' | 'follow' | 'parallel';
  distance?: number;
  fov?: number;
  transitionDuration?: number;
}

interface AnimationTrack {
  targetId: string;
  property: 'animationClip' | 'lookAtTarget' | 'splinePath';
  keyframes?: { time: number; value: any; crossFade?: number }[];
  segments?: SplineSegmentDefinition[];
}

interface DialogueSegment {
  id: string;
  speakerId: string;
  speaker: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  text: string;
  conditionFlag?: string; // Optional flag to dynamically tailor dialogue to past choices
}

interface ChapterNode {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  duration: number;
  tracks: AnimationTrack[];
  cameraShots: CameraShotRule[];
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[];
  decision?: DecisionPrompt;
}

interface PersistentWorldState {
  currentChapterId: string;
  visitedChapters: string[];
  inventory: InventoryItem[];
  flags: Record<string, boolean | number | string>;
  socketAttachments: Record<string, SocketAttachment>;
  assetColorOverrides: Record<string, string>;
  characterTransforms: Record<
    string,
    { position: Vector3Tuple; rotationY: number }
  >;
}

interface ChapterCheckpointSnapshot {
  chapterId: string;
  chapterTitle: string;
  choiceMadeLabel: string;
  worldState: PersistentWorldState;
}

export type VisemeName =
  | 'viseme_sil'
  | 'viseme_PP'
  | 'viseme_FF'
  | 'viseme_TH'
  | 'viseme_DD'
  | 'viseme_kk'
  | 'viseme_CH'
  | 'viseme_SS'
  | 'viseme_RR'
  | 'viseme_aa'
  | 'viseme_E'
  | 'viseme_I'
  | 'viseme_O'
  | 'viseme_U';
