// ============================================================================
// 3. VISEME & EASING HELPERS
// ============================================================================

function smoothstep(x: number): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  return c * c * (3 - 2 * c);
}

interface VisemeCue {
  time: number;
  duration: number;
  viseme: VisemeName;
  weight: number;
}

function compileDialogueVisemes(segment: DialogueSegment): VisemeCue[] {
  const cleanText = segment.text.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/g, '');
  const words = cleanText.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length === 0) return [];

  const totalDuration = Math.max(0.2, segment.end - segment.start);
  const totalChars = words.reduce((acc, w) => acc + w.length + 1, 0);
  const secPerChar = totalDuration / Math.max(1, totalChars);

  const cues: VisemeCue[] = [];
  let cursor = segment.start;

  const charToViseme = (ch: string): VisemeName => {
    switch (ch.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'a':
        return 'viseme_aa';
      case 'e':
        return 'viseme_E';
      case 'i':
      case 'y':
        return 'viseme_I';
      case 'o':
        return 'viseme_O';
      case 'u':
      case 'w':
        return 'viseme_U';
      case 'p':
      case 'b':
      case 'm':
        return 'viseme_PP';
      case 'f':
      case 'v':
        return 'viseme_FF';
      case 't':
      case 'd':
      case 'n':
        return 'viseme_DD';
      default:
        return 'viseme_SS';
    }
  };

  words.forEach((word) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < word.length; i++) {
      const viseme = charToViseme(word[i]);
      cues.push({
        time: cursor,
        duration: secPerChar,
        viseme,
        weight: 0.9
      });
      cursor += secPerChar;
    }
    cues.push({
      time: cursor,
      duration: secPerChar * 0.8,
      viseme: 'viseme_sil',
      weight: 0.1
    });
    cursor += secPerChar;
  });

  return cues;
}

function evaluateSpeakerVisemes(
  speakerId: string,
  dialogue: DialogueSegment[],
  compiledMap: Map<string, VisemeCue[]>,
  t: number
): Record<VisemeName, number> {
  const weights: any = {};
  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (weights[v] = 0));

  const activeSeg = dialogue.find(
    (d) => d.speakerId === speakerId && t >= d.start && t <= d.end
  );
  if (!activeSeg) {
    weights.viseme_sil = 1;
    return weights;
  }

  const cues = compiledMap.get(activeSeg.id) || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < cues.length; i++) {
    const cue = cues[i];
    const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
    const halfWidth = Math.max(0.04, cue.duration * 0.85);
    const dist = Math.abs(t - center);
    if (dist < halfWidth) {
      const influence = Math.cos((dist / halfWidth) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight;
      weights[cue.viseme] = Math.min(1, Math.max(weights[cue.viseme], influence));
    }
  }
  return weights;
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. 15-BONE ARTICULATED HUMANOID RIG BUILDER (WITH SOCKET ACCESS)
// ============================================================================

interface CharacterRigInstance {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  morphMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
  hipsBone: THREE.Bone;
  spineBone: THREE.Bone;
  headBone: THREE.Bone;
  forearmLBone: THREE.Bone;
  forearmRBone: THREE.Bone;
  smoothedHeadingQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedSpineOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedHeadOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  currentSplineTangent: THREE.Vector3;
}

function createArticulatedRig(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  color: string,
  accentColor: string,
  initPos: Vector3Tuple,
  initRotY: number
): CharacterRigInstance {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  root.position.set(...initPos);
  root.rotation.set(0, initRotY, 0);

  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.02, 0);
  root.add(hipsBone);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.35, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.72, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const forearmLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmLBone.name = 'ForearmL';
  forearmLBone.position.set(-0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(forearmLBone);

  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const forearmRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmRBone.name = 'ForearmR';
  forearmRBone.position.set(0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(forearmRBone);

  const thighLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighLBone.name = 'ThighL';
  thighLBone.position.set(-0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighLBone);

  const shinLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinLBone.name = 'ShinL';
  shinLBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighLBone.add(shinLBone);

  const thighRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighRBone.name = 'ThighR';
  thighRBone.position.set(0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighRBone);

  const shinRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinRBone.name = 'ShinR';
  shinRBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighRBone.add(shinRBone);

  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color,
    roughness: 0.32,
    metalness: 0.45
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.65
  });
  const accentMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: accentColor,
    emissive: accentColor,
    emissiveIntensity: 0.6
  });

  hipsBone.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.72, 0.24, 0.42), darkMat));

  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.86, 0.88, 0.46), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.14, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  const chestBadge = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.18, 0.06), accentMat);
  chestBadge.position.set(0, 0.28, 0.24);
  spineBone.add(chestBadge);

  const upperArmGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const armL = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armL.position.set(-0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(armL);

  const handL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handL.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmLBone.add(handL);

  const armR = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armR.position.set(0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(armR);

  const handR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handR.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmRBone.add(handR);

  const thighGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const shinGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, 0.38, 8, 16);

  const thighLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighLBone.add(thighLMesh);

  const shinLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinLBone.add(shinLMesh);

  const thighRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighRBone.add(thighRMesh);

  const shinRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinRBone.add(shinRMesh);

  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.62, 0.6), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const visorMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.54, 0.16, 0.08), accentMat);
  visorMesh.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.28);
  headBone.add(visorMesh);

  // Morph-Target Mouth Mesh
  const baseMouthGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.32, 0.075, 0.1, 8, 4, 2);
  const basePos = baseMouthGeo.attributes.position;
  const morphPositions: THREE.BufferAttribute[] = [];
  const morphDict: Record<string, number> = {};

  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName, idx) => {
    morphDict[vName] = idx;
    const cloned = basePos.clone();
    for (let i = 0; i < cloned.count; i++) {
      let x = cloned.getX(i);
      let y = cloned.getY(i);
      const z = cloned.getZ(i);
      if (vName === 'viseme_aa') {
        y *= 3.6;
        x *= 1.15;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_O') {
        y *= 3.0;
        x *= 0.62;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_PP') {
        y *= 0.25;
      } else {
        y *= 1.8;
      }
      cloned.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    morphPositions.push(cloned);
  });
  baseMouthGeo.morphAttributes.position = morphPositions;

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(baseMouthGeo, accentMat);
  mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary = morphDict;
  mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences = new Array(ALL_VISEMES.length).fill(0);
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.14, 0.29);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  const qEuler = (x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(x, y, z)).toArray();

  const walkTimes = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0];
  const walkClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Walk', 1.0, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      walkTimes,
      [-0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, 0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, -0.03, 0.99, 0]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, -0.08)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, 0.08)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const gTimes = [0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4];
  const idleClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Idle', 2.4, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      gTimes,
      [0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0]
    )
  ]);

  const explainClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Explain', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, -0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.6, 0.1, -0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.0, -0.2, -0.6),
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0.2, 0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, 0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.65, 0.1, 0.35),
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const waveClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Wave', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 1.95),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  [
    ['Idle', idleClip],
    ['Walk', walkClip],
    ['Explain', explainClip],
    ['Wave', waveClip]
  ].forEach(([cName, clip]) => {
    const act = mixer.clipAction(clip as THREE.AnimationClip);
    act.play();
    act.setEffectiveWeight(cName === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
    actions.set(cName as string, act);
  });

  return {
    id,
    name,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    hipsBone,
    spineBone,
    headBone,
    forearmLBone,
    forearmRBone,
    smoothedHeadingQuat: new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
      new THREE.Euler(0, initRotY, 0)
    ),
    smoothedSpineOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    currentSplineTangent: new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(initRotY), 0, Math.cos(initRotY))
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. MAIN INTERACTIVE BRANCHING & PERSISTENT WORLD-STATE PLAYER
// ============================================================================

export default function InteractiveBranchingWorldPlayer() {
  const [worldState, setWorldState] = useState<PersistentWorldState>(INITIAL_WORLD_STATE);
  const [checkpointHistory, setCheckpointHistory] = useState<ChapterCheckpointSnapshot[]>([
    {
      chapterId: 'ch1_anomaly_detected',
      chapterTitle: 'Chapter 1: Anomaly Detected',
      choiceMadeLabel: 'Episode Start',
      worldState: INITIAL_WORLD_STATE
    }
  ]);

  const activeChapter = CHAPTER_GRAPH[worldState.currentChapterId];

  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [decisionActive, setDecisionActive] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [decisionCountdown, setDecisionCountdown] = useState<number>(18);

  const [liveAriaCoords, setLiveAriaCoords] = useState<string>('[-2.8, 0.0, -1.4]');
  const [activeShotLabel, setActiveShotLabel] = useState<string>('');

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const decisionTriggeredRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
  const worldStateRef = useRef<PersistentWorldState>(worldState);
  const characterRigsRef = useRef<Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>>(new Map());
  const objectMapRef = useRef<Map<string, THREE.Object3D>>(new Map());
  const splineGroupRef = useRef<THREE.Group | null>(null);
  const compiledSplinesRef = useRef<
    Map<string, { def: SplineSegmentDefinition; curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3; totalLength: number }[]>
  >(new Map());

  useEffect(() => {
    worldStateRef.current = worldState;
  }, [worldState]);

  const compiledVisemeMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, VisemeCue[]>();
    activeChapter.dialogue.forEach((seg) => {
      map.set(seg.id, compileDialogueVisemes(seg));
    });
    return map;
  }, [activeChapter]);

  const activeSegment = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      activeChapter.dialogue.find(
        (seg) => currentTime >= seg.start && currentTime <= seg.end
      ) || null
    );
  }, [activeChapter.dialogue, currentTime]);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(activeChapter.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
      if (
        activeChapter.decision &&
        clamped < activeChapter.decision.triggerTime - 0.1
      ) {
        decisionTriggeredRef.current = false;
        setDecisionActive(false);
      }
    },
    [activeChapter]
  );

  // Dynamically Stitch Catmull-Rom Splines Whenever `activeChapter` or `worldState` Changes
  const rebuildChapterSplines = useCallback(
    (chapter: ChapterNode, stateSnapshot: PersistentWorldState) => {
      const splineGroup = splineGroupRef.current;
      if (splineGroup) {
        splineGroup.clear();
      }
      const newMap = new Map<
        string,
        { def: SplineSegmentDefinition; curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3; totalLength: number }[]
      >();

      chapter.tracks.forEach((track) => {
        if (track.property !== 'splinePath' || !track.segments) return;
        const list: {
          def: SplineSegmentDefinition;
          curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3;
          totalLength: number;
        }[] = [];

        track.segments.forEach((segDef) => {
          const rawWaypoints = [...segDef.waypoints];

          // DYNAMIC SPLINE STITCHING: Prepend the character's exact live/persisted [x,y,z] as Waypoint 0!
          if (segDef.inheritStartPose) {
            const persistedPose = stateSnapshot.characterTransforms[track.targetId];
            if (persistedPose) {
              const p0 = persistedPose.position;
              const firstWp = rawWaypoints[0];
              const dist = Math.hypot(p0[0] - firstWp[0], p0[2] - firstWp[2]);
              if (dist > 0.15) {
                rawWaypoints.unshift([p0[0], p0[1], p0[2]]);
              } else {
                rawWaypoints[0] = [p0[0], p0[1], p0[2]];
              }
            }
          }

          const pts = rawWaypoints.map((w) => new THREE.Vector3(w[0], w[1], w[2]));
          const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, false, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
          curve.arcLengthDivisions = 250;
          curve.updateArcLengths();

          list.push({
            def: segDef,
            curve,
            totalLength: curve.getLength()
          });

          if (splineGroup) {
            const tube = new THREE.Mesh(
              new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 72, 0.032, 8, false),
              new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                color: '#38bdf8',
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.7
              })
            );
            tube.position.y = 0.03;
            splineGroup.add(tube);

            pts.forEach((p, idx) => {
              const beacon = new THREE.Mesh(
                new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.11, 0.11, 0.05, 16),
                new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                  color: idx === 0 ? '#10b981' : '#38bdf8'
                })
              );
              beacon.position.set(p.x, 0.03, p.z);
              splineGroup.add(beacon);
            });
          }
        });

        newMap.set(track.targetId, list);
      });

      compiledSplinesRef.current = newMap;
    },
    []
  );

  // Execute a User Decision Choice: Mutate Persistent World State, Capture Live Character Poses & Branch!
  const handleSelectChoice = useCallback(
    (choice: DecisionChoice) => {
      // 1. Capture live 3D character coordinates from the Three.js scene so the next chapter stitches seamlessly!
      const liveTransforms: Record<
        string,
        { position: Vector3Tuple; rotationY: number }
      > = {
        ...worldStateRef.current.characterTransforms
      };
      characterRigsRef.current.forEach((rig, charId) => {
        const euler = new THREE.Euler().setFromQuaternion(rig.root.quaternion, 'YXZ');
        liveTransforms[charId] = {
          position: [
            Number(rig.root.position.x.toFixed(2)),
            Number(rig.root.position.y.toFixed(2)),
            Number(rig.root.position.z.toFixed(2))
          ],
          rotationY: Number(euler.y.toFixed(2))
        };
      });

      // 2. Apply Declarative WorldStateEffects (Inventory, Socket Attachments, Flags, Color Overrides)
      const prev = worldStateRef.current;
      let nextInventory = [...prev.inventory];
      const nextAttachments = { ...prev.socketAttachments };
      const nextFlags = { ...prev.flags };
      const nextColors = { ...prev.assetColorOverrides };

      if (choice.effects) {
        const fx = choice.effects;
        if (fx.addItem && !nextInventory.some((i) => i.id === fx.addItem!.id)) {
          nextInventory.push({
            ...fx.addItem,
            acquiredInChapter: prev.currentChapterId
          });
        }
        if (fx.removeItemId) {
          nextInventory = nextInventory.filter((i) => i.id !== fx.removeItemId);
        }
        if (fx.attachAssetToBone) {
          nextAttachments[fx.attachAssetToBone.assetId] = fx.attachAssetToBone;
        }
        if (fx.detachAssetId) {
          delete nextAttachments[fx.detachAssetId];
          // Return detached core to central pedestal position
          const detachedObj = objectMapRef.current.get(fx.detachAssetId);
          if (detachedObj) {
            detachedObj.position.set(-0.2, 1.48, -0.9);
            detachedObj.scale.set(0.42, 0.42, 0.42);
          }
        }
        if (fx.setFlags) {
          Object.assign(nextFlags, fx.setFlags);
        }
        if (fx.mutateAssetColor) {
          nextColors[fx.mutateAssetColor.assetId] = fx.mutateAssetColor.color;
        }
      }

      const nextChapter = CHAPTER_GRAPH[choice.targetChapterId];
      const nextWorldState: PersistentWorldState = {
        currentChapterId: choice.targetChapterId,
        visitedChapters: [...prev.visitedChapters, choice.targetChapterId],
        inventory: nextInventory,
        flags: nextFlags,
        socketAttachments: nextAttachments,
        assetColorOverrides: nextColors,
        characterTransforms: liveTransforms
      };

      // 3. Save Historical Checkpoint Snapshot for One-Click Time-Travel Rewind
      setCheckpointHistory((hist) => [
        ...hist,
        {
          chapterId: choice.targetChapterId,
          chapterTitle: nextChapter.title,
          choiceMadeLabel: choice.label,
          worldState: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(nextWorldState))
        }
      ]);

      // 4. Transition Timeline to Target Chapter at t = 0.0s with Stitched Splines
      setWorldState(nextWorldState);
      worldStateRef.current = nextWorldState;
      rebuildChapterSplines(nextChapter, nextWorldState);

      decisionTriggeredRef.current = false;
      setDecisionActive(false);
      timeRef.current = 0;
      setCurrentTime(0);
      setIsPlaying(true);
    },
    [rebuildChapterSplines]
  );

  // Rewind to any Past Checkpoint Snapshot in the Story Graph
  const handleRestoreCheckpoint = (snapshot: ChapterCheckpointSnapshot, index: number) => {
    const restored: PersistentWorldState = JSON.parse(
      JSON.stringify(snapshot.worldState)
    );
    setWorldState(restored);
    worldStateRef.current = restored;
    setCheckpointHistory((prev) => prev.slice(0, index + 1));

    // Restore 3D character root transforms & pedestal core if detached
    characterRigsRef.current.forEach((rig, charId) => {
      const savedPose = restored.characterTransforms[charId];
      if (savedPose) {
        rig.root.position.set(...savedPose.position);
        rig.smoothedHeadingQuat.setFromEuler(
          new THREE.Euler(0, savedPose.rotationY, 0)
        );
        rig.root.quaternion.copy(rig.smoothedHeadingQuat);
      }
    });

    const coreObj = objectMapRef.current.get('holo_core');
    if (coreObj && !restored.socketAttachments['holo_core']) {
      coreObj.position.set(-0.2, 1.48, -0.9);
      coreObj.scale.set(0.42, 0.42, 0.42);
    }

    const targetChap = CHAPTER_GRAPH[restored.currentChapterId];
    rebuildChapterSplines(targetChap, restored);

    decisionTriggeredRef.current = false;
    setDecisionActive(false);
    timeRef.current = 0;
    setCurrentTime(0);
    setIsPlaying(true);
  };

  // Evaluate whether a DecisionChoice's Inventory or Flag Prerequisite is satisfied
  const isChoiceUnlocked = useCallback(
    (choice: DecisionChoice): boolean => {
      if (choice.requiredItemId) {
        const hasItem = worldState.inventory.some(
          (item) => item.id === choice.requiredItemId
        );
        if (!hasItem) return false;
      }
      if (choice.requiredFlag) {
        if (worldState.flags[choice.requiredFlag.key] !== choice.requiredFlag.value) {
          return false;
        }
      }
      return true;
    },
    [worldState.inventory, worldState.flags]
  );

  // Countdown Timer when a Mid-Video Decision Card is Active
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!decisionActive || !activeChapter.decision) return;
    setDecisionCountdown(activeChapter.decision.timeoutSeconds);

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setDecisionCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          const validChoices = activeChapter.decision!.choices.filter((c) =>
            isChoiceUnlocked(c)
          );
          const fallback =
            validChoices[0] || activeChapter.decision!.choices[0];
          handleSelectChoice(fallback);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [decisionActive, activeChapter, handleSelectChoice, isChoiceUnlocked]);

  // Master Timeline Clock (Pauses timeline progression when Decision Card triggers, while 3D viewport stays live!)
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && !decisionActive && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const delta = (now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000;
        let next = timeRef.current + delta;

        // Check if we crossed the Chapter's Interactive Decision Trigger Time!
        if (
          activeChapter.decision &&
          !decisionTriggeredRef.current &&
          next >= activeChapter.decision.triggerTime
        ) {
          next = activeChapter.decision.triggerTime;
          decisionTriggeredRef.current = true;
          setDecisionActive(true);
        } else if (next >= activeChapter.duration) {
          next = activeChapter.duration;
          setIsPlaying(false);
        }

        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying, decisionActive, activeChapter]);

  // Initialize Persistent Three.js World (Instantiated ONCE across all chapters!)
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color('#070b14');

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      44,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.15,
      50
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.92));
    const keyLight = new THREE.PointLight('#60a5fa', 2.6, 28);
    keyLight.position.set(2, 7, 5);
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, '#1e293b', '#1e293b');
    scene.add(grid);

    const splineGroup = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(splineGroup);
    splineGroupRef.current = splineGroup;

    // Containment Pedestal + Quantum Core Artifact
    const pedestalMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.36, 0.46, 0.95, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#1e293b',
        roughness: 0.4,
        metalness: 0.7
      })
    );
    pedestalMesh.position.set(-0.2, 0.475, -0.9);
    scene.add(pedestalMesh);

    const holoCoreMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.5, 0.16, 80, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#a855f7',
        emissive: '#a855f7',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.5,
        roughness: 0.2,
        metalness: 0.8
      })
    );
    holoCoreMesh.position.set(-0.2, 1.48, -0.9);
    holoCoreMesh.scale.set(0.42, 0.42, 0.42);
    scene.add(holoCoreMesh);

    const objectMap = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();
    objectMap.set('holo_core', holoCoreMesh);
    objectMapRef.current = objectMap;

    // Persistent Character Rigs (ARIA & ZEPHYR)
    const ariaRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_aria',
      'ARIA',
      '#f1f5f9',
      '#38bdf8',
      INITIAL_WORLD_STATE.characterTransforms.actor_aria.position,
      INITIAL_WORLD_STATE.characterTransforms.actor_aria.rotationY
    );
    const zephyrRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_zephyr',
      'ZEPHYR',
      '#334155',
      '#10b981',
      INITIAL_WORLD_STATE.characterTransforms.actor_zephyr.position,
      INITIAL_WORLD_STATE.characterTransforms.actor_zephyr.rotationY
    );

    scene.add(ariaRig.root);
    scene.add(zephyrRig.root);

    const rigsMap = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>();
    rigsMap.set('actor_aria', ariaRig);
    rigsMap.set('actor_zephyr', zephyrRig);
    characterRigsRef.current = rigsMap;

    rebuildChapterSplines(
      CHAPTER_GRAPH[worldStateRef.current.currentChapterId],
      worldStateRef.current
    );

    let renderId: number;
    let frameCount = 0;

    const renderLoop = (nowMs: number) => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      const wallSec = nowMs / 1000;
      frameCount++;

      const currentState = worldStateRef.current;
      const chap = CHAPTER_GRAPH[currentState.currentChapterId];

      // 1. Evaluate Character Spline Locomotion (With Stitched Waypoint 0)
      rigsMap.forEach((rig) => {
        const clipTrack = chap.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === rig.id && tr.property === 'animationClip'
        );
        let baseClip = 'Idle';
        if (clipTrack && clipTrack.keyframes) {
          for (let i = 0; i < clipTrack.keyframes.length; i++) {
            if (t >= clipTrack.keyframes[i].time) {
              baseClip = String(clipTrack.keyframes[i].value);
            }
          }
        }

        const segs = compiledSplinesRef.current.get(rig.id) || [];
        let walkWeight = 0;
        let stridePhase = 0;

        if (segs.length > 0) {
          const activeSeg = segs[0];
          const { def, curve, totalLength } = activeSeg;
          const dur = Math.max(0.01, def.endTime - def.startTime);
          const inWindow = t >= def.startTime && t <= def.endTime;
          const rawA = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - def.startTime) / dur));
          const u = smoothstep(rawA);

          const pos = curve.getPointAt(u);
          const tan = curve.getTangentAt(u).normalize();
          rig.root.position.copy(pos);
          rig.currentSplineTangent.copy(tan);

          if (inWindow && totalLength > 0.1) {
            const uNext = smoothstep(
              Math.min(1, (t + 0.03 - def.startTime) / dur)
            );
            const speed = (Math.abs(uNext - u) * totalLength) / 0.03;
            walkWeight = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(speed / 0.85, 0, 1);
          }

          const headingYaw = Math.atan2(tan.x, tan.z);
          rig.smoothedHeadingQuat.slerp(
            new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, headingYaw, 0)),
            0.22
          );
          rig.root.quaternion.copy(rig.smoothedHeadingQuat);
          stridePhase =
            ((u * totalLength) / Math.max(0.3, def.strideLength || 1.25)) % 1.0;
        }

        rig.actions.forEach((act, name) => {
          if (name === 'Walk') {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(walkWeight);
            act.time = stridePhase * act.getClip().duration;
          } else if (name === baseClip) {
            const isUpper = baseClip === 'Explain' || baseClip === 'Wave';
            act.setEffectiveWeight(isUpper ? 0.85 : 1 - walkWeight);
            // Use wallSec when paused at a Decision Gate so characters keep breathing & gesturing!
            act.time = wallSec % (act.getClip().duration || 1);
          } else {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(0);
          }
        });

        rig.mixer.update(0);
      });

      // 2. Post-Mixer Head Look-At IK
      rigsMap.forEach((rig) => {
        const lookTrack = chap.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === rig.id && tr.property === 'lookAtTarget'
        );
        let targetId = 'actor_zephyr';
        if (lookTrack && lookTrack.keyframes) {
          for (let i = 0; i < lookTrack.keyframes.length; i++) {
            if (t >= lookTrack.keyframes[i].time) {
              targetId = String(lookTrack.keyframes[i].value);
            }
          }
        }

        const targetPos = new THREE.Vector3();
        if (rigsMap.has(targetId)) {
          const other = rigsMap.get(targetId)!;
          other.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
          other.headBone.getWorldPosition(targetPos);
        } else if (objectMap.has(targetId)) {
          objectMap.get(targetId)!.getWorldPosition(targetPos);
        } else {
          targetPos.copy(camera.position);
        }

        rig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        const headWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
        rig.headBone.getWorldPosition(headWorld);
        const rootQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
        rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootQuat);

        const localDir = targetPos
          .clone()
          .sub(headWorld)
          .applyQuaternion(rootQuat.invert());
        const rawYaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          Math.atan2(localDir.x, localDir.z),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-62),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(62)
        );
        const rawPitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          -Math.atan2(
            localDir.y,
            Math.sqrt(localDir.x * localDir.x + localDir.z * localDir.z)
          ) * 0.65,
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-28),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(28)
        );

        rig.smoothedHeadOffset.slerp(
          new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
            new THREE.Euler(rawPitch, rawYaw, 0, 'YXZ')
          ),
          0.18
        );
        rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedHeadOffset);
      });

      // 3. Persistent 3D Bone-Socket Prop Attachment & Color Overrides (e.g., Quantum Core in Aria's Right Hand!)
      const coreColorOverride = currentState.assetColorOverrides['holo_core'];
      if (
        coreColorOverride &&
        holoCoreMesh.material instanceof THREE.MeshStandardMaterial
      ) {
        holoCoreMesh.material.color.set(coreColorOverride);
        holoCoreMesh.material.emissive.set(coreColorOverride);
      }

      const coreAttachment = currentState.socketAttachments['holo_core'];
      if (coreAttachment) {
        const carrierRig = rigsMap.get(coreAttachment.characterId);
        if (carrierRig) {
          carrierRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
          const handBone =
            coreAttachment.boneName === 'ForearmR'
              ? carrierRig.forearmRBone
              : carrierRig.forearmLBone;
          const handWorldPos = new THREE.Vector3();
          const handWorldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
          handBone.getWorldPosition(handWorldPos);
          handBone.getWorldQuaternion(handWorldQuat);

          const offset = new THREE.Vector3(
            ...coreAttachment.localOffset
          ).applyQuaternion(handWorldQuat);
          holoCoreMesh.position.copy(handWorldPos).add(offset);
          holoCoreMesh.scale.set(...coreAttachment.localScale);
        }
      }
      holoCoreMesh.rotation.set(wallSec * 1.8, wallSec * 2.6, 0);

      // 4. Declarative Camera Director (plus subtle cinematic drift when paused at a Decision Card!)
      let activeShot = chap.cameraShots[0];
      for (let i = 0; i < chap.cameraShots.length; i++) {
        if (t >= chap.cameraShots[i].startTime) {
          activeShot = chap.cameraShots[i];
        }
      }

      const ariaPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      ariaRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(ariaPos);
      const zephyrPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      zephyrRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(zephyrPos);

      const lineDir = new THREE.Vector3()
        .subVectors(zephyrPos, ariaPos)
        .setY(0)
        .normalize();
      const sideNormal = new THREE.Vector3(-lineDir.z, 0, lineDir.x).normalize();

      const camTargetPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      const camLookAt = new THREE.Vector3();

      if (activeShot.shotType === 'twoShot') {
        camLookAt.addVectors(ariaPos, zephyrPos).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        camLookAt.y -= 0.15;
        const sep = Math.max(2.2, ariaPos.distanceTo(zephyrPos));
        camTargetPos
          .copy(camLookAt)
          .add(sideNormal.clone().multiplyScalar(sep * 1.15));
        camTargetPos.y = 1.75;
        // Subtle idle camera breathing when waiting on a Decision Card
        if (decisionTriggeredRef.current) {
          camTargetPos.x += Math.sin(wallSec * 0.9) * 0.18;
        }
      } else if (activeShot.shotType === 'overTheShoulder') {
        const isAriaSubject = activeShot.subjectId === 'actor_aria';
        const subj = isAriaSubject ? ariaPos : zephyrPos;
        const anchor = isAriaSubject ? zephyrPos : ariaPos;
        const aToS = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(subj, anchor).setY(0).normalize();
        camTargetPos
          .copy(anchor)
          .add(aToS.multiplyScalar(-1.15))
          .add(sideNormal.clone().multiplyScalar(0.48));
        camTargetPos.y = anchor.y - 0.04;
        camLookAt.lerpVectors(anchor, subj, 0.78);
      } else if (activeShot.shotType === 'closeUp') {
        camTargetPos
          .copy(ariaPos)
          .add(sideNormal.clone().multiplyScalar(1.55));
        camTargetPos.y = ariaPos.y - 0.08;
        camLookAt.copy(ariaPos);
        camLookAt.y -= 0.12;
      } else if (activeShot.shotType === 'splineDolly') {
        const tan = ariaRig.currentSplineTangent.clone().setY(0).normalize();
        const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x).normalize();
        if (activeShot.dollyMode === 'lead') {
          camTargetPos
            .copy(ariaPos)
            .add(tan.multiplyScalar(2.2))
            .add(right.multiplyScalar(0.35));
        } else {
          camTargetPos.copy(ariaPos).add(right.multiplyScalar(2.35));
        }
        camTargetPos.y = 1.65;
        camLookAt.copy(ariaPos);
        camLookAt.y -= 0.1;
      } else {
        const angle = wallSec * 0.4;
        camTargetPos.set(
          Math.sin(angle) * 4.8,
          2.6,
          Math.cos(angle) * 4.8
        );
        camLookAt.set(0, 1.2, 0);
      }

      camera.position.lerp(camTargetPos, 0.12);
      camera.lookAt(camLookAt);

      if (frameCount % 4 === 0) {
        setLiveAriaCoords(
          `[${ariaRig.root.position.x.toFixed(2)}, ${ariaRig.root.position.y.toFixed(
            2
          )}, ${ariaRig.root.position.z.toFixed(2)}]`
        );
        setActiveShotLabel(activeShot.label);
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    renderId = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(renderId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [rebuildChapterSplines]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-6 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-5">
        {/* Header Bar with Branch Breadcrumbs */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <GitBranch className="w-4 h-4" />
              Interactive Branching Video & Persistent World-State Engine
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mt-1">
              {activeChapter.title}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{activeChapter.subtitle}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => handleRestoreCheckpoint(checkpointHistory[0], 0)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium border border-slate-700 transition"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
              Reset Story to Chapter 1
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Grid: 3D Viewport (with Mid-Video Decision Overlay) + World State Inspector */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {/* 3D Viewport (2 Cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[470px] bg-black overflow-hidden">
              <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Top Telemetry Pill */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300 pointer-events-none">
                <span
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                    decisionActive
                      ? 'bg-amber-400 animate-ping'
                      : isPlaying
                      ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse'
                      : 'bg-slate-500'
                  }`}
                />
                <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-white">
                  {activeChapter.id} ({currentTime.toFixed(1)}s /{' '}
                  {activeChapter.duration.toFixed(1)}s)
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-sky-400 font-mono">
                  Aria Pos: {liveAriaCoords}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* MID-VIDEO INTERACTIVE DECISION CARD OVERLAY */}
              {decisionActive && activeChapter.decision && (
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/65 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-20 animate-fadeIn">
                  <div className="max-w-lg w-full bg-slate-900/95 border-2 border-sky-500/60 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-2xl space-y-4">
                    {/* Decision Header + Countdown Timer */}
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                          <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4" />
                          {activeChapter.decision.promptTitle}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 mt-1">
                          {activeChapter.decision.promptSubtitle}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="shrink-0 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono text-amber-300">
                        {decisionCountdown}s
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Countdown Progress Bar */}
                    <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-full bg-amber-400 transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          width: `${
                            (decisionCountdown /
                              activeChapter.decision.timeoutSeconds) *
                            100
                          }%`
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Interactive Branch Choices */}
                    <div className="space-y-2.5">
                      {activeChapter.decision.choices.map((choice) => {
                        const unlocked = isChoiceUnlocked(choice);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={choice.id}
                            disabled={!unlocked}
                            onClick={() => handleSelectChoice(choice)}
                            className={`w-full text-left p-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-all flex items-start justify-between gap-3 ${
                              unlocked
                                ? 'bg-slate-950/90 border-slate-700 hover:border-sky-400 hover:bg-sky-500/10 cursor-pointer group'
                                : 'bg-slate-950/40 border-slate-800/60 opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed'
                            }`}
                          >
                            <div className="space-y-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                {!unlocked ? (
                                  <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
                                ) : (
                                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
                                )}
                                <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white group-hover:text-sky-300">
                                  {choice.label}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
                                {choice.description}
                              </p>
                              {choice.badgeText && (
                                <div className="inline-block text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-emerald-300 border border-slate-700 mt-1">
                                  {choice.badgeText}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>

                            {unlocked && (
                              <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 group-hover:text-sky-400 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform shrink-0 mt-1" />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Subtitles (Hidden while Decision Card is open) */}
              {!decisionActive && activeSegment && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-4 inset-x-5 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-center shadow-2xl">
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider uppercase text-sky-400 mb-0.5">
                      {activeSegment.speaker}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-white leading-relaxed">
                      {activeSegment.text}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Scrubber & Quick Jump to Decision Gate */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={activeChapter.duration}
                step={0.05}
                value={currentTime}
                onChange={(e) => seek(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              />

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition"
                  >
                    {isPlaying ? <Pause className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Play className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    {isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
                  </button>

                  {activeChapter.decision && !decisionActive && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => seek(activeChapter.decision!.triggerTime - 0.3)}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium transition"
                    >
                      <GitBranch className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      Skip to Decision Gate ({activeChapter.decision.triggerTime}s)
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
                  <Film className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                  <span>{activeShotLabel}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Panel: Persistent Inventory, Flags & Interactive Checkpoint Time-Travel */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {/* Persistent Inventory Slots */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" /> Persistent Inventory
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400">
                  {worldState.inventory.length} Items
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                {worldState.inventory.map((item) => (
                  <div
                    key={item.id}
                    className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-xs"
                  >
                    <span
                      className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full shrink-0 mt-0.5 shadow"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: item.color }}
                    />
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="font-semibold text-white truncate">
                        {item.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-snug">
                        {item.description}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Persistent World Flags & Bone Socket Attachments */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3 rounded-xl space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
                <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> World Flags & Hand Sockets
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono">
                {Object.entries(worldState.flags).map(([k, v]) => (
                  <div
                    key={k}
                    className="bg-slate-900 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded border border-slate-800 flex justify-between"
                  >
                    <span className="text-slate-400">{k}:</span>
                    <span className={v ? 'text-emerald-400 font-bold' : 'text-slate-500'}>
                      {String(v)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono bg-slate-900 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded border border-slate-800 text-sky-300">
                Right-Hand Socket:{' '}
                {worldState.socketAttachments['holo_core']
                  ? 'holo_core → Aria.ForearmR'
                  : 'Empty (Core on Pedestal)'}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Visited Chapter Checkpoints (Click to Rewind World State & Transforms!) */}
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <History className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" /> Branch Checkpoints
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Click to Time-Travel</span>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {checkpointHistory.map((snap, idx) => {
                  const isCurrent = idx === checkpointHistory.length - 1;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={`${snap.chapterId}_${idx}`}
                      onClick={() => handleRestoreCheckpoint(snap, idx)}
                      className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs border transition ${
                        isCurrent
                          ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/60 text-white'
                          : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400 mb-0.5">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Step {idx + 1}
                        </span>
                        <span>
                          Aria:{' '}
                          {snap.worldState.characterTransforms.actor_aria.position.join(
                            ', '
                          )}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-200">
                        {snap.chapterTitle}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-400 mt-0.5 truncate">
                        Choice: {snap.choiceMadeLabel}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
4. Why Dynamic Spline Stitching Solves Multi-Hour Interactive Storytelling
Zero Combinatorial Explosion for the Author or LLM: In Chapter 3 (ch3_convergence_finale), ARIA might arrive from the central pedestal ([-0.2, 0, -0.8] in Branch 2A) or from Zephyr's console ([1.1, 0, 0.9] in Branch 2B). Because rebuildChapterSplines inspects inheritStartPose: true and injects ARIA's live [x, y, z] world coordinate as Waypoint 0 of Chapter 3's spline, the author only writes Chapter 3 once, and the 3D engine smoothly routes ARIA from whichever branch the viewer chose.

Instant State-Safe Time Travel: Because every ChapterCheckpointSnapshot serializes the full world state (inventory, flags, socketAttachments, and characterTransforms) in less than 1 KB of JSON, a viewer watching a 4-hour interactive course or story can click any past node in their decision tree and resume from that exact spatial and inventory state immediately.

Where should we take the engine next?

Build the TTS-to-Timeline symbolic anchor compiler

Design the small-LLM system prompt & JSON generator

Add WebM/MP4 video export for chosen story paths
Add option to pause and inspect every asset and environment of the current stage of scene by moving the observing camera using keyboard or mouse including orientation and height from ground. Also, give option to have zoom around view of any point or asset by selecting that experience and clicking the asset while paused. Once resume is clicked all assets and observer should snap back to how they where at the start of pause and continue to be consistency. We can have slow mo snap-back to give it some appeal with cinematic camera swerve.

Adding an Interactive "Bullet-Time" Pause Inspector & Cinematic Slow-Mo Snap-Back turns a passive 3D video into an explorable spatial sandbox without sacrificing a single frame of timeline determinism.

2. Complete React + Three.js Renderer with Pause Inspector, Orbit Zoom & Slow-Mo Swerve
Install three and lucide-react (npm install three lucide-react). This component integrates:

Full Keyboard & Mouse Free-Roam Observer (PAUSED_FREE_ROAM): Pause at any frame and use W/A/S/D or Arrow Keys to fly/walk around the frozen 3D stage, Q/E (or the live Height-From-Ground Slider) to change elevation, and mouse drag to look in any direction.

Click-Any-Asset / Click-Any-Point Orbit Zoom (PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET): Click any character (ARIA, ZEPHYR), the held/pedestal Quantum Core, the Containment Pedestal, or any point on the floor grid while paused to smoothly zoom into a 360° turntable orbit around that exact target. You can even test-spin or elevate the selected asset while inspecting it—and watch it snap back into alignment during the slow-mo resume!

Visual Ghost Director Marker: While you explore the paused scene, a glowing amber Saved Director Camera Frustum stays suspended in 3D space so you can see where the timeline camera is waiting for you, and watch yourself swerve back into it on resume.
