// ============================================================================
// 3. MATHEMATICAL & INTERPOLATION UTILITIES
// ============================================================================

function smoothstep(x: number): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  return c * c * (3 - 2 * c);
}

function easeInOutQuint(x: number): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  return c < 0.5 ? 16 * c * c * c * c * c : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * c + 2, 5) / 2;
}

/**
 * Evaluates a 3D Quadratic Bezier Curve B(u) = (1-u)^2 * P0 + 2(1-u)u * P1 + u^2 * P2
 */
function evalQuadraticBezier3D(
  p0: THREE.Vector3,
  pApex: THREE.Vector3,
  p2: THREE.Vector3,
  u: number
): THREE.Vector3 {
  const inv = 1 - u;
  return new THREE.Vector3()
    .addScaledVector(p0, inv * inv)
    .addScaledVector(pApex, 2 * inv * u)
    .addScaledVector(p2, u * u);
}

/**
 * Computes an outward/upward Cinematic Apex Control Point between P_start and P_end
 * so the Snap-Back camera swerves gracefully around the stage rather than cutting through actors.
 */
function computeCinematicSwerveApex(
  pStart: THREE.Vector3,
  pEnd: THREE.Vector3
): THREE.Vector3 {
  const mid = new THREE.Vector3().addVectors(pStart, pEnd).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  const chord = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(pEnd, pStart);
  const dist = chord.length();

  // Horizontal perpendicular vector for lateral swerve
  const horiz = new THREE.Vector3(chord.x, 0, chord.z);
  let perp = new THREE.Vector3(-horiz.z, 0, horiz.x);
  if (perp.lengthSq() < 0.001) {
    perp.set(1, 0, 0);
  } else {
    perp.normalize();
  }

  // Ensure the lateral curve bows outward away from the stage center (0,0,0)
  const testPoint = mid.clone().addScaledVector(perp, 1.0);
  if (testPoint.lengthSq() < mid.lengthSq()) {
    perp.negate();
  }

  const lateralSwerve = Math.min(2.8, dist * 0.42);
  const verticalLift = Math.min(1.6, dist * 0.22 + 0.35);

  return mid
    .addScaledVector(perp, lateralSwerve)
    .add(new THREE.Vector3(0, verticalLift, 0));
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. 15-BONE ARTICULATED HUMANOID RIG BUILDER
// ============================================================================

interface CharacterRigInstance {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  morphMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
  hipsBone: THREE.Bone;
  spineBone: THREE.Bone;
  headBone: THREE.Bone;
  smoothedHeadingQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedHeadOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  currentSplineTangent: THREE.Vector3;
}

function tagHierarchyWithAssetId(obj: THREE.Object3D, assetId: string) {
  obj.userData.inspectAssetId = assetId;
  obj.traverse((child) => {
    child.userData.inspectAssetId = assetId;
  });
}

function createArticulatedRig(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  color: string,
  accentColor: string,
  initPos: Vector3Tuple
): CharacterRigInstance {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  root.position.set(...initPos);

  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.02, 0);
  root.add(hipsBone);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.35, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.72, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const forearmLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmLBone.name = 'ForearmL';
  forearmLBone.position.set(-0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(forearmLBone);

  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const forearmRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmRBone.name = 'ForearmR';
  forearmRBone.position.set(0.18, -0.4, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(forearmRBone);

  const thighLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighLBone.name = 'ThighL';
  thighLBone.position.set(-0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighLBone);

  const shinLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinLBone.name = 'ShinL';
  shinLBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighLBone.add(shinLBone);

  const thighRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighRBone.name = 'ThighR';
  thighRBone.position.set(0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighRBone);

  const shinRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinRBone.name = 'ShinR';
  shinRBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighRBone.add(shinRBone);

  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color,
    roughness: 0.3,
    metalness: 0.45
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.65
  });
  const accentMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: accentColor,
    emissive: accentColor,
    emissiveIntensity: 0.6
  });

  hipsBone.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.72, 0.24, 0.42), darkMat));

  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.86, 0.88, 0.46), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.14, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  const chestBadge = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.18, 0.06), accentMat);
  chestBadge.position.set(0, 0.28, 0.24);
  spineBone.add(chestBadge);

  const upperArmGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const armL = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armL.position.set(-0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(armL);

  const handL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handL.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmLBone.add(handL);

  const armR = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armR.position.set(0.1, -0.18, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(armR);

  const handR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.095, 0.32, 8, 16), bodyMat);
  handR.position.set(0, -0.18, 0.05);
  forearmRBone.add(handR);

  const thighGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const shinGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, 0.38, 8, 16);

  const thighLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighLBone.add(thighLMesh);

  const shinLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinLBone.add(shinLMesh);

  const thighRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighRBone.add(thighRMesh);

  const shinRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinRBone.add(shinRMesh);

  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.62, 0.6), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const visorMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.54, 0.16, 0.08), accentMat);
  visorMesh.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.28);
  headBone.add(visorMesh);

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.08, 0.08),
    accentMat
  );
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.14, 0.29);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  const qEuler = (x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(x, y, z)).toArray();

  const walkTimes = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0];
  const walkClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Walk', 1.0, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      walkTimes,
      [-0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, 0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, -0.03, 0.99, 0]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, -0.08)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, 0.08)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  const walkAct = mixer.clipAction(walkClip);
  walkAct.play();
  walkAct.setEffectiveWeight(1);
  actions.set('Walk', walkAct);

  tagHierarchyWithAssetId(root, id);

  return {
    id,
    name,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    hipsBone,
    spineBone,
    headBone,
    smoothedHeadingQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    currentSplineTangent: new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1)
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. MAIN REACT COMPONENT: PAUSE INSPECTOR, ORBIT ZOOM & SLOW-MO SNAP-BACK
// ============================================================================

const DURATION = 22.0;
const SNAPBACK_DURATION_SEC = 1.45; // Duration of the cinematic Bezier camera swerve on Resume

export default function PauseInspectAndSlowMoSwervePlayer() {
  const [controlMode, setControlMode] = useState<CameraControlMode>('DIRECTOR_PLAYING');
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [selectedAssetId, setSelectedAssetId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [assetSpinOffsetDeg, setAssetSpinOffsetDeg] = useState<number>(0);
  const [assetHeightOffsetM, setAssetHeightOffsetM] = useState<number>(0);

  const [telemetry, setTelemetry] = useState<InspectorTelemetry>({
    mode: 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING',
    camPos: [0, 1.7, 3.5],
    groundHeightMeters: 1.7,
    yawDeg: 0,
    pitchDeg: 0,
    fovDeg: 44,
    orbitDistance: 2.2,
    selectedAsset: null,
    clickedWorldPoint: null,
    snapbackProgressPct: 100,
    currentTimeScale: 1.0
  });

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const controlModeRef = useRef<CameraControlMode>('DIRECTOR_PLAYING');

  // Keyboard state map for Free-Roam WASD / Arrow / QE flying
  const keysPressedRef = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Free-Roam & Orbit Camera State Refs
  const freeCamPosRef = useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.8, 3.8));
  const freeCamYawRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const freeCamPitchRef = useRef<number>(-0.12);
  const freeCamFovRef = useRef<number>(45);

  const orbitPivotRef = useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.2, 0));
  const orbitTargetPointRef = useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.2, 0));
  const orbitRadiusRef = useRef<number>(2.1);
  const orbitTargetRadiusRef = useRef<number>(2.1);
  const orbitThetaRef = useRef<number>(0.4);
  const orbitPhiRef = useRef<number>(1.25); // Spherical polar angle from +Y
  const autoTurntableRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  // Snap-Back Bezier Swerve State Refs
  const snapbackElapsedRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const snapStartPosRef = useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3());
  const snapStartLookRef = useRef<THREE.Vector3>(new THREE.Vector3());
  const snapStartFovRef = useRef<number>(45);
  const pausedDirectorPoseRef = useRef<{
    position: THREE.Vector3;
    lookAt: THREE.Vector3;
    fov: number;
  }>({
    position: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.7, 3.5),
    lookAt: new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.3, 0),
    fov: 44
  });

  // Inspector Asset Manipulation Refs (Automatically slerped back to 0 during SNAPBACK_SWERVE!)
  const selectedAssetIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const assetSpinRadRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const assetLiftMetersRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const sceneObjectsMapRef = useRef<Map<string, THREE.Object3D>>(new Map());

  useEffect(() => {
    controlModeRef.current = controlMode;
  }, [controlMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    selectedAssetIdRef.current = selectedAssetId;
  }, [selectedAssetId]);

  const activeDialogue = useMemo(() => {
    return (
      SCENE_DIALOGUE.find(
        (d) => currentTime >= d.start && currentTime <= d.end
      ) || null
    );
  }, [currentTime]);

  const activeShot = useMemo(() => {
    let shot = SCENE_SHOTS[0];
    for (let i = 0; i < SCENE_SHOTS.length; i++) {
      if (currentTime >= SCENE_SHOTS[i].startTime) {
        shot = SCENE_SHOTS[i];
      }
    }
    return shot;
  }, [currentTime]);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // ENTER PAUSE & INSPECT MODE (Captures exact Director Camera Snapshot)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleEnterPauseInspect = useCallback(
    (initialSubMode: 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM' | 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET' = 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM') => {
      const savedPose = pausedDirectorPoseRef.current;
      freeCamPosRef.current.copy(savedPose.position);
      freeCamFovRef.current = savedPose.fov;

      // Derive initial yaw & pitch from the Director camera's lookAt vector
      const lookDir = new THREE.Vector3()
        .subVectors(savedPose.lookAt, savedPose.position)
        .normalize();
      freeCamYawRef.current = Math.atan2(-lookDir.x, -lookDir.z);
      freeCamPitchRef.current = Math.asin(
        THREE.MathUtils.clamp(lookDir.y, -0.95, 0.95)
      );

      if (initialSubMode === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET') {
        const defaultTargetId = selectedAssetIdRef.current || 'actor_aria';
        setSelectedAssetId(defaultTargetId);
        const obj = sceneObjectsMapRef.current.get(defaultTargetId);
        if (obj) {
          const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(obj);
          const center = new THREE.Vector3();
          box.getCenter(center);
          orbitTargetPointRef.current.copy(center);
          orbitPivotRef.current.copy(center);
        }
        orbitTargetRadiusRef.current = 2.0;
        const offset = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(
          savedPose.position,
          orbitTargetPointRef.current
        );
        orbitRadiusRef.current = Math.max(1.1, offset.length());
        orbitThetaRef.current = Math.atan2(offset.x, offset.z);
        orbitPhiRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          Math.acos( THREE.MathUtils.clamp(offset.y / orbitRadiusRef.current, -0.95, 0.95) ),
          0.2,
          Math.PI / 2 - 0.04
        );
      }

      setControlMode(initialSubMode);
    },
    []
  );

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // FOCUS & ORBIT-ZOOM ON ANY ASSET BY ID (WHILE PAUSED)
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleFocusAssetOrbit = useCallback((assetId: string) => {
    const obj = sceneObjectsMapRef.current.get(assetId);
    if (!obj) return;

    if (controlModeRef.current === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING') {
      // Automatically pause if user clicks an asset in the inspector list while playing
      const savedPose = pausedDirectorPoseRef.current;
      freeCamPosRef.current.copy(savedPose.position);
    }

    const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(obj);
    const center = new THREE.Vector3();
    const size = new THREE.Vector3();
    box.getCenter(center);
    box.getSize(size);

    orbitTargetPointRef.current.copy(center);
    // Ideal zoom distance proportional to bounding box size
    const maxDim = Math.max(0.8, Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z));
    orbitTargetRadiusRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(maxDim * 1.35, 1.15, 4.5);

    setSelectedAssetId(assetId);
    setAssetSpinOffsetDeg(0);
    setAssetHeightOffsetM(0);
    assetSpinRadRef.current = 0;
    assetLiftMetersRef.current = 0;
    setControlMode('PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET');
  }, []);

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // TRIGGER CINEMATIC SLOW-MO SNAP-BACK SWERVE ON RESUME
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleResumeWithSlowMoSwerve = useCallback(() => {
    // Capture exact current observer camera pose as the start of the Bezier swerve
    snapStartPosRef.current.copy(freeCamPosRef.current);

    if (controlModeRef.current === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET') {
      snapStartLookRef.current.copy(orbitPivotRef.current);
    } else {
      const forward = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1).applyEuler(
        new THREE.Euler(freeCamPitchRef.current, freeCamYawRef.current, 0, 'YXZ')
      );
      snapStartLookRef.current
        .copy(freeCamPosRef.current)
        .addScaledVector(forward, 3.0);
    }

    snapStartFovRef.current = freeCamFovRef.current;
    snapbackElapsedRef.current = 0;
    autoTurntableRef.current = false;
    setControlMode('SNAPBACK_SWERVE');
  }, []);

  // Adjust Height From Ground directly via UI Slider
  const handleGroundHeightChange = (newHeightMeters: number) => {
    const clampedY = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(10.0, newHeightMeters));
    if (controlModeRef.current === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING') {
      handleEnterPauseInspect('PAUSED_FREE_ROAM');
    }
    freeCamPosRef.current.y = clampedY;
    if (controlModeRef.current === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET') {
      // Convert new height into spherical phi angle relative to orbit pivot
      const dy = clampedY - orbitPivotRef.current.y;
      const ratio = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dy / orbitRadiusRef.current, -0.9, 0.95);
      orbitPhiRef.current = Math.acos(ratio);
    }
  };

  // Global Keyboard Listeners for WASD / Arrow Keys / Q / E / Spacebar
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        ['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Space'].includes(
          e.code
        ) &&
        controlModeRef.current !== 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING'
      ) {
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      keysPressedRef.current.add(e.code);
    };
    const onKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      keysPressedRef.current.delete(e.code);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    };
  }, []);

  // ==========================================================================
  // 6. THREE.JS SCENE, RAYCASTER, GHOST FRUSTUM & 60FPS RENDER ENGINE
  // ==========================================================================

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color('#060a12');
    scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2('#060a12', 0.035);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      44,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.1,
      80
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.9));
    const keyLight = new THREE.PointLight('#60a5fa', 2.8, 30);
    keyLight.position.set(3, 7.5, 5);
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const rimLight = new THREE.PointLight('#a855f7', 1.8, 25);
    rimLight.position.set(-4, 5, -4);
    scene.add(rimLight);

    const objectMap = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();
    sceneObjectsMapRef.current = objectMap;

    // 1. Stage Floor & Grid (Inspectable + Click-to-Orbit any surface point!)
    const floorGroup = new THREE.Group();
    const floorPlane = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(20, 20),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#0b1120',
        roughness: 0.8,
        metalness: 0.2
      })
    );
    floorPlane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floorGroup.add(floorPlane);

    const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, '#1e293b', '#1e293b');
    gridHelper.position.y = 0.01;
    floorGroup.add(gridHelper);
    tagHierarchyWithAssetId(floorGroup, 'stage_floor');
    scene.add(floorGroup);
    objectMap.set('stage_floor', floorGroup);

    // 2. Magnetic Containment Pedestal
    const pedestalMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.42, 0.52, 0.95, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#334155',
        roughness: 0.35,
        metalness: 0.75
      })
    );
    pedestalMesh.position.set(-0.2, 0.475, -0.6);
    tagHierarchyWithAssetId(pedestalMesh, 'containment_pedestal');
    scene.add(pedestalMesh);
    objectMap.set('containment_pedestal', pedestalMesh);

    // 3. Quantum Tokamak Core
    const holoCoreMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.46, 0.14, 96, 20),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#a855f7',
        emissive: '#9333ea',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.65,
        roughness: 0.2,
        metalness: 0.8
      })
    );
    holoCoreMesh.position.set(-0.2, 1.52, -0.6);
    holoCoreMesh.scale.set(0.45, 0.45, 0.45);
    tagHierarchyWithAssetId(holoCoreMesh, 'holo_core');
    scene.add(holoCoreMesh);
    objectMap.set('holo_core', holoCoreMesh);

    // 4. Autonomous Telemetry Drone
    const droneMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.32, 0),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#f43f5e',
        emissive: '#e11d48',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.5,
        wireframe: false,
        roughness: 0.25,
        metalness: 0.7
      })
    );
    droneMesh.position.set(1.2, 2.7, -1.5);
    tagHierarchyWithAssetId(droneMesh, 'survey_drone');
    scene.add(droneMesh);
    objectMap.set('survey_drone', droneMesh);

    // 5. Sector-7 Gantry Archway
    const archGroup = new THREE.Group();
    const archMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: '#1e293b',
      roughness: 0.5,
      metalness: 0.7
    });
    const pillarL = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.45, 3.8, 0.45), archMat);
    pillarL.position.set(-2.6, 1.9, -3.2);
    const pillarR = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.45, 3.8, 0.45), archMat);
    pillarR.position.set(2.6, 1.9, -3.2);
    const crossBeam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(5.8, 0.45, 0.55), archMat);
    crossBeam.position.set(0, 3.8, -3.2);
    archGroup.add(pillarL, pillarR, crossBeam);
    tagHierarchyWithAssetId(archGroup, 'tactical_arch');
    scene.add(archGroup);
    objectMap.set('tactical_arch', archGroup);

    // 6. Articulated Character Rigs (ARIA & ZEPHYR)
    const ariaRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_aria',
      'ARIA',
      '#f1f5f9',
      '#38bdf8',
      [-3.0, 0, -1.5]
    );
    const zephyrRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_zephyr',
      'ZEPHYR',
      '#334155',
      '#10b981',
      [2.4, 0, 0.9]
    );
    scene.add(ariaRig.root, zephyrRig.root);
    objectMap.set('actor_aria', ariaRig.root);
    objectMap.set('actor_zephyr', zephyrRig.root);

    const rigsMap = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>([
      ['actor_aria', ariaRig],
      ['actor_zephyr', zephyrRig]
    ]);

    // Compile Catmull-Rom Splines
    const compiledSplines = new Map<
      string,
      { curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3; totalLength: number; strideLength: number }
    >();
    Object.entries(SCENE_SPLINES).forEach(([charId, segDef]) => {
      const pts = segDef.waypoints.map((w) => new THREE.Vector3(...w));
      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, true, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
      curve.arcLengthDivisions = 250;
      curve.updateArcLengths();
      compiledSplines.set(charId, {
        curve,
        totalLength: curve.getLength(),
        strideLength: segDef.strideLength || 1.3
      });

      const ribbon = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 90, 0.025, 8, true),
        new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: charId === 'actor_aria' ? '#38bdf8' : '#10b981',
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.45
        })
      );
      ribbon.position.y = 0.02;
      scene.add(ribbon);
    });

    // 7. Visual Ghost Director Camera Frustum + Swerve Trajectory Ribbon (Visible during Pause & Snap-Back!)
    const ghostCamGroup = new THREE.Group();
    const ghostBody = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.28, 0.2, 0.4),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#f59e0b', wireframe: true })
    );
    const ghostCone = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.35, 0.65, 4),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: '#f59e0b',
        wireframe: true,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.75
      })
    );
    ghostCone.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    ghostCone.rotation.z = Math.PI / 4;
    ghostCone.position.z = -0.5;
    ghostCamGroup.add(ghostBody, ghostCone);
    ghostCamGroup.visible = false;
    scene.add(ghostCamGroup);

    // 3D Selection Ring / Orbit Pivot Reticle (Visible when inspecting an asset or point)
    const selectionRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(0.45, 0.54, 32),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: '#22d3ee',
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.85
      })
    );
    selectionRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    selectionRing.visible = false;
    scene.add(selectionRing);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // MOUSE LOOK, PAN, SCROLL WHEEL & RAYCAST ASSET CLICK HANDLERS
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let isDragging = false;
    let dragButton = 0;
    let pointerDownPos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    let lastPointerPos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();

    const onMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      isDragging = true;
      dragButton = e.button;
      pointerDownPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
      lastPointerPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - lastPointerPos.x;
      const dy = e.clientY - lastPointerPos.y;
      lastPointerPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };

      // If user drags the mouse while playing, automatically enter Pause & Free-Roam!
      if (controlModeRef.current === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING') {
        handleEnterPauseInspect('PAUSED_FREE_ROAM');
        return;
      }

      if (controlModeRef.current === 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM') {
        if (dragButton === 0) {
          // Left-drag: Rotate Camera Yaw & Pitch
          freeCamYawRef.current -= dx * 0.0045;
          freeCamPitchRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            freeCamPitchRef.current - dy * 0.0045,
            -Math.PI / 2 + 0.08,
            Math.PI / 2 - 0.08
          );
        } else {
          // Right-drag: Pan laterally and vertically (adjusting height from ground)
          const right = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0).applyAxisAngle(
            new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
            freeCamYawRef.current
          );
          freeCamPosRef.current.addScaledVector(right, -dx * 0.012);
          freeCamPosRef.current.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            freeCamPosRef.current.y + dy * 0.012,
            0.15,
            10.0
          );
        }
      } else if (controlModeRef.current === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET') {
        autoTurntableRef.current = false;
        orbitThetaRef.current -= dx * 0.0065;
        orbitPhiRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          orbitPhiRef.current - dy * 0.0065,
          0.12,
          Math.PI / 2 - 0.03 // Prevents camera from dipping below the ground plane!
        );
      }
    };

    const onMouseUp = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const moveDist = Math.hypot(
        e.clientX - pointerDownPos.x,
        e.clientY - pointerDownPos.y
      );
      isDragging = false;

      // Short click (< 5px drag): Raycast into 3D scene to Orbit-Zoom any clicked asset or point!
      if (moveDist < 5 && e.button === 0) {
        const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(
          ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
          -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
        );
        raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

        const pickableRoots = Array.from(objectMap.values());
        const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(pickableRoots, true);

        if (hits.length > 0) {
          const hit = hits[0];
          const hitAssetId = hit.object.userData.inspectAssetId as string | undefined;

          if (controlModeRef.current === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING') {
            freeCamPosRef.current.copy(pausedDirectorPoseRef.current.position);
          }

          if (hitAssetId && hitAssetId !== 'stage_floor') {
            // Focus on the center of the clicked 3D Asset!
            const rootObj = objectMap.get(hitAssetId)!;
            const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(rootObj);
            const center = new THREE.Vector3();
            const size = new THREE.Vector3();
            box.getCenter(center);
            box.getSize(size);
            orbitTargetPointRef.current.copy(center);
            orbitTargetRadiusRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
              Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z) * 1.35,
              1.1,
              4.2
            );
            setSelectedAssetId(hitAssetId);
            setAssetSpinOffsetDeg(0);
            setAssetHeightOffsetM(0);
            assetSpinRadRef.current = 0;
            assetLiftMetersRef.current = 0;
          } else {
            // Clicked on the Stage Floor: Zoom-Orbit around that exact [x, y, z] 3D coordinate!
            orbitTargetPointRef.current.copy(hit.point);
            orbitTargetPointRef.current.y += 0.25;
            orbitTargetRadiusRef.current = 2.0;
            setSelectedAssetId('stage_floor');
          }

          // Initialize spherical angles smoothly from current camera position
          const offset = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(
            camera.position,
            orbitTargetPointRef.current
          );
          orbitRadiusRef.current = Math.max(0.9, offset.length());
          orbitThetaRef.current = Math.atan2(offset.x, offset.z);
          orbitPhiRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
            Math.acos(
              THREE.MathUtils.clamp(offset.y / orbitRadiusRef.current, -0.9, 0.95)
            ),
            0.18,
            Math.PI / 2 - 0.04
          );

          setControlMode('PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET');
        }
      }
    };

    const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (controlModeRef.current === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING') {
        handleEnterPauseInspect('PAUSED_FREE_ROAM');
      }
      if (controlModeRef.current === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET') {
        orbitTargetRadiusRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          orbitTargetRadiusRef.current + e.deltaY * 0.0025,
          0.75,
          8.5
        );
      } else if (controlModeRef.current === 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM') {
        // Dolly along look direction on scroll wheel
        const forward = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1).applyEuler(
          new THREE.Euler(freeCamPitchRef.current, freeCamYawRef.current, 0, 'YXZ')
        );
        freeCamPosRef.current.addScaledVector(forward, -e.deltaY * 0.003);
        freeCamPosRef.current.y = Math.max(0.15, freeCamPosRef.current.y);
      }
    };

    const onContextMenu = (e: MouseEvent) => e.preventDefault();

    const domElem = renderer.domElement;
    domElem.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    domElem.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
    domElem.addEventListener('contextmenu', onContextMenu);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 60 FPS MASTER RENDER LOOP (HANDLES ALL 4 CAMERA & TIMELINE STATES)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let rAF: number;
    let lastNow = performance.now();
    let frameCount = 0;

    const renderLoop = (now: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - lastNow) / 1000);
      lastNow = now;
      frameCount++;

      const mode = controlModeRef.current;
      let timeScale = 0;

      // 1. Advance Master Timeline Clock based on current Mode
      if (mode === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING') {
        timeScale = 1.0;
        timeRef.current = (timeRef.current + dt) % DURATION;
        setCurrentTime(timeRef.current);
      } else if (mode === 'SNAPBACK_SWERVE') {
        snapbackElapsedRef.current += dt;
        const rawU = Math.min(
          1,
          snapbackElapsedRef.current / SNAPBACK_DURATION_SEC
        );
        // Slow-Mo Time Ramp: Starts at 0.06x bullet-time and cubic-ramps to 1.0x as the camera swerves home!
        timeScale = 0.06 + 0.94 * (rawU * rawU * rawU);
        timeRef.current = (timeRef.current + dt * timeScale) % DURATION;
        setCurrentTime(timeRef.current);

        // Simultaneously snap any user-rotated/lifted asset back to 0 offset!
        assetSpinRadRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          assetSpinRadRef.current,
          0,
          0.18
        );
        assetLiftMetersRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          assetLiftMetersRef.current,
          0,
          0.18
        );

        if (rawU >= 1.0) {
          assetSpinRadRef.current = 0;
          assetLiftMetersRef.current = 0;
          setAssetSpinOffsetDeg(0);
          setAssetHeightOffsetM(0);
          controlModeRef.current = 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING';
          setControlMode('DIRECTOR_PLAYING');
        }
      }

      const t = timeRef.current;

      // 2. Deterministic Scene Graph Evaluation at Timestamp t
      // 2a. Props (Quantum Core & Orbiting Telemetry Drone)
      holoCoreMesh.position.set(-0.2, 1.52 + Math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.06, -0.6);
      holoCoreMesh.rotation.set(t * 1.4, t * 2.2, 0);

      const droneAngle = t * 0.75;
      droneMesh.position.set(
        Math.cos(droneAngle) * 2.4,
        2.55 + Math.sin(t * 3.0) * 0.15,
        Math.sin(droneAngle) * 1.8 - 0.5
      );
      droneMesh.rotation.set(t * 1.2, t * 1.8, 0);

      // 2b. Character Catmull-Rom Spline Locomotion & Stride Phase
      rigsMap.forEach((rig, charId) => {
        const sp = compiledSplines.get(charId);
        if (!sp) return;
        const u = (t / DURATION) % 1.0;
        const pos = sp.curve.getPointAt(u);
        const tan = sp.curve.getTangentAt(u).normalize();
        rig.root.position.copy(pos);
        rig.currentSplineTangent.copy(tan);

        const headingYaw = Math.atan2(tan.x, tan.z);
        rig.smoothedHeadingQuat.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, headingYaw, 0));
        rig.root.quaternion.copy(rig.smoothedHeadingQuat);

        const distTraveled = u * sp.totalLength;
        const stridePhase = (distTraveled / sp.strideLength) % 1.0;
        const walkAct = rig.actions.get('Walk');
        if (walkAct) {
          walkAct.time = stridePhase * walkAct.getClip().duration;
        }
        rig.mixer.update(0);
      });

      // 2c. Post-Mixer Mutual Head Look-At IK
      const ariaHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      const zephyrHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      ariaRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      zephyrRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      ariaRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(ariaHeadPos);
      zephyrRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(zephyrHeadPos);

      const applyMutualGaze = (
        rig: CharacterRigInstance,
        myHead: THREE.Vector3,
        otherHead: THREE.Vector3
      ) => {
        const rootQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
        rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootQuat);
        const localDir = otherHead
          .clone()
          .sub(myHead)
          .applyQuaternion(rootQuat.invert());
        const yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          Math.atan2(localDir.x, localDir.z),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-60),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(60)
        );
        rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(
          new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, yaw * 0.75, 0))
        );
      };
      applyMutualGaze(ariaRig, ariaHeadPos, zephyrHeadPos);
      applyMutualGaze(zephyrRig, zephyrHeadPos, ariaHeadPos);

      // 2d. Apply Optional Pause-Inspector Asset Manipulation (Turntable Spin / Elevation Lift)
      // Because Stage 2a/2b resets deterministic transforms every frame, applying the inspector offset here
      // means all assets automatically snap back to deterministic consistency when offset returns to 0!
      if (
        selectedAssetIdRef.current &&
        selectedAssetIdRef.current !== 'stage_floor'
      ) {
        const inspectedObj = objectMap.get(selectedAssetIdRef.current);
        if (inspectedObj) {
          inspectedObj.rotation.y += assetSpinRadRef.current;
          inspectedObj.position.y += assetLiftMetersRef.current;
        }
      }

      // 3. Evaluate Deterministic Director Camera Pose at Timestamp t
      let currentShot = SCENE_SHOTS[0];
      for (let i = 0; i < SCENE_SHOTS.length; i++) {
        if (t >= SCENE_SHOTS[i].startTime) currentShot = SCENE_SHOTS[i];
      }

      const lineDir = new THREE.Vector3()
        .subVectors(zephyrHeadPos, ariaHeadPos)
        .setY(0)
        .normalize();
      const sideNormal = new THREE.Vector3(-lineDir.z, 0, lineDir.x).normalize();

      const directorPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      const directorLook = new THREE.Vector3();
      const directorFov = currentShot.fov || 44;

      if (currentShot.shotType === 'splineDolly') {
        const tan = ariaRig.currentSplineTangent.clone().setY(0).normalize();
        const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x).normalize();
        directorPos
          .copy(ariaHeadPos)
          .addScaledVector(tan, 2.25)
          .addScaledVector(right, 0.35);
        directorPos.y = 1.68;
        directorLook.copy(ariaHeadPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.12, 0));
      } else if (currentShot.shotType === 'overTheShoulder') {
        const isAriaSubj = currentShot.subjectId === 'actor_aria';
        const subj = isAriaSubj ? ariaHeadPos : zephyrHeadPos;
        const anchor = isAriaSubj ? zephyrHeadPos : ariaHeadPos;
        const aToS = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(subj, anchor).setY(0).normalize();
        directorPos
          .copy(anchor)
          .addScaledVector(aToS, -1.15)
          .addScaledVector(sideNormal, 0.48);
        directorPos.y = anchor.y - 0.04;
        directorLook.lerpVectors(anchor, subj, 0.78);
      } else {
        directorLook.addVectors(ariaHeadPos, zephyrHeadPos).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        directorLook.y -= 0.12;
        const sep = Math.max(2.4, ariaHeadPos.distanceTo(zephyrHeadPos));
        directorPos
          .copy(directorLook)
          .addScaledVector(sideNormal, sep * 1.1);
        directorPos.y = 1.85;
      }

      pausedDirectorPoseRef.current = {
        position: directorPos.clone(),
        lookAt: directorLook.clone(),
        fov: directorFov
      };

      // Update Ghost Director Camera Marker in 3D space (Visible whenever paused or snapping back!)
      ghostCamGroup.visible = mode !== 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING';
      ghostCamGroup.position.copy(directorPos);
      ghostCamGroup.lookAt(directorLook);

      // 4. Apply Active Camera Mode (Director vs. Free-Roam vs. Orbit-Zoom vs. Slow-Mo Bezier Swerve)
      if (mode === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING') {
        selectionRing.visible = false;
        camera.up.set(0, 1, 0);
        camera.position.copy(directorPos);
        camera.lookAt(directorLook);
        camera.fov = directorFov;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        freeCamPosRef.current.copy(directorPos);
      } else if (mode === 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM') {
        selectionRing.visible = false;
        const keys = keysPressedRef.current;
        const moveSpeed = (keys.has('ShiftLeft') || keys.has('ShiftRight') ? 6.0 : 3.2) * dt;

        // Horizontal forward & right vectors aligned with camera yaw
        const forwardXZ = new THREE.Vector3(
          -Math.sin(freeCamYawRef.current),
          0,
          -Math.cos(freeCamYawRef.current)
        ).normalize();
        const rightXZ = new THREE.Vector3(
          Math.cos(freeCamYawRef.current),
          0,
          -Math.sin(freeCamYawRef.current)
        ).normalize();

        if (keys.has('KeyW') || keys.has('ArrowUp')) {
          freeCamPosRef.current.addScaledVector(forwardXZ, moveSpeed);
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyS') || keys.has('ArrowDown')) {
          freeCamPosRef.current.addScaledVector(forwardXZ, -moveSpeed);
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyD') || keys.has('ArrowRight')) {
          freeCamPosRef.current.addScaledVector(rightXZ, moveSpeed);
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyA') || keys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
          freeCamPosRef.current.addScaledVector(rightXZ, -moveSpeed);
        }
        // Q / E keys adjust camera Height From Ground!
        if (keys.has('KeyE') || keys.has('PageUp')) {
          freeCamPosRef.current.y = Math.min(10.0, freeCamPosRef.current.y + moveSpeed * 0.85);
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyQ') || keys.has('PageDown')) {
          freeCamPosRef.current.y = Math.max(0.15, freeCamPosRef.current.y - moveSpeed * 0.85);
        }

        camera.up.set(0, 1, 0);
        camera.position.copy(freeCamPosRef.current);
        camera.rotation.set(
          freeCamPitchRef.current,
          freeCamYawRef.current,
          0,
          'YXZ'
        );
      } else if (mode === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET') {
        // Also allow keyboard Q/E height adjustment & A/D orbit while in Orbit-Zoom mode!
        const keys = keysPressedRef.current;
        if (keys.has('KeyA') || keys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
          orbitThetaRef.current -= 1.8 * dt;
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyD') || keys.has('ArrowRight')) {
          orbitThetaRef.current += 1.8 * dt;
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyW') || keys.has('ArrowUp')) {
          orbitTargetRadiusRef.current = Math.max(0.75, orbitTargetRadiusRef.current - 2.2 * dt);
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyS') || keys.has('ArrowDown')) {
          orbitTargetRadiusRef.current = Math.min(8.0, orbitTargetRadiusRef.current + 2.2 * dt);
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyE')) {
          orbitPhiRef.current = Math.max(0.15, orbitPhiRef.current - 1.2 * dt);
        }
        if (keys.has('KeyQ')) {
          orbitPhiRef.current = Math.min(Math.PI / 2 - 0.04, orbitPhiRef.current + 1.2 * dt);
        }

        if (autoTurntableRef.current) {
          orbitThetaRef.current += 0.75 * dt;
        }

        // Smoothly damp pivot and radius toward clicked asset
        orbitPivotRef.current.lerp(orbitTargetPointRef.current, 0.16);
        orbitRadiusRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          orbitRadiusRef.current,
          orbitTargetRadiusRef.current,
          0.16
        );

        const r = orbitRadiusRef.current;
        const phi = orbitPhiRef.current;
        const theta = orbitThetaRef.current;

        const camX = orbitPivotRef.current.x + r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta);
        const camY = Math.max(0.15, orbitPivotRef.current.y + r * Math.cos(phi));
        const camZ = orbitPivotRef.current.z + r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);

        freeCamPosRef.current.set(camX, camY, camZ);
        camera.up.set(0, 1, 0);
        camera.position.copy(freeCamPosRef.current);
        camera.lookAt(orbitPivotRef.current);

        // Show 3D Selection Ring underneath the inspected asset/point
        selectionRing.visible = true;
        selectionRing.position.set(
          orbitPivotRef.current.x,
          0.03,
          orbitPivotRef.current.z
        );
        selectionRing.rotation.z = now * 0.002;
      } else if (mode === 'SNAPBACK_SWERVE') {
        selectionRing.visible = false;
        const rawU = Math.min(
          1,
          snapbackElapsedRef.current / SNAPBACK_DURATION_SEC
        );
        const u = easeInOutQuint(rawU);

        // Compute 3D Quadratic Bezier Swerve Arc from Observer Start Pose -> Live Moving Director Pose!
        const apexPos = computeCinematicSwerveApex(
          snapStartPosRef.current,
          directorPos
        );
        const swervePos = evalQuadraticBezier3D(
          snapStartPosRef.current,
          apexPos,
          directorPos,
          u
        );

        const swerveLook = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(
          snapStartLookRef.current,
          directorLook,
          smoothstep(rawU)
        );

        // Cinematic Dutch-Angle Roll & Dynamic FOV Warp peaking at mid-swerve (u = 0.5)
        const bankSin = Math.sin(rawU * Math.PI);
        const dutchRollRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-13 * bankSin);
        const dynamicFov =
          THREE.MathUtils.lerp(snapStartFovRef.current, directorFov, u) +
          10 * bankSin;

        camera.position.copy(swervePos);
        camera.up
          .set(Math.sin(dutchRollRad), Math.cos(dutchRollRad), 0)
          .normalize();
        camera.lookAt(swerveLook);
        camera.fov = dynamicFov;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        freeCamPosRef.current.copy(swervePos);
      }

      if (frameCount % 3 === 0) {
        const euler = new THREE.Euler().setFromQuaternion(camera.quaternion, 'YXZ');
        const selId = selectedAssetIdRef.current;
        setTelemetry({
          mode: controlModeRef.current,
          camPos: [
            Number(camera.position.x.toFixed(2)),
            Number(camera.position.y.toFixed(2)),
            Number(camera.position.z.toFixed(2))
          ],
          groundHeightMeters: Number(Math.max(0, camera.position.y).toFixed(2)),
          yawDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(euler.y)),
          pitchDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(euler.x)),
          fovDeg: Math.round(camera.fov),
          orbitDistance: Number(orbitRadiusRef.current.toFixed(2)),
          selectedAsset: selId ? ASSET_CATALOG[selId] || null : null,
          clickedWorldPoint: [
            Number(orbitTargetPointRef.current.x.toFixed(2)),
            Number(orbitTargetPointRef.current.y.toFixed(2)),
            Number(orbitTargetPointRef.current.z.toFixed(2))
          ],
          snapbackProgressPct:
            controlModeRef.current === 'SNAPBACK_SWERVE'
              ? Math.round(
                  Math.min(
                    1,
                    snapbackElapsedRef.current / SNAPBACK_DURATION_SEC
                  ) * 100
                )
              : 100,
          currentTimeScale: Number(timeScale.toFixed(2))
        });
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      domElem.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      domElem.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
      domElem.removeEventListener('contextmenu', onContextMenu);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [handleEnterPauseInspect]);

  const isPaused =
    controlMode === 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM' || controlMode === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET';

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-6 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-5">
        {/* Top Header & Mode Switcher */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              Interactive 3D Pause-Inspect Sandbox & Slow-Mo Bezier Snap-Back
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mt-1">
              Free-Roam Observer, Click-to-Orbit Asset Zoom & Cinematic Swerve Resume
            </h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
              Click any 3D character or prop to pause & orbit-zoom, or use WASD + Q/E to fly around the frozen stage
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {controlMode === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING' ? (
              <>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleEnterPauseInspect('PAUSED_FREE_ROAM')}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 transition"
                >
                  <Pause className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Pause & Free-Roam Stage
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleEnterPauseInspect('PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET')}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20 transition"
                >
                  <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Pause & Orbit-Zoom Assets
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={handleResumeWithSlowMoSwerve}
                disabled={controlMode === 'SNAPBACK_SWERVE'}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/25 transition animate-pulse"
              >
                <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
                {controlMode === 'SNAPBACK_SWERVE'
                  ? `Slow-Mo Swerve Snap-Back (${telemetry.snapbackProgressPct}%)...`
                  : 'Resume with Slow-Mo Camera Swerve'}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Main Grid: 3D Interactive Viewport + Inspector Controls */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {/* 3D Viewport (2 Cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[470px] bg-black overflow-hidden">
              <div
                ref={mountRef}
                className="w-full h-full cursor-crosshair"
                title="Click any 3D asset or floor point to Orbit-Zoom, or drag to look around!"
              />

              {/* Top-Left Live Camera & Mode Telemetry HUD */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300 pointer-events-none">
                <span
                  className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${
                    controlMode === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse'
                      : controlMode === 'SNAPBACK_SWERVE'
                      ? 'bg-purple-400 animate-ping'
                      : 'bg-amber-400'
                  }`}
                />
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white">
                  {controlMode === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING' && 'DIRECTOR LIVE (1.0x)'}
                  {controlMode === 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM' && 'PAUSED: 6-DOF FREE ROAM'}
                  {controlMode === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET' && 'PAUSED: ASSET ORBIT ZOOM'}
                  {controlMode === 'SNAPBACK_SWERVE' &&
                    `SLOW-MO SWERVE (${telemetry.currentTimeScale}x)`}
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-sky-400 font-mono">
                  Height: {telemetry.groundHeightMeters}m
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                  Yaw/Pitch: {telemetry.yawDeg}° / {telemetry.pitchDeg}°
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Interactive Controls Helper Overlay when Paused */}
              {isPaused && (
                <div className="absolute top-12 left-3 right-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-amber-500/40 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-slate-200">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                      <Navigation className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      {controlMode === 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM'
                        ? 'WASD/Arrows: Move • Q/E: Height • Drag: Look'
                        : 'Click Any 3D Asset to Zoom • Drag: 360° Orbit • Scroll: Zoom'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setControlMode('PAUSED_FREE_ROAM')}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold transition ${
                        controlMode === 'PAUSED_FREE_ROAM'
                          ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950'
                          : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      Free-Roam Walk/Fly
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (!selectedAssetId) setSelectedAssetId('actor_aria');
                        setControlMode('PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET');
                      }}
                      className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold transition ${
                        controlMode === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET'
                          ? 'bg-sky-400 text-slate-950'
                          : 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      Orbit-Zoom Target
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Selected Asset Floating Badge in Orbit Mode */}
              {controlMode === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET' && telemetry.selectedAsset && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-16 left-4 max-w-sm bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-sky-500/50 p-3 rounded-xl text-xs space-y-1 shadow-2xl pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sky-400 font-bold">
                    <span>ORBIT TARGET: {telemetry.selectedAsset.name}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono bg-sky-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                      r = {telemetry.orbitDistance}m
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-slate-300 leading-snug">
                    {telemetry.selectedAsset.description}
                  </p>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400">
                    Pivot Point: [{telemetry.clickedWorldPoint?.join(', ')}] • Dim:{' '}
                    {telemetry.selectedAsset.dimensions}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Synchronized Subtitles */}
              {activeDialogue && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-3 inset-x-6 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-center shadow-xl">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-sky-400 mr-2">
                      {activeDialogue.speaker}:
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs md:text-sm text-white">
                      {activeDialogue.text}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Timeline Scrubber & Transport Bar */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 space-y-3">
              <input
                type="range"
                min={0}
                max={DURATION}
                step={0.02}
                value={currentTime}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  timeRef.current = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                  setCurrentTime(timeRef.current);
                }}
                className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
              />

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {controlMode === 'DIRECTOR_PLAYING' ? (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleEnterPauseInspect('PAUSED_FREE_ROAM')}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition"
                    >
                      <Pause className="w-4 h-4" /> Pause & Inspect Scene
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={handleResumeWithSlowMoSwerve}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl transition"
                    >
                      <Play className="w-4 h-4" /> Resume (Slow-Mo Swerve)
                    </button>
                  )}

                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      timeRef.current = 0;
                      setCurrentTime(0);
                      setControlMode('DIRECTOR_PLAYING');
                    }}
                    className="p-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition"
                    title="Restart Timeline"
                  >
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-slate-400">
                  <Film className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-400" />
                  <span>{activeShot.label}</span>
                  <span>
                    ({currentTime.toFixed(1)}s / {DURATION.toFixed(1)}s)
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Panel: Camera Height/Orientation Controls & Click-to-Orbit Asset Catalog */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {/* Observer Camera Height From Ground & Orientation Sliders */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-3.5 rounded-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Compass className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" /> Observer Camera Rig
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-400">
                  [{telemetry.camPos.join(', ')}]
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Height from Ground Slider */}
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">
                    Height From Ground (Y-Elevation)
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-amber-300 font-semibold">
                    {telemetry.groundHeightMeters.toFixed(2)} m
                  </span>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min={0.15}
                  max={8.0}
                  step={0.05}
                  value={telemetry.groundHeightMeters}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleGroundHeightChange(parseFloat(e.target.value))
                  }
                  className="w-full accent-amber-400 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                />
              </div>

              {/* Quick Elevation Presets */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 pt-0.5">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleGroundHeightChange(0.35)}
                  className="py-1 px-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 rounded text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300 transition"
                >
                  Low Angle (0.35m)
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleGroundHeightChange(1.7)}
                  className="py-1 px-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 rounded text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300 transition"
                >
                  Eye Level (1.7m)
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleGroundHeightChange(5.5)}
                  className="py-1 px-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-800 rounded text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300 transition"
                >
                  Crane Bird&apos;s Eye (5.5m)
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Interactive Asset Manipulation While Paused (Snaps back on Resume!) */}
            {isPaused && selectedAssetId && selectedAssetId !== 'stage_floor' && (
              <div className="bg-sky-950/30 border border-sky-500/40 p-3.5 rounded-xl space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-sky-300">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Inspect & Test-Rotate Asset
                  </span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      autoTurntableRef.current = !autoTurntableRef.current;
                    }}
                    className="text-[10px] font-mono bg-sky-500/20 hover:bg-sky-500/30 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-sky-400/40"
                  >
                    Auto-Orbit Cam
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300">
                    <span>Rotate Selected Asset (Snaps back on Resume)</span>
                    <span className="text-sky-300">{assetSpinOffsetDeg}°</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min={-180}
                    max={180}
                    step={5}
                    value={assetSpinOffsetDeg}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const deg = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                      setAssetSpinOffsetDeg(deg);
                      assetSpinRadRef.current = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(deg);
                    }}
                    className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300">
                    <span>Elevate Asset for Inspection</span>
                    <span className="text-sky-300">+{assetHeightOffsetM.toFixed(2)}m</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min={0}
                    max={1.5}
                    step={0.05}
                    value={assetHeightOffsetM}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const m = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                      setAssetHeightOffsetM(m);
                      assetLiftMetersRef.current = m;
                    }}
                    className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Click-to-Orbit Scene Asset Catalog */}
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" /> Scene Assets (Click to Orbit-Zoom)
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {Object.values(ASSET_CATALOG).map((item) => {
                  const isSelected =
                    controlMode === 'PAUSED_ORBIT_ASSET' &&
                    selectedAssetId === item.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={item.id}
                      onClick={() => handleFocusAssetOrbit(item.id)}
                      className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs border transition flex items-center justify-between gap-2 ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/60 text-white shadow'
                          : 'bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800/60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="font-semibold truncate">{item.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          {item.category} • {item.dimensions}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400 shrink-0" />
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
