        ...qEuler(-1.35, -0.35, 1.05),
        ...qEuler(-1.42, -0.4, 1.12),
        ...qEuler(-1.35, -0.35, 1.05)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const waveClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Wave', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 1.95),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  [
    ['Idle', idleClip],
    ['Walk', walkClip],
    ['Explain', explainClip],
    ['PointRight', pointRightClip],
    ['Wave', waveClip]
  ].forEach(([cName, clip]) => {
    const act = mixer.clipAction(clip as THREE.AnimationClip);
    act.play();
    act.setEffectiveWeight(cName === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
    actions.set(cName as string, act);
  });

  return {
    id,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    headBone,
    smoothedHeadingQuat: new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
      new THREE.Euler(0, initRotY, 0)
    ),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    currentSplineTangent: new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(initRotY), 0, Math.cos(initRotY))
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. MAIN STUDIO COMPONENT: 3D WAYPOINT DRAGGING + MULTI-TRACK NLE + JSON EXPORT
// ============================================================================

export default function VisualSplineAndTimelineAuthoringStudio() {
  const [manifest, setManifest] = useState<SymbolicSceneManifest>(
    INITIAL_SYMBOLIC_MANIFEST
  );
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);

  // Viewport Camera Mode: 'editor_crane' makes dragging 3D floor waypoints effortless;
  // 'director_lens' previews the declarative camera cuts (`splineDolly`, `overTheShoulder`, `twoShot`)
  const [viewportCamMode, setViewportCamMode] = useState<
    'editor_crane' | 'director_lens'
  >('editor_crane');

  // Active Selection in either the 3D Viewport (Waypoint) or Multi-Track Timeline (Keyframe / Segment / Shot)
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState<TimelineSelection>({
    kind: 'keyframe',
    trackId: 'track_aria_clips',
    keyframeId: 'kf_a3'
  });

  const [showJsonExporter, setShowJsonExporter] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedJson, setCopiedJson] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [draggingWaypointLabel, setDraggingWaypointLabel] = useState<string | null>(
    null
  );

  // Compile Symbolic Manifest in < 1ms whenever `manifest` changes
  const compiled = useMemo(() => compileManifest(manifest), [manifest]);
  const compiledRef = useRef(compiled);
  useEffect(() => {
    compiledRef.current = compiled;
  }, [compiled]);

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const viewportCamModeRef = useRef(viewportCamMode);
  useEffect(() => {
    viewportCamModeRef.current = viewportCamMode;
  }, [viewportCamMode]);

  //Imperative Function Ref to Rebuild 3D Spline Tubes & Waypoint Gizmos When `manifest` Waypoints Change
  const rebuild3DSplinesRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(compiled.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
    },
    [compiled.duration]
  );

  // Master Clock Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const dt = (now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000;
        let next = timeRef.current + dt;
        if (next >= compiledRef.current.duration) next = 0;
        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying]);

  // ==========================================================================
  // 6. THREE.JS VIEWPORT WITH INTERACTIVE 3D WAYPOINT RAYCAST-PLANE DRAGGING
  // ==========================================================================

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color('#070b14');

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      45,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.15,
      60
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.92));
    const keyLight = new THREE.PointLight('#60a5fa', 2.8, 30);
    keyLight.position.set(2, 8, 5);
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, '#1e293b', '#1e293b');
    scene.add(grid);

    // Pedestal & Quantum Core
    const pedestalMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.36, 0.46, 0.95, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#1e293b',
        roughness: 0.4,
        metalness: 0.7
      })
    );
    pedestalMesh.position.set(-0.2, 0.475, -0.5);
    scene.add(pedestalMesh);

    const holoCoreMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.46, 0.14, 80, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#38bdf8',
        emissive: '#38bdf8',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.6,
        roughness: 0.2,
        metalness: 0.8
      })
    );
    holoCoreMesh.position.set(-0.2, 1.48, -0.5);
    holoCoreMesh.scale.set(0.42, 0.42, 0.42);
    scene.add(holoCoreMesh);

    // Articulated Character Rigs
    const ariaRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_aria',
      '#f1f5f9',
      '#38bdf8',
      [-3.2, 0, -1.6],
      0.5
    );
    const zephyrRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_zephyr',
      '#334155',
      '#10b981',
      [2.4, 0, -0.8],
      -1.1
    );
    scene.add(ariaRig.root, zephyrRig.root);

    const rigsMap = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>([
      ['actor_aria', ariaRig],
      ['actor_zephyr', zephyrRig]
    ]);

    // Group holding 3D Catmull-Rom Spline Ribbons & Draggable Waypoint Gizmo Handles
    const splineGizmoGroup = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(splineGizmoGroup);

    const waypointHandles: THREE.Mesh[] = [];
    const activeCurvesMap = new Map<
      string,
      {
        curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3;
        totalLength: number;
        startTime: number;
        endTime: number;
        strideLength: number;
      }
    >();

    const buildSplineVisualsFromCompiled = () => {
      splineGizmoGroup.clear();
      waypointHandles.length = 0;
      activeCurvesMap.clear();

      const comp = compiledRef.current;
      comp.tracks.forEach((track) => {
        if (track.property !== 'splinePath') return;
        const isAria = track.targetId === 'actor_aria';
        const colorHex = isAria ? '#38bdf8' : '#10b981';

        track.resolvedSegments.forEach((seg) => {
          if (seg.waypoints.length < 2) return;
          const pts = seg.waypoints.map((w) => new THREE.Vector3(w[0], w[1], w[2]));
          const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, false, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
          curve.arcLengthDivisions = 250;
          curve.updateArcLengths();

          activeCurvesMap.set(track.targetId, {
            curve,
            totalLength: curve.getLength(),
            startTime: seg.resolvedStart,
            endTime: seg.resolvedEnd,
            strideLength: seg.strideLength
          });

          // 3D Spline Tube Ribbon
          const tube = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 72, 0.035, 8, false),
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
              color: colorHex,
              transparent: true,
              opacity: 0.8
            })
          );
          tube.position.y = 0.03;
          splineGizmoGroup.add(tube);

          // Interactive Draggable 3D Waypoint Handles
          seg.waypoints.forEach((wp, wpIdx) => {
            const handleMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
              new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.22, 0.14, 24),
              new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: wpIdx === 0 ? '#facc15' : colorHex,
                emissive: wpIdx === 0 ? '#eab308' : colorHex,
                emissiveIntensity: 0.55,
                roughness: 0.2
              })
            );
            handleMesh.position.set(wp[0], wp[1] + 0.08, wp[2]);

            // Outer ring for easy raycast picking
            const ring = new THREE.Mesh(
              new THREE.RingGeometry(0.26, 0.34, 24),
              new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                color: '#ffffff',
                side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.65
              })
            );
            ring.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            ring.position.y = -0.05;
            handleMesh.add(ring);

            handleMesh.userData = {
              isWaypointHandle: true,
              trackId: track.id,
              segmentId: seg.id,
              waypointIndex: wpIdx,
              targetId: track.targetId
            };

            splineGizmoGroup.add(handleMesh);
            waypointHandles.push(handleMesh);
          });
        });
      });
    };

    rebuild3DSplinesRef.current = buildSplineVisualsFromCompiled;
    buildSplineVisualsFromCompiled();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3D RAYCAST-TO-FLOOR-PLANE WAYPOINT DRAGGER + EDITOR CAMERA ORBIT
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const groundDragPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);
    const planeIntersectPoint = new THREE.Vector3();

    let draggedHandleInfo: {
      trackId: string;
      segmentId: string;
      waypointIndex: number;
      targetId: string;
    } | null = null;

    let isOrbitingEditorCam = false;
    let lastMouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    let editorCamTheta = 0.25;
    let editorCamPhi = 1.02;
    let editorCamRadius = 7.4;

    const getNormalizedMouse = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      return new THREE.Vector2(
        ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
        -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
      );
    };

    const onMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      lastMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
      const ndc = getNormalizedMouse(e);
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

      const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(waypointHandles, true);
      if (hits.length > 0) {
        // Walk up to the handleMesh carrying userData.isWaypointHandle
        let obj: THREE.Object3D | null = hits[0].object;
        while (obj && !obj.userData?.isWaypointHandle) {
          obj = obj.parent;
        }
        if (obj && obj.userData?.isWaypointHandle) {
          const { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId } = obj.userData;
          draggedHandleInfo = { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId };
          setSelection({
            kind: 'waypoint',
            trackId,
            segmentId,
            waypointIndex,
            targetId
          });
          setDraggingWaypointLabel(
            `${targetId} • Waypoint #${waypointIndex + 1}`
          );
          renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
          return;
        }
      }

      if (viewportCamModeRef.current === 'editor_crane') {
        isOrbitingEditorCam = true;
      }
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const ndc = getNormalizedMouse(e);
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

      // Case 1: Actively Dragging a 3D Spline Waypoint along the Y = 0 Floor Plane!
      if (draggedHandleInfo) {
        if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(groundDragPlane, planeIntersectPoint)) {
          const clampedX = Number(
            THREE.MathUtils.clamp(planeIntersectPoint.x, -4.5, 4.5).toFixed(2)
          );
          const clampedZ = Number(
            THREE.MathUtils.clamp(planeIntersectPoint.z, -3.5, 3.5).toFixed(2)
          );
          const { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId } =
            draggedHandleInfo;

          setManifest((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
              if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.segments) return tr;
              return {
                ...tr,
                segments: tr.segments.map((seg) => {
                  if (seg.id !== segmentId) return seg;
                  const nextWps = [...seg.waypoints];
                  nextWps[waypointIndex] = [clampedX, 0, clampedZ];
                  return { ...seg, waypoints: nextWps };
                })
              };
            })
          }));

          setDraggingWaypointLabel(
            `${targetId} WP #${waypointIndex + 1} → [${clampedX}, 0, ${clampedZ}]`
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      // Case 2: Orbiting the Editor Crane Camera
      if (isOrbitingEditorCam && viewportCamModeRef.current === 'editor_crane') {
        const dx = e.clientX - lastMouse.x;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastMouse.y;
        lastMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
        editorCamTheta -= dx * 0.0055;
        editorCamPhi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          editorCamPhi - dy * 0.0055,
          0.3,
          1.42
        );
        return;
      }

      // Case 3: Hover cursor feedback over 3D Waypoint Gizmos
      const hoverHits = raycaster.intersectObjects(waypointHandles, true);
      renderer.domElement.style.cursor =
        hoverHits.length > 0 ? 'grab' : 'default';
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      draggedHandleInfo = null;
      isOrbitingEditorCam = false;
      setDraggingWaypointLabel(null);
      renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'default';
    };

    const onWheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      if (viewportCamModeRef.current === 'editor_crane') {
        e.preventDefault();
        editorCamRadius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          editorCamRadius + e.deltaY * 0.004,
          3.5,
          13.0
        );
      }
    };

    const dom = renderer.domElement;
    dom.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
    dom.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 60 FPS RENDER LOOP
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let rAF: number;

    const renderLoop = () => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      const comp = compiledRef.current;

      // 1. Evaluate Character Spline Locomotion & Skeletal Clips
      rigsMap.forEach((rig, charId) => {
        const clipTrack = comp.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === charId && tr.property === 'animationClip'
        );
        let baseClip = 'Idle';
        if (clipTrack) {
          for (const kf of clipTrack.resolvedKeyframes) {
            if (t >= kf.resolvedTime) baseClip = String(kf.value);
          }
        }

        const sp = activeCurvesMap.get(charId);
        let walkWeight = 0;
        let stridePhase = 0;

        if (sp) {
          const dur = Math.max(0.05, sp.endTime - sp.startTime);
          const inWindow = t >= sp.startTime && t <= sp.endTime;
          const rawA = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - sp.startTime) / dur));
          const u = smoothstep(rawA);

          const pos = sp.curve.getPointAt(u);
          const tan = sp.curve.getTangentAt(u).normalize();
          rig.root.position.copy(pos);
          rig.currentSplineTangent.copy(tan);

          if (inWindow && sp.totalLength > 0.1) {
            const uNext = smoothstep(
              Math.min(1, (t + 0.03 - sp.startTime) / dur)
            );
            const speed = (Math.abs(uNext - u) * sp.totalLength) / 0.03;
            walkWeight = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(speed / 0.85, 0, 1);
          }

          const headingYaw = Math.atan2(tan.x, tan.z);
          rig.smoothedHeadingQuat.slerp(
            new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, headingYaw, 0)),
            0.25
          );
          rig.root.quaternion.copy(rig.smoothedHeadingQuat);
          stridePhase = ((u * sp.totalLength) / sp.strideLength) % 1.0;
        }

        rig.actions.forEach((act, name) => {
          if (name === 'Walk') {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(walkWeight);
            act.time = stridePhase * act.getClip().duration;
          } else if (name === baseClip) {
            const isUpper =
              baseClip === 'Explain' ||
              baseClip === 'PointRight' ||
              baseClip === 'Wave';
            act.setEffectiveWeight(isUpper ? 0.9 : 1 - walkWeight);
            act.time = t % (act.getClip().duration || 1);
          } else {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(0);
          }
        });

        rig.mixer.update(0);
      });

      // 2. Post-Mixer Head Look-At IK & Visemes
      const ariaHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      const zephyrHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      ariaRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      zephyrRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      ariaRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(ariaHeadPos);
      zephyrRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(zephyrHeadPos);

      const gazeTrack = comp.tracks.find((tr) => tr.id === 'track_aria_gaze');
      let ariaTarget = 'actor_zephyr';
      if (gazeTrack) {
        for (const kf of gazeTrack.resolvedKeyframes) {
          if (t >= kf.resolvedTime) ariaTarget = String(kf.value);
        }
      }

      // Pulse Holo Core when Aria looks/points at it
      const isCoreHighlighted = ariaTarget === 'holo_core';
      const targetScale = isCoreHighlighted ? 0.78 : 0.42;
      holoCoreMesh.scale.lerp(
        new THREE.Vector3(targetScale, targetScale, targetScale),
        0.15
      );
      holoCoreMesh.rotation.set(t * 1.8, t * 2.5, 0);

      const ariaTargetVec =
        ariaTarget === 'holo_core'
          ? holoCoreMesh.position.clone()
          : zephyrHeadPos.clone();

      const applyGaze = (
        rig: CharacterRigInstance,
        myHead: THREE.Vector3,
        targetWorld: THREE.Vector3
      ) => {
        const rootQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
        rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootQuat);
        const localDir = targetWorld
          .clone()
          .sub(myHead)
          .applyQuaternion(rootQuat.invert());
        const yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          Math.atan2(localDir.x, localDir.z),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-62),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(62)
        );
        rig.smoothedHeadOffset.slerp(
          new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, yaw * 0.8, 0)),
          0.2
        );
        rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedHeadOffset);
      };
      applyGaze(ariaRig, ariaHeadPos, ariaTargetVec);
      applyGaze(zephyrRig, zephyrHeadPos, ariaHeadPos);

      // Visemes
      rigsMap.forEach((rig, charId) => {
        const activeLine = comp.dialogue.find(
          (d) => d.speakerId === charId && t >= d.startSec && t <= d.endSec
        );
        const weights: Record<string, number> = {};
        ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (weights[v] = 0));
        if (activeLine) {
          activeLine.visemes.forEach((cue) => {
            const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
            const halfW = Math.max(0.035, cue.duration * 0.8);
            const dist = Math.abs(t - center);
            if (dist < halfW) {
              weights[cue.viseme] = Math.max(
                weights[cue.viseme] || 0,
                Math.cos((dist / halfW) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight
              );
            }
          });
        }
        rig.morphMeshes.forEach((mesh) => {
          const dict = mesh.morphTargetDictionary;
          const inf = mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
          if (!dict || !inf) return;
          ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName) => {
            const idx = dict[vName];
            if (typeof idx === 'number') {
              inf[idx] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inf[idx], weights[vName] || 0, 0.45);
            }
          });
        });
      });

      // 3. Camera Mode: Editor Crane (for easy 3D Waypoint Dragging) vs. Declarative Director Lens
      if (viewportCamModeRef.current === 'editor_crane') {
        const cx =
          editorCamRadius * Math.sin(editorCamPhi) * Math.sin(editorCamTheta);
        const cy = editorCamRadius * Math.cos(editorCamPhi);
        const cz =
          editorCamRadius * Math.sin(editorCamPhi) * Math.cos(editorCamTheta);
        camera.position.set(cx, cy, cz);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0.6, 0);
        camera.fov = 46;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      } else {
        let activeShot = comp.cameraShots[0];
        for (const s of comp.cameraShots) {
          if (t >= s.resolvedStart) activeShot = s;
        }
        const lineDir = new THREE.Vector3()
          .subVectors(zephyrHeadPos, ariaHeadPos)
          .setY(0)
          .normalize();
        const sideNormal = new THREE.Vector3(-lineDir.z, 0, lineDir.x).normalize();

        if (activeShot.shotType === 'splineDolly') {
          const tan = ariaRig.currentSplineTangent.clone().setY(0).normalize();
          const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x).normalize();
          camera.position
            .copy(ariaHeadPos)
            .addScaledVector(tan, 2.2)
            .addScaledVector(right, 0.35);
          camera.position.y = 1.68;
          camera.lookAt(ariaHeadPos.x, ariaHeadPos.y - 0.1, ariaHeadPos.z);
        } else if (activeShot.shotType === 'overTheShoulder') {
          const isAria = activeShot.subjectId === 'actor_aria';
          const subj = isAria ? ariaHeadPos : zephyrHeadPos;
          const anchor = isAria ? zephyrHeadPos : ariaHeadPos;
          const aToS = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(subj, anchor).setY(0).normalize();
          camera.position
            .copy(anchor)
            .addScaledVector(aToS, -1.15)
            .addScaledVector(sideNormal, 0.48);
          camera.position.y = anchor.y - 0.04;
          camera.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(anchor, subj, 0.78));
        } else {
          const mid = new THREE.Vector3()
            .addVectors(ariaHeadPos, zephyrHeadPos)
            .multiplyScalar(0.5);
          mid.y -= 0.12;
          const sep = Math.max(2.3, ariaHeadPos.distanceTo(zephyrHeadPos));
          camera.position.copy(mid).addScaledVector(sideNormal, sep * 1.12);
          camera.position.y = 1.78;
          camera.lookAt(mid);
        }
        camera.fov = activeShot.fov;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      dom.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      dom.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, []);

  // Trigger instant 3D spline geometry rebuild whenever `compiled` updates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (rebuild3DSplinesRef.current) {
      rebuild3DSplinesRef.current();
    }
  }, [compiled]);

  // ==========================================================================
  // 7. TIMELINE & WAYPOINT MUTATION HANDLERS
  // ==========================================================================

  const handleInsertWaypointAfterSelected = () => {
    if (selection.kind !== 'waypoint') return;
    const { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId } = selection;

    setManifest((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
        if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.segments) return tr;
        return {
          ...tr,
          segments: tr.segments.map((seg) => {
            if (seg.id !== segmentId) return seg;
            const wps = [...seg.waypoints];
            const cur = wps[waypointIndex];
            const next = wps[waypointIndex + 1];
            const newPt: Vector3Tuple = next
              ? [
                  Number(((cur[0] + next[0]) / 2).toFixed(2)),
                  0,
                  Number(((cur[2] + next[2]) / 2).toFixed(2))
                ]
              : [Number((cur[0] + 0.7).toFixed(2)), 0, Number((cur[2] + 0.5).toFixed(2))];
            wps.splice(waypointIndex + 1, 0, newPt);
            return { ...seg, waypoints: wps };
          })
        };
      })
    }));

    setSelection({
      kind: 'waypoint',
      trackId,
      segmentId,
      waypointIndex: waypointIndex + 1,
      targetId
    });
  };

  const handleDeleteSelectedWaypoint = () => {
    if (selection.kind !== 'waypoint') return;
    const { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId } = selection;

    setManifest((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
        if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.segments) return tr;
        return {
          ...tr,
          segments: tr.segments.map((seg) => {
            if (seg.id !== segmentId || seg.waypoints.length <= 2) return seg;
            const wps = seg.waypoints.filter((_, idx) => idx !== waypointIndex);
            return { ...seg, waypoints: wps };
          })
        };
      })
    }));

    setSelection({
      kind: 'waypoint',
      trackId,
      segmentId,
      waypointIndex: Math.max(0, waypointIndex - 1),
      targetId
    });
  };

  const handleUpdateSelectedKeyframe = (
    newTimeExpr: TimeExpression,
    newValue?: any
  ) => {
    if (selection.kind !== 'keyframe') return;
    const { trackId, keyframeId } = selection;

    setManifest((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
        if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.keyframes) return tr;
        return {
          ...tr,
          keyframes: tr.keyframes.map((kf) => {
            if (kf.id !== keyframeId) return kf;
            return {
              ...kf,
              time: newTimeExpr,
              value: newValue !== undefined ? newValue : kf.value
            };
          })
        };
      })
    }));
  };

  const handleAddKeyframeToTrack = (trackId: string) => {
    const newId = `kf_${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;
    const defaultAnchor = `@line_2.word("surge")`;

    setManifest((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
        if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.keyframes) return tr;
        const defaultVal =
          tr.property === 'animationClip' ? 'Wave' : 'holo_core';
        return {
          ...tr,
          keyframes: [
            ...tr.keyframes,
            { id: newId, time: defaultAnchor, value: defaultVal, crossFade: 0.3 }
          ]
        };
      })
    }));

    setSelection({ kind: 'keyframe', trackId, keyframeId: newId });
  };

  const handleDeleteSelectedKeyframe = () => {
    if (selection.kind !== 'keyframe') return;
    const { trackId, keyframeId } = selection;

    setManifest((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
        if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.keyframes || tr.keyframes.length <= 1)
          return tr;
        return {
          ...tr,
          keyframes: tr.keyframes.filter((kf) => kf.id !== keyframeId)
        };
      })
    }));
  };

  const handleUpdateSplineSegmentTiming = (
    field: 'startTime' | 'endTime',
    expr: string
  ) => {
    if (selection.kind !== 'splineSegment') return;
    const { trackId, segmentId } = selection;
    setManifest((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
        if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.segments) return tr;
        return {
          ...tr,
          segments: tr.segments.map((seg) =>
            seg.id === segmentId ? { ...seg, [field]: expr } : seg
          )
        };
      })
    }));
  };

  const handleUpdateCameraShot = (
    field: 'startTime' | 'endTime' | 'shotType',
    val: string
  ) => {
    if (selection.kind !== 'cameraShot') return;
    setManifest((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      cameraShots: prev.cameraShots.map((s) =>
        s.id === selection.shotId ? { ...s, [field]: val } : s
      )
    }));
  };

  const exportedJsonString = useMemo(
    () => JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2),
    [manifest]
  );

  const handleDownloadSymbolicJson = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([exportedJsonString], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${manifest.id}_symbolic.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const activeDialogue = useMemo(
    () =>
      compiled.dialogue.find(
        (d) => currentTime >= d.startSec && currentTime <= d.endSec
      ) || null,
    [compiled.dialogue, currentTime]
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-5 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-4">
        {/* Top Studio Toolbar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-3.5 rounded-2xl">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sky-400 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
              3D Spline Waypoint Manipulator & Symbolic Multi-Track NLE Studio
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-white mt-0.5">
              Drag 3D Waypoints on the Stage Floor • Bind Keyframes to Spoken Words • Export Symbolic JSON
            </h1>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            {/* Viewport Lens Toggle */}
            <div className="flex bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
              <button
                onClick={() => setViewportCamMode('editor_crane')}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  viewportCamMode === 'editor_crane'
                    ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Move className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 3D Editor Crane (Drag Waypoints)
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setViewportCamMode('director_lens')}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition ${
                  viewportCamMode === 'director_lens'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Active Director Camera
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => setShowJsonExporter(!showJsonExporter)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-purple-500/20 hover:bg-purple-500/30 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/50 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition"
            >
              <Code2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              {showJsonExporter ? 'Hide Symbolic JSON' : 'Export Symbolic JSON'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Upper Row: 3D Interactive Stage Viewport (2 Cols) + Symbolic Property Inspector (1 Col) */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {/* 3D Interactive Stage Viewport */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[360px] bg-black overflow-hidden">
              <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Top-Left Live Status Overlay */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300 pointer-events-none">
                <span
                  className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                    isPlaying ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-400'
                  }`}
                />
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white">
                  T+{currentTime.toFixed(2)}s / {compiled.duration.toFixed(2)}s
                </span>
                <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                <span className="text-sky-400">
                  {viewportCamMode === 'editor_crane'
                    ? 'Click & Drag Any Glowing Cylinder to Reshape 3D Spline'
                    : 'Previewing Declarative Camera Director Shots'}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Active 3D Waypoint Drag Coordinate Readout */}
              {draggingWaypointLabel && (
                <div className="absolute top-12 left-3 bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-mono font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs shadow-lg pointer-events-none">
                  DRAGGING: {draggingWaypointLabel}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Subtitle Preview */}
              {activeDialogue && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-3 inset-x-6 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-center">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-sky-400 mr-2">
                      {activeDialogue.speaker}:
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs md:text-sm text-white">
                      {activeDialogue.text}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Viewport Transport Bar */}
            <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition"
                >
                  {isPlaying ? <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  {isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => seek(0)}
                  className="p-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                Yellow Node = Spline Start (WP #1) • Cyan = Aria Path • Emerald = Zephyr Path
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Col: Context-Sensitive Symbolic Inspector OR Live JSON Exporter */}
          <div className="flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {showJsonExporter ? (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Code2 className="w-4 h-4" /> Exported Symbolic JSON
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        navigator.clipboard.writeText(exportedJsonString);
                        setCopiedJson(true);
                        setTimeout(() => setCopiedJson(false), 1800);
                      }}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs transition"
                    >
                      {copiedJson ? (
                        <>
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> Copied
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={handleDownloadSymbolicJson}
                      className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition"
                    >
                      <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> .JSON
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <pre className="flex-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 text-[11px] font-mono text-sky-300 overflow-auto max-h-[330px]">
                  {exportedJsonString}
                </pre>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3">
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-400" />
                      Symbolic Inspector ({selection.kind})
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* INSPECTOR MODE 1: 3D SPLINE WAYPOINT SELECTED */}
                  {selection.kind === 'waypoint' && (() => {
                    const tr = manifest.tracks.find(
                      (t) => t.id === selection.trackId
                    );
                    const seg = tr?.segments?.find(
                      (s) => s.id === selection.segmentId
                    );
                    const wp = seg?.waypoints[selection.waypointIndex];
                    if (!wp || !seg) return null;

                    return (
                      <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                        <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                          <div className="text-sky-400 font-bold">
                            {selection.targetId} • Waypoint #{selection.waypointIndex + 1} of{' '}
                            {seg.waypoints.length}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-slate-300">
                            World XYZ: [{wp[0].toFixed(2)}, {wp[1].toFixed(2)},{' '}
                            {wp[2].toFixed(2)}]
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 pt-1">
                            Drag this cylinder directly in the 3D viewport or use the fine sliders below.
                          </p>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-2 font-mono">
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px]">
                              <span className="text-slate-400">X Coordinate</span>
                              <span className="text-sky-300">{wp[0].toFixed(2)}m</span>
                            </div>
                            <input
                              type="range"
                              min={-4.5}
                              max={4.5}
                              step={0.05}
                              value={wp[0]}
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                const val = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                                setManifest((prev) => ({
                                  ...prev,
                                  tracks: prev.tracks.map((t) =>
                                    t.id !== selection.trackId
                                      ? t
                                      : {
                                          ...t,
                                          segments: t.segments?.map((s) => {
                                            if (s.id !== selection.segmentId) return s;
                                            const next = [...s.waypoints];
                                            next[selection.waypointIndex] = [
                                              val,
                                              wp[1],
                                              wp[2]
                                            ];
                                            return { ...s, waypoints: next };
                                          })
                                        }
                                  )
                                }));
                              }}
                              className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg"
                            />
                          </div>

                          <div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px]">
                              <span className="text-slate-400">Z Coordinate</span>
                              <span className="text-emerald-300">{wp[2].toFixed(2)}m</span>
                            </div>
                            <input
                              type="range"
                              min={-3.5}
                              max={3.5}
                              step={0.05}
                              value={wp[2]}
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                const val = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                                setManifest((prev) => ({
                                  ...prev,
                                  tracks: prev.tracks.map((t) =>
                                    t.id !== selection.trackId
                                      ? t
                                      : {
                                          ...t,
                                          segments: t.segments?.map((s) => {
                                            if (s.id !== selection.segmentId) return s;
                                            const next = [...s.waypoints];
                                            next[selection.waypointIndex] = [
                                              wp[0],
                                              wp[1],
                                              val
                                            ];
                                            return { ...s, waypoints: next };
                                          })
                                        }
                                  )
                                }));
                              }}
                              className="w-full accent-emerald-400 h-1.5 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg"
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
                          <button
                            onClick={handleInsertWaypointAfterSelected}
                            className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-sky-500/20 hover:bg-sky-500/30 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/40 py-2 rounded-xl font-semibold transition"
                          >
                            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Insert Waypoint
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={handleDeleteSelectedWaypoint}
                            disabled={seg.waypoints.length <= 2}
                            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-rose-500/20 hover:bg-rose-500/30 disabled:opacity-40 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl font-semibold transition"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}

                  {/* INSPECTOR MODE 2: TIMELINE KEYFRAME SELECTED */}
                  {selection.kind === 'keyframe' && (() => {
                    const tr = compiled.tracks.find(
                      (t) => t.id === selection.trackId
                    );
                    const kf = tr?.resolvedKeyframes.find(
                      (k) => k.id === selection.keyframeId
                    );
                    if (!tr || !kf) return null;

                    return (
                      <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                        <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                          <div className="flex justify-between">
                            <span className="text-sky-400 font-bold">{tr.label}</span>
                            <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400">
                              Resolved: {kf.resolvedTime.toFixed(2)}s
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <label className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Symbolic Time Anchor Expression
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={String(kf.time)}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateSelectedKeyframe(e.target.value)
                            }
                            className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 focus:border-sky-400 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-amber-300 text-xs outline-none"
                          />
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <label className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            {tr.property === 'animationClip'
                              ? 'Skeletal Animation Clip'
                              : 'Gaze Target Asset ID'}
                          </label>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                            {(tr.property === 'animationClip'
                              ? ['Idle', 'Explain', 'PointRight', 'Wave']
                              : ['actor_zephyr', 'holo_core', 'camera']
                            ).map((opt) => (
                              <button
                                key={opt}
                                onClick={() =>
                                  handleUpdateSelectedKeyframe(kf.time, opt)
                                }
                                className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg font-mono text-[11px] border transition ${
                                  kf.value === opt
                                    ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-bold border-sky-400'
                                    : 'bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 border-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {opt}
                              </button>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* One-Click Snap Keyframe to Any Spoken Word Token */}
                        <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                            1-Click Snap Keyframe to Spoken Word:
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 max-h-28 overflow-y-auto p-1.5 bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                            {compiled.dialogue.map((line) =>
                              line.words
                                .filter((w) => w.cleanWord.length >= 4)
                                .map((w) => {
                                  const expr = `@${line.id}.word("${w.cleanWord}")`;
                                  return (
                                    <button
                                      key={`${line.id}_${w.index}`}
                                      onClick={() => {
                                        handleUpdateSelectedKeyframe(expr);
                                        seek(w.start);
                                      }}
                                      className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-sky-500/20 text-slate-300 hover:text-sky-300 border border-slate-800 rounded text-[10px] font-mono transition"
                                    >
                                      @{line.id}:&quot;{w.cleanWord}&quot;
                                    </button>
                                  );
                                })
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleAddKeyframeToTrack(tr.id)}
                            className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-sky-500/20 hover:bg-sky-500/30 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/40 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-semibold transition"
                          >
                            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Add Keyframe
                          </button>
                          <button
                            onClick={handleDeleteSelectedKeyframe}
                            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-rose-500/20 hover:bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-semibold transition"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}

                  {/* INSPECTOR MODE 3: SPLINE SEGMENT BLOCK SELECTED */}
                  {selection.kind === 'splineSegment' && (() => {
                    const tr = compiled.tracks.find(
                      (t) => t.id === selection.trackId
                    );
                    const seg = tr?.resolvedSegments.find(
                      (s) => s.id === selection.segmentId
                    );
                    if (!tr || !seg) return null;

                    return (
                      <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                        <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                          <div className="text-sky-400 font-bold">{tr.label}</div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">
                            Compiled Window: {seg.resolvedStart.toFixed(2)}s →{' '}
                            {seg.resolvedEnd.toFixed(2)}s
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <label className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Symbolic Start Anchor
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={String(seg.startTime)}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateSplineSegmentTiming(
                                'startTime',
                                e.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-amber-300 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <label className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Symbolic End Anchor (Arrival Word)
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={String(seg.endTime)}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateSplineSegmentTiming(
                                'endTime',
                                e.target.value
                              )
                            }
                            className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-amber-300 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}

                  {/* INSPECTOR MODE 4: CAMERA SHOT BLOCK SELECTED */}
                  {selection.kind === 'cameraShot' && (() => {
                    const shot = compiled.cameraShots.find(
                      (s) => s.id === selection.shotId
                    );
                    if (!shot) return null;

                    return (
                      <div className="space-y-3 text-xs">
                        <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                          <div className="text-purple-300 font-bold">
                            Camera Shot: {shot.label}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">
                            {shot.resolvedStart.toFixed(2)}s →{' '}
                            {shot.resolvedEnd.toFixed(2)}s
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <label className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Declarative Shot Archetype
                          </label>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
                            {(
                              [
                                'splineDolly',
                                'overTheShoulder',
                                'twoShot',
                                'closeUp'
                              ] as ShotType[]
                            ).map((st) => (
                              <button
                                key={st}
                                onClick={() =>
                                  handleUpdateCameraShot('shotType', st)
                                }
                                className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg font-mono text-[11px] border ${
                                  shot.shotType === st
                                    ? 'bg-purple-500 text-slate-950 font-bold border-purple-400'
                                    : 'bg-slate-950 text-slate-300 border-slate-800'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {st}
                              </button>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="space-y-1">
                          <label className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Symbolic Start Expression
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={String(shot.startTime)}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              handleUpdateCameraShot('startTime', e.target.value)
                            }
                            className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-amber-300 text-xs"
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}
                </div>

                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800/80">
                  Tip: Click any diamond keyframe or track block in the Multi-Track Timeline below to inspect and rebind its symbolic anchor.
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Lower Section: Multi-Track NLE Symbolic Timeline Editor */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-3 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-sky-400">
              <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
              Multi-Track Symbolic Timeline Editor (Click Track Blocks or Keyframe Diamonds)
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
              Playhead: <span className="text-white font-bold">{currentTime.toFixed(2)}s</span> /{' '}
              {compiled.duration.toFixed(2)}s
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Interactive Timeline Ruler Scrubber */}
          <div className="relative pt-1">
            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={compiled.duration}
              step={0.02}
              value={currentTime}
              onChange={(e) => seek(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
              className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Track Lanes Container */}
          <div className="relative space-y-2 pt-1 select-none">
            {/* Vertical Red Playhead Line across all lanes */}
            <div
              className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-rose-500 z-20 pointer-events-none"
              style={{
                left: `calc(180px + (100% - 180px) * ${
                  currentTime / Math.max(1, compiled.duration)
                })`
              }}
            />

            {/* LANE 1: ACOUSTIC DIALOGUE & WORD BOUNDARY STREAM */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-[168px] shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-400 truncate">
                1. TTS Dialogue & Words
              </div>
              <div className="relative flex-1 h-11 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                {compiled.dialogue.map((line) => {
                  const leftPct = (line.startSec / compiled.duration) * 100;
                  const widthPct = (line.duration / compiled.duration) * 100;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={line.id}
                      onClick={() => seek(line.startSec)}
                      style={{ left: `${leftPct}%`, width: `${widthPct}%` }}
                      className="absolute top-1 bottom-1 bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden hover:bg-emerald-500/25 transition"
                    >
                      <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] font-mono text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                        <span>
                          @{line.id} ({line.speaker})
                        </span>
                        <span>{String(line.start)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-300 truncate">
                        {line.text}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* LANES 2–6: SPLINE SEGMENTS & SKELETAL / GAZE KEYFRAME TRACKS */}
            {compiled.tracks.map((track, tIdx) => (
              <div key={track.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-[168px] shrink-0 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 truncate flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>
                    {tIdx + 2}. {track.label}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="relative flex-1 h-9 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                  {/* Render Spline Locomotion Range Blocks */}
                  {track.resolvedSegments.map((seg) => {
                    const leftPct = (seg.resolvedStart / compiled.duration) * 100;
                    const widthPct =
                      ((seg.resolvedEnd - seg.resolvedStart) /
                        compiled.duration) *
                      100;
                    const isSelected =
                      selection.kind === 'splineSegment' &&
                      selection.segmentId === seg.id;

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={seg.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelection({
                            kind: 'splineSegment',
                            trackId: track.id,
                            segmentId: seg.id
                          });
                          seek(seg.resolvedStart);
                        }}
                        style={{ left: `${leftPct}%`, width: `${widthPct}%` }}
                        className={`absolute top-1 bottom-1 rounded-lg px-2 text-left text-[10px] font-mono truncate border transition ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'bg-sky-500/35 border-sky-400 text-white font-bold'
                            : 'bg-sky-500/15 border-sky-500/40 text-sky-300 hover:bg-sky-500/25'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {String(seg.startTime)} → {String(seg.endTime)} (
                        {seg.waypoints.length} WPs)
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}

                  {/* Render Diamond Keyframe Markers */}
                  {track.resolvedKeyframes.map((kf) => {
                    const leftPct = (kf.resolvedTime / compiled.duration) * 100;
                    const isSelected =
                      selection.kind === 'keyframe' &&
                      selection.keyframeId === kf.id;

                    return (
                      <button
                        key={kf.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelection({
                            kind: 'keyframe',
                            trackId: track.id,
                            keyframeId: kf.id
                          });
                          seek(kf.resolvedTime);
                        }}
                        style={{ left: `${leftPct}%` }}
                        className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 group flex items-center gap-1 z-10"
                        title={`${kf.value} @ ${kf.time} (${kf.resolvedTime.toFixed(
                          2
                        )}s)`}
                      >
                        <span
                          className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 rotate-45 block border transition ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-amber-400 border-white scale-125 shadow-lg shadow-amber-400/50'
                              : 'bg-sky-400 border-slate-950 hover:scale-110'
                          }`}
                        />
                        <span
                          className={`text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded whitespace-nowrap ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                              : 'bg-slate-900/90 text-slate-300 border border-slate-800'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {String(kf.value)}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

            {/* FINAL LANE: DECLARATIVE CAMERA DIRECTOR SHOTS */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-[168px] shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-purple-300 truncate">
                7. Camera Director
              </div>
              <div className="relative flex-1 h-10 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                {compiled.cameraShots.map((shot) => {
                  const leftPct = (shot.resolvedStart / compiled.duration) * 100;
                  const widthPct =
                    ((shot.resolvedEnd - shot.resolvedStart) /
                      compiled.duration) *
                    100;
                  const isSelected =
                    selection.kind === 'cameraShot' &&
                    selection.shotId === shot.id;

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={shot.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelection({ kind: 'cameraShot', shotId: shot.id });
                        seek(shot.resolvedStart + 0.05);
                      }}
                      style={{ left: `${leftPct}%`, width: `${widthPct}%` }}
                      className={`absolute top-1 bottom-1 rounded-lg px-2 text-left text-[10px] font-mono truncate border transition ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-purple-500/35 border-purple-400 text-white font-bold'
                          : 'bg-purple-500/15 border-purple-500/40 text-purple-300 hover:bg-purple-500/25'
                      }`}
                    >
                      [{shot.shotType}] {String(shot.startTime)}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
3. How the Studio Completes the Human + Small-LLM Workflow
Zero-Friction Spatial Refinement: A compact 8B LLM can draft a multi-chapter scene with rough waypoint coordinates ([[-3, 0, -1], [0, 0, 1]]) and symbolic word anchors (@line_2.word("surge")). Opening that JSON in this studio lets a human director fine-tune the exact 3D curve on the floor grid with their mouse in seconds while keeping all word-locked synchronization intact.

Round-Trip Symbolic Integrity: Because dragging 3D waypoints or rebinding keyframes mutates the Symbolic AST (SymbolicSceneManifest) rather than baking raw frame numbers, the exported .json remains compact, human-readable, and elastic if you swap TTS voices later.

Where would you like to take the platform next?

Design the small-LLM system prompt & JSON generator

Upgrade video exporter to faster-than-real-time WebCodecs MP4

Add procedural facial emotion layers & upper-body IK
Create the system prompt, few-shot examples, and structured JSON schema so a small 8B LLM can reliably generate symbolic multi-chapter scenes for this studio.

Getting a compact 7B–8B parameter model (such as Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-7B, or Gemma-2-9B) to author multi-chapter 3D scenes reliably requires designing the prompt and JSON schema around how autoregressive transformers generate tokens top-to-bottom.

1. Four Architectural Rules That Make 8B Models Succeed
Failure Mode in Naive Prompts	Root Cause in 8B Models	Architectural Fix in Our Schema & Prompt
Broken Word Anchors (e.g., @line_2.word('surge') when "surge" is missing from line_2.text)	tracks were placed before dialogue in the JSON schema, forcing the model to guess future words before writing the script.	Causal Field Ordering: The schema forces the LLM to emit dialogue first, followed by splineTracks, keyframeTracks, cameraShots, and decision. The model simply copies words already in its context window.
Spatial Collisions & Clipping (Characters walking through pedestals or standing at [0,0,0])	8B models lack an internal 3D physics simulator for arbitrary floating-point coordinates.	Named Stage Landmark Grid: The System Prompt provides a calibrated 9-Zone Stage Map (PEDESTAL_FRONT: [-0.2, 0, 0.3], STAGE_LEFT_ENTRY: [-3.2, 0, -1.6]) so the model routes splines between verified collision-free coordinates.
180-Degree Camera Whiplash (OTS cuts flipping left/right screen direction)	Small models struggle to compute cross-products to keep the camera on one side of the conversation axis.	Canonical Side Lock: The prompt mandates "side": "right" across all consecutive overTheShoulder and twoShot rules within a dialogue exchange.
Malformed Anchor Syntax (e.g., @line2:start or line_1.end + 0.5s)	Unconstrained sampling allows creative punctuation drift.	Constrained Decoding Regex: The JSON Schema enforces a strict regex pattern on every TimeExpression field at the token-sampler level (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, or OpenAI Structured Outputs).
2. The Production System Prompt (Copy-Paste Ready)
Use this exact system prompt for your 8B model. It is compact (~750 tokens) to preserve KV-cache budget while encoding every spatial, symbolic, and cinematographic constraint of the studio.

Markdown
You are a Deterministic 3D Scene & Cinematography Compiler. You convert narrative prompts into structured JSON manifests for a Three.js + TTS declarative video engine.

### 1. CAUSAL GENERATION ORDER (CRITICAL)
Always generate fields in this exact sequence so every symbolic anchor references an ID you have ALREADY defined above it:
1. `chapterPlan` (1-sentence blocking summary)
2. `dialogue` (sequential lines using `@prev_line.end + 0.35`)
3. `tracks` (splines first, then skeletal clips, gaze IK, and prop transforms)
4. `cameraShots` (declarative cinematography rules)
5. `decision` (optional mid-video branching card at `@last_line.end + 0.2`)

### 2. STAGE COORDINATE LANDMARKS (Y = 0.0 IS FLOOR)
Never place characters inside props. Route character `waypoints` using these collision-free stage coordinates `[x, 0, z]`:
- `STAGE_LEFT_BACK`: `[-3.2, 0, -1.6]`
- `STAGE_LEFT_MID`: `[-2.1, 0, 0.8]`
- `STAGE_LEFT_FRONT`: `[-1.2, 0, 1.5]`
- `PEDESTAL_PROP_POS`: `[-0.2, 0, -0.5]` (Occupied by `containment_pedestal` & `holo_core` — DO NOT WALK HERE)
- `PEDESTAL_APPROACH_LEFT`: `[-0.85, 0, 0.55]` (Safe mark to inspect/grab `holo_core`)
- `CENTER_FRONT`: `[0.2, 0, 1.4]`
- `CONSOLE_APPROACH_RIGHT`: `[1.1, 0, 0.7]`
- `STAGE_RIGHT_MID`: `[1.85, 0, 0.35]` (Default mark for `actor_zephyr`)
- `STAGE_RIGHT_BACK`: `[2.4, 0, -0.8]`

### 3. SYMBOLIC TIME EXPRESSION GRAMMAR
NEVER calculate or hardcode raw seconds after `line_1.start`. Bind all events to dialogue or spline IDs:
- Line start/end: `"@line_1.start"`, `"@line_1.end + 0.35"`
- Exact spoken word (MUST exist verbatim in that line's `text`): `"@line_2.word('surge')"`, `"@line_2.word('surge') - 0.1"`
- Fractional line progress: `"@line_2.progress(0.5)"`
- Spline milestone: `"@seg_aria_walk.end"`

### 4. CHARACTER RIGS, CLIPS & GAZE IK
- Valid `characterId`s: `"actor_aria"`, `"actor_zephyr"`
- Valid `propId`s: `"holo_core"`, `"containment_pedestal"`, `"survey_drone"`
- Valid `animationClip` values: `"Idle"`, `"Explain"`, `"PointRight"`, `"Wave"`, `"Inspect"`
  *(Note: `"Walk"` blends automatically whenever a `splinePath` segment is active; do not keyframe `"Walk"` manually.)*
- Valid `lookAtTarget` values: `"actor_aria"`, `"actor_zephyr"`, `"holo_core"`, `"survey_drone"`, `"camera"`, `"auto"`
- Cross-Chapter Continuity: In any branched chapter after Chapter 1, set `"inheritStartPose": true` on the first `splinePath` segment so the character walks smoothly from their previous chapter's final coordinate.

### 5. DECLARATIVE CAMERA DIRECTOR RULES (180-DEGREE LAW)
- Use `"splineDolly"` (`"dollyMode": "lead"` or `"parallel"`, `"fov": 44`) when a character is walking along a spline.
- Use `"overTheShoulder"` (`"fov": 35`) during dialogue exchanges. Set `"subjectId"` to the speaking character and `"secondaryId"` to the listening foreground character. Keep `"side": "right"` constant across cuts to respect the 180-degree line.
- Use `"twoShot"` (`"side": "right"`, `"fov": 45`) when framing both characters or before a `decision` prompt.
- Use `"closeUp"` (`"fov": 28`) for high-impact emotional or technical reveals.
3. Constrained-Decoding JSON Schema (OpenAI / vLLM / Llama.cpp / Outlines)
Pass this JSON Schema directly into response_format (vLLM, Ollama format, Llama.cpp, or OpenAI Structured Outputs). It enforces the symbolic anchor regex, valid asset enums, and top-to-bottom causal key ordering at the logit sampling layer.

JSON
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "SymbolicMultiChapterSceneManifest",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": ["storyId", "chapters"],
  "properties": {
    "storyId": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[a-z0-9_]+$"
    },
    "chapters": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 1,
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/ChapterNode"
      }
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "TimeExpression": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Either '0.2' for the first event, or a symbolic anchor like '@line_1.start', '@line_1.end + 0.35', '@line_2.word(\"surge\") - 0.1', or '@line_2.progress(0.5)'.",
      "pattern": "^([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?|@[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\\.(start|end|duration|word\\(\"[a-zA-Z0-9]+\"\\)|word\\([0-9]+\\)|progress\\(0\\.[0-9]+\\))(\\s*[+-]\\s*[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?)?)$"
    },
    "Vector3Tuple": {
      "type": "array",
      "minItems": 3,
      "maxItems": 3,
      "items": { "type": "number" }
    },
    "ActorOrPropId": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "actor_aria",
        "actor_zephyr",
        "holo_core",
        "containment_pedestal",
        "survey_drone",
        "camera",
        "auto"
      ]
    },
    "ChapterNode": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "id",
        "title",
        "subtitle",
        "chapterPlan",
        "dialogue",
        "tracks",
        "cameraShots",
        "decision"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^ch[0-9a-z_]+$"
        },
        "title": { "type": "string" },
        "subtitle": { "type": "string" },
        "chapterPlan": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Brief chain-of-thought summary of spatial blocking, key trigger words, and camera coverage."
        },
        "dialogue": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": ["id", "speakerId", "speaker", "start", "speakingRateWpm", "text"],
            "properties": {
              "id": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^line_[0-9]+$" },
              "speakerId": { "type": "string", "enum": ["actor_aria", "actor_zephyr"] },
              "speaker": { "type": "string", "enum": ["ARIA", "ZEPHYR"] },
              "start": { "$ref": "#/$defs/TimeExpression" },
              "speakingRateWpm": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 100, "maximum": 190 },
              "text": { "type": "string", "minLength": 10 }
            }
          }
        },
        "tracks": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": ["id", "label", "targetId", "property", "segments", "keyframes"],
            "properties": {
              "id": { "type": "string" },
              "label": { "type": "string" },
              "targetId": { "$ref": "#/$defs/ActorOrPropId" },
              "property": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": ["splinePath", "animationClip", "lookAtTarget", "scale", "color"]
              },
              "segments": {
                "type": ["array", "null"],
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "startTime",
                    "endTime",
                    "inheritStartPose",
                    "strideLength",
                    "waypoints"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "id": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^seg_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$" },
                    "startTime": { "$ref": "#/$defs/TimeExpression" },
                    "endTime": { "$ref": "#/$defs/TimeExpression" },
                    "inheritStartPose": { "type": "boolean" },
                    "strideLength": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0.8, "maximum": 1.8 },
                    "waypoints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "minItems": 2,
                      "maxItems": 6,
                      "items": { "$ref": "#/$defs/Vector3Tuple" }
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "keyframes": {
                "type": ["array", "null"],
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "required": ["id", "time", "value", "crossFade"],
                  "properties": {
                    "id": { "type": "string" },
                    "time": { "$ref": "#/$defs/TimeExpression" },
                    "value": {
                      "anyOf": [
                        {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "Idle",
                            "Explain",
                            "PointRight",
                            "Wave",
                            "Inspect",
                            "actor_aria",
                            "actor_zephyr",
                            "holo_core",
                            "survey_drone",
                            "camera",
                            "auto",
                            "#38bdf8",
                            "#f43f5e",
                            "#10b981",
                            "#facc15",
                            "#a855f7"
                          ]
                        },
                        { "$ref": "#/$defs/Vector3Tuple" }
                      ]
                    },
                    "crossFade": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 1.5 }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "cameraShots": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "required": [
              "id",
              "label",
              "startTime",
              "endTime",
              "shotType",
              "dollyMode",
              "subjectId",
              "secondaryId",
