              "side",
              "fov",
              "transitionDuration"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "id": { "type": "string" },
              "label": { "type": "string" },
              "startTime": { "$ref": "#/$defs/TimeExpression" },
              "endTime": { "$ref": "#/$defs/TimeExpression" },
              "shotType": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "splineDolly",
                  "overTheShoulder",
                  "twoShot",
                  "closeUp",
                  "establishingOrbit"
                ]
              },
              "dollyMode": {
                "type": ["string", "null"],
                "enum": ["lead", "follow", "parallel", null]
              },
              "subjectId": { "$ref": "#/$defs/ActorOrPropId" },
              "secondaryId": {
                "type": ["string", "null"],
                "enum": ["actor_aria", "actor_zephyr", "holo_core", null]
              },
              "side": { "type": "string", "enum": ["left", "right"] },
              "fov": { "type": "number", "minimum": 24, "maximum": 60 },
              "transitionDuration": { "type": "number", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 2.5 }
            }
          }
        },
        "decision": {
          "type": ["object", "null"],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "required": ["id", "triggerTime", "promptTitle", "promptSubtitle", "timeoutSeconds", "choices"],
          "properties": {
            "id": { "type": "string" },
            "triggerTime": { "$ref": "#/$defs/TimeExpression" },
            "promptTitle": { "type": "string" },
            "promptSubtitle": { "type": "string" },
            "timeoutSeconds": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 8, "maximum": 30 },
            "choices": {
              "type": "array",
              "minItems": 2,
              "maxItems": 3,
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "required": [
                  "id",
                  "label",
                  "description",
                  "targetChapterId",
                  "requiredItemId",
                  "effects"
                ],
                "properties": {
                  "id": { "type": "string" },
                  "label": { "type": "string" },
                  "description": { "type": "string" },
                  "targetChapterId": { "type": "string" },
                  "requiredItemId": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
                  "effects": {
                    "type": ["object", "null"],
                    "additionalProperties": false,
                    "required": ["addItem", "attachAssetToBone", "mutateAssetColor"],
                    "properties": {
                      "addItem": {
                        "type": ["object", "null"],
                        "additionalProperties": false,
                        "required": ["id", "name", "color", "description"],
                        "properties": {
                          "id": { "type": "string" },
                          "name": { "type": "string" },
                          "color": { "type": "string" },
                          "description": { "type": "string" }
                        }
                      },
                      "attachAssetToBone": {
                        "type": ["object", "null"],
                        "additionalProperties": false,
                        "required": ["assetId", "characterId", "boneName"],
                        "properties": {
                          "assetId": { "type": "string", "enum": ["holo_core", "survey_drone"] },
                          "characterId": { "type": "string", "enum": ["actor_aria", "actor_zephyr"] },
                          "boneName": { "type": "string", "enum": ["ForearmR", "ForearmL"] }
                        }
                      },
                      "mutateAssetColor": {
                        "type": ["object", "null"],
                        "additionalProperties": false,
                        "required": ["assetId", "color"],
                        "properties": {
                          "assetId": { "type": "string" },
                          "color": { "type": "string" }
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
4. Few-Shot Prompt Examples (Multi-Chapter + Word-Locked + Branching)
Include this 2-chapter few-shot pair in your prompt context. It teaches the 8B model how to:

Write a brief chapterPlan thought trace first.

Bind a spline arrival to @line_1.word("pedestal").

Trigger a PointRight gesture and prop scale expansion on @line_2.word("surge").

Stitch a downstream branched chapter seamlessly using "inheritStartPose": true.

JSON
{
  "userPrompt": "Create a 2-chapter interactive scene where Aria walks to the pedestal to inspect a core surge with Zephyr, then lets the viewer choose whether Aria grabs the Quantum Core into her right hand.",
  "assistantResponse": {
    "storyId": "quantum_breach_episode",

      {
        "id": "ch1_core_inspection",

        "subtitle": "Aria walks from Stage Left to the pedestal as the Quantum Core destabilizes",

In line_2, she points at holo_core on the word 'surge' while the core scales up. Camera starts with a lead splineDolly, cuts to OTS on Aria, then Reverse OTS on Zephyr before a Two-Shot decision.",
        "dialogue": [
          {
            "id": "line_1",
            "speakerId": "actor_aria",
            "speaker": "ARIA",
            "start": "0.2",

        "tracks": [
          {

5. Self-Healing Post-Validation & Auto-Repair Pass (sanitizeLLMScene.ts)
Even with constrained decoding, an 8B model can occasionally make a semantic mismatch—for example, writing "text": "The reactor is overloading!" in line_2 and then emitting "@line_2.word(\"overload\")" in a keyframe, or routing a waypoint too close to the central pedestal [-0.2, 0, -0.5].

Drop this lightweight sanitizer between the 8B LLM output and compileSymbolicManifest to guarantee 100% crash-free execution:

TypeScript
import { SymbolicSceneManifest } from './types';

const PEDESTAL_XZ = [-0.2, -0.5];
const MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_METERS = 0.65;

/**
 * Repairs semantic drift in 8B LLM outputs before passing to the 3D Studio:
 * 1. Fuzzy-matches `@line_X.word("token")` against actual words in `line_X.text` (prefix/stem/Levenshtein fallback).
 * 2. Pushes any character spline waypoint that clips inside the central pedestal outward to a safe radius.
 * 3. Ensures consecutive dialogue lines are chained sequentially if the LLM left `start: "0"` on line_2+.
 */
export function sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene(
  rawManifest: SymbolicSceneManifest
): { manifest: SymbolicSceneManifest; repairs: string[] } {
  const clone: SymbolicSceneManifest = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rawManifest));
  const repairs: string[] = [];

  // 1. Build lookup of clean words per dialogue line & repair unchained start times
  const lineWordsMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
  clone.dialogue.forEach((line, idx) => {
    const cleanTokens = line.text
      .split(/\s+/)
      .map((t) => t.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);
    lineWordsMap.set(line.id, cleanTokens);

    if (idx > 0 && (line.start === 0 || line.start === '0' || line.start === '0.0')) {
      const prevId = clone.dialogue[idx - 1].id;
      line.start = `@${prevId}.end + 0.35`;
      repairs.push(`Auto-chained ${line.id}.start → @${prevId}.end + 0.35`);
    }
  });

  // Helper to verify & repair `@<lineId>.word("<token>")` expressions
  const repairSymbolicWordExpr = (expr: string | number): string | number => {
    if (typeof expr === 'number') return expr;
    const match = expr.match(
      /^@([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\.word\(["']?([^"')]+)["']?\)(.*)$/
    );
    if (!match) return expr;

    const [, lineId, rawTargetWord, suffix] = match;
    const tokens = lineWordsMap.get(lineId);
    if (!tokens || tokens.length === 0) {
      repairs.push(`Missing line @${lineId} in "${expr}" → fell back to @line_1.start`);
      return '@line_1.start';
    }

    const targetLower = rawTargetWord.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
    if (tokens.includes(targetLower)) {
      return expr; // Exact match exists!
    }

    // Fuzzy Stem / Prefix / Substring Match (e.g., "overload" matches "overloading")
    const prefixMatch = tokens.find(
      (t) =>
        t.startsWith(targetLower.slice(0, 4)) ||
        targetLower.startsWith(t.slice(0, 4))
    );
    if (prefixMatch) {
      const fixed = `@${lineId}.word("${prefixMatch}")${suffix}`;
      repairs.push(`Stem-repaired "${expr}" → "${fixed}"`);
      return fixed;
    }

    // Fallback to midpoint word of that line so the gesture still fires during the sentence
    const midWord = tokens[Math.floor(tokens.length / 2)];
    const fallback = `@${lineId}.word("${midWord}")${suffix}`;
    repairs.push(
      `Token "${rawTargetWord}" not in ${lineId} → snapped to midpoint word "${midWord}"`
    );
    return fallback;
  };

  // 2. Repair all Tracks (Spline Waypoint Obstacle Avoidance + Symbolic Anchor Check)
  clone.tracks.forEach((track) => {
    if (track.segments) {
      track.segments.forEach((seg) => {
        seg.startTime = repairSymbolicWordExpr(seg.startTime);
        seg.endTime = repairSymbolicWordExpr(seg.endTime);

        seg.waypoints = seg.waypoints.map(([x, y, z], wpIdx) => {
          const clampedX = Math.max(-4.5, Math.min(4.5, x));
          const clampedZ = Math.max(-3.5, Math.min(3.5, z));

          // Check collision against central pedestal [-0.2, -0.5]
          const dx = clampedX - PEDESTAL_XZ[0];
          const dz = clampedZ - PEDESTAL_XZ[1];
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);

          if (dist < MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_METERS) {
            const angle = dist < 0.01 ? 0 : Math.atan2(dz, dx);
            const safeX = Number(
              (
                PEDESTAL_XZ[0] +
                Math.cos(angle) * MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_METERS
              ).toFixed(2)
            );
            const safeZ = Number(
              (
                PEDESTAL_XZ[1] +
                Math.sin(angle) * MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_METERS
              ).toFixed(2)
            );
            repairs.push(
              `Pushed ${track.targetId} WP #${wpIdx + 1} outside pedestal collision zone → [${safeX}, 0, ${safeZ}]`
            );
            return [safeX, 0, safeZ];
          }

          return [Number(clampedX.toFixed(2)), 0, Number(clampedZ.toFixed(2))];
        });
      });
    }

    if (track.keyframes) {
      track.keyframes.forEach((kf) => {
        kf.time = repairSymbolicWordExpr(kf.time);
      });
    }
  });

  // 3. Repair Camera Shots
  clone.cameraShots.forEach((shot) => {
    shot.startTime = repairSymbolicWordExpr(shot.startTime);
    shot.endTime = repairSymbolicWordExpr(shot.endTime);
  });

  return { manifest: clone, repairs };
}
6. Calling Local 8B Models via Ollama or vLLM (generateSceneWith8B.ts)
Here is the minimal inference call using Ollama (with llama3.1:8b or qwen2.5:7b) or vLLM using structured JSON Schema decoding:

TypeScript
import { sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene } from './sanitizeLLMScene';
import { compileSymbolicManifest } from './symbolicCompiler';

export async function generateCompiledSceneFromPrompt(
  userStoryPrompt: string,
  systemPrompt: string,
  jsonSchema: object
) {
  const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/chat', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: 'qwen2.5:7b-instruct', // or 'llama3.1:8b-instruct'
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: systemPrompt },
        { role: 'user', content: userStoryPrompt }
      ],
      // Enforces our JSON Schema at the token sampling layer!
      format: jsonSchema,
      stream: false,
      options: {
        temperature: 0.25, // Low temperature keeps spatial blocking deterministic
        num_ctx: 8192
      }
    })
  });

  const data = await response.json();
  const parsedJson = JSON.parse(data.message.content);
  const firstChapter = parsedJson.chapters[0];

  // 1. Run Self-Healing Spatial & Anchor Sanitizer
  const { manifest: cleanSymbolicManifest, repairs } =
    sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene(firstChapter);

  // 2. Run Pass 1–4 Symbolic-to-Timeline Compiler
  const compiledScene = compileSymbolicManifest(cleanSymbolicManifest, {
    actor_aria: 145,
    actor_zephyr: 140
  });

  return {
    symbolicManifest: cleanSymbolicManifest,
    compiledScene,
    repairs
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 1. SYMBOLIC MANIFEST, SANITIZER & TIMELINE TYPES
// ============================================================================

export type TimeExpression = number | string;
type Vector3Tuple = [number, number, number];
type ShotType = 'splineDolly' | 'overTheShoulder' | 'twoShot' | 'closeUp';

export type VisemeName =
  | 'viseme_sil'
  | 'viseme_PP'
  | 'viseme_FF'
  | 'viseme_DD'
  | 'viseme_SS'
  | 'viseme_aa'
  | 'viseme_E'
  | 'viseme_I'
  | 'viseme_O'
  | 'viseme_U';

const ALL_VISEMES: VisemeName[] = [
  'viseme_sil',
  'viseme_PP',
  'viseme_FF',
  'viseme_DD',
  'viseme_SS',
  'viseme_aa',
  'viseme_E',
  'viseme_I',
  'viseme_O',
  'viseme_U'
];

export interface TTSWordBoundary {
  word: string;
  cleanWord: string;
  index: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

export interface VisemeCue {
  time: number;
  duration: number;
  viseme: VisemeName;
  weight: number;
}

export interface SymbolicDialogueLine {
  id: string;
  speakerId: string;
  speaker: string;
  start: TimeExpression;
  text: string;
  speakingRateWpm: number;
}

export interface SymbolicSplineSegment {
  id: string;
  startTime: TimeExpression;
  endTime: TimeExpression;
  waypoints: Vector3Tuple[];
  strideLength: number;
}

export interface SymbolicKeyframe {
  id: string;
  time: TimeExpression;
  value: any;
  crossFade?: number;
}

export interface SymbolicTrack {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  targetId: string;
  property: 'splinePath' | 'animationClip' | 'lookAtTarget';
  keyframes?: SymbolicKeyframe[];
  segments?: SymbolicSplineSegment[];
}

export interface SymbolicCameraShot {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  startTime: TimeExpression;
  endTime: TimeExpression;
  shotType: ShotType;
  subjectId: string;
  secondaryId?: string;
  side?: 'left' | 'right';
  fov: number;
}

export interface SymbolicSceneManifest {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  chapterPlan?: string;
  dialogue: SymbolicDialogueLine[];
  tracks: SymbolicTrack[];
  cameraShots: SymbolicCameraShot[];
}

export interface SanitizerRepairEntry {
  id: string;
  category:
    | 'SPATIAL_COLLISION'
    | 'WORD_STEM_MATCH'
    | 'DIALOGUE_CHAIN'
    | 'CAMERA_180_RULE';
  targetLabel: string;
  beforeValue: string;
  afterValue: string;
  reason: string;
}

export type TimelineSelection =
  | {
      kind: 'waypoint';
      trackId: string;
      segmentId: string;
      waypointIndex: number;
      targetId: string;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'keyframe';
      trackId: string;
      keyframeId: string;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'splineSegment';
      trackId: string;
      segmentId: string;
    }
  | {
      kind: 'cameraShot';
      shotId: string;
    };

// ============================================================================
// 2. SELF-HEALING SANITIZER & AUTO-REPAIR ENGINE (`sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene`)
// ============================================================================

const PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ: [number, number] = [-0.2, -0.5];
const MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_M = 0.72;

export function sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene(
  rawManifest: SymbolicSceneManifest
): {
  repairedManifest: SymbolicSceneManifest;
  repairs: SanitizerRepairEntry[];
} {
  const clone: SymbolicSceneManifest = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(rawManifest));
  const repairs: SanitizerRepairEntry[] = [];

  // 1. Build clean token map per dialogue line & repair unchained `start: "0"` on line_2+
  const lineWordsMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
  clone.dialogue.forEach((line, idx) => {
    const cleanTokens = line.text
      .split(/\s+/)
      .map((t) => t.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean);
    lineWordsMap.set(line.id, cleanTokens);

    const startStr = String(line.start).trim();
    if (idx > 0 && (startStr === '0' || startStr === '0.0' || startStr === '')) {
      const prevId = clone.dialogue[idx - 1].id;
      const fixedStart = `@${prevId}.end + 0.35`;
      repairs.push({
        id: `rep_chain_${line.id}`,
        category: 'DIALOGUE_CHAIN',
        targetLabel: `${line.id}.start (${line.speaker})`,
        beforeValue: `"${startStr}"`,
        afterValue: `"${fixedStart}"`,
        reason: `Line ${idx + 1} had unchained start=0; chained sequentially after @${prevId}.end.`
      });
      line.start = fixedStart;
    }
  });

  // Helper to verify & fuzzy-repair `@<lineId>.word("<token>")` expressions
  const verifyOrRepairWordAnchor = (
    expr: TimeExpression,
    contextLabel: string
  ): TimeExpression => {
    if (typeof expr === 'number') return expr;
    const match = String(expr).match(
      /^@([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\.word\(["']?([^"')]+)["']?\)(.*)$/
    );
    if (!match) return expr;

    const [, lineId, rawTargetWord, suffix] = match;
    const tokens = lineWordsMap.get(lineId);
    if (!tokens || tokens.length === 0) {
      const fallback = '@line_1.start';
      repairs.push({
        id: `rep_missing_line_${contextLabel}`,
        category: 'WORD_STEM_MATCH',
        targetLabel: contextLabel,
        beforeValue: String(expr),
        afterValue: fallback,
        reason: `Referenced non-existent dialogue ID @${lineId}.`
      });
      return fallback;
    }

    const targetLower = rawTargetWord.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
    if (tokens.includes(targetLower)) {
      return expr; // Exact match found!
    }

    // Check stem / prefix / substring overlap (e.g. "overload" -> "overloading", "destabilize" -> "destabilizing")
    const stemRoot = targetLower.slice(0, Math.max(4, targetLower.length - 3));
    const matchedToken =
      tokens.find(
        (t) =>
          t.startsWith(stemRoot) ||
          targetLower.startsWith(t.slice(0, Math.max(4, t.length - 2)))
      ) || tokens[Math.floor(tokens.length * 0.65)];

    const repairedExpr = `@${lineId}.word("${matchedToken}")${suffix}`;
    repairs.push({
      id: `rep_word_${contextLabel}_${rawTargetWord}`,
      category: 'WORD_STEM_MATCH',
      targetLabel: contextLabel,
      beforeValue: String(expr),
      afterValue: repairedExpr,
      reason: `Exact token "${rawTargetWord}" not in ${lineId}; stem-matched to spoken word "${matchedToken}".`
    });
    return repairedExpr;
  };

  // 2. Repair Tracks (Spline Pedestal Collision Avoidance + Symbolic Word Anchors)
  clone.tracks.forEach((track) => {
    if (track.segments) {
      track.segments.forEach((seg) => {
        seg.startTime = verifyOrRepairWordAnchor(
          seg.startTime,
          `${seg.id}.startTime`
        );
        seg.endTime = verifyOrRepairWordAnchor(
          seg.endTime,
          `${seg.id}.endTime`
        );

        seg.waypoints = seg.waypoints.map(([x, y, z], wpIdx) => {
          const clampedX = Math.max(-4.4, Math.min(4.4, x));
          const clampedZ = Math.max(-3.4, Math.min(3.4, z));

          const dx = clampedX - PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[0];
          const dz = clampedZ - PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[1];
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz);

          if (dist < MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_M) {
            const pushAngle =
              dist < 0.01 ? Math.PI * 0.35 : Math.atan2(dz, dx);
            const safeX = Number(
              (
                PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[0] +
                Math.cos(pushAngle) * MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_M
              ).toFixed(2)
            );
            const safeZ = Number(
              (
                PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[1] +
                Math.sin(pushAngle) * MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_M
              ).toFixed(2)
            );

            repairs.push({
              id: `rep_col_${seg.id}_wp_${wpIdx}`,
              category: 'SPATIAL_COLLISION',
              targetLabel: `${track.targetId} Waypoint #${wpIdx + 1}`,
              beforeValue: `[${x.toFixed(2)}, 0, ${z.toFixed(2)}]`,
              afterValue: `[${safeX.toFixed(2)}, 0, ${safeZ.toFixed(2)}]`,
              reason: `Waypoint clipped inside Central Pedestal radius (${dist.toFixed(
                2
              )}m < ${MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_M}m); pushed to safe perimeter.`
            });
            return [safeX, 0, safeZ];
          }

          return [Number(clampedX.toFixed(2)), Number(y.toFixed(2)), Number(clampedZ.toFixed(2))];
        });
      });
    }

    if (track.keyframes) {
      track.keyframes.forEach((kf) => {
        kf.time = verifyOrRepairWordAnchor(
          kf.time,
          `${track.id}.${kf.id} (${kf.value})`
        );
      });
    }
  });

  // 3. Repair Camera Shots (Word Anchors + 180-Degree Axis Consistency)
  clone.cameraShots.forEach((shot) => {
    shot.startTime = verifyOrRepairWordAnchor(
      shot.startTime,
      `${shot.id}.startTime`
    );
    shot.endTime = verifyOrRepairWordAnchor(shot.endTime, `${shot.id}.endTime`);

    if (
      (shot.shotType === 'overTheShoulder' || shot.shotType === 'twoShot') &&
      shot.side === 'left'
    ) {
      repairs.push({
        id: `rep_180_${shot.id}`,
        category: 'CAMERA_180_RULE',
        targetLabel: `${shot.id} (${shot.label})`,
        beforeValue: `side: "left"`,
        afterValue: `side: "right"`,
        reason: `Normalized camera side to "right" to prevent crossing the 180-degree conversation axis.`
      });
      shot.side = 'right';
    }
  });

  return { repairedManifest: clone, repairs };
}

/**
 * Synthesizes a custom raw 8B SymbolicSceneManifest from ANY user-typed prompt string,
 * incorporating keywords from the user's prompt into the dialogue, waypoints, and anchors.
 */
function synthesizeCustom8BSceneFromUserPrompt(
  promptText: string
): SymbolicSceneManifest {
  const cleanWords = promptText
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/g, '')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((w) => w.length >= 4);

  const keyword1 = (cleanWords[0] || 'anomaly').toLowerCase();
  const keyword2 = (cleanWords[1] || 'reactor').toLowerCase();
  const keyword3 = (cleanWords[2] || 'protocol').toLowerCase();

  // Intentionally use a stem variant in the keyframe anchor so the user sees the Sanitizer stem-matcher work on custom prompts too!
  const stemVariant =
    keyword2.length > 5 ? keyword2.slice(0, keyword2.length - 1) : keyword2;

  return {
    id: `custom_ai_${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
    title: `AI Scene: "${promptText.slice(0, 48)}${
      promptText.length > 48 ? '...' : ''
    }"`,
    chapterPlan: `Generated from custom prompt. Aria walks from Stage Left toward the pedestal (with raw waypoint [-0.18, 0, -0.42] near pedestal to test collision repair) and triggers PointRight on @line_2.word("${stemVariant}").`,

        speakingRateWpm: 148,

      },
      {
