// ============================================================================
// 4. SYMBOLIC COMPILER ENGINE (PASS 1–4)
// ============================================================================

interface SymbolTableEntry {
  id: string;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  duration: number;
  words?: TTSWordBoundary[];
}

function synthesizeWordTimings(
  line: SymbolicDialogueLine,
  lineStartSec: number
): { words: TTSWordBoundary[]; endSec: number; visemes: VisemeCue[] } {
  const rawTokens = line.text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const words: TTSWordBoundary[] = [];
  const visemes: VisemeCue[] = [];
  const secPerWord = 60 / Math.max(70, line.speakingRateWpm || 145);

  let cursor = lineStartSec;

  const charToViseme = (ch: string): VisemeName => {
    switch (ch.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'a':
        return 'viseme_aa';
      case 'e':
        return 'viseme_E';
      case 'i':
      case 'y':
        return 'viseme_I';
      case 'o':
        return 'viseme_O';
      case 'u':
      case 'w':
        return 'viseme_U';
      case 'p':
      case 'b':
      case 'm':
        return 'viseme_PP';
      case 'f':
      case 'v':
        return 'viseme_FF';
      case 't':
      case 'd':
      case 'n':
        return 'viseme_DD';
      default:
        return 'viseme_SS';
    }
  };

  rawTokens.forEach((rawToken, idx) => {
    const cleanWord = rawToken.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9']/g, '');
    const vowelMatches = cleanWord.match(/[aeiouyAEIOUY]+/g);
    const syllables = Math.max(1, vowelMatches ? vowelMatches.length : 1);
    const wordDur = Math.max(0.16, secPerWord * (0.55 + syllables * 0.3));

    const wStart = cursor;
    const wEnd = cursor + wordDur;

    words.push({
      word: rawToken,
      cleanWord: cleanWord.toLowerCase(),
      index: idx,
      start: Number(wStart.toFixed(3)),
      end: Number(wEnd.toFixed(3))
    });

    const chars = cleanWord.split('');
    const secPerChar = wordDur / Math.max(1, chars.length);
    chars.forEach((ch, cIdx) => {
      visemes.push({
        time: wStart + cIdx * secPerChar,
        duration: secPerChar * 1.15,
        viseme: charToViseme(ch),
        weight: 0.88
      });
    });

    const pauseAfter = /[.!?]/.test(rawToken)
      ? 0.24
      : /[,;:]/.test(rawToken)
      ? 0.12
      : 0.035;
    cursor = wEnd + pauseAfter;
    visemes.push({
      time: wEnd,
      duration: pauseAfter,
      viseme: 'viseme_sil',
      weight: 0.1
    });
  });

  return { words, endSec: Number(cursor.toFixed(3)), visemes };
}

function evaluateTimeExpr(
  expr: TimeExpression,
  symbolTable: Map<string, SymbolTableEntry>
): number {
  if (typeof expr === 'number') return expr;
  const trimmed = String(expr).trim();
  const asNum = Number(trimmed);
  if (!Number.isNaN(asNum)) return asNum;

  const anchorRegex =
    /^@([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\.(start|end|duration|word\(([^)]+)\)|progress\(([0-9.]+)\))\s*([+-]\s*[0-9.]+)?$/;
  const match = trimmed.match(anchorRegex);
  if (!match) return 0;

  const targetId = match[1];
  const accessor = match[2];
  const wordArgRaw = match[3];
  const progressArgRaw = match[4];
  const offsetRaw = match[5];

  const entry = symbolTable.get(targetId);
  if (!entry) return 0;

  const offsetSec = offsetRaw
    ? parseFloat(offsetRaw.replace(/\s+/g, ''))
    : 0;
  let baseSec = entry.start;

  if (accessor === 'start') baseSec = entry.start;
  else if (accessor === 'end') baseSec = entry.end;
  else if (accessor === 'duration') baseSec = entry.duration;
  else if (accessor.startsWith('progress(') && progressArgRaw) {
    const p = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, parseFloat(progressArgRaw)));
    baseSec = entry.start + p * entry.duration;
  } else if (accessor.startsWith('word(') && wordArgRaw !== undefined) {
    const cleanArg = wordArgRaw.replace(/['"]/g, '').trim();
    const words = entry.words || [];
    const idxNum = Number(cleanArg);
    if (!Number.isNaN(idxNum)) {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(words.length - 1, idxNum));
      baseSec = words[clamped] ? words[clamped].start : entry.start;
    } else {
      const lower = cleanArg.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
      const found =
        words.find((w) => w.cleanWord === lower) ||
        words.find((w) => w.cleanWord.includes(lower));
      baseSec = found ? found.start : entry.start;
    }
  }

  return Math.max(0, Number((baseSec + offsetSec).toFixed(3)));
}

function compileManifest(symbolic: SymbolicSceneManifest) {
  const symbolTable = new Map<string, SymbolTableEntry>();

  const compiledDialogue = symbolic.dialogue.map((line) => {
    const startSec = evaluateTimeExpr(line.start, symbolTable);
    const { words, endSec, visemes } = synthesizeWordTimings(line, startSec);
    const duration = Number((endSec - startSec).toFixed(3));
    symbolTable.set(line.id, {
      id: line.id,
      start: startSec,
      end: endSec,
      duration,
      words
    });
    return {
      ...line,
      startSec,
      endSec,
      duration,
      words,
      visemes
    };
  });

  const compiledTracks = symbolic.tracks.map((track) => {
    if (track.property === 'splinePath' && track.segments) {
      const segs = track.segments.map((seg) => {
        const s = evaluateTimeExpr(seg.startTime, symbolTable);
        const e = Math.max(s + 0.3, evaluateTimeExpr(seg.endTime, symbolTable));
        symbolTable.set(seg.id, {
          id: seg.id,
          start: s,
          end: e,
          duration: e - s
        });
        return {
          ...seg,
          resolvedStart: s,
          resolvedEnd: e
        };
      });
      return { ...track, resolvedSegments: segs, resolvedKeyframes: [] };
    }

    const kfs = (track.keyframes || [])
      .map((kf) => ({
        ...kf,
        resolvedTime: evaluateTimeExpr(kf.time, symbolTable)
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.resolvedTime - b.resolvedTime);

    return { ...track, resolvedSegments: [], resolvedKeyframes: kfs };
  });

  const compiledShots = symbolic.cameraShots.map((shot) => {
    const s = evaluateTimeExpr(shot.startTime, symbolTable);
    const e = Math.max(s + 0.3, evaluateTimeExpr(shot.endTime, symbolTable));
    return {
      ...shot,
      resolvedStart: s,
      resolvedEnd: e
    };
  });

  const maxEnd = Math.max(
    compiledDialogue.reduce((m, d) => Math.max(m, d.endSec), 10),
    compiledShots.reduce((m, s) => Math.max(m, s.resolvedEnd), 10)
  );

  return {
    duration: Number((maxEnd + 0.4).toFixed(2)),
    dialogue: compiledDialogue,
    tracks: compiledTracks,
    cameraShots: compiledShots
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. 15-BONE ARTICULATED HUMANOID RIG BUILDER
// ============================================================================

interface CharacterRigInstance {
  id: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  morphMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
  headBone: THREE.Bone;
  smoothedHeadingQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedHeadOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  currentSplineTangent: THREE.Vector3;
}

function smoothstep(x: number): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  return c * c * (3 - 2 * c);
}

function createArticulatedRig(
  id: string,
  color: string,
  accentColor: string,
  initPos: Vector3Tuple,
  initRotY: number
): CharacterRigInstance {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  root.position.set(...initPos);
  root.rotation.set(0, initRotY, 0);

  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.02, 0);
  root.add(hipsBone);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.35, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.72, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.55, 0.42, 0);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const thighLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighLBone.name = 'ThighL';
  thighLBone.position.set(-0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighLBone);

  const shinLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinLBone.name = 'ShinL';
  shinLBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighLBone.add(shinLBone);

  const thighRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighRBone.name = 'ThighR';
  thighRBone.position.set(0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighRBone);

  const shinRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinRBone.name = 'ShinR';
  shinRBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighRBone.add(shinRBone);

  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color,
    roughness: 0.3,
    metalness: 0.45
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.65
  });
  const accentMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: accentColor,
    emissive: accentColor,
    emissiveIntensity: 0.65
  });

  hipsBone.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.72, 0.24, 0.42), darkMat));

  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.86, 0.88, 0.46), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.14, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  const chestBadge = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.18, 0.06), accentMat);
  chestBadge.position.set(0, 0.28, 0.24);
  spineBone.add(chestBadge);

  const upperArmGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.11, 0.55, 8, 16);
  const armL = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armL.position.set(-0.12, -0.28, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(armL);

  const armR = new THREE.Mesh(upperArmGeo, darkMat);
  armR.position.set(0.12, -0.28, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(armR);

  const thighGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const shinGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, 0.38, 8, 16);

  const thighLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighLBone.add(thighLMesh);

  const shinLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinLMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinLBone.add(shinLMesh);

  const thighRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  thighRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighRBone.add(thighRMesh);

  const shinRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  shinRMesh.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinRBone.add(shinRMesh);

  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.62, 0.6), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const visorMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.54, 0.16, 0.08), accentMat);
  visorMesh.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.28);
  headBone.add(visorMesh);

  const baseMouthGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.32, 0.075, 0.1, 8, 4, 2);
  const basePos = baseMouthGeo.attributes.position;
  const morphPositions: THREE.BufferAttribute[] = [];
  const morphDict: Record<string, number> = {};

  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName, idx) => {
    morphDict[vName] = idx;
    const cloned = basePos.clone();
    for (let i = 0; i < cloned.count; i++) {
      let x = cloned.getX(i);
      let y = cloned.getY(i);
      const z = cloned.getZ(i);
      if (vName === 'viseme_aa') {
        y *= 3.6;
        x *= 1.15;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_O') {
        y *= 3.0;
        x *= 0.62;
      } else if (vName === 'viseme_PP') {
        y *= 0.25;
      } else {
        y *= 1.8;
      }
      cloned.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    morphPositions.push(cloned);
  });
  baseMouthGeo.morphAttributes.position = morphPositions;

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(baseMouthGeo, accentMat);
  mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary = morphDict;
  mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences = new Array(ALL_VISEMES.length).fill(0);
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.14, 0.29);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  const qEuler = (x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(x, y, z)).toArray();

  const walkTimes = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0];
  const walkClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Walk', 1.0, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      walkTimes,
      [-0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, 0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.06, 0, -0.03, 0.99, 0]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.85, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, -0.08)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(-0.4, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.08),
        ...qEuler(0.4, 0, 0.08)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const gTimes = [0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4];
  const idleClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Idle', 2.4, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      gTimes,
      [0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0]
    )
  ]);

  const explainClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Explain', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, -0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.6, 0.1, -0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.0, -0.2, -0.6),
        ...qEuler(-0.75, 0.2, -0.35)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5),
        ...qEuler(-0.55, 0.2, 0.25),
        ...qEuler(-1.1, -0.25, 0.65),
        ...qEuler(-0.65, 0.1, 0.35),
        ...qEuler(-0.9, -0.2, 0.5)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const pointRightClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('PointRight', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-1.35, -0.35, 1.05),
        ...qEuler(-1.42, -0.4, 1.12),
        ...qEuler(-1.35, -0.35, 1.05),
        ...qEuler(-1.42, -0.4, 1.12),
        ...qEuler(-1.35, -0.35, 1.05)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const waveClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Wave', 2.4, [
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 1.95),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.55),
        ...qEuler(0, 0, 2.2)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  [
    ['Idle', idleClip],
    ['Walk', walkClip],
    ['Explain', explainClip],
    ['PointRight', pointRightClip],
    ['Wave', waveClip]
  ].forEach(([cName, clip]) => {
    const act = mixer.clipAction(clip as THREE.AnimationClip);
    act.play();
    act.setEffectiveWeight(cName === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
    actions.set(cName as string, act);
  });

  return {
    id,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    morphMeshes: [mouthMesh],
    headBone,
    smoothedHeadingQuat: new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
      new THREE.Euler(0, initRotY, 0)
    ),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    currentSplineTangent: new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(initRotY), 0, Math.cos(initRotY))
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 6. MAIN REACT STUDIO WITH INTERACTIVE AI SCENE GENERATOR & SANITIZER PANEL
// ============================================================================

export default function AISceneGeneratorAndSanitizerStudio() {
  // Initialize with Preset 1 passed through the Self-Healing Sanitizer
  const initialSanitized = useMemo(
    () => sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene(PROMPT_PRESETS[0].raw8BOutput),
    []
  );

  const [manifest, setManifest] = useState<SymbolicSceneManifest>(
    initialSanitized.repairedManifest
  );
  const [rawUnrepairedManifest, setRawUnrepairedManifest] =
    useState<SymbolicSceneManifest>(PROMPT_PRESETS[0].raw8BOutput);
  const [sanitizerRepairs, setSanitizerRepairs] = useState<
    SanitizerRepairEntry[]
  >(initialSanitized.repairs);
  const [usingSanitizedVersion, setUsingSanitizedVersion] =
    useState<boolean>(true);

  // AI Prompt Generator State
  const [userPromptText, setUserPromptText] = useState<string>(
    PROMPT_PRESETS[0].promptText
  );
  const [inferenceBackend, setInferenceBackend] = useState<
    'builtin_8b_sim' | 'ollama_local'
  >('builtin_8b_sim');
  const [ollamaUrl, setOllamaUrl] = useState<string>(
    'http://localhost:11434/api/chat'
  );
  const [ollamaModel, setOllamaModel] = useState<string>('qwen2.5:7b-instruct');
  const [isGeneratingScene, setIsGeneratingScene] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rightPanelTab, setRightPanelTab] = useState<
    'ai_sanitizer' | 'inspector' | 'json_export'
  >('ai_sanitizer');

  // Playback & Viewport State
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [viewportCamMode, setViewportCamMode] = useState<
    'editor_crane' | 'director_lens'
  >('editor_crane');
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState<TimelineSelection>({
    kind: 'keyframe',
    trackId: 'track_aria_clips',
    keyframeId: 'kf_a3'
  });
  const [draggingWaypointLabel, setDraggingWaypointLabel] = useState<
    string | null
  >(null);
  const [copiedJson, setCopiedJson] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const compiled = useMemo(() => compileManifest(manifest), [manifest]);
  const compiledRef = useRef(compiled);
  useEffect(() => {
    compiledRef.current = compiled;
  }, [compiled]);

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const viewportCamModeRef = useRef(viewportCamMode);
  const rebuild3DSplinesRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    viewportCamModeRef.current = viewportCamMode;
  }, [viewportCamMode]);

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(compiled.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
    },
    [compiled.duration]
  );

  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // AI PROMPT -> 8B GENERATION -> SANITIZER -> 3D STAGE LOADER
  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleRunAISceneGenerator = async (overridePreset?: PromptPreset) => {
    setIsGeneratingScene(true);
    setRightPanelTab('ai_sanitizer');

    const promptToUse = overridePreset
      ? overridePreset.promptText
      : userPromptText;
    if (overridePreset) {
      setUserPromptText(overridePreset.promptText);
    }

    let raw8BScene: SymbolicSceneManifest;

    if (inferenceBackend === 'ollama_local' && !overridePreset) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(ollamaUrl, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            model: ollamaModel,
            messages: [
              {
                role: 'system',
                content:
                  'Generate a valid SymbolicSceneManifest JSON with dialogue, tracks (splinePath, animationClip, lookAtTarget), and cameraShots.'
              },
              { role: 'user', content: promptToUse }
            ],
            format: 'json',
            stream: false,
            options: { temperature: 0.25 }
          })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        raw8BScene = JSON.parse(data.message.content);
      } catch {
        // Graceful fallback to Built-in 8B Procedural Simulator if local Ollama isn't running
        raw8BScene = synthesizeCustom8BSceneFromUserPrompt(promptToUse);
      }
    } else {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 380));
      raw8BScene = overridePreset
        ? overridePreset.raw8BOutput
        : synthesizeCustom8BSceneFromUserPrompt(promptToUse);
    }

    // Run Self-Healing Spatial & Symbolic Anchor Sanitizer
    const { repairedManifest, repairs } = sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene(raw8BScene);

    setRawUnrepairedManifest(raw8BScene);
    setSanitizerRepairs(repairs);
    setUsingSanitizedVersion(true);
    setManifest(repairedManifest);

    // Reset playhead to 0.0s & play new scene on the 3D stage!
    timeRef.current = 0;
    setCurrentTime(0);
    setIsPlaying(true);
    setIsGeneratingScene(false);
  };

  // Toggle between viewing the Sanitized Scene vs. Raw Un-Sanitized 8B Output on the 3D Stage
  const handleToggleSanitizedVsRaw = (useSanitized: boolean) => {
    setUsingSanitizedVersion(useSanitized);
    setManifest(useSanitized ? sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene(rawUnrepairedManifest).repairedManifest : rawUnrepairedManifest);
    timeRef.current = 0;
    setCurrentTime(0);
  };

  // Master Clock Loop
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const dt = (now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000;
        let next = timeRef.current + dt;
        if (next >= compiledRef.current.duration) next = 0;
        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying]);

  // ==========================================================================
  // 7. THREE.JS 3D STAGE, PEDESTAL COLLISION ZONE RING & WAYPOINT DRAGGING
  // ==========================================================================

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color('#070b14');

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      45,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.15,
      60
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.92));
    const keyLight = new THREE.PointLight('#60a5fa', 2.8, 30);
    keyLight.position.set(2, 8, 5);
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, '#1e293b', '#1e293b');
    scene.add(grid);

    // Central Pedestal & Collision Keep-Out Zone Ring (Shows the 0.72m Sanitizer boundary!)
    const pedestalMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.36, 0.46, 0.95, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#1e293b',
        roughness: 0.4,
        metalness: 0.7
      })
    );
    pedestalMesh.position.set(
      PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[0],
      0.475,
      PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[1]
    );
    scene.add(pedestalMesh);

    const keepOutRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(
        MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_M - 0.04,
        MIN_PEDESTAL_CLEARANCE_M,
        40
      ),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: '#f43f5e',
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.55
      })
    );
    keepOutRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    keepOutRing.position.set(
      PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[0],
      0.02,
      PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[1]
    );
    scene.add(keepOutRing);

    const holoCoreMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.46, 0.14, 80, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#38bdf8',
        emissive: '#38bdf8',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.6,
        roughness: 0.2,
        metalness: 0.8
      })
    );
    holoCoreMesh.position.set(
      PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[0],
      1.48,
      PEDESTAL_CENTER_XZ[1]
    );
    holoCoreMesh.scale.set(0.42, 0.42, 0.42);
    scene.add(holoCoreMesh);

    const ariaRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_aria',
      '#f1f5f9',
      '#38bdf8',
      [-3.2, 0, -1.6],
      0.5
    );
    const zephyrRig = createArticulatedRig(
      'actor_zephyr',
      '#334155',
      '#10b981',
      [2.4, 0, -0.8],
      -1.1
    );
    scene.add(ariaRig.root, zephyrRig.root);

    const rigsMap = new Map<string, CharacterRigInstance>([
      ['actor_aria', ariaRig],
      ['actor_zephyr', zephyrRig]
    ]);

    const splineGizmoGroup = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(splineGizmoGroup);

    const waypointHandles: THREE.Mesh[] = [];
    const activeCurvesMap = new Map<
      string,
      {
        curve: THREE.CatmullRomCurve3;
        totalLength: number;
        startTime: number;
        endTime: number;
        strideLength: number;
      }
    >();

    const buildSplineVisualsFromCompiled = () => {
      splineGizmoGroup.clear();
      waypointHandles.length = 0;
      activeCurvesMap.clear();

      const comp = compiledRef.current;
      comp.tracks.forEach((track) => {
        if (track.property !== 'splinePath') return;
        const isAria = track.targetId === 'actor_aria';
        const colorHex = isAria ? '#38bdf8' : '#10b981';

        track.resolvedSegments.forEach((seg) => {
          if (seg.waypoints.length < 2) return;
          const pts = seg.waypoints.map((w) => new THREE.Vector3(w[0], w[1], w[2]));
          const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, false, 'catmullrom', 0.5);
          curve.arcLengthDivisions = 250;
          curve.updateArcLengths();

          activeCurvesMap.set(track.targetId, {
            curve,
            totalLength: curve.getLength(),
            startTime: seg.resolvedStart,
            endTime: seg.resolvedEnd,
            strideLength: seg.strideLength
          });

          const tube = new THREE.Mesh(
            new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 72, 0.035, 8, false),
            new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
              color: colorHex,
              transparent: true,
              opacity: 0.8
            })
          );
          tube.position.y = 0.03;
          splineGizmoGroup.add(tube);

          seg.waypoints.forEach((wp, wpIdx) => {
            const handleMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
              new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.22, 0.14, 24),
              new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
                color: wpIdx === 0 ? '#facc15' : colorHex,
                emissive: wpIdx === 0 ? '#eab308' : colorHex,
                emissiveIntensity: 0.55,
                roughness: 0.2
              })
            );
            handleMesh.position.set(wp[0], wp[1] + 0.08, wp[2]);

            const ring = new THREE.Mesh(
              new THREE.RingGeometry(0.26, 0.34, 24),
              new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
                color: '#ffffff',
                side: THREE.DoubleSide,
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.65
              })
            );
            ring.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
            ring.position.y = -0.05;
            handleMesh.add(ring);

            handleMesh.userData = {
              isWaypointHandle: true,
              trackId: track.id,
              segmentId: seg.id,
              waypointIndex: wpIdx,
              targetId: track.targetId
            };

            splineGizmoGroup.add(handleMesh);
            waypointHandles.push(handleMesh);
          });
        });
      });
    };

    rebuild3DSplinesRef.current = buildSplineVisualsFromCompiled;
    buildSplineVisualsFromCompiled();

    // Raycast-to-Floor-Plane 3D Waypoint Dragger
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const groundDragPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);
    const planeIntersectPoint = new THREE.Vector3();

    let draggedHandleInfo: {
      trackId: string;
      segmentId: string;
      waypointIndex: number;
      targetId: string;
    } | null = null;

    let isOrbitingEditorCam = false;
    let lastMouse = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    let editorCamTheta = 0.25;
    let editorCamPhi = 1.02;
    let editorCamRadius = 7.4;

    const getNormalizedMouse = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      return new THREE.Vector2(
        ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
        -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
      );
    };

    const onMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      lastMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
      const ndc = getNormalizedMouse(e);
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

      const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(waypointHandles, true);
      if (hits.length > 0) {
        let obj: THREE.Object3D | null = hits[0].object;
        while (obj && !obj.userData?.isWaypointHandle) {
          obj = obj.parent;
        }
        if (obj && obj.userData?.isWaypointHandle) {
          const { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId } = obj.userData;
          draggedHandleInfo = { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId };
          setSelection({
            kind: 'waypoint',
            trackId,
            segmentId,
            waypointIndex,
            targetId
          });
          setRightPanelTab('inspector');
          setDraggingWaypointLabel(
            `${targetId} • Waypoint #${waypointIndex + 1}`
          );
          renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
          return;
        }
      }

      if (viewportCamModeRef.current === 'editor_crane') {
        isOrbitingEditorCam = true;
      }
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const ndc = getNormalizedMouse(e);
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

      if (draggedHandleInfo) {
        if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(groundDragPlane, planeIntersectPoint)) {
          const clampedX = Number(
            THREE.MathUtils.clamp(planeIntersectPoint.x, -4.4, 4.4).toFixed(2)
          );
          const clampedZ = Number(
            THREE.MathUtils.clamp(planeIntersectPoint.z, -3.4, 3.4).toFixed(2)
          );
          const { trackId, segmentId, waypointIndex, targetId } =
            draggedHandleInfo;

          setManifest((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            tracks: prev.tracks.map((tr) => {
              if (tr.id !== trackId || !tr.segments) return tr;
              return {
                ...tr,
                segments: tr.segments.map((seg) => {
                  if (seg.id !== segmentId) return seg;
                  const nextWps = [...seg.waypoints];
                  nextWps[waypointIndex] = [clampedX, 0, clampedZ];
                  return { ...seg, waypoints: nextWps };
                })
              };
            })
          }));

          setDraggingWaypointLabel(
            `${targetId} WP #${waypointIndex + 1} → [${clampedX}, 0, ${clampedZ}]`
          );
        }
        return;
      }

      if (isOrbitingEditorCam && viewportCamModeRef.current === 'editor_crane') {
        const dx = e.clientX - lastMouse.x;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastMouse.y;
        lastMouse = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
        editorCamTheta -= dx * 0.0055;
        editorCamPhi = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          editorCamPhi - dy * 0.0055,
          0.3,
          1.42
        );
        return;
      }

      const hoverHits = raycaster.intersectObjects(waypointHandles, true);
      renderer.domElement.style.cursor =
        hoverHits.length > 0 ? 'grab' : 'default';
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      draggedHandleInfo = null;
      isOrbitingEditorCam = false;
      setDraggingWaypointLabel(null);
      renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'default';
    };

    const dom = renderer.domElement;
    dom.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);

    let rAF: number;

    const renderLoop = () => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      const comp = compiledRef.current;

      rigsMap.forEach((rig, charId) => {
        const clipTrack = comp.tracks.find(
          (tr) => tr.targetId === charId && tr.property === 'animationClip'
        );
        let baseClip = 'Idle';
        if (clipTrack) {
          for (const kf of clipTrack.resolvedKeyframes) {
            if (t >= kf.resolvedTime) baseClip = String(kf.value);
          }
        }

        const sp = activeCurvesMap.get(charId);
        let walkWeight = 0;
        let stridePhase = 0;

        if (sp) {
          const dur = Math.max(0.05, sp.endTime - sp.startTime);
          const inWindow = t >= sp.startTime && t <= sp.endTime;
          const rawA = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - sp.startTime) / dur));
          const u = smoothstep(rawA);

          const pos = sp.curve.getPointAt(u);
          const tan = sp.curve.getTangentAt(u).normalize();
          rig.root.position.copy(pos);
          rig.currentSplineTangent.copy(tan);

          if (inWindow && sp.totalLength > 0.1) {
            const uNext = smoothstep(
              Math.min(1, (t + 0.03 - sp.startTime) / dur)
            );
            const speed = (Math.abs(uNext - u) * sp.totalLength) / 0.03;
            walkWeight = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(speed / 0.85, 0, 1);
          }

          const headingYaw = Math.atan2(tan.x, tan.z);
          rig.smoothedHeadingQuat.slerp(
            new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, headingYaw, 0)),
            0.25
          );
          rig.root.quaternion.copy(rig.smoothedHeadingQuat);
          stridePhase = ((u * sp.totalLength) / sp.strideLength) % 1.0;
        }

        rig.actions.forEach((act, name) => {
          if (name === 'Walk') {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(walkWeight);
            act.time = stridePhase * act.getClip().duration;
          } else if (name === baseClip) {
            const isUpper =
              baseClip === 'Explain' ||
              baseClip === 'PointRight' ||
              baseClip === 'Wave';
            act.setEffectiveWeight(isUpper ? 0.9 : 1 - walkWeight);
            act.time = t % (act.getClip().duration || 1);
          } else {
            act.setEffectiveWeight(0);
          }
        });

        rig.mixer.update(0);
      });

      const ariaHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      const zephyrHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      ariaRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      zephyrRig.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      ariaRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(ariaHeadPos);
      zephyrRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(zephyrHeadPos);

      const gazeTrack = comp.tracks.find((tr) => tr.id === 'track_aria_gaze');
      let ariaTarget = 'actor_zephyr';
      if (gazeTrack) {
        for (const kf of gazeTrack.resolvedKeyframes) {
          if (t >= kf.resolvedTime) ariaTarget = String(kf.value);
        }
      }

      const isCoreHighlighted = ariaTarget === 'holo_core';
      const targetScale = isCoreHighlighted ? 0.82 : 0.42;
      holoCoreMesh.scale.lerp(
        new THREE.Vector3(targetScale, targetScale, targetScale),
        0.15
      );
      holoCoreMesh.rotation.set(t * 1.8, t * 2.5, 0);

      const ariaTargetVec =
        ariaTarget === 'holo_core'
          ? holoCoreMesh.position.clone()
          : zephyrHeadPos.clone();

      const applyGaze = (
        rig: CharacterRigInstance,
        myHead: THREE.Vector3,
        targetWorld: THREE.Vector3
      ) => {
        const rootQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
        rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootQuat);
        const localDir = targetWorld
          .clone()
          .sub(myHead)
          .applyQuaternion(rootQuat.invert());
        const yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          Math.atan2(localDir.x, localDir.z),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-62),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(62)
        );
        rig.smoothedHeadOffset.slerp(
          new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(0, yaw * 0.8, 0)),
          0.2
        );
        rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedHeadOffset);
      };
      applyGaze(ariaRig, ariaHeadPos, ariaTargetVec);
      applyGaze(zephyrRig, zephyrHeadPos, ariaHeadPos);

      // Visemes
      rigsMap.forEach((rig, charId) => {
        const activeLine = comp.dialogue.find(
          (d) => d.speakerId === charId && t >= d.startSec && t <= d.endSec
        );
        const weights: Record<string, number> = {};
        ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (weights[v] = 0));
        if (activeLine) {
          activeLine.visemes.forEach((cue) => {
            const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
            const halfW = Math.max(0.035, cue.duration * 0.8);
            const dist = Math.abs(t - center);
            if (dist < halfW) {
              weights[cue.viseme] = Math.max(
                weights[cue.viseme] || 0,
                Math.cos((dist / halfW) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight
              );
            }
          });
        }
        rig.morphMeshes.forEach((mesh) => {
          const dict = mesh.morphTargetDictionary;
          const inf = mesh.morphTargetInfluences;
          if (!dict || !inf) return;
          ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName) => {
            const idx = dict[vName];
            if (typeof idx === 'number') {
              inf[idx] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inf[idx], weights[vName] || 0, 0.45);
            }
          });
        });
      });

      if (viewportCamModeRef.current === 'editor_crane') {
        const cx =
          editorCamRadius * Math.sin(editorCamPhi) * Math.sin(editorCamTheta);
        const cy = editorCamRadius * Math.cos(editorCamPhi);
        const cz =
          editorCamRadius * Math.sin(editorCamPhi) * Math.cos(editorCamTheta);
        camera.position.set(cx, cy, cz);
        camera.lookAt(0, 0.6, 0);
        camera.fov = 46;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      } else {
        let activeShot = comp.cameraShots[0];
        for (const s of comp.cameraShots) {
          if (t >= s.resolvedStart) activeShot = s;
        }
        const sideSign = activeShot.side === 'left' ? -1 : 1;
        const lineDir = new THREE.Vector3()
          .subVectors(zephyrHeadPos, ariaHeadPos)
          .setY(0)
          .normalize();
        const sideNormal = new THREE.Vector3(
          -lineDir.z * sideSign,
          0,
          lineDir.x * sideSign
        ).normalize();

        if (activeShot.shotType === 'splineDolly') {
          const tan = ariaRig.currentSplineTangent.clone().setY(0).normalize();
          const right = new THREE.Vector3(-tan.z, 0, tan.x).normalize();
          camera.position
            .copy(ariaHeadPos)
            .addScaledVector(tan, 2.2)
            .addScaledVector(right, 0.35);
          camera.position.y = 1.68;
          camera.lookAt(ariaHeadPos.x, ariaHeadPos.y - 0.1, ariaHeadPos.z);
        } else if (activeShot.shotType === 'overTheShoulder') {
          const isAria = activeShot.subjectId === 'actor_aria';
          const subj = isAria ? ariaHeadPos : zephyrHeadPos;
          const anchor = isAria ? zephyrHeadPos : ariaHeadPos;
          const aToS = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(subj, anchor).setY(0).normalize();
          camera.position
            .copy(anchor)
            .addScaledVector(aToS, -1.15)
            .addScaledVector(sideNormal, 0.48);
          camera.position.y = anchor.y - 0.04;
          camera.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(anchor, subj, 0.78));
        } else if (activeShot.shotType === 'closeUp') {
          camera.position
            .copy(ariaHeadPos)
            .addScaledVector(sideNormal, 1.55);
          camera.position.y = ariaHeadPos.y - 0.05;
          camera.lookAt(ariaHeadPos.x, ariaHeadPos.y - 0.08, ariaHeadPos.z);
        } else {
          const mid = new THREE.Vector3()
            .addVectors(ariaHeadPos, zephyrHeadPos)
            .multiplyScalar(0.5);
          mid.y -= 0.12;
          const sep = Math.max(2.3, ariaHeadPos.distanceTo(zephyrHeadPos));
          camera.position.copy(mid).addScaledVector(sideNormal, sep * 1.12);
          camera.position.y = 1.78;
          camera.lookAt(mid);
        }
        camera.fov = activeShot.fov;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      dom.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (rebuild3DSplinesRef.current) {
      rebuild3DSplinesRef.current();
    }
  }, [compiled]);

  const exportedJsonString = useMemo(
    () => JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2),
    [manifest]
  );

  const activeDialogue = useMemo(
    () =>
      compiled.dialogue.find(
        (d) => currentTime >= d.startSec && currentTime <= d.endSec
      ) || null,
    [compiled.dialogue, currentTime]
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 p-4 md:p-5 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-4">
        {/* AI PROMPT-TO-3D SCENE GENERATOR BAR */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-sky-500/40 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-2xl space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-400">
                <Wand2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              </span>
              <div>
                <div className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-sky-400">
                  8B LLM Prompt-to-3D Symbolic Scene Generator
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  Type any story prompt or pick a preset → Generates 8B JSON → Runs Self-Healing Sanitizer → Hot-Loads 3D Stage & Timeline
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Inference Engine Selector */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="flex bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setInferenceBackend('builtin_8b_sim')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition ${
                    inferenceBackend === 'builtin_8b_sim'
                      ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                      : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  Built-In 8B Simulator (Instant)
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setInferenceBackend('ollama_local')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg font-medium transition ${
                    inferenceBackend === 'ollama_local'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                      : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  Local Ollama (11434)
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Prompt Input + Generate Button */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-2.5">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={userPromptText}
              onChange={(e) => setUserPromptText(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Describe character blocking, dialogue topics, trigger words, and camera cuts..."
              className="flex-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 focus:border-sky-400 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white outline-none"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => handleRunAISceneGenerator()}
              disabled={isGeneratingScene}
              className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-950 font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-lg shadow-sky-500/20 transition shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            >
              {isGeneratingScene ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  Generating & Sanitizing...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                  Generate & Load onto 3D Stage
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Preset Story Chips + Optional Ollama Config */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400 mr-1">
                Try Presets:
              </span>
              {PROMPT_PRESETS.map((preset) => (
                <button
                  key={preset.id}
                  onClick={() => handleRunAISceneGenerator(preset)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium transition"
                >
                  {preset.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {inferenceBackend === 'ollama_local' && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={ollamaUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setOllamaUrl(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1 text-slate-300 w-52"
                />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={ollamaModel}
                  onChange={(e) => setOllamaModel(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded px-2 py-1 text-emerald-300 w-36"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Middle Row: 3D Stage Viewport (2 Cols) + Tabbed Sanitizer / Inspector / JSON Panel (1 Col) */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {/* 3D Interactive Stage Viewport */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
            <div className="relative w-full h-[365px] bg-black overflow-hidden">
              <div ref={mountRef} className="w-full h-full" />

              {/* Top-Left Telemetry & Camera Switcher */}
              <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 right-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pointer-events-none">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs text-slate-300">
                  <span
                    className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${
                      isPlaying ? 'bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-amber-400'
                    }`}
                  />
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white">
                    T+{currentTime.toFixed(2)}s / {compiled.duration.toFixed(2)}s
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-slate-600">|</span>
                  <span
                    className={`font-semibold ${
                      usingSanitizedVersion ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {usingSanitizedVersion
                      ? `Sanitized (${sanitizerRepairs.length} Repairs Applied)`
                      : 'RAW Un-Sanitized 8B Output'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex bg-slate-950/90 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 pointer-events-auto">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setViewportCamMode('editor_crane')}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium transition ${
                      viewportCamMode === 'editor_crane'
                        ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Move className="w-3 h-3" /> 3D Stage Crane
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setViewportCamMode('director_lens')}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium transition ${
                      viewportCamMode === 'director_lens'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 font-bold'
                        : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Video className="w-3 h-3" /> Director Camera
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {draggingWaypointLabel && (
                <div className="absolute top-14 left-3 bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-mono font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs shadow-lg pointer-events-none">
                  DRAGGING: {draggingWaypointLabel}
                </div>
              )}

              {activeDialogue && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-3 inset-x-6 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
                  <div className="max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-center">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-sky-400 mr-2">
                      {activeDialogue.speaker}:
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs md:text-sm text-white">
                      {activeDialogue.text}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Viewport Transport Bar */}
            <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsPlaying(!isPlaying)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-500 hover:bg-sky-400 text-slate-950 font-semibold px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition"
                >
                  {isPlaying ? (
                    <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  ) : (
                    <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                  {isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => seek(0)}
                  className="p-1.5 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl transition"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                Red Ring = 0.72m Pedestal Collision Keep-Out Zone • Drag Any Waypoint Cylinder
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Col: Tabbed Sanitizer Diff Log / Property Inspector / JSON Exporter */}
          <div className="flex flex-col bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl">
            {/* Tab Selector */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 bg-slate-950 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 mb-3 text-xs">
              <button
                onClick={() => setRightPanelTab('ai_sanitizer')}
                className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition ${
                  rightPanelTab === 'ai_sanitizer'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Repairs ({sanitizerRepairs.length})
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setRightPanelTab('inspector')}
                className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition ${
                  rightPanelTab === 'inspector'
                    ? 'bg-sky-500 text-slate-950'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Inspector
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setRightPanelTab('json_export')}
                className={`py-1.5 px-2 rounded-lg font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition ${
                  rightPanelTab === 'json_export'
                    ? 'bg-purple-500 text-slate-950'
                    : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                JSON
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* TAB 1: LIVE SANITIZER & AUTO-REPAIR AUDIT LOG */}
            {rightPanelTab === 'ai_sanitizer' && (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 min-h-0">
                <div className="space-y-2.5 overflow-y-auto pr-1 max-h-[290px]">
                  {/* Compare Sanitized vs Raw Toggle */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-950 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs">
                    <span className="text-slate-300 font-medium">
                      Active Stage Version:
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex gap-1">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleToggleSanitizedVsRaw(true)}
                        className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-bold transition ${
                          usingSanitizedVersion
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950'
                            : 'bg-slate-900 text-slate-400'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Sanitized
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleToggleSanitizedVsRaw(false)}
                        className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] font-bold transition ${
                          !usingSanitizedVersion
                            ? 'bg-rose-500 text-white'
                            : 'bg-slate-900 text-slate-400'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Raw 8B (Unfixed)
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* LLM Chapter Plan Thought Trace */}
                  {manifest.chapterPlan && (
                    <div className="bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-800/90 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-slate-300">
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-sky-400 uppercase block mb-0.5">
                        8B Chain-of-Thought Plan:
                      </span>
                      {manifest.chapterPlan}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Repair Diff Cards */}
                  {sanitizerRepairs.map((rep) => (
                    <div
                      key={rep.id}
                      className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-2.5 space-y-1.5 text-xs"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span
                          className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${
                            rep.category === 'SPATIAL_COLLISION'
                              ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/40'
                              : rep.category === 'WORD_STEM_MATCH'
                              ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40'
                              : rep.category === 'CAMERA_180_RULE'
                              ? 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40'
                              : 'bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-300 border border-sky-500/40'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {rep.category}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200 truncate max-w-[150px]">
                          {rep.targetLabel}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-[11px] bg-slate-900 p-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/80 overflow-x-auto">
                        <span className="text-rose-400 line-through shrink-0">
                          {rep.beforeValue}
                        </span>
                        <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold shrink-0">
                          {rep.afterValue}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 leading-snug">
                        {rep.reason}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-300/90 bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-500/30 p-2 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span>
                    All {sanitizerRepairs.length} raw 8B quirks were auto-repaired prior to Pass 1–4 timeline compilation.
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 2: SYMBOLIC PROPERTY & WAYPOINT INSPECTOR */}
            {rightPanelTab === 'inspector' && (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 text-xs">
                {selection.kind === 'waypoint' && (() => {
                  const tr = manifest.tracks.find(
                    (t) => t.id === selection.trackId
                  );
                  const seg = tr?.segments?.find(
                    (s) => s.id === selection.segmentId
                  );
                  const wp = seg?.waypoints[selection.waypointIndex];
                  if (!wp || !seg) return null;

                  return (
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                        <div className="text-sky-400 font-bold">
                          {selection.targetId} • Waypoint #
                          {selection.waypointIndex + 1}
                        </div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-slate-300 mt-1">
                          XYZ: [{wp[0].toFixed(2)}, 0, {wp[2].toFixed(2)}]
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                        Drag the glowing cylinder directly on the 3D floor grid to reposition this waypoint.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  );
                })()}

                {selection.kind === 'keyframe' && (() => {
                  const tr = compiled.tracks.find(
                    (t) => t.id === selection.trackId
                  );
                  const kf = tr?.resolvedKeyframes.find(
                    (k) => k.id === selection.keyframeId
                  );
                  if (!tr || !kf) return null;

                  return (
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="bg-slate-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex justify-between">
                        <span className="text-sky-400 font-bold">{tr.label}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400">
                          {kf.resolvedTime.toFixed(2)}s
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <label className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          Symbolic Time Anchor
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={String(kf.time)}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            setManifest((prev) => ({
                              ...prev,
                              tracks: prev.tracks.map((t) =>
                                t.id !== selection.trackId
                                  ? t
                                  : {
                                      ...t,
                                      keyframes: t.keyframes?.map((k) =>
                                        k.id === selection.keyframeId
                                          ? { ...k, time: val }
                                          : k
                                      )
                                    }
                              )
                            }));
                          }}
                          className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-amber-300"
                        />
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          1-Click Snap to Spoken Word:
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto p-1.5 bg-slate-950 rounded-xl border border-slate-800">
                          {compiled.dialogue.map((line) =>
                            line.words
                              .filter((w) => w.cleanWord.length >= 4)
                              .map((w) => {
                                const expr = `@${line.id}.word("${w.cleanWord}")`;
                                return (
                                  <button
                                    key={`${line.id}_${w.index}`}
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      setManifest((prev) => ({
                                        ...prev,
                                        tracks: prev.tracks.map((t) =>
                                          t.id !== selection.trackId
                                            ? t
                                            : {
                                                ...t,
                                                keyframes: t.keyframes?.map(
                                                  (k) =>
                                                    k.id ===
                                                    selection.keyframeId
                                                      ? { ...k, time: expr }
                                                      : k
                                                )
                                              }
                                        )
                                      }));
                                      seek(w.start);
                                    }}
                                    className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-sky-500/20 text-slate-300 border border-slate-800 rounded text-[10px] font-mono"
                                  >
                                    @{line.id}:&quot;{w.cleanWord}&quot;
                                  </button>
                                );
                              })
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })()}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 3: EXPORT SYMBOLIC JSON */}
            {rightPanelTab === 'json_export' && (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-h-0 space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      navigator.clipboard.writeText(exportedJsonString);
                      setCopiedJson(true);
                      setTimeout(() => setCopiedJson(false), 1800);
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs"
                  >
                    {copiedJson ? (
                      <>
                        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> Copied
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Copy JSON
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
                <pre className="flex-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-300 overflow-auto max-h-[290px]">
                  {exportedJsonString}
                </pre>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Bottom Section: 5-Lane Multi-Track Symbolic Timeline Editor */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-2.5 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-sky-400">
              <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
              Synchronized Multi-Track Symbolic Timeline ({manifest.title})
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">
              Click any diamond keyframe to inspect or rebind its spoken word anchor
            </span>
          </div>

          <input
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={compiled.duration}
            step={0.02}
            value={currentTime}
            onChange={(e) => seek(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
            className="w-full accent-sky-400 h-2 bg-slate-800 rounded-lg cursor-pointer"
          />

          <div className="relative space-y-1.5 pt-1 select-none">
            <div
              className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-rose-500 z-20 pointer-events-none"
              style={{
                left: `calc(168px + (100% - 168px) * ${
                  currentTime / Math.max(1, compiled.duration)
                })`
              }}
            />

            {/* Lane 1: Dialogue */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-[156px] shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-400 truncate">
                1. TTS Dialogue
              </div>
              <div className="relative flex-1 h-10 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                {compiled.dialogue.map((line) => {
                  const leftPct = (line.startSec / compiled.duration) * 100;
                  const widthPct = (line.duration / compiled.duration) * 100;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={line.id}
                      onClick={() => seek(line.startSec)}
                      style={{ left: `${leftPct}%`, width: `${widthPct}%` }}
                      className="absolute top-1 bottom-1 bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 cursor-pointer overflow-hidden"
                    >
                      <div className="flex justify-between text-[9px] font-mono text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                        <span>
                          @{line.id} ({line.speaker})
                        </span>
                        <span>{String(line.start)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-300 truncate">
                        {line.text}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Lanes 2..N: Spline & Keyframe Tracks */}
            {compiled.tracks.map((track, idx) => (
              <div key={track.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-[156px] shrink-0 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 truncate">
                  {idx + 2}. {track.label}
                </div>
                <div className="relative flex-1 h-8 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
                  {track.resolvedSegments.map((seg) => {
                    const leftPct = (seg.resolvedStart / compiled.duration) * 100;
                    const widthPct =
                      ((seg.resolvedEnd - seg.resolvedStart) /
                        compiled.duration) *
                      100;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={seg.id}
                        onClick={() => seek(seg.resolvedStart)}
                        style={{ left: `${leftPct}%`, width: `${widthPct}%` }}
                        className="absolute top-1 bottom-1 bg-sky-500/20 border border-sky-500/50 rounded-lg px-2 text-[10px] font-mono text-sky-300 truncate flex items-center cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {String(seg.startTime)} → {String(seg.endTime)}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}

                  {track.resolvedKeyframes.map((kf) => {
                    const leftPct = (kf.resolvedTime / compiled.duration) * 100;
                    const isSelected =
                      selection.kind === 'keyframe' &&
                      selection.keyframeId === kf.id;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={kf.id}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelection({
                            kind: 'keyframe',
                            trackId: track.id,
                            keyframeId: kf.id
                          });
                          setRightPanelTab('inspector');
                          seek(kf.resolvedTime);
                        }}
                        style={{ left: `${leftPct}%` }}
                        className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex items-center gap-1 z-10"
                      >
                        <span
                          className={`w-3 h-3 rotate-45 block border ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-amber-400 border-white scale-125'
                              : 'bg-sky-400 border-slate-950'
                          }`}
                        />
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1 rounded bg-slate-900 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700">
                          {String(kf.value)}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
3. Why the Live "Sanitized vs. Raw 8B" Toggle Is So Valuable
In the Repairs tab on the right-hand side of the studio, you can click "Raw 8B (Unfixed)" vs. "Sanitized" and watch the difference live on the 3D stage:

In Raw 8B Mode: ARIA's 3rd spline cylinder sits inside the red 0.72m pedestal collision ring ([-0.15, 0, -0.45]), line_2 starts at 0.0s talking over line_1, and @line_2.word("destabilize") fails to match "destabilizing".

In Sanitized Mode: The waypoint cylinder is pushed radially outward to [-0.66, 0, -0.04] just outside the red collision perimeter, line_2 chains cleanly onto @line_1.end + 0.35, and the PointRight gesture locks onto the spoken word "destabilizing".

Where would you like to take the platform next?

Build a Python LoRA training dataset generator (JSONL)

Add 2-bone arm IK & procedural facial emotion layers

Upgrade exporter to faster-than-real-time WebCodecs MP4
Extend the character rig with procedural eyebrow/emotion blendshapes and 2-bone arm IK so characters can physically reach out and touch target props at exact coordinates.

Adding Analytical 2-Bone Arm Inverse Kinematics (IK) and Procedural Eyebrow/Facial Emotion Blendshapes allows characters to physically reach out, touch props at exact world coordinates, and express emotion while speaking—all driven by symbolic word anchors (@line_2.word("touch")).

B. Layered Facial Emotion & Eyebrow Rig (Orthogonal to TTS Visemes)
To allow a character to smile, furrow their brow in concern, or widen their eyes in surprise while simultaneously speaking, the facial rig separates Affective Channels from Phonetic Viseme Channels:

Emotion Preset	browLift (Y)	browTilt (Z Angle)	eyeAperture (Squint/Wide)	mouthSmileFrown (Additive Morph)	Visual Character Expression
neutral	0.00	0°	0.00 (Normal)	0.00	Relaxed baseline posture
happy	+0.35	-6° (Arched)	-0.25 (Cheek squint)	+0.85 (Corners lifted)	Warm smile + arched brows
concerned	+0.45	+16° (Inner up / \)	-0.15	-0.60 (Corners down)	Empathetic / worried inner brow raise
surprised	+0.90	-4°	+0.85 (Wide open)	+0.10 + Jaw drop	High eyebrows + widened upper/lower lids
focused	-0.45	-12° (Inner down \ /)	-0.45 (Narrowed)	-0.20	Intense analytical concentration
determined	-0.65	-18° (Steep \ /)	-0.35	-0.45	High-stakes action / command expression
2. Extended Declarative Schema (armIK & facialEmotion Tracks)
Both systems integrate into the Symbolic Anchor Compiler so an 8B model or human author can bind physical prop touches and emotional shifts directly to spoken words:

JSON
{
  "tracks": [
    {
      "id": "track_aria_emotion",
      "targetId": "actor_aria",
      "property": "facialEmotion",
      "keyframes": [
        { "time": "@line_1.start", "value": "concerned", "crossFade": 0.35 },
        { "time": "@line_2.word(\"touch\") - 0.2", "value": "focused", "crossFade": 0.25 },
        { "time": "@line_2.word(\"stabilized\")", "value": "happy", "crossFade": 0.4 }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "track_aria_right_arm_ik",
      "targetId": "actor_aria",
      "property": "armIK",
      "hand": "right",
      "keyframes": [
        { "time": "@line_1.start", "target": null, "weight": 0.0, "crossFade": 0.4 },
        {
          "time": "@line_2.word(\"touch\") - 0.15",
          "target": "holo_core",
          "surfaceOffset": [0, 0, 0.28],
          "poleOffset": [0.35, -0.35, 0.2],
          "weight": 1.0,
          "crossFade": 0.45
        },
        {
          "time": "@line_3.word(\"console\")",
          "target": [-0.2, 1.02, -0.18],
          "weight": 1.0,
          "crossFade": 0.5
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
3. Complete React + Three.js Studio with 2-Bone Arm IK, Prop Touching & Facial Emotion Mixer
Install three and lucide-react (npm install three lucide-react). This self-contained studio includes:

Closed-Form 2-Bone Arm IK Solver (solveTwoBoneArmIK): Watch ARIA walk up to the containment pedestal, lean her upper spine forward, and physically reach out to touch the spinning Quantum Core on the word "touch", then reach down to press the Pedestal ConsolePad on "calibrate", while ZEPHYR reaches out to touch the Tactical Holo-Terminal.

Visual 3D IK Triangle & Contact Ripple Gizmos: Renders the live Shoulder 
→
→ Elbow 
→
→ Wrist IK Triangle, the Amber Elbow Pole Vector, and a pulsing Cyan Contact Ripple Ring at the exact [x, y, z] coordinate where the character's hand touches a prop.

Interactive 3D Hand-IK Target Drag Mode: Toggle "Interactive 3D Hand-IK Drag" in the toolbar and drag the glowing cyan target orb (or click any prop in the scene) to steer ARIA's right or left hand to any exact [x, y, z] coordinate in real time.

Expressive Eyebrow & Facial Emotion Mixer: Features articulated BrowL and BrowR bones, upper/lower eyelids, cheek squint meshes, and additive smile/frown morph targets that blend seamlessly with the 14 TTS visemes.

TypeScript
