// ============================================================================
// 2. ANALYTICAL 2-BONE ARM IK SOLVER (LAW OF COSINES + POLE VECTOR)
// ============================================================================

export interface TwoBoneIKChain {
  upperArmBone: THREE.Bone;
  forearmBone: THREE.Bone;
  handBone: THREE.Bone;
  upperArmLength: number; // L1
  forearmLength: number;  // L2
}

export interface SolvedArmIKResult {
  shoulderWorld: THREE.Vector3;
  elbowWorld: THREE.Vector3;
  wristWorld: THREE.Vector3;
  poleWorld: THREE.Vector3;
  shoulderAngleDeg: number;
  elbowFlexionDeg: number;
  reachPct: number;
  isContacting: boolean;
}

/**
 * Solves a 2-Bone Limb (UpperArm L1 -> Forearm L2 -> Hand/Wrist) analytically
 * using the Law of Cosines and a Gram-Schmidt Pole Vector plane.
 * Blends cleanly with the underlying FK skeletal pose by `ikWeight` [0..1].
 */
export function solveAnalyticalTwoBoneArmIK(
  characterRoot: THREE.Object3D,
  spineBone: THREE.Bone,
  chain: TwoBoneIKChain,
  targetWorldPos: THREE.Vector3,
  poleLocalOffset: THREE.Vector3,
  ikWeight: number,
  smoothedSpineLeanQuat: THREE.Quaternion,
  smoothedUpperQuat: THREE.Quaternion,
  smoothedForearmQuat: THREE.Quaternion
): SolvedArmIKResult {
  characterRoot.updateMatrixWorld(true);

  const shoulderWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
  chain.upperArmBone.getWorldPosition(shoulderWorld);

  const L1 = chain.upperArmLength;
  const L2 = chain.forearmLength;
  const maxReach = L1 + L2 - 0.008;
  const minReach = Math.abs(L1 - L2) + 0.02;

  // 1. Upper-Spine Lean Compensation when reaching near maximum extension
  const rawDistToTarget = shoulderWorld.distanceTo(targetWorldPos);
  let targetSpineQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();

  if (ikWeight > 0.05 && rawDistToTarget > maxReach * 0.72) {
    const rootQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
    characterRoot.getWorldQuaternion(rootQuat);
    const localToTarget = targetWorldPos
      .clone()
      .sub(shoulderWorld)
      .applyQuaternion(rootQuat.invert());

    const excessRatio = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      (rawDistToTarget - maxReach * 0.72) / (maxReach * 0.45),
      0,
      1
    );
    const leanPitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      localToTarget.z * 0.28 * excessRatio * ikWeight,
      -0.08,
      0.28 // Up to ~16 deg forward torso lean
    );
    const leanYaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
      Math.atan2(localToTarget.x, Math.max(0.1, localToTarget.z)) *
        0.25 *
        excessRatio *
        ikWeight,
      -0.32,
      0.32
    );
    targetSpineQuat.setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(leanPitch, leanYaw, 0, 'YXZ'));
  }

  smoothedSpineLeanQuat.slerp(targetSpineQuat, 0.16);
  spineBone.quaternion.multiply(smoothedSpineLeanQuat);
  spineBone.updateMatrixWorld(true);

  // Re-query exact Shoulder world position after Spine lean compensation
  chain.upperArmBone.getWorldPosition(shoulderWorld);

  // Compute Pole Vector in World Space relative to Character Root orientation
  const rootWorldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
  characterRoot.getWorldQuaternion(rootWorldQuat);
  const poleWorld = shoulderWorld
    .clone()
    .add(poleLocalOffset.clone().applyQuaternion(rootWorldQuat));

  const toTarget = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(targetWorldPos, shoulderWorld);
  const rawDistance = toTarget.length();
  const clampedDist = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(rawDistance, minReach, maxReach);

  // 2. Law of Cosines for Interior Shoulder Angle (alpha) and Elbow Angle (beta)
  const cosAlpha = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
    (L1 * L1 + clampedDist * clampedDist - L2 * L2) / (2 * L1 * clampedDist),
    -1,
    1
  );
  const alphaRad = Math.acos(cosAlpha);

  const cosBeta = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
    (L1 * L1 + L2 * L2 - clampedDist * clampedDist) / (2 * L1 * L2),
    -1,
    1
  );
  const betaRad = Math.acos(cosBeta);
  const elbowFlexionDeg = Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(Math.PI - betaRad));

  // 3. Construct Orthonormal IK Plane Basis (w_hat along target chord, v_hat toward Pole Vector)
  const wHat =
    rawDistance > 0.0001
      ? toTarget.clone().divideScalar(rawDistance)
      : new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);

  const toPole = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(poleWorld, shoulderWorld);
  // Gram-Schmidt orthogonal projection: remove component parallel to wHat
  const vProj = toPole
    .clone()
    .addScaledVector(wHat, -toPole.dot(wHat));

  const vHat =
    vProj.lengthSq() > 0.0001
      ? vProj.normalize()
      : new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0);

  // 4. Exact World-Space Elbow & Wrist Coordinates
  const elbowWorld = shoulderWorld
    .clone()
    .addScaledVector(wHat, L1 * Math.cos(alphaRad))
    .addScaledVector(vHat, L1 * Math.sin(alphaRad));

  const forearmDirWorld = new THREE.Vector3()
    .subVectors(targetWorldPos, elbowWorld)
    .normalize();
  const wristWorld = elbowWorld.clone().addScaledVector(forearmDirWorld, L2);

  // 5. Convert World Limb Directions into Parent-Local Bone Quaternions
  //In our rig, both UpperArm and Forearm bones have their rest axis pointing along (0, -1, 0)
  const restBoneAxis = new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0);

  if (ikWeight > 0.001) {
    // Save underlying FK animation quaternions so we can slerp by `ikWeight`
    const fkUpperQuat = chain.upperArmBone.quaternion.clone();
    const fkForearmQuat = chain.forearmBone.quaternion.clone();

    // Solve UpperArm Quaternion in Spine-local space
    const upperParentWorldQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
    if (chain.upperArmBone.parent) {
      chain.upperArmBone.parent.getWorldQuaternion(upperParentWorldQuat);
    }
    const upperDirWorld = new THREE.Vector3()
      .subVectors(elbowWorld, shoulderWorld)
      .normalize();
    const upperDirLocal = upperDirWorld
      .clone()
      .applyQuaternion(upperParentWorldQuat.clone().invert())
      .normalize();

    const ikUpperQuat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(
      restBoneAxis,
      upperDirLocal
    );
    smoothedUpperQuat.slerp(ikUpperQuat, 0.32);
    chain.upperArmBone.quaternion.copy(fkUpperQuat).slerp(smoothedUpperQuat, ikWeight);
    chain.upperArmBone.updateMatrixWorld(true);

    // Solve Forearm Quaternion in UpperArm-local space
    const upperWorldQuatNow = new THREE.Quaternion();
    chain.upperArmBone.getWorldQuaternion(upperWorldQuatNow);
    const forearmDirLocal = forearmDirWorld
      .clone()
      .applyQuaternion(upperWorldQuatNow.clone().invert())
      .normalize();

    const ikForearmQuat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(
      restBoneAxis,
      forearmDirLocal
    );
    smoothedForearmQuat.slerp(ikForearmQuat, 0.35);
    chain.forearmBone.quaternion
      .copy(fkForearmQuat)
      .slerp(smoothedForearmQuat, ikWeight);
    chain.forearmBone.updateMatrixWorld(true);

    // Orient Hand/Wrist palm toward the target surface
    chain.handBone.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
      0,
      -0.35,
      ikWeight
    );
    chain.handBone.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  }

  // Read back final blended world coordinates for telemetry & gizmos
  const finalElbowWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
  const finalWristWorld = new THREE.Vector3();
  chain.forearmBone.getWorldPosition(finalElbowWorld);
  chain.handBone.getWorldPosition(finalWristWorld);

  return {
    shoulderWorld,
    elbowWorld: finalElbowWorld,
    wristWorld: finalWristWorld,
    poleWorld,
    shoulderAngleDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(alphaRad)),
    elbowFlexionDeg,
    reachPct: Math.min(100, Math.round((rawDistance / maxReach) * 100)),
    isContacting:
      ikWeight > 0.65 && finalWristWorld.distanceTo(targetWorldPos) < 0.24
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 3. EXPRESSIVE HUMANOID RIG BUILDER (EYEBROWS, EYELIDS, EMOTION MORPHS & HANDS)
// ============================================================================

export interface ExpressiveCharacterRig {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  root: THREE.Group;
  mixer: THREE.AnimationMixer;
  actions: Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>;
  hipsBone: THREE.Bone;
  spineBone: THREE.Bone;
  headBone: THREE.Bone;
  // Facial Emotion Bones & Meshes
  browLBone: THREE.Bone;
  browRBone: THREE.Bone;
  eyelidUpperL: THREE.Mesh;
  eyelidLowerL: THREE.Mesh;
  eyelidUpperR: THREE.Mesh;
  eyelidLowerR: THREE.Mesh;
  cheekLMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  cheekRMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  mouthMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  // 2-Bone Arm IK Chains (Left & Right)
  rightArmChain: TwoBoneIKChain;
  leftArmChain: TwoBoneIKChain;
  // Smoothed State Quaternions & Emotion Channels
  smoothedHeadingQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedHeadOffset: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedSpineLeanQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedUpperRQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedForearmRQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedUpperLQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  smoothedForearmLQuat: THREE.Quaternion;
  currentEmotionWeights: EmotionChannelWeights;
  currentSplineTangent: THREE.Vector3;
}

const UPPER_ARM_LEN = 0.42;
const FOREARM_LEN = 0.40;

function createExpressiveIKRig(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  color: string,
  accentColor: string,
  initPos: Vector3Tuple,
  initRotY: number
): ExpressiveCharacterRig {
  const root = new THREE.Group();
  root.position.set(...initPos);
  root.rotation.set(0, initRotY, 0);

  // 1. Core Skeleton Hierarchy
  const hipsBone = new THREE.Bone();
  hipsBone.name = 'Hips';
  hipsBone.position.set(0, 1.02, 0);
  root.add(hipsBone);

  const spineBone = new THREE.Bone();
  spineBone.name = 'Spine';
  spineBone.position.set(0, 0.35, 0);
  hipsBone.add(spineBone);

  const headBone = new THREE.Bone();
  headBone.name = 'Head';
  headBone.position.set(0, 0.72, 0);
  spineBone.add(headBone);

  // Expressive Left & Right Eyebrow Bones
  const browLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  browLBone.name = 'BrowL';
  browLBone.position.set(-0.15, 0.19, 0.305);
  headBone.add(browLBone);

  const browRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  browRBone.name = 'BrowR';
  browRBone.position.set(0.15, 0.19, 0.305);
  headBone.add(browRBone);

  // 2-Bone Right Arm Hierarchy: ShoulderR -> ForearmR (at -L1) -> HandR (at -L2)
  const shoulderRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderRBone.name = 'ShoulderR';
  shoulderRBone.position.set(0.52, 0.44, 0.02);
  spineBone.add(shoulderRBone);

  const forearmRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmRBone.name = 'ForearmR';
  forearmRBone.position.set(0, -UPPER_ARM_LEN, 0);
  shoulderRBone.add(forearmRBone);

  const handRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  handRBone.name = 'HandR';
  handRBone.position.set(0, -FOREARM_LEN, 0);
  forearmRBone.add(handRBone);

  // 2-Bone Left Arm Hierarchy: ShoulderL -> ForearmL (at -L1) -> HandL (at -L2)
  const shoulderLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shoulderLBone.name = 'ShoulderL';
  shoulderLBone.position.set(-0.52, 0.44, 0.02);
  spineBone.add(shoulderLBone);

  const forearmLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  forearmLBone.name = 'ForearmL';
  forearmLBone.position.set(0, -UPPER_ARM_LEN, 0);
  shoulderLBone.add(forearmLBone);

  const handLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  handLBone.name = 'HandL';
  handLBone.position.set(0, -FOREARM_LEN, 0);
  forearmLBone.add(handLBone);

  // Legs
  const thighLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighLBone.name = 'ThighL';
  thighLBone.position.set(-0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighLBone);

  const shinLBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinLBone.name = 'ShinL';
  shinLBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighLBone.add(shinLBone);

  const thighRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  thighRBone.name = 'ThighR';
  thighRBone.position.set(0.24, -0.08, 0);
  hipsBone.add(thighRBone);

  const shinRBone = new THREE.Bone();
  shinRBone.name = 'ShinR';
  shinRBone.position.set(0, -0.46, 0);
  thighRBone.add(shinRBone);

  // Materials
  const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color,
    roughness: 0.32,
    metalness: 0.45
  });
  const darkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#1e293b',
    roughness: 0.45,
    metalness: 0.65
  });
  const accentMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: accentColor,
    emissive: accentColor,
    emissiveIntensity: 0.65
  });
  const browMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#0f172a',
    emissive: accentColor,
    emissiveIntensity: 0.35
  });
  const scleraMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color: '#f8fafc',
    roughness: 0.15
  });
  const pupilMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#020617' });

  // Torso & Pelvis
  hipsBone.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.72, 0.24, 0.42), darkMat));
  const torsoMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.86, 0.88, 0.46), bodyMat);
  torsoMesh.position.set(0, 0.14, 0);
  spineBone.add(torsoMesh);

  const chestBadge = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.18, 0.06), accentMat);
  chestBadge.position.set(0, 0.28, 0.24);
  spineBone.add(chestBadge);

  // Articulated Arm & Hand Meshes (Aligned strictly along bone -Y axis for exact 2-Bone IK visuals)
  const buildArmVisuals = (
    upperBone: THREE.Bone,
    forearmBone: THREE.Bone,
    handBone: THREE.Bone
  ) => {
    const shoulderJoint = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.13, 16, 16),
      darkMat
    );
    upperBone.add(shoulderJoint);

    const upperMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, UPPER_ARM_LEN - 0.14, 8, 16),
      darkMat
    );
    upperMesh.position.set(0, -UPPER_ARM_LEN * 0.5, 0);
    upperBone.add(upperMesh);

    const elbowJoint = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.11, 16, 16),
      accentMat
    );
    forearmBone.add(elbowJoint);

    const forearmMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.09, FOREARM_LEN - 0.12, 8, 16),
      bodyMat
    );
    forearmMesh.position.set(0, -FOREARM_LEN * 0.5, 0);
    forearmBone.add(forearmMesh);

    // Palm + Emitter Finger Tip at exact HandBone origin (0,0,0)
    const palmMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14, 0.16, 0.08),
      accentMat
    );
    palmMesh.position.set(0, -0.04, 0.02);
    handBone.add(palmMesh);
  };

  buildArmVisuals(shoulderRBone, forearmRBone, handRBone);
  buildArmVisuals(shoulderLBone, forearmLBone, handLBone);

  // Legs
  const thighGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.13, 0.34, 8, 16);
  const shinGeo = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.105, 0.38, 8, 16);
  const tL = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  tL.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighLBone.add(tL);
  const sL = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  sL.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinLBone.add(sL);
  const tR = new THREE.Mesh(thighGeo, darkMat);
  tR.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  thighRBone.add(tR);
  const sR = new THREE.Mesh(shinGeo, bodyMat);
  sR.position.set(0, -0.22, 0);
  shinRBone.add(sR);

  // Head, Eyebrows, Eyelids & Cheek Squint Meshes
  const headMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.64, 0.6), bodyMat);
  headBone.add(headMesh);

  const socketFrame = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.56, 0.24, 0.06), darkMat);
  socketFrame.position.set(0, 0.06, 0.28);
  headBone.add(socketFrame);

  // Expressive Eyebrow Bars on BrowLBone & BrowRBone
  const browGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.21, 0.048, 0.06);
  const browLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(browGeo, browMat);
  browLBone.add(browLMesh);

  const browRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(browGeo, browMat);
  browRBone.add(browRMesh);

  // Eyes + Upper/Lower Eyelids for Surprised (Wide) vs Focused/Happy (Squint)
  const buildExpressiveEye = (xOffset: number) => {
    const eyeGroup = new THREE.Group();
    eyeGroup.position.set(xOffset, 0.06, 0.285);
    headBone.add(eyeGroup);

    const sclera = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.085, 20, 20), scleraMat);
    sclera.scale.set(1, 1, 0.7);
    eyeGroup.add(sclera);

    const iris = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.044, 0.044, 0.02, 16),
      accentMat
    );
    iris.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    iris.position.set(0, 0, 0.056);
    eyeGroup.add(iris);

    const pupil = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.022, 0.022, 0.025, 12),
      pupilMat
    );
    pupil.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    pupil.position.set(0, 0, 0.06);
    eyeGroup.add(pupil);

    const upperLid = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.19, 0.09, 0.12),
      bodyMat
    );
    upperLid.position.set(0, 0.08, 0.02);
    eyeGroup.add(upperLid);

    const lowerLid = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.19, 0.08, 0.12),
      bodyMat
    );
    lowerLid.position.set(0, -0.08, 0.02);
    eyeGroup.add(lowerLid);

    return { upperLid, lowerLid };
  };

  const leftEyeLids = buildExpressiveEye(-0.145);
  const rightEyeLids = buildExpressiveEye(0.145);

  // Cheekbones (Elevate during Happy smile squint)
  const cheekGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.16, 0.065, 0.06);
  const cheekLMesh = new THREE.Mesh(cheekGeo, accentMat);
  cheekLMesh.position.set(-0.2, -0.06, 0.29);
  headBone.add(cheekLMesh);

  const cheekRMesh = new THREE.Mesh(cheekGeo, accentMat);
  cheekRMesh.position.set(0.2, -0.06, 0.29);
  headBone.add(cheekRMesh);

  // Combined Viseme (10) + Emotion (`emotion_smile`, `emotion_frown`) Morph-Target Mouth Mesh!
  const baseMouthGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.075, 0.1, 10, 4, 2);
  const basePos = baseMouthGeo.attributes.position;
  const morphPositions: THREE.BufferAttribute[] = [];
  const morphDict: Record<string, number> = {};

  const allMorphNames = [...ALL_VISEMES, 'emotion_smile', 'emotion_frown'];

  allMorphNames.forEach((mName, idx) => {
    morphDict[mName] = idx;
    const cloned = basePos.clone();
    for (let i = 0; i < cloned.count; i++) {
      let x = cloned.getX(i);
      let y = cloned.getY(i);
      const z = cloned.getZ(i);
      const normX = Math.abs(x) / 0.17; // 0 at center of lips, 1 at outer corners

      if (mName === 'emotion_smile') {
        // Curve outer mouth corners upward and widen slightly
        x *= 1.22;
        y += normX * normX * 0.085;
      } else if (mName === 'emotion_frown') {
        // Curve outer mouth corners downward
        x *= 0.94;
        y -= normX * normX * 0.085;
      } else if (mName === 'viseme_aa') {
        y *= 3.5;
        x *= 1.12;
      } else if (mName === 'viseme_O') {
        y *= 3.0;
        x *= 0.62;
      } else if (mName === 'viseme_U') {
        y *= 2.0;
        x *= 0.45;
      } else if (mName === 'viseme_E' || mName === 'viseme_I') {
        y *= 2.0;
        x *= 1.32;
      } else if (mName === 'viseme_PP') {
        y *= 0.25;
      } else {
        y *= 1.65;
      }
      cloned.setXYZ(i, x, y, z);
    }
    morphPositions.push(cloned);
  });
  baseMouthGeo.morphAttributes.position = morphPositions;

  const mouthMesh = new THREE.Mesh(baseMouthGeo, accentMat);
  mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary = morphDict;
  mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences = new Array(allMorphNames.length).fill(0);
  mouthMesh.position.set(0, -0.15, 0.29);
  headBone.add(mouthMesh);

  // Base FK Skeletal Clips (Walk & Idle)
  const qEuler = (x: number, y: number, z: number) =>
    new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(x, y, z)).toArray();
  const walkTimes = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0];
  const walkClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Walk', 1.0, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      walkTimes,
      [-0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.05, 0, 0.03, 0.99, 0, 0.0, 1.05, 0, -0.03, 0.99, 0]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.5, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.5, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.8, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ThighR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.52, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.1, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.5, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.52, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShinR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.2, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.15, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.8, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.32, 0, -0.1),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.1),
        ...qEuler(0.32, 0, -0.1),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, -0.1),
        ...qEuler(-0.32, 0, -0.1)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      walkTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.32, 0, 0.1),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.1),
        ...qEuler(-0.32, 0, 0.1),
        ...qEuler(0.0, 0, 0.1),
        ...qEuler(0.32, 0, 0.1)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const gTimes = [0, 0.6, 1.2, 1.8, 2.4];
  const idleClip = new THREE.AnimationClip('Idle', 2.4, [
    new THREE.VectorKeyframeTrack(
      'Hips.position',
      gTimes,
      [0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0, 0, 1.04, 0, 0, 1.02, 0]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.05, 0, -0.12),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, -0.14),
        ...qEuler(0.05, 0, -0.12),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, -0.14),
        ...qEuler(0.05, 0, -0.12)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ShoulderR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(0.05, 0, 0.12),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0.14),
        ...qEuler(0.05, 0, 0.12),
        ...qEuler(0.08, 0, 0.14),
        ...qEuler(0.05, 0, 0.12)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ForearmL.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.3, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.3, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0)
      ]
    ),
    new THREE.QuaternionKeyframeTrack(
      'ForearmR.quaternion',
      gTimes,
      [
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.3, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.3, 0, 0),
        ...qEuler(-0.25, 0, 0)
      ]
    )
  ]);

  const mixer = new THREE.AnimationMixer(root);
  const actions = new Map<string, THREE.AnimationAction>();
  [
    ['Idle', idleClip],
    ['Walk', walkClip]
  ].forEach(([cName, clip]) => {
    const act = mixer.clipAction(clip as THREE.AnimationClip);
    act.play();
    act.setEffectiveWeight(cName === 'Idle' ? 1 : 0);
    actions.set(cName as string, act);
  });

  return {
    id,
    name,
    root,
    mixer,
    actions,
    hipsBone,
    spineBone,
    headBone,
    browLBone,
    browRBone,
    eyelidUpperL: leftEyeLids.upperLid,
    eyelidLowerL: leftEyeLids.lowerLid,
    eyelidUpperR: rightEyeLids.upperLid,
    eyelidLowerR: rightEyeLids.lowerLid,
    cheekLMesh,
    cheekRMesh,
    mouthMesh,
    rightArmChain: {
      upperArmBone: shoulderRBone,
      forearmBone: forearmRBone,
      handBone: handRBone,
      upperArmLength: UPPER_ARM_LEN,
      forearmLength: FOREARM_LEN
    },
    leftArmChain: {
      upperArmBone: shoulderLBone,
      forearmBone: forearmLBone,
      handBone: handLBone,
      upperArmLength: UPPER_ARM_LEN,
      forearmLength: FOREARM_LEN
    },
    smoothedHeadingQuat: new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
      new THREE.Euler(0, initRotY, 0)
    ),
    smoothedHeadOffset: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedSpineLeanQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedUpperRQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedForearmRQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedUpperLQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    smoothedForearmLQuat: new THREE.Quaternion(),
    currentEmotionWeights: { ...EMOTION_PRESETS.neutral },
    currentSplineTangent: new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(initRotY), 0, Math.cos(initRotY))
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 4. LAYERED FACIAL EMOTION + VISEME APPLICATOR
// ============================================================================

function applyFacialEmotionAndVisemes(
  rig: ExpressiveCharacterRig,
  targetEmotion: EmotionChannelWeights,
  visemeWeights: Record<string, number>,
  t: number
) {
  // 1. Smoothly damp current emotion channels toward target emotion
  const cur = rig.currentEmotionWeights;
  cur.browLift = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(cur.browLift, targetEmotion.browLift, 0.16);
  cur.browTiltDeg = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
    cur.browTiltDeg,
    targetEmotion.browTiltDeg,
    0.16
  );
  cur.eyeWideSquint = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
    cur.eyeWideSquint,
    targetEmotion.eyeWideSquint,
    0.18
  );
  cur.mouthSmileFrown = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
    cur.mouthSmileFrown,
    targetEmotion.mouthSmileFrown,
    0.18
  );

  // 2. Drive Left & Right Eyebrow Bones (Height + Mirrored Symmetrical Tilt)
  const browY = 0.185 + cur.browLift * 0.055;
  const tiltRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(cur.browTiltDeg);
  rig.browLBone.position.y = browY;
  rig.browRBone.position.y = browY;
  // Positive tilt = inner brows raised (/ \ concerned); Negative tilt = inner brows lowered (\ / focused)
  rig.browLBone.rotation.z = tiltRad;
  rig.browRBone.rotation.z = -tiltRad;

  // 3. Drive Upper & Lower Eyelids (Periodic Blink + Surprised Wide / Happy Squint)
  const isBlinking = (t + (rig.id === 'actor_aria' ? 0 : 1.7)) % 3.6 > 3.45;
  const upperY = isBlinking
    ? 0.03
    : 0.085 + cur.eyeWideSquint * 0.032;
  const lowerY = isBlinking
    ? -0.03
    : -0.085 - cur.eyeWideSquint * 0.022;

  rig.eyelidUpperL.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
    rig.eyelidUpperL.position.y,
    upperY,
    0.45
  );
  rig.eyelidUpperR.position.y = rig.eyelidUpperL.position.y;
  rig.eyelidLowerL.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
    rig.eyelidLowerL.position.y,
    lowerY,
    0.45
  );
  rig.eyelidLowerR.position.y = rig.eyelidLowerL.position.y;

  // 4. Cheek Lift on Smile
  const cheekLift = Math.max(0, cur.mouthSmileFrown) * 0.025;
  rig.cheekLMesh.position.y = -0.06 + cheekLift;
  rig.cheekRMesh.position.y = -0.06 + cheekLift;

  // 5. Apply Orthogonal Mouth Morph Targets (10 Visemes + Additive Smile/Frown)
  const dict = rig.mouthMesh.morphTargetDictionary;
  const inf = rig.mouthMesh.morphTargetInfluences;
  if (!dict || !inf) return;

  ALL_VISEMES.forEach((vName) => {
    const idx = dict[vName];
    if (typeof idx === 'number') {
      inf[idx] = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(inf[idx], visemeWeights[vName] || 0, 0.45);
    }
  });

  const smileIdx = dict['emotion_smile'];
  const frownIdx = dict['emotion_frown'];
  if (typeof smileIdx === 'number') {
    inf[smileIdx] = Math.max(0, cur.mouthSmileFrown);
  }
  if (typeof frownIdx === 'number') {
    inf[frownIdx] = Math.max(0, -cur.mouthSmileFrown);
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// 5. WORD-ANCHORED SCENE COMPILER (WITH ARM IK & EMOTION TRACKS)
// ============================================================================

function smoothstep(x: number): number {
  const c = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x));
  return c * c * (3 - 2 * c);
}

function buildCompiledIKAndEmotionScene() {
  const rawLines = [
    {
      id: 'line_1',
      speakerId: 'actor_aria',
      speaker: 'ARIA',
      wpm: 145,
      text: 'I am approaching the pedestal with a concerned expression as the core harmonic spikes.'
    },
    {
      id: 'line_2',
      speakerId: 'actor_aria',
      speaker: 'ARIA',
      wpm: 145,
      text: 'Watch my right arm IK: on the word touch I reach out to the Quantum Core, and on calibrate I press the keypad!'
    },
    {
      id: 'line_3',
      speakerId: 'actor_zephyr',
      speaker: 'ZEPHYR',
      wpm: 142,
      text: 'And on the word terminal my left arm reaches the holo-screen while we both smile at stabilization!'
    }
  ];

  const charToViseme = (ch: string): VisemeName => {
    switch (ch.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'a':
        return 'viseme_aa';
      case 'e':
        return 'viseme_E';
      case 'i':
      case 'y':
        return 'viseme_I';
      case 'o':
        return 'viseme_O';
      case 'u':
      case 'w':
        return 'viseme_U';
      case 'p':
      case 'b':
      case 'm':
        return 'viseme_PP';
      case 'f':
      case 'v':
        return 'viseme_FF';
      case 't':
      case 'd':
      case 'n':
        return 'viseme_DD';
      default:
        return 'viseme_SS';
    }
  };

  let cursor = 0.25;
  const dialogue: DialogueLine[] = [];
  const wordTimestampLookup = new Map<string, number>();

  rawLines.forEach((raw, idx) => {
    const lineStart = idx === 0 ? cursor : cursor + 0.35;
    const tokens = raw.text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    const secPerWord = 60 / raw.wpm;

    let wordCursor = lineStart;
    const words: TTSWordBoundary[] = [];
    const visemes: VisemeCue[] = [];

    tokens.forEach((tok, wIdx) => {
      const clean = tok.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toLowerCase();
      const syllables = Math.max(1, (clean.match(/[aeiouy]+/g) || []).length);
      const wDur = Math.max(0.16, secPerWord * (0.55 + syllables * 0.3));
      const wStart = wordCursor;
      const wEnd = wordCursor + wDur;

      words.push({
        word: tok,
        cleanWord: clean,
        index: wIdx,
        start: Number(wStart.toFixed(3)),
        end: Number(wEnd.toFixed(3))
      });

      wordTimestampLookup.set(`${raw.id}:${clean}`, Number(wStart.toFixed(3)));

      const chars = clean.split('');
      const charDur = wDur / Math.max(1, chars.length);
      chars.forEach((ch, cIdx) => {
        visemes.push({
          time: wStart + cIdx * charDur,
          duration: charDur * 1.15,
          viseme: charToViseme(ch),
          weight: 0.9
        });
      });

      const pauseAfter = /[.,!?]/.test(tok) ? 0.22 : 0.035;
      wordCursor = wEnd + pauseAfter;
      visemes.push({
        time: wEnd,
        duration: pauseAfter,
        viseme: 'viseme_sil',
        weight: 0.1
      });
    });

    cursor = Number(wordCursor.toFixed(3));
    dialogue.push({
      id: raw.id,
      speakerId: raw.speakerId,
      speaker: raw.speaker,
      start: Number(lineStart.toFixed(3)),
      end: cursor,
      text: raw.text,
      words,
      visemes
    });
  });

  const tTouch = wordTimestampLookup.get('line_2:touch') ?? 5.8;
  const tCalibrate = wordTimestampLookup.get('line_2:calibrate') ?? 8.5;
  const tTerminal = wordTimestampLookup.get('line_3:terminal') ?? 12.2;
  const tSmile = wordTimestampLookup.get('line_3:smile') ?? 14.5;

  // Declarative 2-Bone Arm IK Tracks bound to exact spoken words
  const ariaArmIKKeyframes: ArmIKKeyframe[] = [
    {
      id: 'ik_a0',
      time: '@line_1.start',
      resolvedTime: dialogue[0].start,
      hand: 'right',
      target: null,
      weight: 0.0,
      crossFade: 0.3
    },
    {
      id: 'ik_a1_touch_core',
      time: '@line_2.word("touch") - 0.25',
      resolvedTime: tTouch - 0.25,
      hand: 'right',
      target: 'holo_core',
      surfaceOffset: [-0.22, -0.04, 0.18],
      poleOffset: [0.38, -0.42, 0.15],
      weight: 1.0,
      crossFade: 0.45
    },
    {
      id: 'ik_a2_press_pad',
      time: '@line_2.word("calibrate") - 0.2',
      resolvedTime: tCalibrate - 0.2,
      hand: 'right',
      target: 'pedestal_pad',
      surfaceOffset: [0, 0.05, 0],
      poleOffset: [0.42, -0.35, 0.25],
      weight: 1.0,
      crossFade: 0.45
    },
    {
      id: 'ik_a3_release',
      time: '@line_3.word("smile")',
      resolvedTime: tSmile,
      hand: 'right',
      target: null,
      weight: 0.0,
      crossFade: 0.55
    }
  ];

  const zephyrArmIKKeyframes: ArmIKKeyframe[] = [
    {
      id: 'ik_z0',
      time: 0,
      resolvedTime: 0,
      hand: 'left',
      target: null,
      weight: 0.0,
      crossFade: 0.3
    },
    {
      id: 'ik_z1_touch_terminal',
      time: '@line_3.word("terminal") - 0.25',
      resolvedTime: tTerminal - 0.25,
      hand: 'left',
      target: 'holo_terminal',
      surfaceOffset: [0.1, 0.08, 0.12],
      poleOffset: [-0.38, -0.4, 0.2],
      weight: 1.0,
      crossFade: 0.45
    }
  ];

  // Declarative Facial Emotion Tracks bound to spoken words
  const ariaEmotionKeyframes: EmotionKeyframe[] = [
    {
      id: 'em_a1',
      time: '@line_1.start',
      resolvedTime: dialogue[0].start,
      emotion: 'concerned',
      crossFade: 0.35
    },
    {
      id: 'em_a2',
      time: '@line_2.start',
      resolvedTime: dialogue[1].start,
      emotion: 'surprised',
      crossFade: 0.3
    },
    {
      id: 'em_a3',
      time: '@line_2.word("touch") - 0.2',
      resolvedTime: tTouch - 0.2,
      emotion: 'focused',
      crossFade: 0.3
    },
    {
      id: 'em_a4',
      time: '@line_3.word("smile") - 0.1',
      resolvedTime: tSmile - 0.1,
      emotion: 'happy',
      crossFade: 0.35
    }
  ];

  const zephyrEmotionKeyframes: EmotionKeyframe[] = [
    {
      id: 'em_z1',
      time: 0,
      resolvedTime: 0,
      emotion: 'concerned',
      crossFade: 0.3
    },
    {
      id: 'em_z2',
      time: '@line_3.start',
      resolvedTime: dialogue[2].start,
      emotion: 'determined',
      crossFade: 0.35
    },
    {
      id: 'em_z3',
      time: '@line_3.word("smile") - 0.1',
      resolvedTime: tSmile - 0.1,
      emotion: 'happy',
      crossFade: 0.35
    }
  ];

  return {
    duration: Number((cursor + 0.6).toFixed(2)),
    dialogue,
    ariaArmIKKeyframes,
    zephyrArmIKKeyframes,
    ariaEmotionKeyframes,
    zephyrEmotionKeyframes
  };
}

// ============================================================================
// 6. MAIN REACT COMPONENT: 2-BONE ARM IK & FACIAL EMOTION STUDIO
// ============================================================================

export default function ArmIKAndFacialEmotionStudio() {
  const compiledScene = useMemo(() => buildCompiledIKAndEmotionScene(), []);

  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showIKTriangleGizmos, setShowIKTriangleGizmos] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Interactive 3D Hand-IK Override & Live Emotion Mixer State
  const [interactiveIKOverride, setInteractiveIKOverride] =
    useState<boolean>(false);
  const [activeIKHand, setActiveIKHand] = useState<'right' | 'left'>('right');
  const [manualTargetXYZ, setManualTargetXYZ] = useState<Vector3Tuple>([
    -0.2, 1.48, -0.25
  ]);
  const [poleElbowSpread, setPoleElbowSpread] = useState<number>(0.38);

  const [emotionOverridePreset, setEmotionOverridePreset] = useState<
    EmotionPresetName | 'timeline_auto'
  >('timeline_auto');
  const [customEmotionWeights, setCustomEmotionWeights] =
    useState<EmotionChannelWeights>({ ...EMOTION_PRESETS.concerned });
  const [useCustomSliders, setUseCustomSliders] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [telemetry, setTelemetry] = useState<ArmIKTelemetry>({
    activeHand: 'right',
    targetLabel: 'holo_core',
    targetWorldXYZ: [-0.2, 1.48, -0.25],
    wristWorldXYZ: [-0.5, 1.2, 0.2],
    elbowWorldXYZ: [-0.6, 1.1, 0.1],
    ikBlendWeight: 0,
    shoulderElevationDeg: 0,
    elbowFlexionDeg: 0,
    reachExtensionPct: 0,
    spineLeanDeg: 0,
    isContactingTarget: false,
    activeEmotion: 'concerned'
  });

  const mountRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const timeRef = useRef<number>(0);
  const lastFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastSpokenSegRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  // Sync Refs for 60FPS Loop
  const showGizmosRef = useRef(showIKTriangleGizmos);
  const interactiveIKRef = useRef(interactiveIKOverride);
  const activeHandRef = useRef(activeIKHand);
  const manualTargetVecRef = useRef(new THREE.Vector3(...manualTargetXYZ));
  const poleSpreadRef = useRef(poleElbowSpread);
  const emotionOverrideRef = useRef(emotionOverridePreset);
  const customEmotionRef = useRef(customEmotionWeights);
  const useCustomSlidersRef = useRef(useCustomSliders);

  useEffect(() => {
    showGizmosRef.current = showIKTriangleGizmos;
  }, [showIKTriangleGizmos]);
  useEffect(() => {
    interactiveIKRef.current = interactiveIKOverride;
  }, [interactiveIKOverride]);
  useEffect(() => {
    activeHandRef.current = activeIKHand;
  }, [activeIKHand]);
  useEffect(() => {
    manualTargetVecRef.current.set(...manualTargetXYZ);
  }, [manualTargetXYZ]);
  useEffect(() => {
    poleSpreadRef.current = poleElbowSpread;
  }, [poleElbowSpread]);
  useEffect(() => {
    emotionOverrideRef.current = emotionOverridePreset;
  }, [emotionOverridePreset]);
  useEffect(() => {
    customEmotionRef.current = customEmotionWeights;
  }, [customEmotionWeights]);
  useEffect(() => {
    useCustomSlidersRef.current = useCustomSliders;
  }, [useCustomSliders]);

  const activeDialogue = useMemo(
    () =>
      compiledScene.dialogue.find(
        (d) => currentTime >= d.start && currentTime <= d.end
      ) || null,
    [compiledScene.dialogue, currentTime]
  );

  const seek = useCallback(
    (t: number) => {
      const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(compiledScene.duration, t));
      timeRef.current = clamped;
      setCurrentTime(clamped);
    },
    [compiledScene.duration]
  );

  // Browser TTS Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying || !activeDialogue) {
      if (!isPlaying && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (lastSpokenSegRef.current !== activeDialogue.id) {
      lastSpokenSegRef.current = activeDialogue.id;
      if (ttsEnabled && typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utter = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(activeDialogue.text);
        utter.rate = 1.05;
        utter.pitch = activeDialogue.speakerId === 'actor_zephyr' ? 0.85 : 1.12;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utter);
      }
    }
  }, [activeDialogue, isPlaying, ttsEnabled]);

  // Master Clock
  useEffect(() => {
    let rAF: number;
    const tick = (now: number) => {
      if (isPlaying && lastFrameRef.current !== null) {
        const dt = (now - lastFrameRef.current) / 1000;
        let next = timeRef.current + dt;
        if (next >= compiledScene.duration) next = 0;
        timeRef.current = next;
        setCurrentTime(next);
      }
      lastFrameRef.current = now;
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
  }, [isPlaying, compiledScene.duration]);

  // ==========================================================================
  // 7. THREE.JS SCENE, 2-BONE ARM IK SOLVER, GIZMOS & EMOTION LOOP
  // ==========================================================================

  useEffect(() => {
    const container = mountRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color('#070b14');

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      42,
      container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight,
      0.15,
      50
    );
    camera.position.set(0.1, 1.72, 2.75);
    camera.lookAt(0.0, 1.32, -0.2);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    container.innerHTML = '';
    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.92));
    const keyLight = new THREE.PointLight('#60a5fa', 2.8, 28);
    keyLight.position.set(2, 6, 4);
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const grid = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, '#1e293b', '#1e293b');
    scene.add(grid);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // INTERACTIVE TARGET PROPS (Clickable in 3D to snap Hand-IK onto them!)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const propsMap = new Map<string, THREE.Object3D>();

    // Prop 1: Containment Pedestal + Keypad Button ('pedestal_pad')
    const pedestalMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.32, 0.42, 0.96, 24),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#1e293b',
        roughness: 0.4,
        metalness: 0.7
      })
    );
    pedestalMesh.position.set(-0.2, 0.48, -0.45);
    scene.add(pedestalMesh);

    const pedestalPadMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.28, 0.06, 0.22),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#10b981',
        emissive: '#059669',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.7
      })
    );
    pedestalPadMesh.position.set(-0.2, 0.98, -0.22);
    pedestalPadMesh.rotation.x = 0.35;
    pedestalPadMesh.userData = { propId: 'pedestal_pad' };
    scene.add(pedestalPadMesh);
    propsMap.set('pedestal_pad', pedestalPadMesh);

    // Prop 2: Floating Quantum Core ('holo_core')
    const holoCoreMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.24, 0.075, 80, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#38bdf8',
        emissive: '#0284c7',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.75,
        roughness: 0.2,
        metalness: 0.8
      })
    );
    holoCoreMesh.position.set(-0.2, 1.48, -0.42);
    holoCoreMesh.userData = { propId: 'holo_core' };
    scene.add(holoCoreMesh);
    propsMap.set('holo_core', holoCoreMesh);

    // Prop 3: Zephyr's Tactical Holo-Terminal ('holo_terminal')
    const terminalStand = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.08, 0.2, 1.05, 16),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#334155', metalness: 0.7 })
    );
    terminalStand.position.set(0.58, 0.525, 0.08);
    scene.add(terminalStand);

    const holoTerminalMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.28, 0.04),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: '#a855f7',
        emissive: '#9333ea',
        emissiveIntensity: 0.75,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.88
      })
    );
    holoTerminalMesh.position.set(0.58, 1.18, 0.08);
    holoTerminalMesh.rotation.y = -0.55;
    holoTerminalMesh.rotation.x = -0.25;
    holoTerminalMesh.userData = { propId: 'holo_terminal' };
    scene.add(holoTerminalMesh);
    propsMap.set('holo_terminal', holoTerminalMesh);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // EXPRESSIVE CHARACTER RIGS (ARIA & ZEPHYR)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const ariaRig = createExpressiveIKRig(
      'actor_aria',
      'ARIA',
      '#f1f5f9',
      '#38bdf8',
      [-2.1, 0, -0.9],
      0.6
    );
    const zephyrRig = createExpressiveIKRig(
      'actor_zephyr',
      'ZEPHYR',
      '#334155',
      '#10b981',
      [1.15, 0, -0.15],
      -0.75
    );
    scene.add(ariaRig.root, zephyrRig.root);

    // Aria's Entrance Walk Spline (Brings her right within arm's reach of the Pedestal & Core!)
    const ariaCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
      [
        new THREE.Vector3(-2.1, 0, -0.9),
        new THREE.Vector3(-1.35, 0, 0.05),
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.72, 0, -0.08)
      ],
      false,
      'catmullrom',
      0.5
    );
    ariaCurve.arcLengthDivisions = 200;
    ariaCurve.updateArcLengths();
    const ariaCurveLen = ariaCurve.getLength();

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 3D IK GIZMOS: SHOULDER-ELBOW-WRIST TRIANGLE, POLE VECTOR & CONTACT RIPPLE
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const ikGizmoGroup = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(ikGizmoGroup);

    // Cyan Limb Line: Shoulder -> Elbow -> Wrist, plus Dashed Chord Shoulder -> Target
    const ikLimbLine = new THREE.Line(
      new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
        new THREE.Vector3(),
        new THREE.Vector3(),
        new THREE.Vector3(),
        new THREE.Vector3()
      ]),
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: '#22d3ee', linewidth: 2 })
    );
    ikGizmoGroup.add(ikLimbLine);

    // Amber Pole Vector Line: Shoulder -> Pole Target -> Elbow
    const ikPoleLine = new THREE.Line(
      new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
        new THREE.Vector3(),
        new THREE.Vector3(),
        new THREE.Vector3()
      ]),
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
        color: '#f59e0b',
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.8
      })
    );
    ikGizmoGroup.add(ikPoleLine);

    const poleBeacon = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.055, 0),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#f59e0b', wireframe: true })
    );
    ikGizmoGroup.add(poleBeacon);

    // Draggable 3D Hand-IK Target Sphere + Pulsing Contact Ripple Ring
    const ikTargetOrb = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.085, 20, 20),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: '#22d3ee',
        wireframe: true
      })
    );
    ikGizmoGroup.add(ikTargetOrb);

    const contactRippleRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.RingGeometry(0.09, 0.145, 32),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: '#38bdf8',
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.9
      })
    );
    ikGizmoGroup.add(contactRippleRing);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // INTERACTIVE 3D TARGET DRAGGING & PROP CLICK-TO-TOUCH RAYCASTER
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const dragPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), 0.25);
    const dragHitPoint = new THREE.Vector3();
    let isDraggingTargetOrb = false;

    const getNDC = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      return new THREE.Vector2(
        ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1,
        -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1
      );
    };

    const onMouseDown = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const ndc = getNDC(e);
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

      // Check if user clicked the IK Target Orb or any of the 3 Interactive Props!
      const clickableList = [
        ikTargetOrb,
        holoCoreMesh,
        pedestalPadMesh,
        holoTerminalMesh
      ];
      const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects(clickableList, false);

      if (hits.length > 0) {
        const hitObj = hits[0].object;
        setInteractiveIKOverride(true);
        interactiveIKRef.current = true;
        isDraggingTargetOrb = true;

        const hitPt = hits[0].point;
        manualTargetVecRef.current.copy(hitPt);
        setManualTargetXYZ([
          Number(hitPt.x.toFixed(2)),
          Number(hitPt.y.toFixed(2)),
          Number(hitPt.z.toFixed(2))
        ]);

        // Set drag plane depth to the clicked object's Z coordinate
        dragPlane.constant = -hitObj.position.z;
        renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
      }
    };

    const onMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const ndc = getNDC(e);
      raycaster.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);

      if (isDraggingTargetOrb) {
        if (raycaster.ray.intersectPlane(dragPlane, dragHitPoint)) {
          const cx = Number(
            THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dragHitPoint.x, -1.6, 0.8).toFixed(2)
          );
          const cy = Number(
            THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dragHitPoint.y, 0.65, 2.05).toFixed(2)
          );
          const cz = Number(
            THREE.MathUtils.clamp(dragHitPoint.z, -0.85, 0.65).toFixed(2)
          );
          manualTargetVecRef.current.set(cx, cy, cz);
          setManualTargetXYZ([cx, cy, cz]);
        }
        return;
      }

      const hoverHits = raycaster.intersectObjects(
        [ikTargetOrb, holoCoreMesh, pedestalPadMesh, holoTerminalMesh],
        false
      );
      renderer.domElement.style.cursor =
        hoverHits.length > 0 ? 'grab' : 'default';
    };

    const onMouseUp = () => {
      isDraggingTargetOrb = false;
      renderer.domElement.style.cursor = 'default';
    };

    const dom = renderer.domElement;
    dom.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // 60 FPS RENDER LOOP (SPLINE -> FK MIXER -> HEAD IK -> 2-BONE ARM IK -> EMOTION)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let rAF: number;
    let frameCount = 0;

    const renderLoop = (nowMs: number) => {
      const t = timeRef.current;
      const wallSec = nowMs / 1000;
      frameCount++;

      const {
        dialogue,
        ariaArmIKKeyframes,
        zephyrArmIKKeyframes,
        ariaEmotionKeyframes,
        zephyrEmotionKeyframes
      } = compiledScene;

      // 1. Animate Floating Quantum Core & Terminal
      holoCoreMesh.position.y = 1.48 + Math.sin(wallSec * 2.4) * 0.035;
      holoCoreMesh.rotation.set(wallSec * 1.4, wallSec * 2.1, 0);

      // 2. Evaluate ARIA's Entrance Walk Spline (0 -> line_1.end) & Base FK Mixer
      const walkEnd = dialogue[0].end;
      const inWalk = t <= walkEnd && !interactiveIKRef.current;
      const u = interactiveIKRef.current
        ? 1.0
        : smoothstep(Math.min(1, t / Math.max(0.1, walkEnd)));

      const ariaPos = ariaCurve.getPointAt(u);
      const ariaTan = ariaCurve.getTangentAt(u).normalize();
      ariaRig.root.position.copy(ariaPos);
      ariaRig.currentSplineTangent.copy(ariaTan);
      ariaRig.root.rotation.set(0, Math.atan2(ariaTan.x, ariaTan.z), 0);

      const walkAct = ariaRig.actions.get('Walk')!;
      const idleAct = ariaRig.actions.get('Idle')!;
      walkAct.setEffectiveWeight(inWalk ? 1 : 0);
      walkAct.time = (((u * ariaCurveLen) / 1.2) % 1.0) * walkAct.getClip().duration;
      idleAct.setEffectiveWeight(inWalk ? 0 : 1);
      idleAct.time = wallSec % idleAct.getClip().duration;

      ariaRig.mixer.update(0);
      zephyrRig.mixer.update(0);

      // 3. Resolve Active 2-Bone Arm IK Target & Blend Weight for ARIA
      let resolvedTargetLabel = 'None (FK Idle)';
      let targetWorld = new THREE.Vector3(-0.2, 1.48, -0.25);
      let ikWeight = 0;
      let activeHand: 'right' | 'left' = 'right';
      let poleLocal = new THREE.Vector3(poleSpreadRef.current, -0.4, 0.15);

      if (interactiveIKRef.current) {
        resolvedTargetLabel = 'Interactive 3D Target Gizmo';
        targetWorld.copy(manualTargetVecRef.current);
        ikWeight = 1.0;
        activeHand = activeHandRef.current;
        poleLocal.set(
          activeHand === 'right' ? poleSpreadRef.current : -poleSpreadRef.current,
          -0.4,
          0.18
        );
      } else {
        // Evaluate Declarative Arm IK Track at timestamp t
        let activeIdx = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < ariaArmIKKeyframes.length; i++) {
          if (t >= (ariaArmIKKeyframes[i].resolvedTime ?? 0)) {
            activeIdx = i;
          }
        }
        const curKf = ariaArmIKKeyframes[activeIdx];
        const prevKf = activeIdx > 0 ? ariaArmIKKeyframes[activeIdx - 1] : null;
        const elapsed = t - (curKf.resolvedTime ?? 0);
        const alpha =
          curKf.crossFade > 0
            ? smoothstep(Math.min(1, elapsed / curKf.crossFade))
            : 1;

        const resolveKfPoint = (kf: ArmIKKeyframe | null): THREE.Vector3 => {
          if (!kf || !kf.target) return new THREE.Vector3(-0.35, 1.15, 0.25);
          if (Array.isArray(kf.target)) {
            return new THREE.Vector3(...kf.target);
          }
          const propObj = propsMap.get(kf.target);
          if (propObj) {
            const p = new THREE.Vector3();
            propObj.getWorldPosition(p);
            if (kf.surfaceOffset) {
              p.add(new THREE.Vector3(...kf.surfaceOffset));
            }
            return p;
          }
          return new THREE.Vector3(-0.2, 1.48, -0.25);
        };

        const curPt = resolveKfPoint(curKf);
        const prevPt = resolveKfPoint(prevKf);
        targetWorld.lerpVectors(prevPt, curPt, alpha);
        ikWeight = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          prevKf ? prevKf.weight : 0,
          curKf.weight,
          alpha
        );
        resolvedTargetLabel = curKf.target ? String(curKf.target) : 'FK Rest';
        if (curKf.poleOffset) {
          poleLocal.set(
            poleSpreadRef.current,
            curKf.poleOffset[1],
            curKf.poleOffset[2]
          );
        }
      }

      // 4. Execute Analytical 2-Bone Arm IK Pass for ARIA
      const chosenChain =
        activeHand === 'right' ? ariaRig.rightArmChain : ariaRig.leftArmChain;
      const ikSolved = solveAnalyticalTwoBoneArmIK(
        ariaRig.root,
        ariaRig.spineBone,
        chosenChain,
        targetWorld,
        poleLocal,
        ikWeight,
        ariaRig.smoothedSpineLeanQuat,
        activeHand === 'right'
          ? ariaRig.smoothedUpperRQuat
          : ariaRig.smoothedUpperLQuat,
        activeHand === 'right'
          ? ariaRig.smoothedForearmRQuat
          : ariaRig.smoothedForearmLQuat
      );

      // Also solve ZEPHYR's Left-Arm IK when touching the Holo-Terminal in Line 3
      const zKf = zephyrArmIKKeyframes[1];
      const zElapsed = t - (zKf.resolvedTime ?? 99);
      const zWeight =
        zElapsed >= 0
          ? smoothstep(Math.min(1, zElapsed / zKf.crossFade))
          : 0;
      const termPos = holoTerminalMesh.position
        .clone()
        .add(new THREE.Vector3(-0.12, 0.02, 0.06));
      solveAnalyticalTwoBoneArmIK(
        zephyrRig.root,
        zephyrRig.spineBone,
        zephyrRig.leftArmChain,
        termPos,
        new THREE.Vector3(-0.38, -0.4, 0.2),
        zWeight,
        zephyrRig.smoothedSpineLeanQuat,
        zephyrRig.smoothedUpperLQuat,
        zephyrRig.smoothedForearmLQuat
      );

      // Highlight Prop Emissive Glow when Hand Contacts It!
      const coreMat = holoCoreMesh.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial;
      const padMat = pedestalPadMesh.material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial;
      const isTouchingCore =
        ikSolved.wristWorld.distanceTo(holoCoreMesh.position) < 0.36;
      const isTouchingPad =
        ikSolved.wristWorld.distanceTo(pedestalPadMesh.position) < 0.28;

      coreMat.color.set(isTouchingCore ? '#f43f5e' : '#38bdf8');
      coreMat.emissive.set(isTouchingCore ? '#e11d48' : '#0284c7');
      padMat.color.set(isTouchingPad ? '#facc15' : '#10b981');
      padMat.emissive.set(isTouchingPad ? '#eab308' : '#059669');

      // 5. Update 3D IK Triangle, Pole Vector & Contact Ripple Gizmos
      ikGizmoGroup.visible =
        showGizmosRef.current && (ikWeight > 0.05 || interactiveIKRef.current);

      if (ikGizmoGroup.visible) {
        const limbAttr = ikLimbLine.geometry.attributes
          .position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
        limbAttr.setXYZ(
          0,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.x,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.y,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.z
        );
        limbAttr.setXYZ(
          1,
          ikSolved.elbowWorld.x,
          ikSolved.elbowWorld.y,
          ikSolved.elbowWorld.z
        );
        limbAttr.setXYZ(
          2,
          ikSolved.wristWorld.x,
          ikSolved.wristWorld.y,
          ikSolved.wristWorld.z
        );
        limbAttr.setXYZ(
          3,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.x,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.y,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.z
        );
        limbAttr.needsUpdate = true;

        const poleAttr = ikPoleLine.geometry.attributes
          .position as THREE.BufferAttribute;
        poleAttr.setXYZ(
          0,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.x,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.y,
          ikSolved.shoulderWorld.z
        );
        poleAttr.setXYZ(
          1,
          ikSolved.poleWorld.x,
          ikSolved.poleWorld.y,
          ikSolved.poleWorld.z
        );
        poleAttr.setXYZ(
          2,
          ikSolved.elbowWorld.x,
          ikSolved.elbowWorld.y,
          ikSolved.elbowWorld.z
        );
        poleAttr.needsUpdate = true;

        poleBeacon.position.copy(ikSolved.poleWorld);
        ikTargetOrb.position.copy(targetWorld);

        contactRippleRing.visible = ikSolved.isContacting;
        contactRippleRing.position.copy(targetWorld);
        contactRippleRing.lookAt(camera.position);
        const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(wallSec * 8) * 0.25;
        contactRippleRing.scale.set(pulse, pulse, 1);
      }

      // 6. Head Look-At IK (Aria looks at her hand target when reaching, or at Zephyr)
      const ariaHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      const zephyrHeadPos = new THREE.Vector3();
      ariaRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(ariaHeadPos);
      zephyrRig.headBone.getWorldPosition(zephyrHeadPos);

      const ariaLookTarget =
        ikWeight > 0.4 ? targetWorld : zephyrHeadPos;
      const applyHeadLook = (
        rig: ExpressiveCharacterRig,
        myHead: THREE.Vector3,
        lookPt: THREE.Vector3
      ) => {
        const rootQuat = new THREE.Quaternion();
        rig.root.getWorldQuaternion(rootQuat);
        const localDir = lookPt
          .clone()
          .sub(myHead)
          .applyQuaternion(rootQuat.invert());
        const yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          Math.atan2(localDir.x, localDir.z),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-58),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(58)
        );
        const pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(
          -Math.atan2(
            localDir.y,
            Math.sqrt(localDir.x * localDir.x + localDir.z * localDir.z)
          ) * 0.65,
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(-28),
          THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(28)
        );
        rig.smoothedHeadOffset.slerp(
          new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(
            new THREE.Euler(pitch, yaw, 0, 'YXZ')
          ),
          0.18
        );
        rig.headBone.quaternion.multiply(rig.smoothedHeadOffset);
      };
      applyHeadLook(ariaRig, ariaHeadPos, ariaLookTarget);
      applyHeadLook(zephyrRig, zephyrHeadPos, ariaHeadPos);

      // 7. Evaluate Facial Emotion Track + Orthogonal TTS Visemes
      let resolvedEmotionName: EmotionPresetName = 'concerned';
      for (const ekf of ariaEmotionKeyframes) {
        if (t >= (ekf.resolvedTime ?? 0)) {
          resolvedEmotionName = ekf.emotion;
        }
      }

      if (emotionOverrideRef.current !== 'timeline_auto') {
        resolvedEmotionName = emotionOverrideRef.current;
      }

      const targetAriaEmotionWeights = useCustomSlidersRef.current
        ? customEmotionRef.current
        : EMOTION_PRESETS[resolvedEmotionName];

      let zephyrEmotionName: EmotionPresetName = 'concerned';
      for (const zkf of zephyrEmotionKeyframes) {
        if (t >= (zkf.resolvedTime ?? 0)) {
          zephyrEmotionName = zkf.emotion;
        }
      }

      const activeLine =
        dialogue.find((d) => t >= d.start && t <= d.end) || null;

      [
        { rig: ariaRig, emotionW: targetAriaEmotionWeights },
        { rig: zephyrRig, emotionW: EMOTION_PRESETS[zephyrEmotionName] }
      ].forEach(({ rig, emotionW }) => {
        const vWeights: Record<string, number> = {};
        ALL_VISEMES.forEach((v) => (vWeights[v] = 0));
        if (activeLine && activeLine.speakerId === rig.id) {
          activeLine.visemes.forEach((cue) => {
            const center = cue.time + cue.duration * 0.5;
            const halfW = Math.max(0.035, cue.duration * 0.8);
            const dist = Math.abs(t - center);
            if (dist < halfW) {
              vWeights[cue.viseme] = Math.max(
                vWeights[cue.viseme] || 0,
                Math.cos((dist / halfW) * (Math.PI / 2)) * cue.weight
              );
            }
          });
        }
        applyFacialEmotionAndVisemes(rig, emotionW, vWeights, wallSec);
      });

      if (frameCount % 3 === 0) {
        const spineEuler = new THREE.Euler().setFromQuaternion(
          ariaRig.smoothedSpineLeanQuat,
          'YXZ'
        );
        setTelemetry({
          activeHand,
          targetLabel: resolvedTargetLabel,
          targetWorldXYZ: [
            Number(targetWorld.x.toFixed(2)),
            Number(targetWorld.y.toFixed(2)),
            Number(targetWorld.z.toFixed(2))
          ],
          wristWorldXYZ: [
            Number(ikSolved.wristWorld.x.toFixed(2)),
            Number(ikSolved.wristWorld.y.toFixed(2)),
            Number(ikSolved.wristWorld.z.toFixed(2))
          ],
          elbowWorldXYZ: [
            Number(ikSolved.elbowWorld.x.toFixed(2)),
            Number(ikSolved.elbowWorld.y.toFixed(2)),
            Number(ikSolved.elbowWorld.z.toFixed(2))
          ],
          ikBlendWeight: Number(ikWeight.toFixed(2)),
          shoulderElevationDeg: ikSolved.shoulderAngleDeg,
          elbowFlexionDeg: ikSolved.elbowFlexionDeg,
          reachExtensionPct: ikSolved.reachPct,
          spineLeanDeg: Math.round(THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(spineEuler.x)),
          isContactingTarget: ikSolved.isContacting,
          activeEmotion: resolvedEmotionName
        });
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);
    };

    rAF = requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      camera.aspect = container.clientWidth / container.clientHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(container.clientWidth, container.clientHeight);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rAF);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      dom.removeEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
      renderer.dispose();
    };
  }, [compiledScene]);

  return (

Product Requirements Document (PRD): ChronosStage 3D
Declarative 3D Video Engine, Symbolic TTS Compiler & Small-LLM Authoring Studio

1. Executive Summary & Product Vision
1.1 Problem Statement
Current generative video paradigms (pixel-diffusion models) suffer from four structural bottlenecks that prevent them from scaling to long-form, interactive, or educational media:

Compute & Parameter Bloat: Hallucinating 24 to 60 frames of pixels per second requires massive multi-billion or trillion-parameter diffusion transformers and expensive GPU clusters.

Temporal & Spatial Drift: Over multi-minute or multi-hour timelines, characters, props, and room layouts mutate or vanish whenever the camera cuts away.

Opaque, Non-Interactive Pixels: Diffusion outputs flat raster pixels—viewers cannot pause to inspect 3D objects, branch the story without jump cuts, or dynamically edit a single word or gesture without re-rendering the entire video.

Audio-Visual Desynchronization: Authoring frame-accurate animations synced to Text-to-Speech (TTS) breaks whenever the voice model, speaking rate (WPM), or language changes.

1.2 Solution Overview
ChronosStage 3D replaces pixel diffusion with a deterministic 3D scene graph driven by a symbolic timeline manifest. Compact 7B–8B parameter LLMs (or human authors) emit lightweight JSON scripts containing symbolic acoustic anchors (@line_2.word("surge")), Catmull-Rom spline waypoints, post-mixer inverse kinematics (IK), and declarative camera rules. A 4-pass compiler resolves these symbolic anchors against TTS word boundaries in under 5 milliseconds, driving a 60 FPS React + Three.js engine that can run coherently for hours in the browser or export directly to standalone MP4/WebM video files.

2. Target Personas & Core Use Cases
Persona	Primary Use Case	Key Value Proposition
EdTech & Technical Course Creators	Multi-hour interactive 3D explainers, software/hardware walkthroughs, and virtual labs.	Viewers can pause at any second, free-roam the 3D stage, orbit-zoom into components, and resume with a slow-motion camera swerve.
Interactive Story & Game Designers	Branching narrative episodes with persistent inventory, 3D bone-socket props, and world flags.	Dynamic spline stitching (inheritStartPose) eliminates jump cuts across story branches regardless of where characters stood previously.
Automated AI Media Pipelines	Local 8B LLM batch generation of localized training videos in 20+ languages.	Symbolic word anchors (@line_1.word("reactor")) automatically stretch or compress spline walks, gestures, and camera cuts to match each language's TTS cadence.
Indie Directors & Pre-Vis Teams	Rapid 3D storyboarding and camera blocking with instant MP4/WebM export.	Drag 3D spline waypoints on the floor grid while the Declarative Camera Director enforces the 180-degree rule automatically.
3. Functional Requirements (FR)
FR-01: Symbolic TTS-to-Timeline Compiler (@line.word())
FR-01.1 (Symbolic DSL): Support symbolic time expressions across all timeline fields: @<id>.start, @<id>.end, @<id>.duration, @<id>.word("<token>"), @<id>.word(<index>), @<id>.progress(<0..1>), and arithmetic offsets (+ 0.35, - 0.15).

FR-01.2 (Acoustic Word Alignment): Ingest exact word/phoneme boundary arrays from neural TTS APIs (ElevenLabs, Azure Speech, Kokoro/WhisperX) or fall back to a deterministic syllable/punctuation prosody estimator for instant offline previewing.

FR-01.3 (4-Pass Elastic Compilation): Resolve (1) sequential dialogue chains, (2) spline locomotion windows, (3) skeletal/IK/emotion keyframes, and (4) camera director cuts into a flat, chronologically sorted CompiledSceneManifest.

Frame Pacing & Scrub Determinism	≥60 FPS on integrated desktop GPUs; 0.0mm pose variance when scrubbing to timestamp t from any direction.	Automated unit test comparing bone world matrices at t=12.40s after forward playback vs. backward seek.
Symbolic Compilation Latency	Less than 5ms for a 15-minute chapter manifest (Pass 1–4).	Benchmark timer in compileSymbolicManifest().
Multi-Hour VRAM Footprint	Flat memory growth (less than 15MB delta over 3 hours of chapter transitions).	Chrome DevTools WebGL memory profiler across 20 sequential chapter transitions.
8B LLM Compilation Success Rate	Greater than 99.5% crash-free compilation when combining Constrained JSON Decoding + sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene.	500-prompt automated fuzzing suite with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |# Product Requirements Document (PRD): Chronos3D — Declarative 3D Video Engine & Symbolic AI Studio

Document Version: 1.0.0

Architecture Paradigm: Deterministic 3D Scene Graph + Symbolic TTS Timeline Compiler + Compact 8B LLM Director

Target Runtime: WebGL2 / WebGPU (React + Three.js) with Native MP4/WebM Offline & Real-Time Export

1. Executive Summary & Product Vision
Chronos3D replaces compute-heavy, hallucination-prone pixel diffusion video generation with a deterministic 3D scene graph driven by a symbolic, word-locked timeline manifest. Instead of requiring a multi-trillion-parameter video diffusion model to synthesize 60 frames of pixels per second—which suffers from character identity drift after a few seconds and cannot support real-time user interaction—Chronos3D allows a compact 7B–8B parameter LLM (or human author) to emit sparse, declarative JSON manifests (~5 KB per minute of video).

By binding 3D Catmull-Rom spline locomotion, skeletal animation crossfades, hierarchical gaze/arm Inverse Kinematics (IK), facial emotion blendshapes, and declarative cinematography rules directly to symbolic TTS word anchors (@line_2.word("surge")), Chronos3D delivers multi-hour world consistency, mid-video branching choices, 6-DOF pause-and-inspect exploration, and one-click MP4/WebM video export.

2. Problem Statement & Strategic Value Proposition
Dimension	Pixel Diffusion Video Models	Traditional Game Engines (Unity/Unreal)	Chronos3D Declarative 3D Video Engine
Multi-Hour Consistency	Degrades after 10–30 seconds; characters, props, and room layouts morph unpredictably.	High consistency, but stateful physics/delta clocks break when scrubbing backward/forward like a video.	100% Invariant: Persistent Asset Registry guarantees an object at 00:01:00 is identical at 04:30:00, with O(1) deterministic scrubbing at any timestamp t.
Compute & LLM Footprint	Requires massive GPU clusters per second of generated video.	Requires manual keyframe authoring in complex desktop editors.	Runs on 8B Local LLMs + Browser WebGL: Generates scenes in milliseconds via constrained JSON decoding and renders at 60–120 FPS on consumer devices.
Audio / Visual Sync	Post-hoc lip-sync dubbing often drifts from body language and camera cuts.	Requires manual timeline re-keying whenever voiceover audio or language changes.	Acoustically Elastic: Symbolic anchors (@line_1.word("core")) automatically stretch or compress spline walks, gestures, and camera cuts to match any TTS voice or language.
Interactivity	Passive flat pixels; zero object inspection or state memory.	Full interactivity, but lacks video transport ergonomics and instant MP4 export.	Hybrid Video + 3D Sandbox: Supports branching decision cards, persistent inventory, 6-DOF pause inspection with slow-mo Bezier snap-back, and burned-in MP4 export.
3. Target Personas & Core Use Cases
AI-Native EdTech & Interactive Course Creators: Build multi-hour interactive technical simulations (e.g., engineering labs, medical procedures, software architecture walk-throughs) where learners can pause at any second, orbit-zoom into 3D components, and make branching diagnostic decisions.

Automated Episodic Media & Pre-Visualization Studios: Use local 8B models to generate multi-episode animated series with consistent characters, automated 180-degree-safe camera direction, and instant human fine-tuning via 3D floor waypoint dragging.

Documentation-to-Video Pipelines: Convert technical Markdown blogs or SOPs into narrated, word-synchronized 3D explainer videos with downloadable MP4/WebM outputs for distribution on YouTube, LMS platforms, or social media.

4.2 Symbolic Compiler & 8B LLM Generation Pipeline (P0)
FR-07: 4-Pass Symbolic Anchor Compiler (compileSymbolicManifest): Resolve symbolic time expressions (@line_1.start, @line_1.end + 0.35, @line_2.word("surge") - 0.1, @line_2.progress(0.5), @seg_walk.end) into strict numeric timestamps in less than 2ms.

FR-09: Self-Healing Spatial & Anchor Sanitizer (sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene): Automatically detect and repair raw 8B model errors prior to compilation, including:

Radial push-out of spline waypoints that clip inside prop collision zones.

Stem/prefix fuzzy matching when a @line.word("token") anchor uses a morphological variant of a spoken word.

Auto-chaining of unchained start: "0" dialogue lines.

Normalization of side: "right" across consecutive Over-The-Shoulder camera cuts to enforce the 180-degree rule.

4.3 Declarative Cinematography, Interactivity & Studio (P1)
FR-10: Declarative Camera Director (evaluateCameraDirectorAtTime): Support twoShot (with adaptive actor-separation zoom), overTheShoulder (180° axis-locked), splineDolly (lead, follow, parallel), closeUp (85mm portrait), and establishingOrbit, with both instant hard cuts and scrub-safe multi-second crane blends.

5. Non-Functional Requirements & Performance SLAs
Metric	Target SLA	Architectural Enforcement
Viewport Frame Rate	60 FPS minimum (16.6ms frame budget) on integrated GPUs; 120 FPS on discrete GPUs	Zero React state allocations inside requestAnimationFrame; only UI telemetry updates are throttled to 15–20 Hz.
Timeline Scrub Latency	Less than 2.0ms for arbitrary seek across a 3-hour manifest	Pure functional evaluation S(t) of tracks, splines, and mixer.update(0) + chapter boundary checkpoint snapshots.
Symbolic Compilation Time	Less than 1.5ms per chapter manifest	Single-pass symbol table hash map + pre-computed CatmullRomCurve3 arc-length lookup tables (arcLengthDivisions = 250).
VRAM Memory Ceiling	Less than 350 MB across multi-hour playback	Persistent assetMapRef singleton cache + shared BufferGeometry/Material instancing across chapters.
8B LLM Valid Scene Rate	Greater than 99.5% crash-free compilation rate	Constrained JSON Schema logit masking + sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene post-processor.

Transitioning **Chronos3D** from single-file React prototypes and the Product Requirements Document (PRD) into a production monorepo can be broken down into five immediate engineering tracks.

## 1. Immediate Implementation Tracks (Phase 1–3 Execution)

| Track | Target Package / Service | Concrete Deliverable | Primary Technical Goal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **1. Monorepo Scaffolding & AST Extraction** | `@chronos3d/schema` & `@chronos3d/compiler`<br> | Extract the TypeScript interfaces, constrained decoding JSON schema (`LLM_SCENE_JSON_SCHEMA`), 4-pass symbolic compiler (`compileSymbolicManifest`), and self-healing sanitizer (`sanitizeAndRepairLLMScene`) into standalone zero-dependency packages.

 | Hit the `< 1.5ms` compilation SLA and verify `> 99.5%` compilation pass rates with automated unit tests (`compiler.test.ts`, `sanitizer.test.ts`).

 |
| **2. Real Neural TTS & Forced Alignment Service** | `services/tts-aligner-service`<br> | Build the Python FastAPI backend (`POST /api/v1/synthesize-aligned`) integrating local **Kokoro-82M + WhisperX** forced alignment alongside **ElevenLabs** and **Azure Speech** viseme/word-boundary adapters.

 | Replace the fallback syllable prosody estimator with sub-20ms acoustic word and phoneme timestamps.

 |
| **3. Production GLTF/GLB Character Loader** | `@chronos3d/engine-core` (`GLTFCharacterLoader.ts`)

 | Upgrade the 15-bone procedural humanoid rig to load rigged `.glb`/`.gltf` characters (ReadyPlayerMe / Mixamo compatible) with automatic bone-socket mapping (`ForearmR`, `Spine`, `Head`, `EyeL/R`) and 14 Oculus/ARKit viseme blendshape binding.

 | Enable production-ready character meshes while keeping `< 350 MB` VRAM usage across multi-hour episodes via `AssetRegistry` instancing.

 |
| **4. 8B Synthetic Dataset & QLoRA Pipeline** | `services/llm-director-training`<br> | Implement `generate_synthetic_scenes.py` to procedurally generate 1,000 to 5,000 collision-free symbolic JSONL examples and validate them against `@chronos3d/compiler` before running `train_lora_unsloth.py` on **Qwen-2.5-7B** or **Llama-3.1-8B**.

 | Eliminate spatial collisions and malformed symbolic anchors at the model weights level.

 |

---

## 2. High-Impact Feature Prototypes (Phase 4–5 Roadmap)

If you prefer to continue building interactive prototypes before splitting the code into a monorepo, the PRD outlines four high-value features that have not yet been written in code:

* **Faster-Than-Real-Time 4K Offline Video Exporter (`WebCodecsOfflineMuxer.ts`):** Upgrade the real-time `MediaRecorder` pipeline to use the browser's native `VideoEncoder` (WebCodecs API) and `OfflineAudioContext`. Stepping the deterministic renderer frame-by-frame (`new VideoFrame(canvas, { timestamp })`) allows rendering 60 FPS MP4 files faster than real-time playback without dropped frames.


* **"Raise Hand" Live Viewer Voice Interruption:** Extend the **Bullet-Time Pause Inspector** so viewers can speak or type a question directly to ARIA or ZEPHYR while paused. A local 8B model + streaming TTS generates an impromptu response (`@live_reply_1`) while the character turns their gaze IK toward `"camera"` and gestures, then triggers the **Slow-Mo Quadratic Bezier Swerve** to seamlessly rejoin the main timeline.


* **Dual-Hand Collaborative IK & Actor-to-Actor Prop Handover:** Extend `TwoBoneArmIKSolver` and `BoneSocketManager` so a character can carry large props with both hands locked to a bounding box, or smoothly transfer a 3D prop from `actor_aria.ForearmR` to `actor_zephyr.ForearmL` on an exact spoken word cue.


* **Deterministic Spring-Bone Secondary Motion & Gaussian Splat Stages:** Add a closed-form damped harmonic oscillator pass ($x(t) = A e^{-\zeta \omega_0 t} \cos(\omega_d t + \phi)$) for scrub-safe hair/cloth physics, or integrate a WebGPU **3D Gaussian Splatting (`.splat` / `.ply`)** background loader so characters walk inside photorealistic captured environments.



---

## 3. Recommended Immediate Action Plan

1. **Lock the Core Compiler & Sanitizer Package:** Generate the complete, standalone source files for `@chronos3d/schema` and `@chronos3d/compiler` (including the regex expression parser, 4-pass hydrator, obstacle push-out sanitizer, and Vitest test suite) so your data contract is frozen.


2. **Stand Up the Local TTS + WhisperX Alignment Server:** Build the `services/tts-aligner-service` FastAPI microservice so the studio can ingest real synthesized audio buffers and exact word boundaries.


3. **Prototype the "Raise Hand" Live Interruption orGLTF Loader:** Build the next interactive React + Three.js artifact demonstrating either real `.glb` character loading or live mid-pause conversational interruption with characters.
